videoTitle: Guia de Matchup: Renekton vs Aatrox (Godrekton)
summaryEn: The essence of this match up is essentially dodging Aatrox's Q sweet spots, avoiding his passive and playing for short trades to whittle his health down. Eventually when fighting Aatrox, try to force fights when he is 50% HP, as this threshold will allow you to kill him or force him into a tower diving situation. This match up heavily relies on the ability to sidestep his abilities, while also utilising  healing reduction through ignite or executioners to help weaken his laning and mid game power. Building burst items through Eclipse, Cleaver or BoTRK also help stat check and provide the damage needed to help keep him behind. Within skirmishes and teamfights, try to avoid  Aatrox getting kills through his R, as he can use it to reset his CD and keep up his R timer. When fighting Aatrox solo, try to also use your R to help you have the necessary damage and stats to overpower him. Later on you can potentially build DD to help weaken his overall dueling power..
summaryPt: A essência desse confronto é essencialmente desviar dos pontos ideais do Q de Aatrox, evitando sua passiva e jogando trocas curtas para reduzir sua saúde. Eventualmente, ao lutar contra Aatrox, tente forçar luta quando ele estiver com 50% de HP, já que esse limite permitirá que você o mate ou o force a uma situação de tower diving. Este confronto depende fortemente da capacidade de contornar suas habilidades, ao mesmo tempo que utiliza redução de cura por meio de Ignite ou executores para ajudar a enfraquecer seu poder de rota e mid game. Construir itens burst através de Eclipse, Cleaver ou BoTRK também ajuda stat check e fornece o dano necessário para ajudar a mantê-lo para trás. Dentro de skirmishes e teamfights, tente evitar que Aatrox seja morto por meio de seu R, pois ele pode usá-lo para zerar seu CD e manter seu cronômetro R. Ao lutar sozinho com Aatrox, tente também usar seu R para ajudá-lo a obter o dano e as stats necessárias para dominá-lo. Mais tarde, você poderá construir DD para ajudar a enfraquecer seu poder geral de duelo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Aatrox with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Aatrox. Try to avoid tanking Aatrox’s Q damage in the process by using short in and out clicks to bait them out.

(2) Dodge Aatrox’s Q's - The biggest aspect towards overpowering and beating Aatrox is trying to avoid his Q sweet spots. Try to abuse short clicks against Aatrox, by clicking in and out very fast. We can essentially avoid Aatrox’s Q1 and Q2 from doing this alone, allowing us to hold our E for his Q3. Being able to dodge Aatrox Q's is necessary in being able to win the match up. Be aware his CD will drastically lower through the game, so ensure that you remain confident with your movement to help avoid Aatrox’s overall threat level. 

(3) Avoid Aatrox’s W Pull - Aatrox W is by far one of his strongest abilities he has, mainly for the reason that his W slow sets up his Q hits. If done right, Aatrox’s W can also instantly cancel your E amid its animation, preventing you from escaping and pulling you back. Make sure to avoid using your E within the last second, using it earlier allows you to escape his potential Q hits as well as his ability to keep you in his range.

(4) Avoid Aatrox’s Passive Auto - Aatrox Passive is another underrated strength in this match up, as it allows him to deal damage based on his target’s maximum HP, while healing him up to 100% of the post mitigation damage dealt. When laning vs Aatrox, make sure to wait for him to use his passive, preventing him the ability to help stat check Renekton within a 1v1. Do note that each time Aatrox uses an auto attack or an ability, he lowers the overall CD of his passive’s 22 to 10 second CD by 2 seconds. If Aatrox hits his Q sweet spots, he’s able to drop the passive CD by 4 seconds for each individual sweet spot he hits. 

(5) Rush Antiheal - It's no secret how crazy Aatrox’s overall healing can be within a fight, so make sure you don’t avoid giving him any chances without grievous wounds. Simply take Ignite or rush an early Executioner’s to lower his overall sustain, as this is a giant powercut to Aatrox's survivability, which affects his passive, Q, Sundered Sky and R interactions. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Having Renekton R within this match up essentially allows you to go toe to toe with Aatrox. Aatrox R is a giant powerspike in itself, however the consistent damage from Renekton R on top of the increased fury generation allows you to consistently overpower Aatrox if you're even or ahead. Try to always play around your R for all ins or if Aatrox is threatening an overextended fight.  

(9) Respect Aatrox's R Strength - Aatrox's R increases his attack damage from 20/30/40% AD, and his overall healing by 50/75/100%. Aatrox’s R can be absolutely monstrous in fights, allowing his R to continue an additional 5 seconds for killing enemy champions. When fighting Aatrox, either bait out his R if you want to force it out before teamfights or tower dives, or apply healing reduction against his R if you're committed to the all in.

(10) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or Death's Dance - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Aatrox's overall damage and to utilise the movement speed vs Aatrox Q / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go Death's Dance to hard counter Aatrox's Damage and overall healing. 

(11) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid game, Aatrox's spikes are considerably strong in skirmishes and teamfights. Try to lock Aatrox down and protect your carries from him landing his Q's. Aatrox is very easy to shut down in isolation, play off your W and your allies CC to easily shut him down. Before any major objectives, you can also try to catch him out in the side lane. If you’re strong enough to 1v1, make sure to kill him before any major objectives. Or if you have your teammates aside of you, simply focus him down to free up any map pressure he is creating, then look to force fights on his death timer.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 Q Start - tente push para vantagem de level 2 enquanto poking Aatrox com seu Q, na habilidade level 2 E/W use vantagem para dividir Aatrox. Tente evitar tankar o dano do Q de Aatrox no processo usando cliques curtos de entrada e saída para atraí-los.

(2) Desviar dos Q's de Aatrox - O maior aspecto para dominar e derrotar Aatrox é tentar evitar seus pontos ideais de Q. tente abusar de cliques curtos contra Aatrox, clicando dentro e fora muito rápido. Podemos essencialmente evitar que Q1 e Q2 de Aatrox façam isso sozinhos, permitindo-nos manter nosso E para seu Q3. Ser capaz de desviar dos Q's Aatrox é necessário para vencer o confronto. Esteja ciente de que seu CD diminuirá drasticamente ao longo do jogo, então certifique-se de permanecer confiante em seus movimentos para ajudar a evitar o nível geral de ameaça de Aatrox. 

(3) Evite o W Pull de Aatrox - Aatrox W é de longe uma de suas habilidades mais fortes que ele possui, principalmente pelo motivo de sua lentidão do W configurar seus acertos de Q. Se bem feito, o W de Aatrox também pode cancelar instantaneamente seu E em meio à animação, evitando que você escape e o puxe para trás. Certifique-se de evitar usar seu E no último segundo, usá-lo antes permite que você escape de seus possíveis acertos de Q, bem como de sua capacidade de mantê-lo ao alcance dele.

(4) Evite o Auto Passivo de Aatrox - Aatrox Passivo é outra força subestimada neste confronto, pois permite que ele cause dano com base no HP máximo de seu alvo, enquanto o cura em até 100% do dano pós-mitigação causado. Ao jogar na rota contra Aatrox, certifique-se de esperar que ele use sua passiva, impedindo-o de ajudar stat check Renekton dentro de um 1v1. Observe que cada vez que Aatrox usa um auto attack ou uma habilidade, ele reduz o CD geral do CD de 22 a 10 segundos de seu passivo em 2 segundos. Se Aatrox atingir seus pontos ideais de Q, ele será capaz de reduzir o passivo CD em 4 segundos para cada ponto ideal individual que atingir. 

(5) Rush Antiheal - Não é nenhum segredo o quão louca a cura geral de Aatrox pode ser dentro de uma luta, então certifique-se de não evitar dar a ele nenhuma chance sem ferimentos graves. Simplesmente pegue Ignite ou apresse um Executor inicial para diminuir sua sustentação geral, pois isso é um grande corte de poder na capacidade de sobrevivência de Aatrox, o que afeta suas interações passivas, Q, Sundered Sky e R. 

(6) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(7) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador. 

(8) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Ter Renekton R neste confronto essencialmente permite que você fique cara a cara com Aatrox. Aatrox R é um powerspike gigante por si só, no entanto, o dano consistente de Renekton R além do aumento da geração de fúria permite que você domine Aatrox de forma consistente se estiver empatado ou à frente. tente sempre brincar com seu R para all ins ou se Aatrox estiver ameaçando uma luta prolongada.  

(9) Respeite a força R de Aatrox - o R de Aatrox aumenta seu dano de ataque de 20/30/40% AD e sua cura geral em 50/75/100%. O R de Aatrox pode ser absolutamente monstruoso em lutas, permitindo que seu R continue por mais 5 segundos para matar campeões inimigos. Ao lutar contra Aatrox, use a isca para seu R se quiser forçá-lo antes de teamfights ou mergulhos na torre, ou aplique redução de cura contra seu R se você estiver comprometido com o all in.

(10) Construa Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou Death's Dance - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Aatrox e para utilizar a velocidade de movimento vs Aatrox Q / Go Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilidade. / Vá Death's Dance para contrariar fortemente o dano e a cura geral de Aatrox. 

(11) Dicas de meio de jogo + teamfighting - Dentro do mid game, os picos de Aatrox são consideravelmente fortes em skirmishes e teamfights. tente travar Aatrox e proteger seus carregadores contra ele acertar seus Q's. Aatrox é muito fácil de desligar isoladamente, use seu W e seus aliados CC para desligá-lo facilmente. Antes de qualquer objetivo principal, você também pode tentar pegá-lo na side lane. Se você for forte o suficiente para 1v1, certifique-se de matá-lo antes de qualquer objetivo principal. Ou se você tiver seus companheiros de equipe ao seu lado, simplesmente concentre-o para liberar qualquer pressão no mapa que ele esteja criando e, em seguida, procure lutas forçadas em seu cronômetro de morte.

videoTitle: Guia de Matchup: Renekton vs Ahri (Godrekton)
summaryEn: The Ahri match up is very difficult due to her ability to easily contest wave pushes, having a mass use of utility to help teammates, and having the ability to easily deny Renekton’s trading patterns. As Renekton we must play around keeping our health up, while playing around our teammates to help get kills on Ahri, or roam the map to help obtain objectives and provide our utility on the map. Make sure to build more defensively and put your ego to the side to put your teammates first. If you try to fight Ahri, make sure to avoid your charm using your E, or look to burst her out and waste her R, providing you and your team more chances to have winning outcomes.
summaryPt: O confronto de Ahri é muito difícil devido à sua habilidade de contestar facilmente os pushes de wave, ter um uso massivo de utilidade para ajudar os companheiros de equipe e ter a habilidade de negar facilmente os padrões de trocas de Renekton. Como Renekton, devemos brincar para manter nossa saúde em dia, enquanto brincamos com nossos companheiros de equipe para ajudar a matar em Ahri, ou roam no mapa para ajudar a obter objetivos e fornecer nossa utilidade no mapa. Certifique-se de construir mais defensivamente e colocar seu ego de lado para colocar seus companheiros em primeiro lugar. Se você tentar lutar contra Ahri, evite seu charme usando seu E, ou procure burst para ela e desperdice seu R, proporcionando a você e sua equipe mais chances de obter resultados vencedores.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Ahri you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Ahri lose a lot more. 

(3) Play For Sustain Early - Ahri's laning phase is very oppressive early, try to outsustain Ahri through using Empowered Q and abusing D Shield + Second Wind. Make sure to play to keep your HP up, while having the objective to mana burn and cause Ahri to recall. Play for your teammates and item spikes to win and find relevance. 

(3) Avoid Ahri Charm - Ahri Charm is one of the most annoying abilities Renekton can deal with, as she can instantly cancel Renekton E if he engages directly into it. Try to always find ways to creatively bait it out, try to stand behind minions and look to dash or double dash behind her to avoid her charm, or E into her then quickly side step the incoming Ahri charm. Another way is to E in and quickly E out, as this will help you bait out a charm, allowing your teammates access to ganking her. Or with the same method, you can E behind her from E2 in that sequence, to dodge the incoming Ahri charm, allowing you to burn her R or allow you to heavy trade her.  . 

(4) Rush Merc Treads - This is very essential to rush in this match up, as this allows you to have an easier time tanking charms as well as Ahri's overall damage. Having the additional mobility from boots also helps you make faster plays  with E, on top of having the mobility to easily side step her abilities.  

(5) Play For Ganks - Ganks are pretty essential to obtain kills on Ahri. Ahri is a relatively boring statemate lane, so getting ganks from your teammates is going to be crucial in being able to force her out of lane to shove waves and get plates, or simply obtain kill gold in the ability to help you snowball and create a lead within the lane. 

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Typically it will allow her to proc her Conq or Electrocute super fast, while allowing her insane damage onto her target. tips.titlePt: Evite e puna Akali Q's
tips.contentEn: Avoiding Akali Q is crucial for the early stage of the lane. From level 1, you want to be constantly weaving in and out of her, to help you bait out her Q and punish her long energy usage. An easy way to know if Akali will Q is walking into low HP minions, then quickly using S or clicking back to bait the animation. Once she does miss, make sure to abuse your combos within this time.
tips.contentPt: Evitar Akali Q é crucial para o estágio inicial da pista. A partir de level 1, você quer estar constantemente entrando e saindo dela, para ajudá-lo a atrair seu Q e punir seu longo uso de energia. Uma maneira fácil de saber se Akali terá Q é caminhar até lacaios com baixo HP e, em seguida, usar S rapidamente ou clicar em voltar para atrair a animação. Quando ela errar, certifique-se de abusar de seus combos nesse período.

tips.titlePt: Evite Akali E
tips.contentEn: Akali E is a big game changer for Akali if she is able to land it. Typically it will allow her to proc her Conq or Electrocute super fast, while allowing her insane damage onto her target. Simply bait or avoid it by E'ing towards her, but just around your minions, or try to walk in then side step to the side. If Akali misses E, she simply can not win the fight vs Renekton.
tips.contentPt: Akali E é uma grande virada de jogo para Akali se ela conseguir acertar. Normalmente, isso permitirá que ela proceda seu Conq ou Electrocute super rápido, ao mesmo tempo que permite dano insano em seu alvo. Simplesmente isque ou evite-o indo em direção a ela, mas apenas ao redor de seus lacaios, ou tente entrar e dar um passo para o lado. Se Akali errar E, ela simplesmente não conseguirá vencer a luta contra Renekton.

tips.titleEn: Buffer W into Akali E or W Stealth
tips.titlePt: Buffer W em Akali E ou W Stealth
tips.contentEn: Another tip to dominating the lane is utilising W buffer into Akali W or E frame. When Akali goes invisible, make sure to hold W and as soon as she comes out, instantly click or use attack move to get the instant hit to help you shred out, or utilise a full combo. For Akali E, you can time it as she's in E1 or at the end of E2.
tips.contentPt: Outra dica para dominar a pista é utilizar o buffer W no quadro Akali W ou E. Quando Akali ficar invisível, certifique-se de segurar W e assim que ela sair, clique instantaneamente ou use o movimento de ataque para obter o golpe instantâneo para ajudá-lo a destruir, ou utilize um combo completo. Para Akali E, você pode cronometrar como ela está em E1 ou no final de E2.

tips.titlePt: Abuse de Renekton's Waveclear
tips.contentEn: A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game.
tips.contentPt: Uma grande vantagem que Renekton tem neste confronto é sua habilidade geral de eliminar facilmente o lacaio waves. Isso pode ajudá-lo a obter redefinições de tempo perfeitas ou permitir que ele proxy waves ajude a aumentar sua vantagem de ouro, ao mesmo tempo que refém o top laner inimigo sob sua própria torre. Ser capaz de limpar rapidamente também força o inimigo a contestar o ataque, permitindo que você queime mana facilmente e crie posições vantajosas a partir dele. Abuse dessa força para evitar situações ruins de rota ou aumentar seu poder geral no jogo.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Rápidas (Short Trades)
tips.contentEn: E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash
tips.contentPt: E> Q> AA> W> AA> E Out / E> Q> W> E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash

tips.titlePt: Respeite Akali R Damage
tips.contentEn: Akali's R2 damage is increased based on your missing HP, so make sure you use your R to mitigate damage against reaching her execute threshold or try to simply time your flash or E to avoid her R.
tips.contentPt: O dano de R2 de Akali é aumentado com base em seu HP perdido, então certifique-se de usar seu R para mitigar o dano ao atingir seu limite de execução ou tente simplesmente cronometrar seu Flash ou E para evitar seu R.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de chegar a level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check consistentemente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titleEn: Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Hexdrinker to lower Akali's overall damage and have a MR shield / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Akali’'s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá Hexdrinker para diminuir o dano geral de Akali e tenha um escudo MR / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Akali’ e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Akali's role within the mid game is trying to actively search for your squisher teammates with the objective of trying to one shot them before any major objectives. Your role to stop her in the game is simply putting out wards in fog of war, trying to spot her out and deny her flank opportunities. In each fight simply use W as soon as you can on her, whether that’s the beginning of her engage, or just as soon as she comes out of W. Make sure to use your full combo on Akali as you will be able to easily one shot her alone, or with your teammates' damage on top. Once Akali is dead, her team will lose out on a lot of backline focused damage, allowing you and your team to steamroll the rest of the fight.
tips.contentPt: O papel de Akali dentro do mid game é tentar procurar ativamente por seus companheiros de equipe esmagadores com o objetivo de tentar detê-los com one-shot antes de qualquer objetivo principal. Seu papel para detê-la no jogo é simplesmente colocar proteções na névoa da guerra, tentando identificá-la e negar-lhe oportunidades de flanco. Em cada luta, simplesmente use W assim que puder nela, seja no início de seu engage ou assim que ela sair de W. Certifique-se de usar seu combo completo em Akali, pois você será capaz de facilmente dar one-shot nela sozinho ou com o dano de seus companheiros por cima. Assim que Akali estiver morto, sua equipe perderá muitos danos focados na retaguarda, permitindo que você e sua equipe controlem o resto da luta.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de E. Use E1 para entrar, aplique 3 AAs com PTA e saia com E2 para tirar metade do HP dela antes que ela pegue a mortalha.
level1ExplanationEn: Start E. Use E1 to gapclose, 3 AAs with PTA and E2 away to chunk her before shroud.
winConditionPt: Aproveite a vantagem de robustez do Renekton para punir tentativas de all-in com W Fortalecido + Q; mantenha a fúria acima de 50 para contra-atacar instantaneamente.
winConditionEn: Leverage Renekton's durability to punish all-in attempts with Empowered W + Q; keep fury above 50 to counter-burst immediately.
cautionPt: Respeite os picos de mobilidade e dano letal de Akali; não gaste o stun no vazio quando Akali estiver com habilidades de fuga ativas.
cautionEn: Respect Akali's mobility spikes and lethal burst; do not waste your stun when they have escape tools ready.

tips.titlePt: Aproveitar a Força no Early Game
tips.contentEn: Renekton is strong early while Akali is weak. Use Q and W for aggressive trades in levels 1-3 to pressure Akali's health and gain lane priority.
tips.contentPt: Renekton é dominante no início do jogo, enquanto Akali é frágil. Utilize Q e W para trocas agressivas nos níveis 1 a 3 para pressionar a vida da Akali e ditar a prioridade da rota.

tips.titlePt: Neutralizar a Akali com Dominus (R)
tips.contentEn: When Akali uses W (Twilight Shroud), activate R (Dominus) for bonus health and area-of-effect magic damage. This makes it easier to chase Akali within her shroud and set up a lethal kill window.
tips.contentPt: Quando Akali usar a Proteção do Crepúsculo (W), ative sua Ultimate Dominus (R) para ganhar vida máxima adicional e causar dano mágico contínuo em área, facilitando persegui-la e finalizar o abate dentro da fumaça.

videoTitle: Guia de Matchup: Renekton vs Akshan (Godrekton)
summaryEn: The whole objective vs Akshan, is simply surviving his aggression with D Shield and Second Wind, while trying to keep the wave on your side of the map. Playing the wave on your side will allow you to easily catch Akshan with your quick combos, as well as run him down post level 6 with Plated Steelcaps. Within the mid game, make sure to avoid giving him kill resets to revive his team, you can prevent him by either jumping on him solo or communicating with your team to focus him first.
summaryPt: Todo o objetivo contra Akshan é simplesmente sobreviver à sua agressão com D Shield e Second Wind, enquanto tenta manter o wave do seu lado do mapa. Jogar o wave ao seu lado permitirá que você pegue facilmente Akshan com seus combos rápidos, bem como derrube-o após level 6 com Plated Steelcaps. Dentro do mid game, evite dar a ele redefinições de morte para reviver sua equipe. Você pode evitá-lo saltando sobre ele sozinho ou comunicando-se com sua equipe para concentrá-lo primeiro.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Early on in the laning phase, Akshan’s oppressive playstyle can prevent Renekton from being able to be aggressive, as Akshan’s damage and early mobility are pretty hard to deal with. Wait until level 3 to be aggressive, try to keep your HP up and wait for the minion wave to crash on your side before trying to do any trades. Make sure to utilise D Shield and Second Wind to help you combat against Akshan’s early oppression. 

(2) Avoid Akshan Passive + PTA Proc - Akshan’s main source of damage comes out of his 3 hit passive, where Akshan will do burst damage and obtain movement speed procing his passive, as well as abusing PTA for additional proc damage. As previously mentioned, play for sustain and try to avoid getting hit by his 3 hits, make sure to wait for it to wear off before looking for trading patterns. 

(3) Avoid Akshan Or Punish Akshan E - Akshan E is another big ability that allows him to deal a ton of damage onto his targets, while also providing mobility to out space away from his opponents. As Renekton you want to make sure to avoid standing near walls, if Akshan can aggressively use it to chunk you out early. However, if you’re looking to fight Akshan with your powerspikes, make sure to walk in and hit your E1 or E2 to cancel his E. If any champion interacts with his E hitbox, this can instantly cancel the ability and leave Akshan in a horrible situation.

(4) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(5) Ping Akshan’s Roams - After Akshan’s first few levels, Renekton will start to gain the upper edge after his first back. Akshan’s win condition is simply to roam and utilise his scoundrel passive, to help provide utility and finish off any champions with his R or overall damage. Akshan can be utterly disgusting when it comes to roams as he can stealthy gank with his W, on top of also being able to revive his teammates, cheating the overall time to punish death timers. Try to spam ping as much as you can if Akshan roams, try to also provide control wards within the river to spot Akshan roams. Try to also punish Akshan’s roams with wave crashes, as this will help you gain XP and Gold to put him behind even harder.

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Rushing Plated Steelcaps allows you to lower Askhan’s overall damage, while also being able to consistently stick onto Akshan allowing you to obtain kills on him. Once you have these you’re essentially allowed to do any combos and even all in’s after Akshan makes a mistake, so make sure to rush these to make the lane a lot easier.

(8) Avoid Akshan R - Akshan R can be a great tool to snipe off low HP targets, as this can help him utilise respawning his teammates, on top of also using it to finish off anyone that is low. If you’re in a teamfight, try to block it if you’re tanky enough to help save your teammates, otherwise try to avoid it by using minions, towers or teammates to block the shots if you’re low. 

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(10) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Akshan’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid game, Akshan’s main priority will be trying to snipe off carries with his W stealth and high scaling damage. In each fight against Akshan  your priority will be trying to protect your low HP carries, otherwise Akshan will be able to secure revives, which overall can doom the entire leverage you gain from killing his teammates. Whenever you have the opportunity, simply jump on him as fast as possible to eliminate him from the fights so he is unable to apply his mass utility and damage against your carries.

(9) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base de Renekton e as stats de seu R permitem que Renekton stat check complete seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

Akshan can be utterly disgusting when it comes to roams as he can stealthy gank with his W, on top of also being able to revive his teammates, cheating the overall time to punish death timers. Try to spam ping as much as you can if Akshan roams, try to also provide control wards within the river to spot Akshan roams. Try to also punish Akshan’s roams with wave crashes, as this will help you gain XP and Gold to put him behind even harder.
tips.contentPt: Após os primeiros níveis de Akshan, Renekton começará a ganhar a vantagem superior após sua primeira volta. A condição de vitória de Akshan é simplesmente roam e utilizar sua passiva canalha, para ajudar a fornecer utilidade e acabar com qualquer campeão com seu R ou dano geral. Akshan pode ser totalmente nojento quando se trata de roaming, já que ele pode ser furtivo gank com seu W, além de também ser capaz de reviver seus companheiros de equipe, trapaceando o tempo geral para punir os cronômetros de morte. Tente enviar spam o máximo que puder se Akshan estiver vagando, tente também fornecer sentinelas de controle dentro do rio para detectar Akshan vagando. Tente também punir os roamings de Akshan com travamentos de wave, pois isso ajudará você a ganhar XP e ouro para deixá-lo ainda mais para trás.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Rápidas (Short Trades)
tips.contentEn: E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash.
tips.contentPt: E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash.

tips.titlePt: Rush de Plated Steelcaps
tips.contentEn: Rushing Plated Steelcaps allows you to lower Askhan’s overall damage, while also being able to consistently stick onto Akshan allowing you to obtain kills on him. Once you have these you’re essentially allowed to do any combos and even all in’s after Akshan makes a mistake, so make sure to rush these to make the lane a lot easier.
tips.contentPt: Apressar Plated Steelcaps permite que você reduza o dano geral de Askhan, ao mesmo tempo em que é capaz de manter Akshan de forma consistente, permitindo que você o mate. Depois de obtê-los, você poderá fazer qualquer combo e até mesmo all in após Akshan cometer um erro, então certifique-se de apressá-los para tornar a pista muito mais fácil.

tips.titlePt: Evite Akshan R
tips.contentEn: Akshan R can be a great tool to snipe off low HP targets, as this can help him utilise respawning his teammates, on top of also using it to finish off anyone that is low. If you’re in a teamfight, try to block it if you’re tanky enough to help save your teammates, otherwise try to avoid it by using minions, towers or teammates to block the shots if you’re low.
tips.contentPt: Akshan R pode ser uma ótima ferramenta para atirar em alvos com baixo HP, pois isso pode ajudá-lo a utilizar o respawn de seus companheiros de equipe, além de também usá-lo para acabar com qualquer um que esteja com baixo HP. Se você estiver em um teamfight, tente bloqueá-lo se você for tanque o suficiente para ajudar a salvar seus companheiros de equipe, caso contrário, tente evitá-lo usando lacaios, torres ou companheiros de equipe para bloquear os tiros se você estiver baixo.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base e stats de seu R de Renekton permitem que Renekton stat check completamente seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Akshan’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Akshan e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Within the mid game, Akshan’s main priority will be trying to snipe off carries with his W stealth and high scaling damage. In each fight against Akshan  your priority will be trying to protect your low HP carries, otherwise Akshan will be able to secure revives, which overall can doom the entire leverage you gain from killing his teammates. Whenever you have the opportunity, simply jump on him as fast as possible to eliminate him from the fights so he is unable to apply his mass utility and damage against your carries.
tips.contentPt: Dentro do mid game, a principal prioridade de Akshan será evitar ataques furtivos com sua furtividade W e dano de alta escala. Em cada luta contra Akshan, sua prioridade será tentar proteger seus carregadores de HP baixo, caso contrário, Akshan será capaz de garantir revives, o que no geral pode condenar toda a vantagem que você ganha ao matar seus companheiros de equipe. Sempre que tiver oportunidade, simplesmente salte sobre ele o mais rápido possível para eliminá-lo das lutas para que ele não consiga aplicar sua utilidade em massa e dano contra seus carregadores.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de E para encurtar a distância e punir a fragilidade de campeões de longo alcance.
level1ExplanationEn: Start E to gapclose and punish ranged champions early.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Akshan e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Akshan with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Akshan.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Akshan's disengage crowd control.

startingItems: Doran's Blade / Doran's Shield / Long Sword
videoTitle: Hot Girl Renekton vs Alistar
summaryEn: Alistar is essentially a free match up, however his hard to kill playstyle does make it hard to reliably get kills onto him. Instead, try to play for giant farm leads, using your proxy style gameplay to help create tempo advantages, allowing you to have time to kill the enemy jungler, or get better resets towards item spikes. Eventually within the match up, simply avoid Alistar engages by playing from a safe distance, then look to kill his carries whenever you get the chance to.
summaryPt: Alistar é essencialmente um confronto livre, no entanto, seu estilo de jogo difícil de matar torna difícil matá-lo de maneira confiável. Em vez disso, tente jogar com líderes de fazendas gigantes, usando seu estilo de jogo proxy para ajudar a criar vantagens de ritmo, permitindo que você tenha tempo para matar o caçador inimigo ou obter melhores redefinições para picos de itens. Eventualmente, dentro do confronto, simplesmente evite o envolvimento de Alistar jogando de uma distância segura e, em seguida, procure matar seus carregadores sempre que puder.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Alistar with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Alistar.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Alistar you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Alistar lose a lot more. HOWEVER, if Alistar has his abilities up and he isn’t entirely in W kill range, simply wait for the wave to bounce back to your side, while trying to freeze him out from the ability to get any CS and abuse his pick.

(3) Avoid Alistar’s CC Combo - Alistar really doesn’t have a lot of tools to threaten Renekton, however he is a great neutraliser if played right. With that also said his only main tool to give him any survivability is the ability to use his CC to prevent Renekton from killing him. Aside from Alistar’s naturally hard to kill nature, his gank setup is also great for setting up team plays and utilising his CC with a damage jungler. Try to be very cautious of ganks, or even putting respect on Alistar’s utility when going for tower trade or all in plays. Wait for him to use his naturally long CDs, then abuse him after. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Abuse Renekton's Waveclear - A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game. 

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Ping Alistar’s Roams - One of the only other things Alistar can really play for to gain an advantage is simply trying to roam the map and look for plays with his team. Alistar cannot really achieve anything top lane, so mainly he will play to look for engages for his team and try to secure objectives based on his presence. With that said, try to abuse Alistar’s roams by crashing waves for plates or minion waves. Try to really gain as big of a lead as you can with your top side advantage, try to also ping Alistar’s roams or try to counter with your own roams or TP plays if you really need to. More than not, I’d just farm it out and utilise my proxies opportunities to gain an even bigger tempo advantage. 

(8) Respect Alistar R - One thing to note about Alistar is that if you’re trying to commit a fight against him, trying to simply aim to burst him down is practically a waste of time. Most fights with Alistar are entirely pointless, as he is able to knock you away or neutralise you from even trading back against him. So most often, just avoid fighting him unless you want to mana burn him from doing anything else in lane, and instead just play to farm or go into the enemy jungle to take camps or kill the enemy jungle if they’re there.

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - Alistar’s main objective within the game is to play for engages, while also trying to peel off any damage threats from his team’s carries. As Renekton, your job is simply trying to creatively jump into his back line, with the objective of trying to one shot and overall disrupt his carries from playing teamfights. To achieve this, wait for Alistar to engage with his W onto your teammate, then aim to dash onto his backline and try to play for any kills you can. Focusing Alistar is a waste of time, so just simply ignore him and stick to your gameplan to eliminate any enemy win conditions.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 Q Start - tente push para vantagem de level 2 enquanto poking Alistar com seu Q, na habilidade level 2 E/W use vantagem para dividir Alistar.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de destruir Alistar, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Alistar perca muito mais. NO ENTANTO, se Alistar tiver suas habilidades aumentadas e não estiver totalmente no alcance de morte do W, simplesmente espere o wave voltar para o seu lado, enquanto freeze o impede de pegar qualquer CS e abusar de sua escolha.

(3) Evite o combo CC de Alistar - Alistar realmente não tem muitas ferramentas para ameaçar Renekton, porém ele é um ótimo neutralizador se jogado corretamente. Com isso dito, sua única ferramenta principal para lhe dar qualquer capacidade de sobrevivência é a habilidade de usar seu CC para evitar que Renekton o mate. Além da natureza naturalmente difícil de matar de Alistar, sua configuração gank também é ótima para preparar jogadas em equipe e utilizar seu CC com um caçador de dano. tente ser muito cauteloso com ganks, ou até mesmo respeitar a utilidade de Alistar ao fazer troca de torre ou jogadas de all in. Espere que ele use seu CDs naturalmente longo e depois abuse dele. 

(4) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(5) Abusar do waveclear de Renekton - Uma grande vantagem que Renekton tem neste confronto é sua habilidade geral de eliminar facilmente o lacaio waves. Isso pode ajudá-lo a obter redefinições de tempo perfeitas ou permitir que ele proxy waves ajude a aumentar sua vantagem de ouro, ao mesmo tempo que refém o top laner inimigo sob sua própria torre. Ser capaz de limpar rapidamente também força o inimigo a contestar o ataque, permitindo que você queime mana facilmente e crie posições vantajosas a partir dele. Abuse dessa força para evitar situações ruins de rota ou aumentar seu poder geral no jogo. 

(6) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(7) Ping nas Roams de Alistar - Uma das únicas outras coisas pelas quais Alistar pode realmente jogar para ganhar vantagem é simplesmente tentar roam o mapa e procurar jogadas com seu time. Alistar realmente não consegue alcançar nada na rota superior, então principalmente ele jogará para buscar engajamento para sua equipe e tentar objetivos seguros com base em sua presença. Com isso dito, tente abusar das rondas de Alistar por crashing waves em busca de placas ou lacaio waves. Tente realmente ganhar a maior vantagem possível com sua vantagem no lado superior, tente também executar ping nos roams de Alistar ou tente counter com seus próprios roams ou jogadas de TP se você realmente precisar. Mais do que não, eu simplesmente aproveitaria e utilizaria minhas oportunidades de proxy para obter uma vantagem de ritmo ainda maior. 

(8) Respeite Alistar R - Uma coisa a se notar sobre Alistar é que se você está tentando lutar contra ele, tentar simplesmente tentar derrubá-lo é praticamente uma perda de tempo. A maioria das lutas com Alistar são totalmente inúteis, já que ele é capaz de te derrubar ou neutralizar até mesmo trocas contra ele. Então, na maioria das vezes, evite lutar contra ele, a menos que você queira queimá-lo de mana por fazer qualquer outra coisa na rota, e em vez disso, apenas jogue para farmar ou ir para a selva inimiga para acampar ou matar a selva inimiga, se eles estiverem lá.

(9) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Meio de jogo + dicas de teamfighting - O principal objetivo de Alistar no jogo é jogar para engajar, ao mesmo tempo em que evita peel de qualquer ameaça de dano dos carregamentos de sua equipe. Como Renekton, seu trabalho é simplesmente tentar saltar criativamente para a linha de trás dele, com o objetivo de tentar um golpe e impedir que seus carregadores joguem teamfights. Para conseguir isso, espere Alistar até engage com seu W em seu companheiro de equipe, então tente correr para sua linha de fundo e tente jogar para qualquer morte que puder. Focar Alistar é uma perda de tempo, então simplesmente ignore-o e siga seu plano de jogo para eliminar quaisquer condições de vitória do inimigo.

videoTitle: Guia de Matchup: Renekton vs Ambessa (Godrekton)
summaryEn: The Ambessa match up is all about avoiding her main damage, using your range to weave in and out of her abilities, as well as punishing her if she dashes into you. Make sure to use empowered W on her shield, while also trying to actively avoid taking her Q damage. Renekton stat checks Ambessa at all points in the game, so make sure to play to counter her trading patterns, as these provide the most beneficial gain to beating her. Within teamfights or skirmishes, try to protect any carries from her R engage by tanking it yourself, as her value from R is entirely lost if she uses it on the wrong target.
summaryPt: O confronto de Ambessa consiste em evitar seu dano principal, usando seu alcance para entrar e sair de suas habilidades, bem como puni-la se ela colidir com você. Certifique-se de usar Empowered W em seu escudo, ao mesmo tempo em que tenta evitar ativamente receber dano de Q. Renekton verifica as stats de Ambessa em todos os pontos do jogo, então certifique-se de jogar para contrariar seus padrões de trocas, pois eles fornecem o ganho mais benéfico para vencê-la. Dentro de teamfights ou skirmishes, tente proteger qualquer carregamento de seu R engage tankando-o você mesmo, já que o valor de R é totalmente perdido se ela usá-lo no alvo errado.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - When playing into Ambessa, try to avoid her damage from her Q’s and look to push the wave without taking too much damage. Renekton’s Q waveclear allows him to easily reach level 2, providing Renekton the ability to skill W or E to allow him to heavily trade against Ambessa. Once chunking out Ambessa, we can play for a potential level 2 or 3 kill if it’s available. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Due to Ambessa’s mobility, the kill angle may not always be there against Ambessa. However, a way we can make use of our level 1/2 trades is our ability to force a wave bounce against her. If we are able to crash the 2nd minion wave, then allow her 3rd and 4th wave to push back towards us, this will help us create room to easily force a fight and potentially kill her. Ambessa’s overall weakness is playing in a frozen or extended wave state, taking away her ability to escape to safety. Try to always keep the wave state on your side if you want beneficial trades, as Renekton’s early game completely surpasses Ambessa’s ability to do much. 

(3) Respect Ambessa’s Short Trades - One of Ambessa’s strengths within the Renekton match up is her ability to force short trades. If Ambessa has a safe wave state on her side of the map or a giant minion wave, Ambessa can force her trades with W and grasp, allowing her to jump onto Renekton and mitigate against his incoming damage, as well as using her Q to help her whittle down Renekton’s HP while utilising her dashes to avoid any direct confrontation with Renekton. Ambessa’s short trades must be punished or avoided, which Renekton can do within a handful of ways. If Ambessa tries to engage with W, try to utilise your empowered stun immediately onto her shield, as it will instantly break her shield and punish her hard within the process. If Ambessa tries to go for Q trades, try to use your dash to avoid taking her Q damage or use your movement to side step her Q2, to make her lose her additional damage. 

(4) Respect And Avoid Ambessa’s Q - Ambessa’s Q1 allows her to deal damage in a cone, while her Q2 allows her to extend and slam her damage within a line. Ambessa’s Q does a lot of damage, utilising her target’s maximum HP as additional physical damage. When fighting Ambessa, try to use your dashes to avoid her Q damage, or look to use your movement to wriggle in and out of her Q positioning. Once Ambessa doesn’t have her Q damage, Renekton can simply brute force a heavy trade onto her, punishing Ambessa’s 14 to 10 seconds Q cooldown. 

(5) Abuse Renekton’s W Shield Break - Renekton’s W can instantly break Ambessa’s shield, allowing her to completely lose out on her ability to mitigate against Renekton’s damage. Try to make sure you’re always holding fury for an empowered W if Ambessa is constantly dashing towards you, as you will be able to easily counter her W as soon as she uses it. 

(6) Play Around Ambessa’s Dashes - Ambessa’s passive allows her to constantly dash after using each ability, providing her with a disgusting amount of mobility through each ability. While this can be annoying, Renekton’s playstyle into Ambessa consists of playing to counter attack her. Each time Ambessa engages on Renekton, Renekton should adequately hold his dashes until she has a limited amount of dashes left. For example, if Ambessa does E > AA > W > AA > Q1 > AA > Q2 Disengage, she will only use her last Q2 to space away against you, allowing you to constantly be in range to use your damage and follow up her Q2 with your own E. Overall, it entirely depends on how Ambessa is using her dashes, but each time she uses an ability it puts each of them on a 10 second + CD earlier on, allowing you to hard punish her back.

(7) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(8) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(9) Respect Ambessa’s R - Ambessa’s R isn’t so much a powerful tool into Renekton, due to her overall lack of strength within the match up not really allowing her to use it as much other than a way of an escape. Ambessa’s R will mainly be used against squishy targets, allowing her to skirmish pretty deep into her isolated or back line targets, providing her an easy way to assassinate. With that said, you shouldn’t really be scared of her R herself within the lane, although if she does have multiple allies near her you should still try to use your E or movement to help dodge her R cast. Within skirmishes or teamfights, you should try to block the R for your team by standing directly behind them, as Ambessa’s R only works on the furthest target of her R cast. 

(10) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Ambessa’s overall objective is simply trying to use her R to look for gigantic engages, allowing her to easily assassinate any squishy carries or isolated targets. Ambessa’s overall dueling ability improves massively through the mid to late game, due to her low CDs and high damage she’s able to deal. As Renekton, Ambessa’s overall weaknesses are still prevalent against Renekton, making her still an easy champion to duel in the side lane as long as we’re building Renekton offensively. Our job within the game is trying to avoid Ambessa’s R engages, by standing near our carries to help CC and lock down Ambessa, or preventing her engages by previously spam pinging her positioning and back pinging our team mates. Ambessa without R is incredibly useless vs Renekton, as her way of engage is completely telegraphed, preventing Ambessa from being able to effectively play her role within the game.

videoTitle: Renekton vs Amumu Video Test
summaryEn: Amumu is one of the easiest match ups you can play against as Renekton, as Amumu's linear playstyle completely relies on landing his Q and setting up plays for his team. Within the laning phase, play off your abiltiies to burst him down and try to avoid any Q's he throws out. Renekton can pretty much kill Amumu at will if he forces the wave states on your side, so make sure to set up your all ins when the wave is frozen or slow pushing from your side of the map. Within mid game, try to avoid Amumu looking for Q > R engages, as this will provide he and his team an AoE stun to easily win a teamfight.
summaryPt: Amumu é uma das partidas mais fáceis contra as quais você pode jogar como Renekton, já que o estilo de jogo linear de Amumu depende completamente de acertar seu Q e preparar jogadas para seu time. Dentro da fase de rotas (laning phase), use suas habilidades para burst ele cair e tente evitar qualquer Q que ele jogue fora. Renekton pode praticamente matar Amumu à vontade se ele forçar os estados wave do seu lado, então certifique-se de configurar seus all ins quando o wave estiver congelado ou empurrando lentamente do seu lado do mapa. Dentro de mid game, tente evitar Amumu procurando engajamentos Q > R, pois isso fornecerá a ele e sua equipe um atordoamento AoE para vencer facilmente um teamfight.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Amumu you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Amumu lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(5) Respect Amumu's CC Setup - Amumu’s only real threat in the match up is the ability to provide great CC setup. Amumu’s 2Q’s and potential R is simply enough to completely lock out Renekton out of an entire fight. Try to avoid his Q’s with your movement, if the enemy has easy to land CC from other members then you can try and rush Mercury Treads to help you combat the CC.

(6) Respect Amumu’s Extended Damage - Amumu’s extended fights are low key pretty strong, this usually comes from the fact that taking damage lowers his E CD on top of his W damage, which works based on his targets maximum HP. Simply abuse quick trades unless you’re ahead of him, in that case Renekton will be able to 1000 > 0 him relatively easy.

(7) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(8) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Amumu’s role within the mid game is mostly to focus on landing a giant Q R play in a major teamfight. Amumu’s role is pretty limited outside of landing this, with that said your objective is trying to cut Amumu’s position from being able to land it. If you’re in a teamfight try to body block Amumu or his Q’s from reaching your team, alternatively jumping into his back line will also force him to use his R early too, or potentially lose his team’s ability to follow up on his R play. Whatever you can do to avoid him landing a mass R will ultimately win you the fight, try to also build the right resistances and tank items such as Sterak’s Gage or another resistance item to allow you to easily tank his teams incoming damage.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 Q ou E Start - Como mencionado em outras notas, jogar Q e E requer jogadas diferentes, porém neste confronto você pode essencialmente fazer qualquer uma delas e ter um bom sucesso. Com isso dito, experimente os pontos fortes de level 1 e procure uma morte de level 2. 

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Amumu, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Amumu perca muito mais. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(5) Respeite a configuração do CC de Amumu - A única ameaça real de Amumu no confronto é a capacidade de fornecer uma ótima configuração de CC. Os 2Qs e R potencial de Amumu são simplesmente suficientes para bloquear completamente Renekton de uma luta inteira. Tente evitar seus Q's com seu movimento, se o inimigo tiver facilidade para pousar CC de outros membros, então você pode tentar apressar Mercury Treads para ajudá-lo a combater o CC.

(6) Respeite o dano estendido de Amumu - as lutas estendidas de Amumu são discretas e muito fortes, isso geralmente vem do fato de que receber dano reduz seu E CD além do dano de W, que funciona com base no HP máximo de seu alvo. Basta abusar de trocas rápidas a não ser que você esteja na frente dele, nesse caso Renekton conseguirá 1000 > 0 nele relativamente fácil.

(7) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(8) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(9) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - O papel de Amumu dentro do mid game é principalmente focar em acertar uma jogada QR gigante em um teamfight principal. O papel de Amumu é bastante limitado fora de pousar isso, com isso dito, seu objetivo é tentar impedir a posição de Amumu de conseguir pousar. Se você estiver em um teamfight tente body block Amumu ou seus Q's de alcançar seu time, alternativamente, pular para sua linha de fundo também irá forçá-lo a usar seu R mais cedo, ou potencialmente perder a capacidade de seu time de acompanhar seu jogo R. Tudo o que você puder fazer para evitá-lo acertar uma massa R acabará ganhando a luta, tente também construir as resistências certas e itens de tanque, como o Gage de Sterak ou outro item de resistência, para permitir que você tanke facilmente os danos recebidos de sua equipe.

videoTitle: Guia de Matchup: Renekton vs Anivia (Godrekton)
summaryEn: Anivia is a tricky style match up for Renekton, as her ability to harass Renekton pre 6 is very hard to deal with. As Renekton, try to use Doran's Shield and Second Wind to help sustain through her auto attacks and abilities, while also playing with the intent of avoiding her Q at all times. When you're level 6 and have Hexdrinker or Mercury Treads, Renekton can win all in's if you manage to avoid her Q with your dashes, allowing you to burst her down and allow any teammates to easily jump on her. Within the mid game, Renekton excels a lot more as a teamfighter than Anivia, however try to avoid fog of war as Anivia will sit in bushes looking to burst you or your teammates. Eventually look for Baron in the game, as it weakens Anivia's power to waveclear.
summaryPt: Anivia é um confronto de estilo complicado para Renekton, já que sua capacidade de assediar Renekton antes dos 6 anos é muito difícil de lidar. Como Renekton, tente usar Doran's Shield e Second Wind para ajudar a sustentar seu auto attacks e habilidades, enquanto também joga com a intenção de evitar seu Q o tempo todo. Quando você é level 6 e tem Hexdrinker ou Mercury Treads, Renekton pode ganhar all in se você conseguir evitar o Q dela com seus ataques, permitindo que você burst ela derrube e permita que qualquer companheiro de equipe salte facilmente sobre ela. Dentro do mid game, Renekton se destaca muito mais como teamfighter do que Anivia, no entanto, evite a névoa da guerra, pois Anivia ficará sentado em arbustos buscando burst você ou seus companheiros de equipe. Eventualmente procure por Baron no jogo, pois isso enfraquece o poder de Anivia para waveclear.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Anivia’s overall strengths within the game come from her strong laning phase. Early in the game Anivia will try to hard poke you with Q and E, in which you need to avoid her Q as much as possible. Her E will do no damage if she doesn’t land her Q or R damage onto you, meaning you can easily tank that with ease. On top of that she will try to auto attack a lot so utilising D Shield and Second Wind will help you sustain through her consistent assault, presenting you the ability to outstain and survive the laning phase.
 
(2) Avoid Anivia’s Q - Aside from Anivia having very high base damage, she will only be able to out trade if she lands her Q, which boosts her overall E damage by a substantial amount. Try your best to avoid Anivia Q in the following ways. Try to weave in and out with short clicks to bait her Q, use E towards her then sidestep to the side or E2 behind her to avoid her Q hit. All of these can allow you to get more successful trades, or allow you to kill her. 

(3) Rush Mercury Treads - Anivia’s main source of survivability towards Renekton is using her Q to peel Renekton off of herself, on top of also using her wall to block Renekton from running her down. Typically Anivia can successful peel and space away from Renekton when doing this right, however if Renekton rushes Mercury Treads he is able to break out of her Q a lot faster, overall ruining Anivia’s ability to perfectly space away in time, giving Renekton the chance to E2 in and easily run her down with the additional movement speed and MR.

(4) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(5) Play For Ganks - Anivia’s naturally fast pushing and over extending playstyle will most often present the ability to gank. Depending on the lane, if you’re top lane top lane you can most often just kill Anivia with ease with jungle presence, however if it’s mid this will be more challenging. When receiving a gank, try to double dash into Anivia and use your W to lock her down to help your jungler gank. Burning her flash or passive is a giant advantage to winning the lane, so try to utilise the waves on your side and ping your jungler to gank.

(6) Quick Trades - If you can avoid Anivia’s Q, you can try to punish her with the following trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Hexdrinker to lower Aniva’s overall damage and have a MR shield / Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Anivia’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Anivia through the later stages of the game essentially suffers from her old champion design, as most champions can easily surpass her wall or allow themselves to easily avoid Anivia’s Q or R. Anivia’s main win condition through the game is trying to look for easy targets that walk into her in fog of war, or forcing fights in choke points within the jungle. Try to avoid fighting Anivia in tight spaces, playing in the open provides an easy opportunity to avoid her damage and negate her overall advantages. Try to also ward around fog of war objectives with yellow or blue trinkets, these will help you spot out Anivia and help you avoid her easy access to kills. Within teamfights you can burst Anivia pretty easily, on top of the fact you can easily W her to cancel her R damage and cast, preventing Anivia’s DPS in a fight. Play the fights accordingly and try to one shot the main carries if Anivia isn’t as big of a threat. Whenever you win fights, try to force a baron when its available, this will help you push against Aniva’s naturally strong waveclear.
