detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Azir is quite a disgusting matchup when it comes to laning as Renekton, this is mainly due to the reason Azir takes away a lot of space with his soldiers, providing consistent poke out against Renekton as well as 0 room to really trade back. Try to utilise D Shield + Second Wind to survive his early poke until you’re level 3, in which you can attempt to trade back if possible. 

(2) Avoid And Punish Azir’s Soldier Positioning - As previously mentioned, Azir’s main source of damage you need to worry about is based around his Soldiers. Azir can position them aggressively or defensively to utilise his ability to either escape with them, or use them to poke out his laner. Try to punish Azir if he uses E to force his soldiers into you, if he does this you can combo into him forcing a big trade to either kill or deal a big amount of damage to him. Do note that if he can summon another Soldier, he could put it behind and use it to dash away. Play around this wisely to create opportunities even if they’re rare. 

(3) Rush Mercury Treads or Hexdrinker - Azir’s damage may be considered low early game however Azir really can poke the absolute hell out of you early, in which rushing an early Mercury Tread’s for MR or movement speed is most certainly not a bad idea to avoid his early advantages. Going Hexdrinker is also a pretty decent option to sustain damage into him, as this will help you edge the fights against him if you’re given the chance to go for an all in.

(4) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Play For Ganks - Trying to kill Azir solo is very, VERY hard depending on how good the player is, so with that said playing for ganks is your best bet to create positive advantages. Trying to either burn his flash, R or chunk him out of the lane at the very least can be very helpful for gaining an advantage or setting up future kills within that window against Azir. Try to really focus on your wave state and ping your teammates to help gank Azir. 

(7) Play Around Azir R - Azir R is a great tool for play making and creating giant play opportunities, as it also is for its defensive capabilities to avoid Renekton’s all in attempts. Once you are strong enough you can deliberately burn it out by trying to focus Azir after he burns his dash, or if you can successfully time your stun on his E, which will force him to use R. Doing this can create you a kill opportunity on your next flash or dash play if you play it right, or alternatively you can try to double dash onto Azir in the time to avoid his R frame to knock you back or you can simply flash it to stay on top of him. Overall this is a very hard match up for mid lane compared to top lane, so make sure to do what you can to take away this power from him before any skirmishes or any teamfights. 

(8) Play For Teammates - Overall the main objective of Renekton vs Azir is simply to play around your team and look for any skirmish or play opportunities that can help you enable yourself or your teammates within the game. Renekton is already very limited within this match up, so the best case scenario will come from trying to play around your team and focus on getting them ahead . 

(9) Build Maw of Malmortius, Eclipse or Stridebreaker - Build Maw if the enemy has multiple AP champions and you want a MR shield. Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Azir's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Azir’s overall role in the game is to scale into being a hyper carry, while trying to also look out for any Q > E > R plays. This combo is absolutely crazy for its play making potential, so you need to always respect the situation of the map you’re in to avoid being overthrown into turrets, blocked in chokepoints or pinpalled into his own team. Try to always monitor his position in the fights and try to outplay his R with your flash, or attempt to jump on him before he is able to jump onto your team. If Azir loses his R he loses so much utility and protection that he will become a free target within this stage of the game. Try to always keep Azir and his team preoccupied with yourself to actively help your team play front to back, preventing Azir to shred or burst any teammates.

tips.contentEn: Azir’s overall role in the game is to scale into being a hyper carry, while trying to also look out for any Q > E > R plays. This combo is absolutely crazy for its play making potential, so you need to always respect the situation of the map you’re in to avoid being overthrown into turrets, blocked in chokepoints or pinpalled into his own team. Try to always monitor his position in the fights and try to outplay his R with your flash, or attempt to jump on him before he is able to jump onto your team. If Azir loses his R he loses so much utility and protection that he will become a free target within this stage of the game. Try to always keep Azir and his team preoccupied with yourself to actively help your team play front to back, preventing Azir to shred or burst any teammates.
tips.contentPt: O papel geral de Azir no jogo é se tornar um hiper carry, ao mesmo tempo em que tenta também ficar atento a qualquer jogada de Q > E > R. Se Azir perder seu R ele perde tanta utilidade e proteção que se tornará um alvo livre nesta fase do jogo. Tente sempre manter Azir e sua equipe preocupados consigo mesmo para ajudar ativamente seu time a jogar de frente para trás, evitando que Azir destrua ou burst qualquer companheiro de equipe.

videoTitle: HITTING MASTERS with BARD/RENEKTON | LoR Gameplay Video
summaryEn: Bard is practically a very easy match up, as you're able to dash and kill him on repeat, as long as you avoid his Q stun and try to force fights when he is away from the walls to use his E. Bard can be pretty negative in avoiding death, so playing for farm leads and proxy attempts is super necessary. Try to use the proxy timers to invade the enemy jungler, or look for tempo resets to gain an advantage. All Bard can really do into Renekton is use his high mobility to gank other lanes, so make sure to ping his locations and abuse your side lane presence to abuse this playstyle.
summaryPt: Bard é praticamente um confronto muito fácil, já que você é capaz de correr e matá-lo repetidamente, desde que evite seu Q stun e tente force fights quando ele estiver longe das paredes para usar seu E. Bard pode ser bastante negativo para evitar a morte, então jogar para farm leads e tentativas de proxy é super necessário. Tente usar os temporizadores proxy para invadir o caçador inimigo ou procure redefinições de tempo para obter vantagem. Tudo o que Bard pode realmente fazer em Renekton é usar sua alta mobilidade para gank outras pistas, então certifique-se de fazer ping em suas localizações e abusar de sua presença na side lane para abusar desse estilo de jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Bard you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Bardlose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Avoid Bard Q - Bard’s only form of self peel comes from his Q. Typically if you try to dash into Bard he will throw his Q back out trying to stun you if you’re close to a minion, ally or wall. Try to avoid his Q stun from your E engages, try to be on the edge of his minions to get a better placement dash if you’re looking to quick or heavy trade him. Any bit of damage you can deal to him with this play method will be giant in being able to secure a kill or an advantageous play. 

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Ping Bard’s Roams - Most of the time Bard will most likely play to roam the map, trying to secure his chimes to scale into the game or trying to be as big of a tumor as possible. Try to spam ping Bard’s whereabouts as much as you can, that’s the only real thing he can do to gain an advantage for his team. Abuse his roams by crashing waves on his roams, try to get as much gold and xp as you can to ultimately carry the mid to late stages of the game. 

(7) Respect Bard’s Utility - Bard offers a lot of utility when playing around his team, as he is able to use his E to go through walls with his teammates in unpredictable angles, or the ability to stun lock people through his Q and R. Try to ward up around your lane, try to pay attention to each lane and make sure to respect any roams from any strong members into your lane. As the game goes on, try to ward around the areas you’re pushing up on his side of the map, do your best to not get caught out and give the enemies any additional gold.  

(8) Go Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Bard’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - As already mentioned, Bard’s whole objective is essentially going to be playing around his team from minute 1. Try to respect any of his plays when you’re pushing solo, try not to get caught by his E engages or R, try to to utilise your lead when it comes to later fights. If you have farmed up enough you’re most likely able to control and dominate most fights. Simply ignore focusing Bard, focus on his carries and try to assassinate them from the game. Bard can’t really do much without team members so make sure to take those resources away from him. Alternatively, ping your team away from being isolated as bard can easily engage with his R and create catch opportunities, try to avoid this situation as much as you can otherwise his team will be able to take objectives and leave you a player down.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Bard, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer Bardlose ainda mais. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes desde o início até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Evite Bard Q - a única forma de identidade de Bard peel vem de seu Q. Normalmente, se você tentar atacar Bard, ele jogará seu Q de volta para atordoá-lo se você estiver perto de um lacaio, aliado ou parede. Tente evitar o atordoamento Q dele em seus ataques E, tente estar no limite de seus lacaios para obter um melhor posicionamento se você estiver buscando uma troca rápida ou pesada com ele. Qualquer dano que você possa causar a ele com este método de jogo será enorme para garantir uma morte ou uma jogada vantajosa. 

(5) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(6) Ping Bard’s Roams - Na maioria das vezes, Bard provavelmente jogará para roam o mapa, tentando proteger seus sinos para escalar no jogo ou tentando ser o maior tumor possível. Tente enviar spam para o paradeiro de Bard o máximo que puder, essa é a única coisa real que ele pode fazer para obter uma vantagem para sua equipe. Abuse de suas andanças por crashing waves em suas roamings, tente obter o máximo de ouro e XP que puder para finalmente levar os estágios intermediários ao final do jogo. 

(7) Respeite a utilidade de Bard - Bard oferece muita utilidade ao jogar em torno de sua equipe, já que ele é capaz de usar seu E para atravessar paredes com seus companheiros de equipe em ângulos imprevisíveis, ou a habilidade de atordoar as pessoas através de seu Q e R. Tente se proteger em torno de sua pista, preste atenção em cada pista e certifique-se de respeitar qualquer roaming de qualquer membro forte em sua pista. À medida que o jogo avança, fique atento às áreas que você está empurrando no lado dele do mapa, faça o seu melhor para não ser pego e dê aos inimigos qualquer ouro adicional.  

(8) Vá Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para obter potência consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Bard e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Como já mencionado, todo o objetivo de Bard é essencialmente jogar em torno de seu time desde o minuto 1. Tente respeitar qualquer uma de suas jogadas quando estiver empurrando sozinho, tente não ser pego por seus engajamentos E ou R, tente utilizar sua liderança quando se trata de lutas posteriores. Se você tiver cultivado o suficiente, provavelmente será capaz de controlar e dominar a maioria das lutas. Simplesmente ignore o foco de Bard, concentre-se em seus carregadores e tente assassiná-los no jogo. Bard realmente não pode fazer muito sem membros da equipe, então certifique-se de tirar esses recursos dele. Alternativamente, evite que seu time fique isolado, pois Bard pode facilmente engage com seu R e criar oportunidades de captura, tente evitar essa situação o máximo que puder, caso contrário o time dele será capaz de atingir objetivos e deixar você como um jogador a menos.

videoTitle: HE MASTERED THE FORGOTTEN CHAMPION! RANK 1 BEL'VETH IN KR
summaryEn: Bel'Veth is a completely giant grief pick into Renekton, as her poor ability to handle Renekton results in her getting hard snowballed through most stages of the game. Bel'Veth needs kills or jungle camps to scale with her kit, which is hard for her to obtain in solo lane and this style of match up. Renekton can easily fight her by forcing fights on Bel'Veth when she has CDs on her opposite Q indicators, forcing her to stay in melee range and die to Renekton. Try to also deny Bel'Veth from getting top side objectives, as these can provide her a giant powerspike within the game.

Bel'Veth precisa de mortes ou acampamentos na selva para escalar com seu kit, o que é difícil para ela obter na rota solo e neste estilo de confronto. Renekton pode facilmente lutar contra ela forçando lutas em Bel'Veth quando ela tem CDs em seus indicadores Q opostos, forçando-a a permanecer no alcance corpo a corpo e morrer para Renekton. Tente também negar a Bel'Veth a obtenção de objetivos secundários superiores, pois estes podem fornecer a ela um powerspike gigante dentro do jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Bel’Veth you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Bel’Veth lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Abuse Bel’veth Q - Bel’veth’s Q works by her being able to dash into 4 different directions. Her Q against Renekton is most typically used as an escape tool away from him, however Renekton can easily catch up to Bel’veth with his E’s. Most typically, Bel’Veth will try to farm or trade with 2 forward Q’s, then instantly dash away. Once it goes on CD, you can choose to abuse any combos on her as she will have no way to escape, leaving her a sitting duck to the slaughter. 

(5) Avoid Combo’ing Into Bel’Veth W - Her W ability is the only strong tool into dealing with Renekton. While Bel’veth doesn’t really possess any strengths towards fighting Renekton, her W can block from 35% to 55% damage making it a strong tool to lower Renekton’s DPS. There’s two ways to deal with Bel’Veth W, firstly if you’re trying to all in Bel’Veth, you can hold your W till her W wears off, allowing you to burst her down right after with W. Another way is that if you’re low or you’re trying to save an allied teammate, then you can use W to instantly cancel her W activation to stop her from dealing damage. Use your W wisely and hold any additional damage until after her W. 

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Prevent Bel’veth Obtaining Topside Objectives - Bel’veth is one of the most unique champions in the game, as her obtaining objectives such as Grubs, Herald and Baron, all synergise her passive of getting additional attack speed from her passive, as much as also giving her free R stacks and additional buffs, which overall help with side lane pushing and providing even combat stats for 1v1. With your early advantage try to utilise it to the max by playing off your team to neutralise her receiving these objectives, doing this will make her even more useless and more of a troll pick.

(8) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 


(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Bel’Veth at this stage in the game as a top lane pick won’t naturally be as strong as she is when she’s played in the jungle, who consistently has access to farm her stacks through jungle camps. With that said, Bel’Veth shouldn’t be nearly as strong as she is so take advantage of that by using your core strength to dominate teamfights. Make sure to play to one shot her carries, or alternatively try to lock her down instantly and allow your team to nuke her out of the fights. Her overall strength will be decided on whether or not she obtained top side objectives, so make sure she was not able to obtain them to truly win the game with ease.

videoTitle: Renekton vs Blitzcrank Top - Ancien Top 800 avec Renekton
summaryEn: Blitzcrank has no chance at beating Renekton, due to Renekton's high stats and consistent amount of damage. Blitzcrank's slow animations and high mana costs prevent Blitzcrank from having any winning exchanges, making it a complete troll pick. Whenever you keep the wave on your side, Blitzcrank is only forced to overextend, forcing him to die any moment you engage on him.  The only strength Blitzcrank has, is that he will try to roam and find picks with his team. With that said, try to avoid getting grabbed and try to take fights when you're grouped with your team.
summaryPt: Blitzcrank não tem chance de derrotar Renekton, devido às altas stats de Renekton e à quantidade consistente de danos. As animações lentas e os altos custos de mana de Blitzcrank impedem que Blitzcrank tenha qualquer troca vencedora, tornando-o uma escolha de troll completa. Sempre que você mantém o wave ao seu lado, Blitzcrank só é forçado a se estender demais, forçando-o a morrer a qualquer momento que você engage estiver nele.  A única força que Blitzcrank tem é que ele tentará roam e encontrará escolhas com sua equipe. Com isso dito, evite ser agarrado e tente brigar quando estiver agrupado com seu time.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Blitzcrank Invade - Blitzcrank’s only real early leverage to gaining a lead over Renekton, is simply looking for an invade play with his team and trying to catch anyone out. Try to ping your teammates level 1 to cover all 5 points of entry on your side of the map, as doing this will deny any attempts for him to force an invade on vision. DO NOT AFK level 1 too, if Blitz is behind you don’t be afraid to use flash or skill E to avoid his hook and waste his flash. 

(2) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Blitzcrank you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Blitzcrank lose a lot more. 

(4) Play For Manaburn - The main problem with Blitzcrank solo lane is that he needs to force mana items to make him useful, therefore losing a lot of damage from his AP or AD builds. Simply try to do heavy trades and force him to use mana from his E and Q. His damage is nowhere close to scary so forcing any trades onto him will leave him in a panic, which will use him expend a lot of mana to save himself. Abuse his low mana to force advantageous positions of proxying, diving or forcing resets. 

(5) Respect Mana Passive - Blitzcrank’s mana passive can be pretty surprising in 1v1’s, typically whenever Blitz opts into more mana he can also create a giant shield for himself. Whenever Blitz is low, you can aim to hold your empowered W or use your next empowered W to completely shred Blitz shield and instantly nuke him to death. 

(6) Abuse Renekton's Waveclear - A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game. 

(7) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(8) Ping Blitzcrank Roams - Blitzcrank essentially cannot do anything in the Renekton match up, no matter how he plays it he will always be at a disadvantage. Instead Blitzcrank’s only play making opportunity will come from his roams and teamplay actions. Try to ping Blizcrank’s roams as much as you can, try to always ping your team from walking into fog of war, otherwise it will present Blitzcrank free picks and the ability to come back in the game. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - Blitzcrank’s mid to late game objective is essentially to look for Q grab plays, in order for his team to look for picks then look for the ability to force objectives or pushes onto his opposing team. With that said, try to avoid Blitzcrank Q as much as possible (Especially Isolated or walking into fog of war) as these can really change the tides of the game and allow his team to get even more ahead or to comeback. When directly in a fight, try to ignore Blitzcrank and force your engages onto his team. Killing his carries will present Blitz with less opportunities for plays.

videoTitle: BRAND vs RENEKTON (TOP) | KR Grandmaster | 26.10
summaryEn: Brand is a relatively easy match up to have access onto, with his only main strength being his combo based damage if he's able to land his abiltiies. Renekton can easily jump onto Brand at will, allowing him to easily burst him down and kill him within 1 or 2 trades. When playing into Brand, try to avoid his W damage, as well as looking to avoid his Q stun. You can avoid Brand Q by using your E creatively to bait it out, or side step when walking towards him, providing you the kill windows needed to kill Brand. When it comes to teamfights, try to avoid clumping up into Brand's potential R usage. If Brand does R you, try to reposition away from any teammates, as you're able to deny his R from doing any bonus damage or applying his blaze passive.
summaryPt: Brand é um confronto relativamente fácil de se ter acesso, com sua única força principal sendo o dano baseado em combo se ele conseguir acertar suas habilidades. Renekton pode facilmente pular em Brand à vontade, permitindo-lhe facilmente burst derrubá-lo e matá-lo em 1 ou 2 trocas. Ao jogar em Brand, tente evitar o dano do W, bem como evite o atordoamento do Q. Você pode evitar Brand Q usando seu E de forma criativa para atraí-lo, ou dar um passo para o lado ao caminhar em direção a ele, fornecendo as janelas de eliminação necessárias para matar Brand. Quando se trata de teamfights, evite se aglomerar no uso potencial de R de Brand. Se Brand causar R em você, tente se reposicionar longe de qualquer companheiro de equipe, pois você pode impedir que seu R cause qualquer dano bônus ou aplique seu passivo de chama.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Brand's Damage can most certainly be very annoying within most parts of the game, especially combined with Renekton's low magic resist. To combat Brand’s early poke damage, make sure to abuse D Shield + Second Wind to soak up his overall damage, allowing you to combo more effectively and lower his overall lane presence. 

(2) Respect Brand's Blaze Combo - The way his passive works is that if he lands one ability he applies his blaze passive, which empowers his next ability. Most often Brand will E to easily apply blaze, then he will Q > W. Respect his combo to remove the leverage and advantage Brand can gain within the lane. 

(3) Dodge His Stun - Once Brand E's he will most likely look to Q if there's nothing blocking it, with that we can dash to the side or try to double dash over him if the opportunity is there. If he misses you can look to heavy trade and heavily abuse the Brand pick. The more damage you have the easier it is to kill him too. 

(4) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.  

(5) Respect His R - Brand R is an annoyingly frustrating ability that can change any skirmish or teamfight, so make sure to drag it away if brand R hits. Also Understand He can cheese in bushes and try to full combo onto you or your team. Play for vision and don't give him that opportunity to land. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Rush Mercury Treads - Rushing Mercury is a giant advantage against Brand as you’re easily able to tank his CC duration, as well as the fact you lower a ton of his overall damage. Another underrated aspect is the movement speed, which also allows you to easily manoeuvre against his abilities and presents an easier time in dealing with Brand. 

(8) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Hexdrinker to lower Brand’s overall damage and have a MR shield / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Brand's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfight Tips - As already mentioned, Brand’s overall objective will be trying to get a maximum value R in a teamfight, which ultimately leads into cataclysmic circumstances if you play into it. Within teamfights try to hard burst him before he gets into a position to land his AoE R. Try to hard burst him first if he tries to get into range of your team, or alternatively try to tank the R he lands and reposition away from your team. Doing this simply means he loses out on a ton of damage for his team overall presenting you with the ability to easily win and shut him down.

(6) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(7) Rush Mercury Treads - Rushing Mercury é uma grande vantagem contra Brand, pois você é facilmente capaz de aguentar sua duração de CC, bem como o fato de reduzir uma tonelada de seu dano geral. Outro aspecto subestimado é a velocidade de movimento, que também permite manobrar facilmente contra suas habilidades e apresenta maior facilidade para lidar com Brand. 

(8) Construa Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Hexdrinker para diminuir o dano geral de Brand e tenha um escudo MR / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Brand e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(9) Dicas mid game + teamfight - Como já mencionado, o objetivo geral de Brand será tentar obter um valor máximo de R em um teamfight, o que acabará levando a circunstâncias cataclísmicas se você entrar nisso. Dentro de teamfights tente com força burst ele antes que ele fique em posição de acertar seu AoE R. tente com força burst ele primeiro se ele tentar entrar no alcance de seu time, ou alternativamente tente tankar o R ​​que ele pousar e se reposicionar longe de seu time. Fazer isso significa simplesmente que ele perde muitos danos para sua equipe em geral, apresentando a você a capacidade de vencê-lo e derrubá-lo facilmente.

videoTitle: Renekton Support vs Braum - KR Master Patch 26.14
summaryEn: Braum is practically a free match up, as Braum's inability to have damage to fight Renekton essentially makes it a complete auto lose match up for him. While Braum cannot do anything aggressive, defensive Braum is very hard to kill with his shield and E resistances, forcing him to stone wall various situations within the lane. Instead, Renekton can use his strong wave clearing ability to help him crash waves on demand, as well as being able to proxy behind Braum's tower. Proxying allows Renekton to set up tempo advantages through various situations of the game, as well as giving him the ability to kill Braum's jungler. Do note that fighting 1v2 can be tricky, as Braum's passive and R can be used to CC lock Renekton out of fights. With that said, take the right winning fights, as well as using your general advantage to dominate top lane and the rest of the map.

If Braum doesn’t have HoB, you can simply start Q and just look to bully him with Q and look for push, to easily ensure a lead over him.

(2) Respect His Defensive Abilities - Braum's defensive abilities can leave him a bit tricky to kill at points, mainly due to the fact his W gives quite a bit of armour and his E can reduce your damage from 35% to 55%. Try to play for short combos without your E to bait out his abilities, or try to fight Braum behind his shield so your damage won't be reduced. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Waveclear - A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game. 

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler 

(6) Respect Braum's Teamplay - Braum's only real strength within the game is using his kit to help his team. His passive stun, his line up knock up and defensive abilities all triumph over Renekton's ability to peel and protect. Your objective instead is to not let Braum get picks or to pick you off with his jungler. Avoid his Q slow, and use dashes to dash out the way of his R to avoid being caught. 

(7) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

The main difficulty vs a Braum is just how annoying he is at protecting carries. Try to avoid being hit by his passive procs from his auto attacks, Q and R. The main thing Renekton can do is simply go in while Braum is focused on somebody else, quickly utilise your flash combos on his protected target and go for a one shot play. Once Braum's carries are dead you can simply move onto his other targets and finish him off when he is the last one alive.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Briar - KR Master Patch 13.22
summaryEn: Renekton brute force strength and general control, allows him to completely dominate this match up if he plays it optimally. When playing vs Briar, try not to take long trades into her passive and general ability up times as her damage is stronger pre 6. When you have your abilties, use short trades to burst her down and disengage with your dashes. Rushing Executioner's is vital to lowering her overall healing, allowing you to completely stat check and beat her with ease. Briar cannot really do much once Renekton is ahead, however try to avoid walking into her R or fighting around multiple people with her R aiming at you. Briar R allows her to enhance her ability to beat Renekton in fights, as well as giving her teammates the damage needed to shut her down. Try to also ping Briar's R when your teammates are overextending, as this allows you to deny your teammates throwing over their leads to Briar.
summaryPt: Renekton força bruta e controle geral, permitem que ele domine completamente este confronto se ele jogar de forma otimizada. Ao jogar contra Briar, tente não fazer trocas longas em seus tempos de aumento de habilidade passiva e geral, pois seu dano é mais forte antes de 6. Quando você tiver suas habilidades, use trocas curtas para burst ela para baixo e disengage com seus ataques. Rushing Executioner é vital para diminuir sua cura geral, permitindo que você stat check completamente e derrote-o com facilidade. Briar realmente não pode fazer muito quando Renekton está à frente, no entanto, evite entrar no R dela ou brigar perto de várias pessoas com o R dela apontando para você. Briar R permite que ela melhore sua habilidade de vencer Renekton em lutas, além de dar a seus companheiros o dano necessário para desligá-la. Tente também executar ping no R de Briar quando seus companheiros de equipe estão estendendo demais, pois isso permite que você evite que seus companheiros de equipe joguem suas lideranças para Briar.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Her Early Power - Briar's Strength's come from long trades and being able to utilize her W, once she W she will stat check any longer than necessary trades. Best thing to do is if she starts W, you can start W to quickly proc your damage then walk away from the fight. By Level 3, try to go for fast combos and disengage before the fight goes long. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Briar you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Briar lose a lot more.

(3) Respect Her Passive - Briar's surprising amount of damage also comes from her bleed passive, which can stack up to 9x while also providing her additional healing the more stacks she has onto you. The gameplan is to maintain short trades and prevent her from being able to heal against you. Buy Executioners if you need, or try to play for short trades and respect her power. 

(4) Respect Her E - Her E is the only basic ability that can really leverage her winning the fight into Renekton. Briar can either start the fight with E if Renekton engages with E, or she can use it towards the middle or end of her combo to end her W. Her E provides damage reduction, so if you're able to hold off any additional damage until she uses it, you will end up saving your abilities to burst her down right after, or before she uses the ability. Also make sure not to stand near walls so she deals less damage. 

(5) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Avoid Briar R - Her R is the biggest tool in being able to completely BS a fight. If you get hit by R, her abilities and stats are amplified, allowing her to win most 1v1s in the entire game. Avoid being hit by R at all times, make sure to also use your E to avoid it and make sure you're constantly looking around yourself. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) Build Executioners, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Executioners to lower Briar's overall healing power / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.  

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - At this stage you're most likely able to side lane vs her and kill her at will. Make sure to take the right fights, don't get caught by her R or her team's rotations, as her lockdown can be crazy in combination with her teammates. Within teamfights try to avoid her R at all costs, even if one of your teammates gets hit by it, that can severely damage your chances of winning a team fight. The way to play these stages of the game, is try to bait her R to where she misses it, then follow up with a more committed teamfight where she has no R. In terms of navigating the fight, try to one shot her first if she's trying to jump on your team. Once she is out of the way you can play front to back more effectively and win vs her team.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite seu poder inicial - A força de Briar vem de longas trocas e da capacidade de utilizar seu W, uma vez que ela W ela irá stat check por mais tempo do que as trocas necessárias. A melhor coisa a fazer é se ela começar com W, você pode começar com W para processar rapidamente seu dano e depois sair da luta. Por level 3, tente fazer combos rápidos e disengage antes que a luta seja longa. 

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Briar, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Briar perca muito mais.

(3) Respeite sua passiva - a quantidade surpreendente de dano de Briar também vem de sua passiva de sangramento, que pode acumular até 9x, ao mesmo tempo que fornece cura adicional quanto mais pilhas ela tiver sobre você. O plano de jogo é manter trocas curtas e evitar que ela consiga Heal contra você. Compre Carrascos se precisar, ou tente jogar trocas curtas e respeite o poder dela. 

(4) Respeite o E dela - O E dela é a única habilidade básica que pode realmente alavancar a vitória dela na luta até Renekton. Briar pode começar a luta com E se Renekton se envolver com E, ou ela pode usá-lo no meio ou no final de seu combo para encerrar seu W. Seu E fornece redução de dano, então se você for capaz de evitar qualquer dano adicional até que ela o use, você acabará salvando suas habilidades para burst ela logo depois, ou antes que ela use a habilidade. Certifique-se também de não ficar perto das paredes para que ela cause menos danos. 

(5) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(6) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(7) Evite Briar R - O R dela é a maior ferramenta para ser capaz de BS completamente uma luta. Se você for atingido por R, suas habilidades e stats serão amplificadas, permitindo que ela vença a maioria dos 1v1s em todo o jogo. Evite ser atingido por R o tempo todo, certifique-se de usar também seu E para evitá-lo e certifique-se de estar constantemente olhando ao seu redor. 

(8) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(9) Construir Executores, Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Executores para diminuir o poder de cura geral de Briar / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.  

(10) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - Neste estágio, você provavelmente será capaz de sair da rota lateral contra ela e matá-la à vontade. Certifique-se de fazer as lutas certas, não seja pego pelo R dela ou pelas rotações de sua equipe, pois seu bloqueio pode ser uma loucura em combinação com seus companheiros de equipe. Dentro de teamfights tente evitar o R ​​dela a todo custo, mesmo que um de seus companheiros de equipe seja atingido por ele, isso pode prejudicar gravemente suas chances de vencer uma luta em equipe. A maneira de jogar essas fases do jogo é tentar atrair seu R para onde ela erra e, em seguida, seguir com um teamfight mais comprometido onde ela não tem R. Em termos de navegação na luta, tente one-shot nela primeiro se ela estiver tentando pular em seu time. Depois que ela estiver fora do caminho, você poderá jogar de frente para trás com mais eficácia e vencer o time dela.

summaryEn: Caitlyn's early oppression and range can lead to Renekton having a harder time to find his damage and kill angles onto Caitlyn. Renekton's gameplan early into Cait, should be taking Doran's Shield and Second Wind, allowing him to sustain against her damage, as well as rushing Plated Steelcaps to help provide him the utility to tank her damage and create additional kill windows to run her down the lane. summaryPt: A opressão e o alcance iniciais de Caitlyn podem fazer com que Renekton tenha mais dificuldade para encontrar seu dano e ângulos de morte em Caitlyn. Dentro do mid game, o dano de Caitlyn aumentará lentamente até que ela alcance seus itens late game, fornecendo a Renekton uma janela no jogo para forçar suas forças naturais a ajudar a vencer skirmishes e teamfights.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Caitlyn as a pick is very unusual as a top laner, however her kit is relatively pretty decent in poking down Renekton and keeping him at bay with her abilities. Early on in the laning phase, try to utilise the bushes to avoid Caitlyn’s range early with the intention of trying to keep your HP up the entire time. Utilise D Shield and Second Wind to survive her early poke and play to over power Cait with your Plated Steelcaps and R powerspikes. 

(2) Play For Mana Burn - This matchup is very difficult with how high range and oppressive caitlyn is. To secure kills early, you need to burn her mana out, which then follows up to the ability to kill her by yourself or with your own jungler. By trying to initiate with E in the lane, you can play to bait out her E and traps, with the intention of using E2 to reset and burn her mana. Eventually this will stack up and present you an easier time to combo onto her, or present you the ability to kill her.

(3) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash 

(4) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Rushing Plated Steelcaps into Caitlyn will essentially allow you to counter her pick and provide you an easier time to deal with her. Utilising the armour and on hit passive will completely cut Caitlyn’s ability to have poke you down effectively, or have the damage to over throw Renekton. Once having boots try to play more aggressively and look to play for kills when the wave is on your side of the map.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Play For Ganks - Her kit is almost tailored made early to deny Renekton from his strengths, however Renekton's gank setup is what can easily obtain kills on Caitlyn. Try to spam ping assistance to help you receive a gank, to take advantage of Caitlyn's low mobility and squishy stats. If you’re able to burn Caitlyn’s flash, you may be able to dive her or present yourself the overall opportunity to solo kill her.

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Caitlyn’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting TIps - Once you get into the mid game, Caitlyn’s mid game is generally a lot weaker than her early or late game stages are, due to the fact her item prices cost a lot and overall she needs to have a solid early game to really make use of a good mid game. With that said, try to abuse Caitlyn’s downtime power by using Renekton’s advantage over taking objectives and trying to force plays. Renekton generally will be able to have a much easier time into her potential team comp, due to the Caitlyn pick losing out the defensive frontlining abilities a team comp like hers would need. Mid game will be your total advantage, building items like Randuin's Omen to nullify crit damage as well as mobility will be giant in being able to soak up damage and carry off this role alone.
detailedNotesRawPt:

No início da fase de rotas (laning phase), tente utilizar os arbustos para evitar o alcance de Caitlyn no início, com a intenção de tentar manter seu HP alto o tempo todo. Utilize D Shield e Second Wind para sobreviver ao seu poke inicial e jogue para dominar Cait com seu Plated Steelcaps e R powerspikes. 

(2) Play For Mana Burn - Este confronto é muito difícil com o quão alto e opressivo é o Caitlyn. Para garantir mortes precoces, você precisa queimar a mana dela, o que então resulta na capacidade de matá-la sozinho ou com seu próprio caçador. Ao tentar iniciar com E na rota, você pode jogar para atrair seu E e armadilhas, com a intenção de usar E2 para redefinir e queimar sua mana. Eventualmente, isso se acumulará e proporcionará a você um momento mais fácil de fazer um combo contra ela, ou lhe dará a capacidade de matá-la.

(3) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash 

(4) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Rush Plated Steelcaps em Caitlyn essencialmente permitirá que você contra-ataque a escolha dela e lhe proporcionará um momento mais fácil para lidar com ela. Utilizar a armadura e o passivo on-hit cortará completamente a capacidade de Caitlyn de derrubar você poke de forma eficaz, ou terá o dano de arremesso excessivo Renekton. Depois de ter botas, tente jogar de forma mais agressiva e procure jogar para matar quando o wave estiver do seu lado do mapa.

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Jogue por ganks - O kit dela é quase feito sob medida para negar Renekton seus pontos fortes, no entanto, a configuração gank de Renekton é o que pode facilmente obter mortes em Caitlyn. tente spam ping assistência para ajudá-lo a receber um gank, para aproveitar a baixa mobilidade e as stats frágeis de Caitlyn. Se você for capaz de queimar o Flash de Caitlyn, você poderá dive ela ou apresentar a si mesmo a oportunidade geral de matá-la sozinho.

(7) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base e stats de seu R de Renekton permitem que Renekton stat check completamente seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Caitlyn e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(9) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - Depois de entrar no mid game, o mid game de Caitlyn é geralmente muito mais fraco do que seus estágios iniciais ou late game, devido ao fato de que os preços dos itens custam muito e, no geral, ela precisa ter um early game sólido para realmente fazer uso de um bom mid game. Com isso dito, tente abusar do poder de inatividade de Caitlyn usando a vantagem de Renekton em relação a atingir objetivos e tentar jogos de força. Renekton geralmente será capaz de ter muito mais facilidade em sua composição de equipe em potencial, devido à escolha de Caitlyn perder as habilidades defensivas de linha de frente que uma composição de equipe como a dela precisaria. mid game será sua vantagem total, construir itens como Randuin's Omen para anular dano crítico e também mobilidade será gigante para ser capaz de absorver danos e desempenhar essa função sozinho.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Camille - KR Challenger Patch 26.05
summaryEn: Camille's early game is substantially weaker within the early stages of the game, providing Renekton the ability to easily stat check and snowball on her if played correctly. When laning vs Camille early, try to avoid taking trades with her shield up, instead play around your empowered W and instantly nuke her passive shield when she walks up. If Camille has boneplating, try to auto attack her before fully comitting with an empowered W. When laning vs Camile, try to also stay out of W range to prevent her poking and sustaining, this can easily be done with good movement to weave in and out of range. Try to also avoid standing near any walls, as this can easily allow her to engage of disengage, keep the wave in the middle of the lane or try to fight her while she is stun in her W animation. Renekton can also cancel her E if she tries to disengage, so make sure to use your W when she's in her E2 travelling animation. Within the mid game, try to use your early game lead to help you brute force winning fights into objectives before Camille scales into the rest of the game. Try to also avoid being caught solo by Camille and her team, as she's able to easily pick up kills and snowball them into a lead.

Se Camille tiver boneplating, tente auto attack ela antes de se comprometer totalmente com um Empowered W. Ao laning vs Camile, tente também ficar fora do alcance do W para evitar seu poking e sustentação, isso pode ser feito facilmente com um bom movimento para entrar e sair do alcance. Tente também evitar ficar perto de qualquer parede, pois isso pode facilmente permitir que ela engage de disengage, mantenha o wave no meio da pista ou tente lutar com ela enquanto ela está atordoada em sua animação W. Renekton também pode cancelar seu E se tentar disengage, então certifique-se de usar seu W quando ela estiver em sua animação de viagem E2. Dentro do mid game, tente usar seu lead early game para ajudá-lo a vencer lutas com força bruta em objetivos antes que Camille se expanda para o resto do jogo. Tente também evitar ser pega sozinha por Camille e sua equipe, já que ela é capaz de matar facilmente e snowball colocá-los na liderança.

From Level 1, try not to engage fighting Camille with her passive or Q up, instead play off your Q poke and look to abuse your wave clear to reach level 2 before her. (1) Play For Sustain Early - Within the Renekton vs Cassiopeia match up, Renekton simply needs to play to keep his HP up within the start of the laning phase, with his overall objective simply trying to get level 3 or his first back to overall assert dominance with the laning phase. Try to play around D Shield and Second Wind to maintain sustain within the laning phase, try to also avoid tanking Cassio Q’s to avoid her empowered E and poison trades.

(2) Respect Cassio’s Q - When Cassio hits her Q, she is able to obtain a burst of movement speed, additional damage with her E and she is able to heal from her target. With that said, it is absolutely vital to utilise your movement to bait out her Q’s and use your dashes to avoid her receiving any additional damage. You can potentially try to bait out Cassio Q by doing short clicks in and out, or trying to walk up to minions then walking back. These little subtleties can help you find trading patterns to help you abuse her.

(3) Rush Hexdrinker or Mercury Treads - Personally this depends overall, but if you’re worried about Cassio’s damage and the way you’re playing, then going either is a pretty good option to help you survive within the match up. I like to opt more into Eclipse rush personally, but as mentioned this is just if you feel the lane isn’t going your way.

(4) Avoid And Punish Cassio’s W - Cassiopeia’s W is considered to be one of the worst abilities to play around as Renekton, mainly due to the reason she can completely lock you out from being able to dash. As Renekton, we can cheese her W by baiting it out with our dashes, where we can easily E in and quickly E out, with the intention of putting it on its 24 second CD. After W is on CD, we can look to abuse it within its downtime to look for kill attempts. 

(5) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 
Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Corki you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Corki lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Corki’s Damage - Corki doesn’t have the most oppressive laning phase, however his poke can be something as he can easily access his damage on to you within the lane. Try to abuse D Shield and Second Wind to help you out sustain his low to medium damage, and try to avoid tanking his autos and E damage as those are his main sources of damage. 

(4) Play Around Corki’s W - Corki’s W is 20 seconds on his rank 1 cooldown, making it 4 seconds shorter than Renekton’s E. Abusing this window timer to set up kills is crucial, as your next E trade will not allow him to disengage from your damage within the lane. Try to also time your ganks around baiting his W out, as this will make him a very easy and gankable target for Renekton.

(5) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Respect Corki’s Scaling - Corki’s overall damage scaling within the match up does massively ramp up, through the main reason of him getting Triforce and Manamune. As Corki’s early game is substantially weaker, you can try to abuse your early game to abuse his late scaling playstyle. Use your map rotations and overall lead to help you and your teammates close the game out as soon as he can scale in the game.

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Corki’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - As previously mentioned, as Renekton we want to make sure we can hard abuse our early to mid game presence, to help us create the win conditions we need before Corki scales into the game. Once Corki gets his main items, he will be able to dish out a ton of burst damage, making him a threatening target. As Renekton, we want to try and always focus him and shut him down within the fights, otherwise his utility from his E can make it difficult alongside other AD champions within the game. Alternatively, if Corki is mega behind we can just aim to focus other priority carries.

summaryEn: The Darius match ups if favoured towards Renekton in higher MMR, however Darius essentially must lead the dance in Renekton being able to find his right openings. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Darius Bush Cheese - Darius level 1 is a lot stronger than Renekton, allowing him to utilise bush cheeses in combination with W/E start and ghost, to help him run down and kill his opponents with his passive. From level 1 we want to try and mitigate or remove these factors from Darius within the following ways: Warding our closest top bush to force minion aggro and spot out Darius, Avoid standing or walking towards pixel bush, and covering our side of the jungle to avoid Darius cheese attempts. If you can do all of these, Darius won’t be able to cover the laning power needed to get an early advantage.

(2) Skill Abilities Accordingly - Darius has a number of ways to utilise his level 1, as he can practically skill every ability under the right circumstance. As good as this is for Darius, Renekton can also do the same and counter him accordingly. It should be noted however, that Renekton shouldn’t start his chosen ability first, as Darius can also counter accordingly. If Darius starts Q, we can also start Q to help us shove the wave and poke him back. If Darius takes W, we can take W or E, to help us trade harder in our damage or reposition away from him (I do recommend E vs W more, as if he has boneplating, we won’t be able to squeeze enough damage out to make W worth it). If Darius takes E, we can skill E to either dash instantly away, or use E2 after we try and disengage with E1. In the cases Darius does take E, we can typically know if his only incentive is to run past the wave and force a fight onto us, which in this case we can just try to avoid fighting and wait till the wave crashes. 

(3) Respect Darius’s Passive - Darius passive is one of his most important skill elements when it comes to the match up, as playing around his passive will provide all the success you need to consistently dominate the match up. Darius passive allows him to get up towards 200+ AD later on in the game, on top of also applying a DoT bleed to help out trade us in the fights. With that said, we never want to play to give Darius passive. Utilising our movement, dashes and overall feint playstyle to bait out abilities is absolutely essential for taking away Darius’s main strengths of the match up. Make sure that whenever you’re in a deep fight with Darius that you’re able to space correctly away from him keeping his passive stacks up, as Darius losing his passive stacks can be a giant disadvantage for him being able to win.

(4) Avoid Darius’s Q - Darius Q is another aspect of the match up we need to play around, as hitting his Q can essentially be the decider in being able to win a fight or not. Darius Q provides him with a moderate amount of damage, increasing even more if he lands his outer blade, which applies a free bleed stack and healing based on the amount of champions hit. With all that said, Darius Q packs quite a punch and has so many variables to allow him to outsustain and win a fight, so we need to utilise ways to avoid his Q. Renekton can achieve this by using his movement to bait out Darius Q with short in and out clicks, or the ability to dash into Darius to make him miss all his additional variables. Dashing into Darius isn’t as scary as you think, as Renekton can abuse fast combos to safely get him in and out.

(5) Avoid Overextended Wave States - Darius’s only real kill window is within his ability to run down his opponent within the lane, allowing him to easily obtain this with his use of slows, E pull and ghost activation. As Renekton, we want to always play waves on our side, as we’re able to safely trade into Darius, as much as being able to use enough room to avoid his overall strengths. Make sure to get your jungler to help you shove waves if you have a bad wave state, as this can also be a deciding factor into Darius snowballing.

(6) Respect Darius E - Darius E is another annoying ability, as a poorly timed E from ourselves can be very detrimental for Darius to abuse. Make sure to always use your W before disengaging from Darius, otherwise he will be easily able to pull you within your E animation to prevent you from escaping. As long as you always W to disengage, Darius will never be able to pull you. It should also be said that you can Empowered W and AA right before you disengage to apply more damage onto him.

(7) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) Respect Darius R - In combination with max passive stacks, Darius R can deal a ton of true damage which scales overall with how many stacks he has from a target. Darius can also R execute a low HP target to also quickly gain his passive stacks, always making him a potential danger within the fights. Try your hardest to avoid giving him max stacks, on top of also avoid giving him a free R execute as these can entirely decide a teamfight and 1v1 within the side lane. When fighting against Darius, make sure you always have your R available too, as it will help you easily mitigate against Darius’s overall damage and execution range of his ultimate. 

(10) 3 Points Q > W Max - I find this playstyle vastly great into Darius, due to the reason we can obtain a 7 to 4 second W, which will allow us to easily peel and out damage Darius in a 1v1. Abusing items such as Eclipse and BoTRK can also help us easily abuse W max to an even greater level, always leaving Darius at a total disadvantage. The 3 points Q also helps to provide early wave clear and poke against Darius, allowing us to have the best of all words when it comes to playability. 

(11) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Plated Steelcaps if Darius rushes them to avoid being at a movement speed disadvantage. Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Typically Darius struggles quite hard within the mid to later stages of the game, mainly due to his lack of mobility and his heavy summoner reliance. As Renekton, we can heavily play into Darius’s lack of mobility by utilising our W max playstyle to hard peel against him from our teammates. When it comes to side lane, Renekton can confidently fight Darius if he is even or ahead, as long as you’re playing by the overall match up tips. Making sure you kill Darius from fights is essentially if you want to take away his summoner strengths for team fights, or his overall ability to join the fights to help his team. When teamfighting vs Darius, try to avoid giving him 5 bleed stacks if he is focusing you and try to space away from him till it wears off. If Darius is focusing on an ally, try to hard peel your target with 5 bleed stacks as he is looking to obtain his mass stacks for heavier damage in his overall teamfighting potential.
