videoTitle: (FNC Empyros) Renekton Top vs Elise - EUW Challenger Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Elise being an uncommon laner can be difficult to figure out at first, providing Renekton to play safe early with the intention of reaching level 6 with Mercury Treads and his ultimate power spike. When laning vs Elise, try to take Doran's Shield and Second Wind to help you play into her damage, eventually if Elise over commits on Renekton at level 6, Renekton can double dash behind her to avoid her cacoon, as well using her missed E to force an all in opportunity. Elise through the rest of the game is absolutely useless as a top laner, so make sure to deny her early game strengths to make her useless within the rest of the game.
summaryPt: Elise ser um laner incomum pode ser difícil de descobrir no início, permitindo que Renekton jogue com segurança cedo com a intenção de alcançar level 6 com Mercury Treads e seu pico de poder final. Ao laning vs Elise, tente pegar Doran's Shield e Second Wind para ajudá-lo a aproveitar o dano dela, eventualmente, se Elise cometer over commit em Renekton em level 6, Renekton pode correr duas vezes atrás dela para evitar seu casulo, além de usar seu E perdido para forçar uma oportunidade de all in. Elise durante o resto do jogo é absolutamente inútil como top laner, então certifique-se de negar os pontos fortes de early game para torná-la inútil no resto do jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Elise's as a laner is pretty underrated when it comes to how strong and annoying her early game actually is. Elise’s poke pattern relies on playing Grasp with the intention of trying to poke and collect grasp stacks switching forms into her spider form. This can be incredibly annoying with how cheesy this, so make sure to avoid any grasp and auto attack damage using the bushes, as well as also using D Shield and Second WInd to help you nullify and survive against her damage.

(2) Dodge Elise’s E - Whenever you try to engage Elise's natural instinct is to stun you into her disengaging with spider form. The trick to getting her to miss Cacoon, is trying to surprise her with your E to bait it out. You can E close to her Q > E out, this can bait out her cocoon allowing you to burn her mana for free. Another way is double dashing through her, which will make her miss her E while you're dashing past her, this gives you a free all in window to fight her and potentially kill her. 

(3) Rush Mercury Treads - Rushing Mercury Treads is a giant power play into this playstyle, as all her damage relies entirely off AP, as well as the fact the tenacity easily helps you escape her cocoon in case you’re hit by it. Overall, rushing this will present you with a much easier time dealing with her early strengths within the game, allowing you to easily outscale and surpass Elise as a top lane pick. 

(4) Play For Manaburn - The main objective for the early game is trying to keep your HP up, while trying to abuse quick combos to make her waste her mana. Eventually Elise won’t be able to keep sustaining damage against Renekton due to his heavy sustain based playstyle, preventing Elise from utilising her abilities in her ranged form, forcing her into her melee form, presenting Renekton a much easier time in fighting. 

(5) Play Around Elise Repel - Once you’re able to reach Elise, Elise may be able to switch form and look to panic E away onto a target. Make sure when you’re fighting Elise, try to cut off any path of escape she has by dashing on her side of the map, or angling your position to leave Elise within a vulnerable position within the lane.

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Elise’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(9) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - When it comes to midgame vs Elise, this is essentially Renekton's element within the matchup, as Renekton's pure skirmishing and teamfighting tools through his naturally tanky and high damage kit allow him to reign supreme as the better top lane pick compared to Elise. In side lane Renekton will have the power to always win an all in's vs Elise, as well as also being able to shove waves with ease to out tempo and setup flanks. The only main threat Elise has is playing the fog of war game, make sure your team doesn't go alone vs Elise hiding in bushes, otherwise she will pick off your team with her cocoon setups. Try to walk with your team to gain vision, in fights try to peel your allies off Elise jumping onto your win condition, or try to one shot the enemy carries before Elise is able to do anything.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Jogue For Sustain Early - Elise como laner é bastante subestimado quando se trata de quão forte e irritante seu early game realmente é. O padrão poke de Elise depende de jogar Grasp com a intenção de tentar poke e coletar pilhas de Grasp trocando de forma para sua forma de aranha. Isso pode ser incrivelmente irritante com o quão cafona isso é, então certifique-se de evitar qualquer dano de Grasp e auto attack usando os arbustos, bem como também use D Shield e Second Wind para ajudá-lo a anular e sobreviver contra seus danos.

(2) Esquivar-se do E de Elise - Sempre que você tentar engage, o instinto natural de Elise é atordoá-lo e fazê-la se libertar da forma de aranha. O truque para fazer com que ela sinta falta de Cacoon é tentar surpreendê-la com seu E para atraí-la. Você pode usar E perto de seu Q> E, isso pode atrair seu casulo, permitindo que você queime sua mana de graça. Outra maneira é correr duas vezes através dela, o que fará com que ela perca seu E enquanto você passa por ela, isso lhe dá uma janela all in grátis para lutar contra ela e potencialmente matá-la. 

(3) Rush Mercury Treads - Rushing Mercury Treads é um jogo de poder gigante neste estilo de jogo, já que todo o seu dano depende inteiramente do AP, bem como o fato de que a tenacidade facilmente ajuda você a escapar de seu casulo caso seja atingido por ele. No geral, apressar isso lhe dará muito mais facilidade para lidar com seus pontos fortes iniciais no jogo, permitindo que você melhore facilmente e supere Elise como uma escolha de rota superior. 

(4) Play For Manaburn - O objetivo principal do early game é tentar manter seu HP alto, enquanto tenta abusar de combos rápidos para fazê-lo desperdiçar mana. Eventualmente, Elise não será capaz de continuar sofrendo danos contra Renekton devido ao seu estilo de jogo baseado em sustentação pesada, impedindo Elise de utilizar suas habilidades em sua forma de longo alcance, forçando-a a entrar em sua forma corpo a corpo, apresentando Renekton um tempo muito mais fácil na luta. 

(5) Brincar com Elise Repel - Assim que você conseguir alcançar Elise, Elise poderá mudar de forma e causar pânico E em direção a um alvo. Certifique-se de que, quando estiver lutando contra Elise, tente cortar qualquer caminho de fuga que ela tenha, correndo para o lado dela do mapa ou inclinando sua posição para deixar Elise em uma posição vulnerável dentro da pista.

(6) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(7) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base de Renekton e as stats de seu R permitem que Renekton stat check complete seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

(8) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Elise e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

(9) Dicas de meio de jogo + teamfighting - Quando se trata de meio de jogo vs Elise, este é essencialmente o elemento de Renekton dentro do confronto, já que as escaramuças puras de Renekton e as ferramentas de teamfighting através de seu kit naturalmente tank e de alto dano permitem que ele reine supremo como a melhor escolha da rota superior em comparação com Elise. Na rota lateral, Renekton terá o poder de sempre vencer um all in contra Elise, além de ser capaz de empurrar waves com facilidade para diminuir o ritmo e configurar os flancos. A única ameaça principal que Elise tem é jogar o jogo da névoa de guerra, certifique-se de que seu time não vá sozinho contra Elise se escondendo em arbustos, caso contrário ela irá abater seu time com suas configurações de casulo. tente caminhar com sua equipe para ganhar visão, em lutas tente peel seus aliados Elise saltando para sua condição de vitória, ou tente one-shot que o inimigo carregue antes que Elise seja capaz de fazer qualquer coisa.

videoTitle: Renekton vs Evelynn One for All Epic Moments#1
summaryEn: Evenlynn's only strength as a top laner revolves around her level 1, where Evenylnn can force a Q trade on repeat to get Renekton low to help force her a kill. If Renekton avoids hard trading into Evelynn Level 1, Renekton can hard burst and chunk Evelynn each chance he gets to jump on her. When fighting Evelynn, try to avoid taking her charm damage as it amplifies the rest of her damage onto her target. When you're low, try to also avoid fighting or getting caught by her R, as it provides execution damage to instantly kill you before you're able to ult. Evelynn doesn't really have the pure strength to beat Renekton outside of him messing up, so make sure to always keep healthy and play optimally around her W CD. Once Evelynn is level 6, try to spam ping your laners of her missing whereabouts to avoid giving her free kills. Later on in the game, make sure to have red trinket to help easily spot her out in fights, providing you a free window to easily kill her or force her to R out of fights.
summaryPt: A única força de Evenlynn como top laner gira em torno de seu level 1, onde Evenylnn pode forçar uma Q troca repetida para obter Renekton baixo para ajudar a forçá-la a matar. Se Renekton evita trocas difíceis em Evelynn level 1, Renekton pode fazer burst forte e fragmentar Evelynn cada chance que tiver de pular sobre ela. Ao lutar contra Evelynn, evite sofrer dano de charme, pois isso amplifica o resto do dano em seu alvo. Quando você estiver baixo, tente também evitar lutar ou ser pego por seu R, pois ele fornece dano de execução para matá-lo instantaneamente antes que você possa usar o ult. Evelynn realmente não tem força pura para vencer Renekton fora ele estragando tudo, então certifique-se de sempre se manter saudável e jogar de forma otimizada perto de seu W CD. Assim que Evelynn for level 6, tente enviar spam para seus laners sobre o paradeiro desaparecido dela para evitar matá-la gratuitamente. Mais tarde no jogo, certifique-se de ter uma bugiganga vermelha para ajudar a identificá-la facilmente nas lutas, fornecendo a você uma janela livre para matá-la facilmente ou forçá-la a sair das lutas.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Evelynn’s Level 1 - This is by far one of Renekton's easiest matchups, however her Level 1 is actually really crazy. Renekton's weak level 1 means Evelynn will look to exploit it by cheesing with bushes and spamming her Q level 1. Make sure not to get baited into fighting her with your own ego, otherwise she will kill you and can actually snowball the game. For Level 1, focus on your wave clear with Q, try to give up CS if she is being hyper aggressive and wait for level 3 to cruise through the lane. 

(2) Abuse Your Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(3) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(4) Respect Her Charm - Evelynn's Charm is a really cheesy and crazy ability in the fact that, if she uses it onto you she can burst you down with you losing up to 35%-45% Magic Reduction, while also being able to use her E to gain additional max HP damage and movement speed to kite out after her combo. Overall, the best thing to do is simply try to walk away from her charm using your tower or dashes to avoid her charm proc, otherwise she can burst you down and leave you in a problematic scenario. 

(5) Ping Her Roams - Outside of her laning ability, the scariest thing to deal with against Evelynn is her roams. Evelynn's roam's with her level 6 powerspike are S+ Tier strong in lower MMR, in which that's how she will try to get ahead. Try to always ping Evelynn's whereabouts as soon as she is missing, try to also plant a control ward outside of the midlane bushes to potentially spot her out. 

(6) Respect Her R - Evelynn R is another ability that must be respected at all times, due to its surprisingly strong and crazy usage as an ability. Evelynn's R works based off missing HP, meaning the lower HP you are the more damage it will be dealing. With that said, overstaying vs Evelynn is absolutely a death sentence, so any time you're in the lane or game with close to no HP, Evelynn will be trying to bait you into fighting her. The best thing to do vs Evelynn R is just try to avoid this situation with your HP and try to ping your teammates not to overstay under any circumstance. 

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Build Hexdrinker, Mercury Treads, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Hexdrinker to lower Evelynn’s overall damage and have a MR shield / Go Mercury Treads to lower Evelynn’s overall damage and CC duration. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Evelynn’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - The main aspect of this match up is essentially preventing Evelynn from trying to assassinate your teammates. The objective for Renekton is trying to carry through the usage of his pings, to help provide his teammates with the alert of Evelynn’s whereabouts. This can obviously be difficult in lower elos, so just make sure you do at least hard ping wherever Eve can be, or alternatively use control wards on your side of the map to help spot out and prevent Evelynn’s chances of killing your team. When it comes to team fights where Evelynn uses her charm on your carry, try to walk in front of them and peel Evelynn away from reaching them. You can also use red trinkets or control wards to spot her in her stealth, making her a free target to jump on to force her R leaving her in a very vulnerable position. Furthermore, if you manage to jump on her auto pilioting towards your team, try to go for the one shot on her with your full combo to burst her out before she can disengage with R.

(1) Respeite o level 1 de Evelynn - Este é de longe um dos matchups mais fáceis de Renekton, porém seu level 1 é realmente muito louco. O level 1 fraco de Renekton significa que Evelynn irá explorá-lo brincando com arbustos e enviando spam para seu Q level 1. Certifique-se de não ser levado a lutar contra ela com seu próprio ego, caso contrário ela irá matá-lo e poderá realmente snowball o jogo. Para level 1, concentre-se em limpar seu wave com Q, tente desistir de CS se ela estiver sendo hiperagressiva e espere level 3 cruzar a pista. 

(2) Abuse do seu early game - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. summaryEn: Ezreal's main threat within this match up is based around his scaling ability, allowing him to always have abilities to throw out at Renekton, as well as being tankier enough to stat check him the later the game gets. Early on in the game, Ezreal's damage is practically non existent, allowing Renekton to force the trades he wants to easily gather an advantage. Try to use your movement to bait out his abilities, or use E1 to bait out his E, allowing you to use E2 to follow up onto him or wait until your next E to force a kill window. Try to keep wave states on your side of the map, as this allows you to easily force fights onto him. If Renekton wins the lane, make sure to use your lead to influence fights and objectives on the map, allowing you to take the upper hand in the game while Ezreal is behind trying to scale.

With that said, avoid being hit by his Q and W, to avoid being chunked out and try to fight him when he misses an ability to get the most value out of yourself within fights. 

(5) Play For Manaburn - Ezreal's main focus early is playing to scale through tear into triforce then manamune, in which he spikes at his hardest once completing both of these items. Based on this we can play to outsustain him early with second wind and d shield, allowing us to force our E to bait out his own E CD and mana, leaving him in a vulnerable position to lose mana and his blink. Right after this, we can force our next E trade to burst him down, or force a jungle gank to punish the Ezreal. 

(6) Abuse Ezreal E CD - Following on from the last point, Ezreal's E is 26 seconds at rank 1, which is lowered by 1.5seconds each time his Q lands onto a target. Renekton can bait out the Ezreal E with his own E, then within that time you potentially have from 10-5 seconds to abuse Ezreal before his next dash comes up. In the event that it comes up while you're dashing onto him, you can use your E2 to gap close even closer against Ezreal, preventing him from being able to escape you. Play off this intently to create the kill windows you need against him.

Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.

Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

Make sure to look around you each time you're recalling to avoid his R hit, otherwise you will be giving free kill gold to help Ezreal scale into a monster. Also make sure to ping his R at the start of his animation to wake up your teammates from being hit by it, otherwise it will present free kill opportunities for Ezreal to scale faster.

Ezreal's role in the game will be trying to poke out his enemies, with the gameplan of getting his targets low to present his team the opportunity to jump on those targets and finish them off. Within this situation you can't let him and him play his game, instead you must use your early and mid game lead to start the fight by engaging onto him or his other carries. Ezreal is very weak against upfront damage, so being able to dash onto him and stun him for your team is crucial for being able to win the fight.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Ezreal’s Passive Steroid
tips.contentEn: The way Ezreal's Passive works is that if he lands his abilities onto his target, he is able to get a burst of attack speed which stacks up to 50%. With that said, avoid being hit by his Q and W, to avoid being chunked out and try to fight him when he misses an ability to get the most value out of yourself within fights.
tips.contentPt: A forma como o passivo de Ezreal funciona é que se ele acertar suas habilidades em seu alvo, ele será capaz de obter burst de velocidade de ataque que acumula até 50%. Dito isso, evite ser atingido por seu Q e W, para evitar ser destruído e tente lutar com ele quando ele perder a habilidade de tirar o máximo proveito de si mesmo nas lutas.

tips.titlePt: Jogue para Esgotar a Mana Inimiga
tips.contentEn: Ezreal's main focus early is playing to scale through tear into triforce then manamune, in which he spikes at his hardest once completing both of these items. Based on this we can play to outsustain him early with second wind and d shield, allowing us to force our E to bait out his own E CD and mana, leaving him in a vulnerable position to lose mana and his blink. Right after this, we can force our next E trade to burst him down, or force a jungle gank to punish the Ezreal.
tips.contentPt: O foco principal de Ezreal no início é jogar para escalar através do tear até o triforce e depois o manamune, no qual ele atinge seu pico ao completar ambos os itens. Com base nisso, podemos jogar para sustentá-lo mais cedo com Second Wind e d escudo, permitindo-nos forçar nosso E a atrair seu próprio E CD e mana, deixando-o em uma posição vulnerável para perder mana e seu piscar. Logo depois disso, podemos forçar nossa próxima troca E para burst ele cair, ou forçar um gank da selva para punir o Ezreal.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Tempo de Recarga (CD) de Ezreal E
tips.contentEn: Following on from the last point, Ezreal's E is 26 seconds at rank 1, which is lowered by 1.5seconds each time his Q lands onto a target. Renekton can bait out the Ezreal E with his own E, then within that time you potentially have from 10-5 seconds to abuse Ezreal before his next dash comes up. In the event that it comes up while you're dashing onto him, you can use your E2 to gap close even closer against Ezreal, preventing him from being able to escape you. Play off this intently to create the kill windows you need against him.
tips.contentPt: Seguindo o último ponto, o E de Ezreal tem 26 segundos no nível 1, que é reduzido em 1,5 segundos cada vez que seu Q atinge um alvo. Renekton pode atrair o Ezreal E com seu próprio E, então, dentro desse tempo, você terá potencialmente de 10 a 5 segundos para abusar de Ezreal antes que seu próximo ataque apareça. Caso isso aconteça enquanto você está correndo em direção a ele, você pode usar seu E2 para se aproximar ainda mais de Ezreal, evitando que ele consiga escapar de você. Jogue isso com atenção para criar as janelas de eliminação necessárias contra ele.

tips.titlePt: Mantenha a Wave do seu Lado
tips.contentEn: Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.
tips.contentPt: Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Pesadas (Heavy Trades)
tips.contentEn: Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Respeite His R
tips.contentEn: Each time you're low HP make sure to respect that Ezreal can use R at any time. Make sure to look around you each time you're recalling to avoid his R hit, otherwise you will be giving free kill gold to help Ezreal scale into a monster. Also make sure to ping his R at the start of his animation to wake up your teammates from being hit by it, otherwise it will present free kill opportunities for Ezreal to scale faster.
tips.contentPt: Cada vez que você estiver com HP baixo, respeite que Ezreal pode usar R a qualquer momento. Certifique-se de olhar ao seu redor cada vez que estiver se lembrando para evitar o acerto R, caso contrário, você estará dando ouro de morte grátis para ajudar Ezreal a se transformar em um monstro. Certifique-se também de fazer ping em seu R no início de sua animação para evitar que seus companheiros de equipe sejam atingidos por ele, caso contrário, ele apresentará oportunidades de morte grátis para Ezreal escalar mais rápido.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Ezreal's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Ezreal e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: At this point in the game Ezreal's powerspike will have finally come online. Ezreal's role in the game will be trying to poke out his enemies, with the gameplan of getting his targets low to present his team the opportunity to jump on those targets and finish them off. Within this situation you can't let him and him play his game, instead you must use your early and mid game lead to start the fight by engaging onto him or his other carries. Ezreal is very weak against upfront damage, so being able to dash onto him and stun him for your team is crucial for being able to win the fight.
tips.contentPt: Neste ponto do jogo, o powerspike de Ezreal finalmente estará online. O papel de Ezreal no jogo será tentar poke seus inimigos, com o plano de jogo de diminuir seus alvos para dar à sua equipe a oportunidade de pular sobre esses alvos e acabar com eles. Nessa situação, você não pode deixá-lo jogar seu jogo; em vez disso, você deve usar sua vantagem inicial e mid game para iniciar a luta, atacando-o ou seus outros carregadores. Ezreal é muito fraco contra danos iniciais, então ser capaz de atacá-lo e atordoá-lo para sua equipe é crucial para vencer a luta.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de E para trocas rápidas nível 1 com E1 > 3 AAs (PTA) > E2 para trás.
level1ExplanationEn: Start E for fast level 1 trades with E1 > 3 AAs (PTA) > E2 disengage.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Ezreal e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Ezreal with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Ezreal.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Ezreal's disengage crowd control.

summaryEn: Fiddlesticks is practically an easy match up within the lane, however his mid game focused playstyle with his R allows him to easily come back within the later stages of the game. videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Fiora - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.09
summaryEn: Fiora's gameplay is entirely dictated off her vital passive, which allows her to win out on trades and duels if she's able to hit that location of the vital. When playing vs Fiora, try to always position away from her hitting the vital, as this allows her to easily get winning trades. Instead, try to use your movement to move away from the side she's trying to hit, or use walls to prevent her from hitting the vital location. Another trick you can do is by completely walking away from her vital range, providing you the ability to get a better vital position. When fighting Fiora, always let her W first as this allows you to avoid getting stunned by her own W. Once Fiora uses her W, Renekton can use his W right after to negate the attack speed slow as well as applying his damage back. Once you figure out her W pattern, Renekton can completely mind game her by using W first or activating W and walking into her, baiting out her W to win the fight. Later on Fiora eventually will have the damage to win, although Renekton's role should be to use his lead within figths or objective timings, while making sure to cover the side lanes well enough by his own admission or his team to prevent her from taking free towers.
summaryPt: A jogabilidade de Fiora é inteiramente ditada por sua passiva vital, o que lhe permite vencer trocas e duelos se conseguir acertar aquele local do vital. Ao jogar contra Fiora, tente sempre se posicionar longe de ela acertar o vital, pois isso permite que ela consiga facilmente trocas vencedoras. Em vez disso, tente usar seu movimento para se afastar do lado que ela está tentando atingir ou use as paredes para evitar que ela atinja o local vital. Outro truque que você pode fazer é afastar-se completamente de seu alcance vital, proporcionando-lhe a capacidade de obter uma posição vital melhor. Ao lutar contra Fiora, sempre deixe seu W primeiro, pois isso permite que você evite ficar atordoado por seu próprio W. Uma vez que Fiora usa seu W, Renekton pode usar seu W logo depois para negar a velocidade de ataque lenta, bem como aplicar seu dano de volta. Depois de descobrir seu padrão de W, Renekton pode fazer um jogo mental com ela usando W primeiro ou ativando W e caminhando até ela, atraindo seu W para vencer a luta. Mais tarde, Fiora eventualmente terá o dano para vencer, embora o papel de Renekton deva ser usar sua liderança em lutas ou tempos objetivos, ao mesmo tempo em que se certifica de cobrir as side lanes bem o suficiente, por sua própria admissão ou por sua equipe, para impedi-la de tomar torres livres.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Her Passive - Fiora's biggest strength across her kit is simply hitting her passive procs, if Fiora manages to hit her passive she is able to obtain true damage, healing and movement speed against her target. The skill factor in this matchup is trying to avoid her passive at all costs, we can do this in a number of ways: Running out of her passive range to reapply a better vital spawn - Positioning the vital onto the opposite side of Fiora - Using the terrain to prevent Fiora from hitting that vital. Overall if you do any of these it will aid you in 1v1 allowing you to easily deal with her. 

(2) Respect And Punish Her Q - Fiora's Q works in a way where if she hits a target with her Q, it refunds her Q CD by 50%. For example, if she hits her rank 1 Q onto you, it will be 6.5 seconds instead of 13. If Fiora ever misses her Q by accidently using it on a dying minion, being out of range of hitting you, or trying to use it to disengage, you should try to punish it at all costs as she loses out on a lot of consistent damage. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Q - Renekton Q is a huge tool in this match up as it's able to consistently poke down Fiora HP, while also allowing you to out shove Fiora and reach level up spikes a lot faster. Early in the lane you can use it to trickle down her HP to set up a kill, and use the level up timers to abuse taking W or E to force a big trade off. If Fiora loses too much HP early she is unable to do anything and you can dive her with ease if you play it properly. 

(4) Respect And Outplay Fiora's W - The next biggest skill indicator in this matchup is essentially outplaying her W. This is the biggest and most fun mindgame of the lane, which essentially can make or break a 1v1.To outplay Fiora W make sure to study how she uses it, sometimes they use it at the start of the fight, after you E, middle of a fight, or as late as possible. Depending on how consistent she is using it, this can allow you to either W before or after her own. At most hold W and play around your vitals, she won't ever get you low enough in the 1v1 unless she is hitting them and if you W into her stun. 

(5) Respect And Deny Fiora R - Fiora R is a giant dueling tool to help her win her 1v1's, however the way she has to play it is very complicated, especially vs a champion such as Renekton. Just like the first point, do NOT let her get her Vitals, simply hold one side of the wall or walk on the opposite side of her to create awkward angles for her. If she is unable to hit them, she loses so much damage alongside the fact she cannot get her healing after hitting them all. 

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Renekton's R Powerspike is simply too much for Fiora to play around, especially if she uses R on Renekton. While Fiora is trying to proc her R vitals, her HP will be absolutely melting from Renekton's raw R damage, on top of him having too many stats for Fiora to successfully shred against (Until later at least). Use Renekton R to hard statcheck Fiora, each time she tries to force a hard fight. 
(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - Honestly Q max into E isn't bad into Fiora, but the idea that Renekton can get 3 W's before Fiora can even get hers is such a disgusting advantage for dueling, meaning you always have a W ready for the situation Fiora puts you into. Simply max this if you're hard snowballing vs Fiora or you simply just want to have an easy time in being able to deal with her. 

(9) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower her overall damage and utilize the movement speed vs Fiora's movement, / Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Fiora's job later on in the game is abusing her insanely strong side laning and dueling power. Fiora can easily take towers with ease the longer a game goes on, while her damage also gets ridiculously strong with how much true damage she is able to apply onto her opponents. Renekton's job vs Fiora is to make sure she is put really hard behind from denying overall CS, kills and tower gold. As the game progresses, try to always clear side lanes and try to defend pushes from Fiora. Sometimes if you're fed you may need to join the rest of the game and negate side lane vs Fiora. In these situations if you don't have TP, tell your teammate to play side lane to cover the lane while you can use your lead on the map. Alternatively try to kill Fiora off the side lane solo or with your team, so then you're able to force fights or objectives with her off the map.

(10) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O trabalho de Fiora mais tarde no jogo é abusar de seu poder de duelo e rotas laterais insanamente fortes. Fiora pode facilmente tomar torres com facilidade à medida que o jogo avança, enquanto seu dano também fica ridiculamente forte com a quantidade de dano verdadeiro que ela é capaz de aplicar em seus oponentes. O trabalho de Renekton vs Fiora é garantir que ela seja muito prejudicada por negar CS, mortes e torres de ouro no geral. À medida que o jogo avança, tente sempre limpar as side lanes e defender os empurrões de Fiora. Às vezes, se você estiver alimentado, pode precisar entrar no resto do jogo e negar a rota lateral contra Fiora. Nessas situações, se você não tiver TP, diga ao seu companheiro de equipe para jogar na rota lateral para cobrir a rota enquanto você pode usar sua liderança no mapa. tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Fiora's job later on in the game is abusing her insanely strong side laning and dueling power. Fiora can easily take towers with ease the longer a game goes on, while her damage also gets ridiculously strong with how much true damage she is able to apply onto her opponents. Renekton's job vs Fiora is to make sure she is put really hard behind from denying overall CS, kills and tower gold. As the game progresses, try to always clear side lanes and try to defend pushes from Fiora. Sometimes if you're fed you may need to join the rest of the game and negate side lane vs Fiora. In these situations if you don't have TP, tell your teammate to play side lane to cover the lane while you can use your lead on the map. Alternatively try to kill Fiora off the side lane solo or with your team, so then you're able to force fights or objectives with her off the map.
tips.contentPt: O trabalho de Fiora mais tarde no jogo é abusar de seu poder de duelo e rotas laterais insanamente fortes. Fiora pode facilmente tomar torres com facilidade à medida que o jogo avança, enquanto seu dano também fica ridiculamente forte com a quantidade de dano verdadeiro que ela é capaz de aplicar em seus oponentes. O trabalho de Renekton vs Fiora é garantir que ela seja muito prejudicada por negar CS, mortes e torres de ouro em geral. À medida que o jogo avança, tente sempre limpar as side lanes e defender os empurrões de Fiora. Às vezes, se você estiver alimentado, pode precisar entrar no resto do jogo e negar a rota lateral contra Fiora. Nessas situações, se você não tiver TP, diga ao seu companheiro de equipe para jogar na rota lateral para cobrir a rota enquanto você pode usar sua liderança no mapa. Alternativamente, tente matar Fiora fora da rota lateral sozinho ou com sua equipe, para que você possa forçar lutas ou objetivos com ela fora do mapa.

winConditionEn: Hug the wall during her Ult to protect your back vital; bait her Riposte (W) before committing your Empowered W.
cautionPt: Se Fiora aparar seu W com o dela, você será atordoado e perderá o duelo imediatamente.
cautionEn: If Fiora parries your W, you get stunned and will instantly lose the duel.

tips.titleEn: Gain the Psychological Edge with Riposte (W)
tips.titlePt: Baitando o Ripostar (W) da Fiora
tips.contentEn: Fiora's Riposte (W) can block Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W), but Renekton has the psychological advantage. Make it difficult for Fiora to bait out Riposte by only using E-Q followed by an auto-attack, or by faking with E-Q-auto-W.
tips.contentPt: O Ripostar (W) de Fiora pode bloquear seu W, mas a vantagem mental é sua. Alterne o timing: use combos falsos como E > Q > Auto-ataque e segure o W para quando ela gastar a habilidade defensiva em falso.

tips.titleEn: Solidify Your Stat Advantage with Dominus (R) at Level 6
tips.titlePt: Garantir a Vantagem no Nível 6 com Dominus (R)
tips.contentEn: After Level 6, using Dominus (R) significantly increases Renekton's stats, making it difficult for Fiora to keep up. Utilize your ultimate to gain an overwhelming advantage in trades and look for solo kill opportunities.
tips.contentPt: Após o nível 6, o aumento de vida e dano em área de Dominus (R) sobrepuja o kit inicial da Fiora. Ative o R em all-ins e busque oportunidades claras de solo kill.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Fizz - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Fizz cannot really do anything into Renekton, as Renekton can always reliably get his damage off before or after he uses his Q or E. Fizz's stats are simply too weak to deal with Renekton in 1v1 scenarios, instead forcing him to roam and play the role of killing squishier champions. As Renekton you want to make sure you always ping his whereabouts on the map, using that time to crash waves and make him miss gold and xp. Within teamfights, Renekton should try to protect his team by using his W on Fizz before or while he engages, providing Renekton the ability to always stiffle Fizz's role within the game.
summaryPt: Fizz realmente não pode fazer nada em Renekton, já que Renekton sempre pode remover seu dano de forma confiável antes ou depois de usar seu Q ou E. As stats de Fizz são simplesmente fracas demais para lidar com Renekton em cenários de 1v1, em vez disso, forçando-o a roam e desempenhar o papel de matar campeões mais frágeis. Como Renekton você quer ter certeza de sempre marcar o paradeiro dele no mapa, usando esse tempo para crash waves e fazê-lo perder ouro e XP. Dentro de teamfights, Renekton deve tentar proteger sua equipe usando seu W em Fizz antes ou enquanto ele se engaja, proporcionando a Renekton a habilidade de sempre restringir o papel de Fizz dentro do jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Fizz you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Fizz lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(5) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(6) Abuse Fizz’s Long Early Cooldowns - Fizz early cooldowns are fairly long and easy to abuse. Any slight mistake from Fizz can be absolutely monstrous for Renekton to abuse. Try to bait his E by dashing into him, once he finishes his animation try to W him as soon as possible to obtain your burst onto him. Doing this will present Fizz with no opportunities to out damage. 

(7) Ping And Abuse Fizz Roams - Fizz's only win condition for this lane is simply to outroam and try to establish a lead from other kills on the map. Fizz is pretty excellent at this with his R and high mobility, so it's pretty important to always track his movement for your team so he is unable to obtain free kills. Try to punish Fizz’s roams by crashing in the wave, as well as taking plates and the incoming minion waves. 

(8) Respect Fizz R - While Renekton doesn't usually die to Fizz R, he can still cheese you with his Q > R combo, which can catch you off guard if you're low and set up a kill for himself. The important detail to recognise when this is happening is watching Fizz Q onto a minion to position himself into R'ing right from it, simply try to dash away and he will completely miss his R. Once he has no R he simply will have no kill threat unless you misplay. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Midgame And Teamfighting Tips - Fizz's goal in mid to late game is essentially to pick off isolated targets with his assassin based playstyle. He does this by looking for E Flash plays, or landing a gigantic R to gain max value damage for his damage for solo kills or teamfights. Typically you're able to tank Fizz's R in a teamfight if you want to peel against him, this eats up the majority of Fizz's play options and leaves him in a useless position. Another thing to look out for is to try and stun him as soon as he dashes in, this then leads to him getting one shot by your own damage, or allowing your teammates to apply additional damage to kill him off.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 Q ou E Start - Como mencionado em outras notas, jogar Q e E requer jogadas diferentes, porém neste confronto você pode essencialmente fazer qualquer uma delas e ter um bom sucesso. Com isso dito, experimente os pontos fortes de level 1 e procure uma morte de level 2. 

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Fizz, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Fizz perca muito mais. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(5) Trocas pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

(6) Abuse dos longos tempos de espera iniciais de Fizz - os primeiros tempos de espera de Fizz são bastante longos e fáceis de abusar. Qualquer pequeno erro de Fizz pode ser absolutamente monstruoso para Renekton abusar. tente iscar seu E correndo contra ele, assim que ele terminar sua animação, tente W nele o mais rápido possível para obter seu burst nele. Fazer isso apresentará a Fizz nenhuma oportunidade de causar danos. 

(7) Ping e abuso de Fizz Roams - A única condição de vitória de Fizz para esta pista é simplesmente dar outroam e tentar estabelecer uma vantagem de outras mortes no mapa. Fizz é excelente nisso com seu R e alta mobilidade, então é muito importante sempre monitorar o movimento dele para sua equipe para que ele não consiga obter mortes gratuitas. tente punir as perambulações de Fizz por crashing na wave, bem como pegar placas e o lacaio que chega waves. 

(8) Respeite Fizz R - Embora Renekton normalmente não morra para Fizz R, ele ainda pode te atacar com seu combo Q> R, que pode pegá-lo desprevenido se você estiver baixo e preparar uma morte para si mesmo. O detalhe importante a reconhecer quando isso está acontecendo é observar Fizz Q em um lacaio para se posicionar em R'ing a partir dele, simplesmente tente sair correndo e ele perderá completamente seu R. Uma vez que ele não tenha R, ele simplesmente não terá ameaça de morte, a menos que você jogue errado. 

(9) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting - O objetivo de Fizz no meio de late game é essencialmente abater alvos isolados com seu estilo de jogo baseado em assassino. Ele faz isso procurando jogadas de E Flash ou acertando um R gigantesco para ganhar o valor máximo de dano por seu dano em mortes solo ou teamfights. Normalmente você é capaz de tankar o R ​​de Fizz em um teamfight se quiser peel contra ele, isso consome a maioria das opções de jogo de Fizz e o deixa em uma posição inútil. Outra coisa a observar é tentar atordoá-lo assim que ele entrar, o que fará com que ele receba one-shot com seu próprio dano ou permita que seus companheiros de equipe apliquem dano adicional para matá-lo.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Gangplank’s Level 1 - GP’s level 1 is pretty lethal if you play into his overall game plan, which consists of him hitting passive onto his target followed by using his barrels to reset his passive damage to out trade and potentially kill his target. Level 1 against  GP, you should avoid walking into bushes otherwise he will be able to apply his damage really easily. Once GP uses his passive on the minions, you can play to get push with Q and try to hard shove for level 2. Doing this can help you reach level 2 to try and force a fight for lane dominance. 

(2) Respect Gangplank’s Passive - As previously mentioned, GP’s strength relies on being able to hit his passive in melee range, on top of resetting his passive from destroying barrels. As Renekton you always want to let him hit his passive first onto a target, followed by trying to last his barrels to prevent him from getting his passive. If you’re able to do this, GP will lose out on tons of consistent damage, allowing Renekton to easily overpower him within all ins. 

(3) Play For Sustain Early - GP’s Grasp or Comet Q procs can pack quite the punch, especially when he reaches his sheen proc powerspike. As Renekton, you want to try and avoid tanking Q’s in the open, tanking too many Q’s will lose you play opportunities, leaving you in a vulnerable situation forcing you to recall, or potentially die. To make the lane a lot easier, Renekton should also abuse D Shield and Second Wind, to allow Renekton to tank GP’s damage as well as mana burn GP’s consistently. 

(4) Play For Mana Burn - GP’s oppressive lane nature can be very difficult to play against. However Renekton’s playstyle to simply force trades to burn GP’s mana, while abusing D Shield, Second Wind and playing off quick combos, remain a core factor to successfully beating GP. To play this successfully, while trying to avoid GP Q’s, try to force burst heavy combos to burn his  W, which eventually amounts up to burning GP’s mana pool, forcing him to recall or leads to his death.

(5) Avoid And Deny Gangplank’s E - As we have mentioned already, GP’s E is essentially the main skill element of the match up. If we’re able to consistently last hit or avoid the barrels, GP will not be able to assert any damage to deter Renekton from fighting him. Whenever you try to fight GP, it is within your best intentions to always focus on them first to lower his overall damage within the fights to give you the best success possible.

(6) Play Around Gangplank’s W - GP’s W is another element within the match up that you really need to pay attention to, as playing around this successfully will help you understand when you’re able to kill GP. Typically when trading vs GP if you’re W’ing him he will most likely try to break out of it with his own W, allowing him to potentially win out or survive the fight vs Renekton. Typically as Renekton, we play to kill GP within 2 combos, as the first combo is what’s ultimately going to help us set up for the eventual kill against GP. GP’S W CD is around 22 seconds, allowing us to have a 10-6 second window, depending on how early we used our E and how late GP used his W. Once you’re able to re-enter a second trade vs GP, you should try to go all out on your damage to help you chunk him out for a tower dive, or provide you the ability to kill him right there and then.

(7) Rush Plated Steelcaps - In my own preference, I personally like to rush Plated Steelcaps to help me deal with GP’s sheen poke if we’re even or he is ahead. This playstyle allows me to help mana burn GP harder, while utilising the rest of my sustain based playstyle, to give me more opportunities to trade, while also being able to keep more of my HP up. You can opt into straight damage if the lane is going too smoothly, however I find that GP can feel very awkward if you’re rushing straight AD as even the simplest mistakes can be very costly with how Squishy you are into him. 

(8) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(9) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(10) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Gangplank’s role within the late stages of the game is simply to scale into a behemoth using his side lane and farm dedicated playstyle, to help him farm up to his giant item and R upgrade powerspikes. Before these points of the game, you should be trying to utilise your early mid game power to help secure objectives and win fights while you’re at your strongest. Utilising your strengths within this stage of the game by roaming and grouping will help you overpower Gangplank’s chances of being able to farm to help his team contest objectives. Within teamfights, Gangplank will use his R to slow you while trying to set up his barrel plays, with the hope of trying to decimate any squishy carries. Against GP, try to bait out his W early so you’re able to get your team to use their additional CC abilities onto him. Also play with the aim to deny any barrels, as even one barrel can change the whole course of a fight.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Garen’s Level 1 Trades - Garen’s level 1 can be pretty strong when it comes to playing vs Renekton, as Garen can simply AA Q AA then proc his phase rush, or utilise his raw damage from Conqueror, in being able to easily out trade Renekton. Doing this will help you go even or ahead of Garen in the trade. Level 1 you will have push advantage to help you shove the wave and reach level 2 before him, so make sure to play to push and abuse your strong level 2 and 3 spikes.

(2) Abuse Garen’s Q Timing - So we already mentioned that you can AA Q in Garen’s Q frames, however Renekton can also W as well, allowing him to CC Garen on his own silence, providing Renekton with a safety net of locking Garen from being able to trade back. Doing this will help you easily win trades and overpower Garen without his W, so make sure you’re doing this if Garen doesn’t have W. Otherwise if he does use W he will eat up your damage and CC timer, helping him break out faster allowing him to out damage you. Alternatively I recommend simply baiting out Garen’s Q to begin with, by short clicking in and out of his range to bait out his Q. Overall this helps me put it on CD allowing me to get beneficial trading patterns against him, allowing my overall changes to overpower and win against him.

(3) Respect And Avoid Garen E - Garen E is the real strength when it comes to playing vs Garen, as this is the ability he usually maxes on top of it also being uncancelable against CC. As Renekton typically if Garen tries to Q me, I will buffer my W within the cast, followed by E’ing out of his beginning E frames to help me avoid his overall damage. If you tank too much E damage this will essentially lose you the duels, so try and play around avoiding his E and abusing his CDs to leverage power within the lane.

(4) Avoid Comboing into Garen’s W - Garen’s W is a really annoying ability for Renekton, as he can use it to reduce your overall damage, alongside easily breaking out of your CC. As Renekton you never want to blow your damage into his W, otherwise this results in you losing fights against Garen. Typically later through the laning phase, I simply will try to dash on Garen after his Q is on CD, then I will hold my entire damage until W wears off, then I will use all my damage and try to look for an all in if I’m available to. Alternatively, if Garen does engage with Q and W’s at the same time, I’ll hold old from using my W and will only use it after his W wears off. 

(5) Remove Garen’s Passive - Garen’s passive allows him to heal health while he isn’t in combat, allowing him to consistently sustain in lane with doran’s shield and second wind after any short combos. Once Garen exists while staying in range to you, make sure you chip his passive off with Q, or alternatively you can use your E Q to strategically hit Garen without ruining your potential wave state. Doing this can help you dive Garen within that window of his passive being on CD, or you can drop his overall sustain to help you zone him off the minion wave. 

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - I personally prefer W max into Garen, as I’m available to use multiple W’s onto Garen within a fight, denying the ability for him to escape or overpower me within the 1v1 battles. Doing this when you’re even or ahead is a great way to nullify and consistently overpower Garen in 1v1’s, so make sure to fully take advantage of this to always have the edge over Garen. 

(9) Respect And Avoid His R - Garen R is by far his most dangerous ability that can help him cheese kills over Renekton, alongside helping him pick up kills through skirmishes and teamfights. When playing vs Garen, you always want to make sure your HP is higher than his at all points, so playing away from his damage through the use of other tips is very important. If Garen has flash and ignite, he will try to flash on you with 40-30% and look to kill you with R execute. Try to consider this whenever you’re low, otherwise Garen will easily secure a kill on you. Alternatively, you can bait out his combo and buffer your R through Q, to help you miscalculate his damage and help you turn the fight against him. When it comes to avoiding Garen using R on your teammates, make sure to abuse your pings before the fights so Garen’s potential kills can be avoided.

(10) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid stages of the game, if you have successfully played the Garen match, you should have a substantial CS advantage over him and you should have taken his tower. Being in Gnar’s auto attack range can be very dangerous as the game progresses, so make sure to always avoid being hit by his W passive, on top of also utilising D Shield and Second Wind earlier on to nullify his ranged strengths within the lane. 

(4) Respect And Punish Gnar E - The biggest skill element in the match up comes from abusing Gnar’s E Jump, which essentially sets up your kill patterns in being able to beat Gnar. Gnar’s jump from level 1 is 22 seconds, meaning within that down time Renekton is able to punish Gnar and potentially kill him if he plays it correctly. Firstly within the lane, try to do a bait trade by dashing into him with E > Q. Doing this will either make him jump, or it will allow you to force your damage on top of him, severely weakening him in the process. If Gnar does jump, you can wait for your next E engage to burst him down and potentially kill him.

(5) Respect Mega Gnar - Mega Gnar allows Gnar to empower his base stats, which also transforms his playstyle into a close range heavy damage bruiser. Within this time, Renekton should play to simply avoid his damage and R, using his movement or dashes to dodge Gnar’s W CC and Q damage. Typically you want to always avoid fighting Gnar in mega form, due to his high base health and armour stats. Most often you would rather wait it out until he’s back in mini form, in which after that you can then plan for your kill trades.

(6) Respect Gnar’s Kite Potential - As the game reaches the later stages, Gnar’s mobility combined with Triforce and Black Cleaver can be absolutely disgusting and unplayable. Within this stage you want to avoid taking these fights, as well as taking long trades with Gnar in the laning phase. If Gnar is able to consistently get his W damage off, he is able to get a burst of movement speed to help him kite you out and out damage you. Try to use bushes and do your best to play off getting his E off while also playing the wave on your side, helping you avoid his kite playstyle.

(7) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(8) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(10) Respect And Avoid Gnar R - Gnar R can be a really powerful tool that can completely change the whole course of a fight, allowing him to easily chain all his damage and CC together in combination with his W and Q in mega form. No matter if you’re in a 1v1 or a teamfight, you must respect gnar’s engage, so make sure to either wait out his mega form, or try to play to avoid his E and R, with a well timed dash or flash. When you’re around mega Gnar, try to avoid standing near walls to avoid his bonus damage and cc duration, as providing these to Gnar will most likely send you into a death sentence, or heavily out trade you forcing you to recall. 

(11) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Gnar’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Later on in the game Renekton should avoid fighting Gnar, as his overall stats severely weaken Renekton throughout the game. Renekton’s best interest should be looking for teamfights, where he can successfully play to peel his team, or play to dive the enemy backline carries. In the teamfights as already mentioned, try to avoid playing against Gnar’s mega form, as this will easily provide Gnar a clear game plan to help him win the fights. Once Gnar is in mini form, try to take fights as a team where you’re able to jump onto his carries, with the overall objective of trying to shut them down. If Gnar has no mega form, he simply cannot peel hard enough and will not outdo Renekton’s overall teamfighting presence.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2. Fazer isso também ajudará você a tirar seu Bone Plating para matar level 2. 

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Gnar, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Gnar perca muito mais. 

(3) Respeite o poke de Gnar - a principal forma de dano de Gnar ocorrerá com ele em sua forma mini, o que fornece a ele um alcance decente e poke de seu passivo auto attacks, Q e W. Estar no alcance auto attack de Gnar pode ser muito perigoso conforme o jogo avança, então evite sempre ser atingido por seu passivo W, além de usar D Shield e Second Wind anteriormente para anular suas forças de longo alcance dentro da rota. 

(4) Respeitar e punir Gnar E - O maior elemento de habilidade no confronto vem do abuso do E Jump de Gnar, que essencialmente configura seus padrões de morte para ser capaz de vencer Gnar. O salto de Gnar de level 1 é de 22 segundos, o que significa que dentro desse tempo de inatividade Renekton é capaz de punir Gnar e potencialmente matá-lo se ele jogar corretamente. Primeiramente, dentro da pista, tente fazer uma troca de isca, atacando-o com E> Q. Fazer isso o fará pular ou permitirá que você force seu dano em cima dele, enfraquecendo-o severamente no processo. Se Gnar pular, você pode esperar seu próximo E engage para burst derrubá-lo e potencialmente matá-lo.

(5) Respeite Mega Gnar - Mega Gnar permite que Gnar fortaleça suas stats básicas, o que também transforma seu estilo de jogo em um destruidor de grande dano a curta distância. Dentro deste tempo, Renekton deve jogar para simplesmente evitar seu dano e R, usando seu movimento ou investidas para evitar o dano de W CC e Q de Gnar. Normalmente, você deseja sempre evitar lutar contra Gnar em mega forma, devido à sua alta base de saúde e stats de armadura. Na maioria das vezes, você prefere esperar até que ele volte em forma mini, e depois disso você poderá planejar suas trocas de morte.

(6) Respeite o potencial kite de Gnar - À medida que o jogo atinge os estágios posteriores, a mobilidade de Gnar combinada com Triforce e Black Cleaver pode ser absolutamente nojenta e impossível de jogar. Dentro desta fase você quer evitar essas lutas, além de fazer longas trocas com Gnar na fase de rotas (laning phase). Se Gnar for capaz de reduzir consistentemente o dano do W, ele será capaz de obter burst de velocidade de movimento para ajudá-lo a kite causar dano total a você. tente usar arbustos e faça o seu melhor para tirar o E enquanto também joga o wave ao seu lado, ajudando você a evitar o estilo de jogo kite dele.

(7) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(8) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(9) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(10) Respeitar e evitar Gnar R - Gnar R pode ser uma ferramenta realmente poderosa que pode mudar completamente todo o curso de uma luta, permitindo-lhe encadear facilmente todos os seus danos e CC juntos em combinação com seu W e Q em mega forma. Não importa se você está em um 1v1 ou um teamfight, você deve respeitar o engage de Gnar, então certifique-se de esperar sua mega forma ou tentar jogar para evitar seu E e R, com um dash na hora certa ou Flash. Quando você estiver perto de mega Gnar, evite ficar perto de paredes para evitar seu dano bônus e duração de CC, pois fornecê-los a Gnar provavelmente o levará a uma sentença de morte ou a uma troca pesada, forçando-o a se lembrar. 

(11) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilidade. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Gnar e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(12) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Mais tarde no jogo, Renekton deve evitar lutar contra Gnar, pois suas stats gerais enfraquecem severamente Renekton ao longo do jogo. O melhor interesse de Renekton deve ser procurar teamfights, onde ele possa jogar com sucesso para peel seu time, ou jogar para dive que a linha de fundo inimiga carrega. No teamfights como já mencionado, evite jogar contra a mega forma de Gnar, pois isso facilmente fornecerá a Gnar um plano de jogo claro para ajudá-lo a vencer as lutas. Quando Gnar estiver na forma mini, tente lutar em equipe onde você possa pular em seus carregadores, com o objetivo geral de evitar desligá-los. Se Gnar não tiver mega forma, ele simplesmente não conseguirá peel com força suficiente e não superará a presença geral de Renekton em teamfighting.

tips.titlePt: Baitar e Punir o Salto (E) do Gnar
