If he takes Q, or W level 1, you can simply take Q and try to out push him, presenting you a level 2 trade window, or the ability to have complete wave control. 

(2) Respect Gragas’s Combo - At level 3 onwards gragas will typically W > E > Q > AA, which allows him to burst your HP, on top of him receiving phase rush to completely nullify his opponent from trading pack. The best way to avoid this is simply playing around minions, as he won’t be able to get his E hit, and if Gragas does E a minion, this presents you in a free trading opportunity to help you chunk out Gragas.

(3) Abuse Your Waveclear - Renekton's waveclear typically allows for gragas to use a lot of Mana back in trying to secure CS, or deny Renekton's push. This leads to Gragas losing mana fast on his early levels, leaving him unable to contest Renekton's roams or even tower dives if Gragas is low enough. If you’re able to crash waves and deny any Gragas roams, or skirmishes, this is huge for Renekton to have total control, on top of him also being able to easily reach his own powerspikes a lot easier. 

(4) Abuse W Buffer vs E - One of the biggest tools to deny gragas's play pattern is abusing Renekton's W into Gragas E interaction. The way this works is that if you activate W just before Gragas collides, Renekton can spam right click to help him stun Gragas right on the collision animation, stunning Gragas right on top of him. Doing this sets Renekton up to use his E's and the rest of his abilities to out trade Gragas and hard punish him from playing recklessly. 

(5) Rush Mercury Treads - If Renekton is able to buy Mercury Treads, this allows him to easily escape Gragas’s E stun, allowing him to punish Gragas even harder with the W buffer trick. Buying boots also allows you to easily lower Gragas’s overall damage, while providing you more mobility to help you manoeuvre against Gragas Q and his overall combos. 

(6) Respect Gragas Combos - Gragas has a ton of combos that can most certainly catch you off guard, these consist of plays such as his E Flash if you’re low or if he’s trying to setup a gank for his team, or using his R into Q combos to help one shot or push you towards his tower. Make sure to read the situation accurately by taking into account where you are in the lane, while also taking into account how much HP you’re around too. You can also use this foresight in your advantage to bait Gragas with your R to turn the fights, or waste his R and Flash with your movement, E or Flash.

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - I personally love W max in this match up as I’m able to consistently provide W’s around the same time as Gragas has E, allowing me to counteract his negative playstyle to help provide me consistent access to getting my damage off on Gragas, as well as being able to find more kill opportunities onto him. Once I have more Haste, this presents me with an even much easier time to find kills and easily shut down his playstyle.

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Gragas as a champion has a lot of tools, playstyles and overall gameplans to help him provide plenty of utility towards his teammates, or enough damage to easily nuke people from the game. Some of these come in the form of him playing as a tank, bruiser or a full damage carry, all of which come with their own strengths and weaknesses. Currently as a top laner, Gragas prefers playing a more heavy AP playstyle, as this is what can easily help him maintain his relevancy within the game as much as providing him a clear win condition to play around. Overall Gragas’s win condition is playing off his flash, followed by his E and R, allowing him to create disgusting full damage combos. As Renekton, before any major fights, you want to try your hardest to make sure you can burn his flash out within the side lane or skirmishes.  Try to hard focus him when you get the opportunity to, as losing this will severely weaken his overall team fighting plays. Within teamfights, try your hardest to block his E and his path to reaching your teammates, as this will nullify Gragas’s overall strengths as a pick.

A melhor maneira de evitar isso é simplesmente brincar com lacaios, já que ele não será capaz de acertar seu E, e se Gragas fizer E em um lacaio, isso lhe dará uma oportunidade de trocas gratuitas para ajudá-lo a eliminar Gragas.

(3) Abuse de seu waveclear - O waveclear de Renekton normalmente permite que Gragas use muita Mana para tentar proteger CS ou negar o push de Renekton. Isso faz com que Gragas perca mana rapidamente em seus níveis iniciais, deixando-o incapaz de contestar as andanças de Renekton ou mesmo os mergulhos na torre se Gragas estiver baixo o suficiente. Se você for capaz de crash waves e negar qualquer roaming de Gragas, ou skirmishes, isso é ótimo para Renekton ter controle total, além de ser capaz de alcançar facilmente seu próprio powerspikes com muito mais facilidade. 

(4) Abusar do W Buffer vs E - Uma das maiores ferramentas para negar o padrão de jogo de Gragas é abusar do W de Renekton na interação de Gragas E. A maneira como isso funciona é que se você ativar W pouco antes de Gragas colidir, Renekton pode enviar spam com o botão direito para ajudá-lo a atordoar Gragas logo na animação de colisão, atordoando Gragas bem em cima dele. Fazer isso prepara Renekton para usar seus E's e o resto de suas habilidades para trocar Gragas e puni-lo severamente por jogar de forma imprudente. 

(5) Rush Mercury Treads - Se Renekton for capaz de comprar Mercury Treads, isso permitirá que ele escape facilmente do atordoamento E de Gragas, permitindo-lhe punir Gragas ainda mais duramente com o truque do buffer W. Comprar botas também permite reduzir facilmente o dano geral de Gragas, ao mesmo tempo que fornece mais mobilidade para ajudá-lo a manobrar contra Gragas Q e seus combos gerais. 

(6) Respeite Gragas Combos - Gragas tem uma tonelada de combos que certamente podem pegar você desprevenido, estes consistem em jogadas como seu E Flash se você estiver baixo ou se ele estiver tentando configurar um gank para sua equipe, ou usando seus combos R em Q para ajudar one-shot ou empurrá-lo em direção à torre dele. Certifique-se de ler a situação com precisão, levando em consideração onde você está na pista, ao mesmo tempo em que leva em consideração quanto HP você está por perto. Você também pode usar essa previsão a seu favor para atrair Gragas com seu R para virar as lutas, ou desperdiçar seu R e Flash com seu movimento, E ou Flash.

(7) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(8) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Eu pessoalmente adoro W max neste confronto, pois sou capaz de fornecer W consistentemente ao mesmo tempo que Gragas tem E, permitindo-me neutralizar seu estilo de jogo negativo para ajudar a me fornecer acesso consistente para diminuir meu dano em Gragas, além de ser capaz de encontrar mais oportunidades de matar ele. Assim que tiver mais pressa, será ainda mais fácil encontrar mortes e encerrar facilmente seu estilo de jogo.

(9) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Gragas como campeão tem muitas ferramentas, estilos de jogo e planos de jogo gerais para ajudá-lo a fornecer bastante utilidade para seus companheiros de equipe ou dano suficiente para facilmente eliminar as pessoas do jogo. Alguns deles vêm na forma de ele jogar como tanque, brigão ou carregador de dano total, todos com seus próprios pontos fortes e fracos. Atualmente como top laner, Gragas prefere jogar um estilo de jogo com AP mais pesado, pois é isso que pode facilmente ajudá-lo a manter sua relevância dentro do jogo, além de fornecer a ele uma clara condição de vitória para jogar. No geral, a condição de vitória de Gragas é jogar com seu Flash, seguido por seu E e R, permitindo que ele crie combos nojentos de dano total. Como Renekton, antes de qualquer luta importante, você quer tentar o seu melhor para ter certeza de que pode queimar seu Flash na side lane ou skirmishes.  tente concentrá-lo fortemente quando tiver a oportunidade, pois perder isso enfraquecerá severamente as jogadas gerais de luta de sua equipe. Dentro de teamfights, tente ao máximo bloquear seu E e seu caminho para alcançar seus companheiros de equipe, pois isso anulará os pontos fortes gerais de Gragas como escolha.

summaryEn: Gwen is a hard style match up for Renekton the later the game gets, as her overall windows to punish are a lot shorter than most other match ups. Renekton must make sure to avoid getting hit by her stacked Q, as it provides her a lot of damage to win the fights. Renekton should look for fights on his side of the map, as he's able to reliably get in range as well as avoiding consistent damage back. Renekton's quick trades matter a lot into Gwen, as Gwen's strength comes from her extended trades, allowing her to have the upper hand. When Gwen uses R, try to always disengage away from her at all costs, as her damage and slow are too much to deal with. Once Renekton has Eclipse, Renekton is able to have more lethal trades against her, allowing him to stat check Gwen reliably with Eclipse and R. Later in the game, Renekton should buy Kaenic to survive her scaling damage, otherwise she will completely melt him. Make sure to also peel your teammates from Gwen's R, using your W's to help stop her from running your team down.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Gwen’s Level 1 - Gwen as a champion can leverage a pretty great level 1 vs a lot of her opponents, mainly due to the reason she can abuse her high attack speed steroid from her E in combination with her Conqueror. As of a result, she can force a lot of early kills if she plays it correctly with her spacing. With that said if she does take E and she is trying to zone you off level 1, you can try to skill W to help you peel her off yourself, however losing the opportunity to touch the wave level 1 can be a big deal, on top of the fact W doesn’t really help vs Gwen’s boneplating in these early stages of the lane. Alternatively, I personally prefer Q start as it can help me easily poke it and allow me to poke my Q into the range of minions, if I’m able to touch the wave without going into auto range vs E start Gwen. 

If Gwen takes Q start the lane will overall be a lot easier to navigate, allowing you the opportunity to push hard against her to reach level 2 before her, resulting in a potential level 2 trade with E/W. Obviously respect her Q stacks, the higher they are the more damage she will deal, so space optimally and abuse your level 1 advantage with Q if you’re able to.

(2) Respect Gwen’s Passive - One of the most underrated aspects of the Gwen matchup comes from how strong her passive actually is. Firstly, Gwen is able to deal the target's maximum health damage based on her overall AP , resulting in her auto attacks, Q and R, to deal an insane amount of damage within duels. On top of this, Gwen can also heal for 50% of post mitigation damage dealt against champions, resulting in powerful sustain based fighting that allows her to win a lot of duels. These hidden variables present her in a strong time within extended fights, so try to to avoid taking these as much as possible and try to abuse Renekton’s strong trading patterns to over power Gwen.

(3) Respect And Avoid Gwen’s Q - When laning vs Gwen, if she has priority on the wave, she will build her passive Q stacks, then look to E Q at the same time, dealing tons of damage and heavily chunking you out. In this case, you can try to do short clicks to walk in and out, to help you bait her E Q early, assisting you to avoid her damage while making her over extend towards you. After she misses you should look to trade immediately, as you will have the upper hand within your damage. As also mentioned, you can use your dash to dash away, or you can use it towards her. Renekton E if timed well, can dash through her beginning frames of E Q, to majority of her entire damage from E Q, allowing you to heavily punish her, followed by a kill if you have R or if she’s low enough for lethal. Another factor of Gwen W, is her ability to gain 22 armour and magic resist, scaling off her overall AP. videoTitle: RENEKTON vs HECARIM FULL BUILD FIGHTS & Best Pentakills!
summaryEn: Hecarim is one of the easiest match ups for Renekton, simply due to his weak ability to lane within modern league as well as Renekton's damage being  way too high for him to deal with.  When playing vs Hecarim, try to avoid fighting him with your abilities down, as his Q stacked damage can help him out trade Renekton within the early stages of the lane. Once reaching level 3, Renekton can dictate all trades onwards within the game, completely taking away Hecarim's ability to do anything. Hecarim's only role within the mid to late game is looking for E and R engages onto your squishier teammates. As Renekton, we can use our W to completely stop Hecarim from fully utilising his engage, providing him as a free target to kill with our teammates.
summaryPt: Hecarim é uma das partidas mais fáceis para Renekton, simplesmente devido à sua fraca habilidade de rota na liga moderna, bem como ao dano de Renekton ser muito alto para ele lidar.  Ao jogar contra Hecarim, evite lutar contra ele com suas habilidades baixas, pois o dano acumulado do Q dele pode ajudá-lo a sair da troca Renekton nos estágios iniciais da rota. Ao atingir level 3, Renekton pode ditar todas as trocas seguintes dentro do jogo, tirando completamente a capacidade de Hecarim de fazer qualquer coisa. A única função de Hecarim entre meados e late game é procurar E e R se engajar em seus companheiros de equipe mais frágeis. Como Renekton, podemos usar nosso W para impedir completamente que Hecarim utilize totalmente seu engage, fornecendo-o como um alvo livre para matar com nossos companheiros de equipe.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Hecarim’s Q - Hecarim's main playstyle and source of damage comes from his Q ability. His Q deals AOE style damage which stacks up 3 times as well as the cooldown being lowered on each stack. As long as you don't heavily overtrade early into his Q, Hecarim won't really have an answer for your early game, so make sure to keep the fights short and play off your abilities to maintain consistent success.. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Hecarim you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Hecarim lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Hecarim’s Mana Issues - Hecarim’s solo lane has been pretty terrible for years, mainly due to the reason that his base mana and mana costs are just not suitable for top lane these days. Hecarim’s base mana usually gets consumed by his Q and his W abilities, as both are great combat and sustain tools within the lane. The problem for Hecarim however, is that the biggest issue within the Renekton match up, is the fact he has to use all his abilities at once in order to survive, making him quite a helpless target for Renekton to snowball off. Being that Hecarim has to defensively use his abilities to try and survive, this substantially burns his mana leaving him in a terrible position if Renekton plays to either dive or freeze minion waves. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Respect Hecarim’s R - The only thing you really need to care about within this match up is Hecarim's gank or teamfighting setup. If Hecarim can play off a CC jungler correctly, they can potentially lock you from being able to use abilities and punish you for overextending within the lane or their territory of the map. Try to avoid this by making sure to ward and deny Hecarim from this opportunity, limiting his overall options in being able to play the game.

(8) Ping Hecarim Roams - As already mentioned, Hecarim R is a giant utility tool that can allow him to get back into the game. With that said, he can also roam towards mid lane or any objectives and use R to help his team win the fights. Simply Ping his roams out before he is able to make these plays happen. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Hecarim's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(10) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - At this point within the game, Hecarim's only real threat and overall objective is to simply look for a Ghost R play onto your backline. Doing this will result in Hecarim’s ability to mass CC your team, providing himself plenty of burst and consistent damage through his high movement speed playstyle. As Renekton, shutting down a Hecarim is actually pretty easy, as Renekton’s W alone can completely lock Hecarim from engaging, or simply try to disengage. Try to burst him down as fast as you can, you can do this if he’s trying to initiate first onto your team, with that you can just target your W stun onto him and make quick work of him relatively easy. Overall Hecarim really isn’t that big of a threat, especially within his full damage build, which makes this overall gameplan really easy to stick to. The only other thing he will try to play for, is trying to engage on isolated picks that are overextended. With that in mind, try to always spam ping your teammates away from the fog of war territories if he isn’t on the map, as this will be the only play making opportunity he will be able to do.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite o Q de Hecarim - O principal estilo de jogo e fonte de dano de Hecarim vem de sua habilidade Q. Seu Q causa dano de estilo AOE que acumula 3 vezes, bem como o tempo de espera é reduzido em cada pilha. Contanto que você não faça overtrade no início do Q dele, Hecarim realmente não terá uma resposta para seu early game, então certifique-se de manter as lutas curtas e usar suas habilidades para manter um sucesso consistente. 

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Hecarim, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Hecarim perca muito mais. 

(3) Abuse dos problemas de mana de Hecarim - A rota solo de Hecarim tem sido terrível há anos, principalmente devido ao motivo de que sua mana base e custos de mana simplesmente não são adequados para a rota superior atualmente. A mana base de Hecarim geralmente é consumida por suas habilidades Q e W, já que ambas são ótimas ferramentas de combate e sustentação na rota. O problema para Hecarim, entretanto, é que o maior problema dentro do confronto de Renekton é o fato de ele ter que usar todas as suas habilidades de uma vez para sobreviver, tornando-o um alvo bastante indefeso para Renekton e snowball. Sendo que Hecarim tem que usar defensivamente suas habilidades para tentar sobreviver, isso queima substancialmente sua mana, deixando-o em uma posição terrível se Renekton jogar para dive ou freeze lacaio waves. 

(4) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(5) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(6) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(7) Respeite o R de Hecarim - A única coisa com a qual você realmente precisa se preocupar neste confronto é a configuração de gank ou teamfighting de Hecarim. Se Hecarim puder jogar com um caçador CC corretamente, eles podem potencialmente impedir você de usar habilidades e puni-lo por se estender demais dentro da rota ou do território do mapa. Tente evitar isso certificando-se de afastar e negar Hecarim desta oportunidade, limitando suas opções gerais de poder jogar o jogo.

(8) Ping Hecarim Roams - Como já mencionado, Hecarim R é uma ferramenta utilitária gigante que pode permitir que ele volte ao jogo. Dito isso, ele também pode roam em direção ao meio ou qualquer objetivo e usar R para ajudar seu time a vencer as lutas. Simplesmente faça um ping em seus roamings antes que ele consiga fazer essas jogadas acontecerem. 

(9) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Hecarim e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

(10) Meio de jogo + dicas de teamfighting - Neste ponto do jogo, a única ameaça real e objetivo geral de Hecarim é simplesmente procurar uma jogada de Ghost R em sua linha de defesa. Fazer isso resultará na capacidade de Hecarim de reunir CC sua equipe, proporcionando bastante burst e dano consistente através de seu estilo de jogo de alta velocidade de movimento. Como Renekton, desligar um Hecarim é realmente muito fácil, já que o W de Renekton sozinho pode bloquear completamente o envolvimento de Hecarim, ou simplesmente tentar disengage. tente burst derrubá-lo o mais rápido que puder, você pode fazer isso se ele estiver tentando iniciar primeiro em sua equipe, com isso você pode simplesmente direcionar seu atordoamento W para ele e fazer um trabalho rápido com ele relativamente fácil. No geral, Hecarim realmente não é uma ameaça tão grande, especialmente dentro de seu dano total, o que torna esse plano de jogo geral muito fácil de seguir. A única outra coisa pela qual ele tentará jogar é tentar engage em escolhas isoladas que estão sobrecarregadas. Com isso em mente, tente sempre enviar spam para seus companheiros de equipe para longe da névoa dos territórios de guerra se ele não estiver no mapa, pois esta será a única oportunidade de criação de jogo que ele poderá aproveitar.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Heimerdinger - VN Grandmaster Patch 25.24
summaryEn: The Heimerdinger match up is a pretty uninteractive match up till level 6, although Renekton can find kill windows post level 3, he should simply work up to that by waiting for Heimerdinger to miss his E. Renekton can easily force Heimerdinger to play in his way, as he can use his E to quickly dash in and out to bait his grenade, forcing Heimer to lose mana and play into Renekton's mind games. Renekton can also use his Q to easily kill Heimer's turrets, allowing him to take away damage and force him to waste more mana using them. Eventually at level 6, Renekton can take advantage of Heimer's E miss to force a kill window, allowing him to use his R to help him stat check towards a kill. Renekton needs to be careful of Heimerdinger's R turret, as this provides him a ton of damage to kill him. Instead, wait out of his R turret, then force the kill as soon as it's gone. Renekton can use items like Hexdrinker or Eclipse to provide him great success within the match up. Later on Renekton's role is a lot more versatile than Heimerdinger's, allowing him to play in any way he wants towards the mid to late game. Make sure to ward any bushes before any major objective timers, as Heimerdinger will camp bushes looking to burst down any targets.

Renekton também pode usar seu Q para matar facilmente as torres de Heimer, permitindo-lhe remover danos e forçá-lo a desperdiçar mais mana usando-as. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Heimerdinger’s Turrets - At level 1, Heimer will attempt to place all his turrets in the middle of the lane, as doing this provides him with easy time to push and zone his opponents off the minion wave. Trying to fight him or his turrets at this point is practically impossible without level 3. With that said, try to let him push and play for your level 3 spike, in which you will be able to use empowered Q to help you kill and outsustain through his poke.

(2) Play For Sustain - Heimer's early lane power will force you into tanking a lot of damage, providing a giant problem for Renekton’s early lane bully style. However within this match up, we simply try to win this lane by abusing our sustain and our ability to easily mana burn Heimerdinger. To do this, simply abuse Doran Shield and Second Wind, as these allow us to easily tank and kill his turrets. Once we hit level 3 we’re also able to do quick combos to get in and out, allowing us to easily avoid his abilities and successfully mana burn him towards an advantageous position. 

(3) Play For E Miss - Heimer's main weakness is located within his squishyness and the fact he only has one defensive ability with his E. Renekton can quickly dash in and out to avoid his stun, allowing him to burn through his mana and look for trading opportunities. Eventually Renekton can double dash to avoid his E and go for a one shot if Renekton played well prior to this. 

(4) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Avoid Extended Fights - Trying to look for extended fights vs Heimerdinger without a giant lead is always a recipe for disaster. Hemier generates additional movement speed when running next to his turrets, meaning that whenever you’re trying to greed your damage he will simply just run away and his turrets will end up eating you alive. As already mentioned, play for short trades and make sure you avoid his E stun to really leverage any kind of fights onto Heimer.

(8) Respect Heimerdingers R - When looking to fight heimerdinger in an all in attempt, he will usually try to use his R and look to use his Q. If he does this within a fight, simply use your E2 to exit, or simply walk out of range. Whenever Heimer uses R, it seriously isn’t recommended to fight with him as he’s able to nuke any targets in range with him. Another attempt at Heimer using his R, is that if you’re low and you potentially tank his grenade stun, Heimer can look to use R W to completely one shot or finish you off. As mentioned, try to always avoid and punish his grenade as that will dictate how you will be able to fight him within the lane. 

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(9) Rush Mercury Treads, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Mercury Treads to lower Heimer's overall damage and CC duration. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Heimerdinger's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(10) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - Heimerdinger’s overall strength within the mid game is a lot more linear when it compares to his early game. Within the mid game, Hemier’s role is either to look for picks, using his R > E to help CC his enemies, place turrets and cheese using bushes, or rushing objectives using his turrets. When playing around Heimerdinger make sure to provide vision in an area with blue trinket or prior wards, as heimer won't be able to cheese his damage onto you or your team. In a teamfight he is essentially a sitting duck to kill once he has no major abilities up, with that in mind you can engage for your team and try to lock him down into a one shot. Be aware of his R E, as it's a major utility stun tool, however if he misses he also falls under being very useless. It also should be said that, if Heimer tries to look for a R Q, you should try to reposition the fight away from his R, or simply try to kill Heimer or his turret as fast as possible.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite as torres de Heimerdinger - Em level 1, Heimer tentará colocar todas as suas torres no meio da pista, pois isso lhe dará tempo fácil para empurrar e afastar seus oponentes do lacaio wave. tentar lutar contra ele ou suas torres neste ponto é praticamente impossível sem level 3. Dito isso, tente deixá-lo empurrar e jogar para obter seu pico de level 3, no qual você poderá usar Empowered Q para ajudá-lo a matar e superar seu poke.

(2) Jogue para Sustentar – O poder inicial de Heimer na rota irá forçá-lo a sofrer muitos danos, proporcionando um grande problema para o estilo agressivo da rota inicial de Renekton. Porém dentro deste confronto, simplesmente tentamos vencer esta lane abusando de nosso sustentação e de nossa habilidade de esgotar a mana facilmente Heimerdinger. Para fazer isso, simplesmente abuse de Doran Shield e Second Wind, pois eles nos permitem tankar e matar facilmente suas torres. Assim que atingirmos level 3, também seremos capazes de fazer combos rápidos para entrar e sair, permitindo-nos evitar facilmente suas habilidades e esgotar a mana com sucesso para uma posição vantajosa. 

(3) Play For E Miss - A principal fraqueza de Heimer está localizada em sua fragilidade e no fato de ele ter apenas uma habilidade defensiva com seu E. Renekton pode entrar e sair rapidamente para evitar seu stun, permitindo que ele queime sua mana e procure oportunidades de trocas. Eventualmente, Renekton pode fazer um double dash para evitar seu E e tentar um one shot se Renekton tiver jogado bem antes disso. 

(4) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Evite lutas prolongadas - tentar lutar por lutas prolongadas contra Heimerdinger sem uma liderança gigante é sempre uma receita para o desastre. Hemier gera velocidade de movimento adicional ao correr próximo a suas torres, o que significa que sempre que você estiver tentando causar dano, ele simplesmente fugirá e suas torres acabarão comendo você vivo. Como já mencionado, jogue trocas curtas e evite seu atordoamento E para realmente alavancar qualquer tipo de luta em Heimer.

(8) Respeite o R de Heimerdinger - Ao buscar lutar contra Heimerdinger em uma tentativa de all in, ele normalmente tentará usar seu R e tentará usar seu Q. Se ele fizer isso dentro de uma luta, simplesmente use seu E2 para sair, ou simplesmente saia do alcance. Sempre que Heimer usa R, não é seriamente recomendado lutar com ele, pois ele é capaz de destruir qualquer alvo ao seu alcance. Outra tentativa de Heimer usando seu R é que se você estiver baixo e potencialmente tankar seu atordoamento de granada, Heimer pode usar R W para completar one-shot ou acabar com você. Como mencionado, tente sempre evitar e punir sua granada, pois isso ditará como você será capaz de combatê-lo na pista. 

(9) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base de Renekton e as stats de seu R permitem que Renekton stat check complete seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

(9) Rush Mercury Treads, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Use Mercury Treads para diminuir o dano geral de Heimer e a duração de CC. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Heimerdinger e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(10) Meio de jogo + Dicas de teamfighting - A força geral de Heimerdinger dentro do mid game é muito mais linear quando comparada ao seu early game. Dentro do mid game, o papel de Hemier é procurar picaretas, usando seu R > E para ajudar CC seus inimigos, posicionar torres e queijos usando arbustos ou atacar objetivos usando suas torres. Ao brincar com Heimerdinger, certifique-se de fornecer visão em uma área com bugiganga azul ou sentinelas anteriores, pois heimer não será capaz de causar dano a você ou sua equipe. Em um teamfight ele é essencialmente um alvo fácil para matar, uma vez que não tem grandes habilidades, com isso em mente você pode engage para sua equipe e tentar prendê-lo em um único tiro. Esteja ciente de seu RE, pois é uma ferramenta de atordoamento de grande utilidade, no entanto, se ele errar, ele também se tornará muito inútil. Também deve ser dito que, se Heimer tentar procurar um R Q, você deve tentar reposicionar a luta longe de seu R, ou simplesmente tentar matar Heimer ou sua torre o mais rápido possível.

summaryEn: Laning vs Hwei is very hard, due to Hwei's abundance of abilities that allow him to deny Renekton from getting the trades he wants. All that Renekton can really do early is use Second Wind and Doran's Shield, as this allows him to sustain and survive the laning phase. Renekton's main objective should be to rush Mercury Treads, as it allows him to escape Hwei's CC faster, as well as lower his overall damage. Make sure to get your teammates to help gank Hwei, as his over extending playstyle will force him up into free kill. At post 6, Renekton can potentially kill Hwei, but this is pretty rare unless you're able to bush camp and wait for for him to use all his abilities. Renekton's main focus should just be to play around his team, playing around the necessary win conditions to help him find relevancy and win the game. Make sure when fighting that if Hwei R's you, that you try to dash or walk away from your team to avoid him dealing AoE damage.

The only event Renekton could maybe avoid his fear is that if Hwei already uses it onto one of your teammates, or you can quickly double dash past him to avoid it. videoTitle: Renekton vs Illaoi - Full Counter Matchup - Full Game
summaryEn: Illoai is a super hard match up for Renekton, due to her low CDs and punishing abilities being way too much for Renekton to really deal with. Renekton's best bet at gaining an advantage is from his first few levels, as he can take W to counter Illoai's W start playstyle, or take Q if Illoai starts Q. Make sure to keep the wave state close to the middle, as being near her tower or your own provides her the ability to easily use tentacles. If Illaoi fights you in the middle of the lane, you can go toe to toe against her, potentially forcing a kill if she's low enough. By level 6, Illoai will straight up win fights if she lands E, so make sure to always avoid being hit by E in any way possible. Alternatively if Illoai does miss E, Renekton can force an all in on her E down timer, allowing him or his allies to easily shut her down and take away her power. Later on in the game, Illoai's weak teamfighting presence allows Renekton to fulfill a valuable role on his team. Illaoi will most likely look to push side lane with her items, forcing you and your team to remove her from the map before making any plays possible. Once she is dead, you and your team should force any major objectives or fights that are available on her death timer.

(1) Respect Illaoi Level 1 - Illaoi’s level 1 is pretty underrated in the fact she can hard outtrade her opponents with her grasp W trades, which allows her to also abuse her tentacles to hit the targets she is hitting. As Renekton, we can’t do much other than trying to mitigate it by trying to hard push the wave, on top of also trying to avoid her tentacle slams. If we hesitate too hard vs Illaoi, she will completely zone us from the wave preventing level 2 and the ability to get a hard trade on her.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once we reach level 2 vs Illaoi, we’re able to look for a hard trade to abuse her. It is absolutely essential to put everything into the first few levels in our trades before her inevitable fun times. As Renekton, try to look for a heavy trade when we reach level 2, then look for a level 3 kill on the wave shove back. Try to hard push first 2 waves and look for the waves to crash back around the middle, as staying away from the walls and her side of the map will leave her in an uncomfortable state.

(3) Respect And Kill Illaoi Tentacles - Playing around Illaoi’s tentacles is absolutely crucial to keeping your HP up and preventing her overall sustain. Illaoi will always try to poke with her W and Q, providing she misses her E. Try to kill any tentacles you can whenever Illoai doesn’t have her E or range available to poke with. Doing this will also limit her overall tentacles she can receive through her R. 

(4) Avoid And Punish Illaoi E - Illaoi E is an absolutely horrible ability, which quite honestly is probably my most hated ability in the entire game. What does hard suck for this match up is how big Renekton’s hit box is, which can completely feel awful when it comes to trying to dodge on lower movement speed thresholds. As Renekton, the best thing we can do to deal with this and avoid being hit, is trying to rush movement speed to easily out manoeuvre her E, trying to use minions to block her tentacle hits and just trying to utilise our E dash to bait her ability. Within this match up, Renekton does have to play very on edge to beat Illaoi, so trying to fast trade and look for any opportunity to bait or miss her E is essential for fights. Once Illaoi misses even one E, we can look for a heavy trade or kill window, as Renekton’s power completely overpowers Illaoi once she has no E. Just be aware her E CD is very short as the game goes on, so make sure you play around your timers effectively to have success over her.

(5) Rush Antiheal - If you don’t take ignite into this match up, then going Executioners is absolutely a must if you’re going to beat Illaoi. Illaoi’s overall healing from her tentacles can be the absolute decider for her being able to cheese low hp fights, hence why anti heal is needed to take away that opportunity for her. Later on in the game, the healing reduction will become even more essential for defeating illaoi within fights with your team. 

(6) Play Wave Within The Middle - Playing within the middle of the lane is most certainly the best point around the Illaoi match up, as Illaoi won’t be able to easily access her tentacles compared to inner points of either side of the lane. Typically if you’re pushed in, Illaoi can spawn to tentacles aside of the tower wall and rocks, making it incredibly hard to deal with her poking ability. When you’re shoving in, Illaoi can easily farm and prevent herself to trades using her tentacles around her tower, overall making it impossible to leverage any fights. Keeping the wave in the middle is always the best case, so try to always stick to this if you’re available to. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Avoid Illoai R - Whenever Illaoi R’s there’s a couple of situations that make it more impactful on whether or not you can kill, or you absolutely need to dip away from her. If Illaoi misses E, her R is generally not as impactful as it spawns less tentacles, as well as the fact she will be dealing way less DPS in the process. In these moments where she doesn’t land E, you need to abuse it, so as long as you have R up you can tank against Illaoi’s R and stat check the overall fight if played well. If Illaoi hits E then R however then you need to instantly dash away, otherwise she will absolutely fist you. 

(9) Play For Ganks - Ganks can be very awkward vs Illaoi as most people don’t understand that getting hit by her E is simply GG, so with that said if you can make her miss by dashing in with E then side stepping or double dashing past her to avoid it, you can then create a free gank setup and easily shut her down.

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Illaoi as a teamfighter isn’t really her strong point, as CC is one of Illaoi’s difficult attributes to deal with. Another huge con towards Illaoi’s playstyle within the mid game, is trying to deal with high mobility based targets, which she absolutely sucks at. With that said, Illaoi will try to play heavy for side lane push, as she can essentially dominate most champions in the entire game with her high stat check and low CD playstyle. As Renekton, this is a very difficult point within the game, as most often you’re relegated towards dealing with her. Renekton can’t really offer a lot within the 1v1 or in terms of trying to deter her from pushing, so you need to get your team to help you shut her down. Como Renekton, tente procurar uma troca pesada quando chegarmos a level 2, então procure por uma morte de level 3 no empurrão de volta de wave. tente empurrar com força primeiro 2 waves e procure o waves a crash no meio, pois ficar longe das paredes e do lado dela do mapa a deixará em um estado desconfortável.

Fazer isso também limitará os tentáculos gerais que ela pode receber através de seu R.

O que é difícil para este confronto é o quão grande é a hit box de Renekton, o que pode ser completamente horrível quando se trata de tentar esquivar em limites de velocidade de movimento mais baixos. Como Renekton, a melhor coisa que podemos fazer para lidar com isso e evitar ser atingido, é tentar acelerar a velocidade de movimento para manobrar facilmente seu E, tentar usar lacaios para bloquear seus golpes de tentáculos e apenas tentar utilizar nosso E dash para atrair sua habilidade. Mais tarde no jogo, a redução de cura se tornará ainda mais essencial para derrotar Illaoi nas lutas com seu time.

Quando você está avançando, Illaoi pode facilmente cultivar e evitar trocas usando seus tentáculos ao redor de sua torre, tornando impossível alavancar qualquer luta. Manter o wave no meio é sempre o melhor caso, então tente sempre seguir isso se estiver disponível.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1)  Respect Irelia Level 1 - Irelia’s level 1 can be very strong if you play directly into it. Irelia’s level 1 goal will be simply trying to get her 4 passive stacks from minions, allowing her to Q onto you and auto attack you down. This is one of Renekton’s biggest mistakes within the match up, to where he doesn’t respect this and lets Irelia kill him. As Renekton, you can either play to shove the wave if you’re there first, to avoid Irelia getting her level 1 all in, or you can simply wait it out and let her shove the wave. I personally prefer letting Irelia shove first two waves, otherwise if I shove the first two waves, Irelia can abuse the 3rd and 4th wave crash to stack on her passive and get her fast back, or allow her to maintain her passive damage to out trade Renekton. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once letting Irelia push the first two waves into our turret, we can look to play more aggressively with the wave on our side. Make sure to use our wave state, to force more aggressive plays by utilising trades onto Irelia when she Q’s a minion. Punishing her minion dashing is absolutely free for obtaining damage onto her, as long as we don’t W her W and hold her damage accordingly. Once doing this optimally, we can either instant kill Irelia within a fight, or we can look for a kill on our next ability timers. 

(3) Play Around Minions - As previously mentioned, Irelia’s deaths or kills are all determined under how you’re playing around her minions. Irelia will always use them to land her E’s, as she can easily mask her E ability onto the minion, then target from that minion onto you to land her damage. Try to always be observant and anticipate any form of engage, by short clicking side to side or towards her, as these will easily allow her to make a mistake and lose out her winning trade potential. Spotting out any of your low HP minions when trying to run across to Irelia can also be a great way to cut her off and also anticipate her own movements, which are very linear when you really play off these conditions. 

(4) Avoid Comboing Into Irelia W - Irelia W provides Irelia with the ability to survive Renekton’s burst if used correctly, however it should be in Renekton’s best interest to always play around her W to ensure he gets the max damage possible. tips.contentEn: Once you chunk out Janna level 1, you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Janna lose a lot more.
tips.contentPt: Depois de separar Janna level 1, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Janna perca muito mais.

tips.titlePt: Abuse de Renekton's Waveclear
tips.contentEn: A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game.
tips.contentPt: Uma grande vantagem que Renekton tem neste confronto é sua habilidade geral de eliminar facilmente o lacaio waves. Isso pode ajudá-lo a obter redefinições de tempo perfeitas ou permitir que ele proxy waves ajude a aumentar sua vantagem de ouro, ao mesmo tempo que refém o top laner inimigo sob sua própria torre. Ser capaz de limpar rapidamente também força o inimigo a contestar o ataque, permitindo que você queime mana facilmente e crie posições vantajosas a partir dele. Abuse dessa força para evitar situações ruins de rota ou aumentar seu poder geral no jogo.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Janna Q
tips.contentEn: Janna’s Q is probably one of the only things you need to worry about when it comes to this match up, as if timed right she can instantly cancel your dash before you get E2, or she can use it to simply peel you away from her carries or herself within the lane. Overall, if Janna is play her Q well enough, simply just play to proxy or play to freeze her out and let her waste Q to get the wave. If she uses Q to get minions, try to abuse this by double dashing from the wave with the intent of heavy trading her.  Doing this can help you tower dive her or force her to back.
tips.contentPt: O Q de Janna é provavelmente uma das únicas coisas com que você precisa se preocupar quando se trata deste confronto, como se fosse cronometrado corretamente, ela pode cancelar instantaneamente seu avanço antes de você chegar a E2, ou ela pode usá-lo para simplesmente peel você se afastar de seus carregadores ou de si mesma dentro da pista. No geral, se Janna estiver jogando seu Q bem o suficiente, simplesmente jogue para proxy ou jogue para freeze e deixe-o desperdiçar Q para obter o wave. Se ela usar Q para conseguir lacaios, tente abusar disso correndo duas vezes da wave com a intenção de fazer trocas pesadas nela.  Fazer isso pode ajudá-lo a tower dive ou forçá-la a recuar.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Pesadas (Heavy Trades)
tips.contentEn: Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Ping nas rondas de Janna
tips.contentEn: Janna as a champion absolutely sucks as a laner, so expect her to cheese roams the whole game to get her teammates ahead. Simply spam ping her movements and play for perma push to punish Janna’s decision making, as this will help you easily snowball the game and dominate top side of the map.
tips.contentPt: Janna como campeã é absolutamente péssima como laner, então espere que ela percorra todo o jogo para colocar seus companheiros de equipe na frente. Simplesmente envie spam para seus movimentos e jogue para push permanente para punir a tomada de decisão de Janna, pois isso o ajudará a snowball facilmente o jogo e a dominar a parte superior do mapa.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Janna's R
tips.contentEn: Janna’s R can be quite an annoying ability when it comes to playing against it. Most of the time at this point, if you try to fully commit to Janna she will instantly press R to knock you away. As annoying as this is burning her ult is an absolute win, as any chance a teamfight or skirmish opens up, if she has no R to play around she instantly loses all value to protect her carries from your engages.
tips.contentPt: O R de Janna pode ser uma habilidade bastante irritante quando se trata de jogar contra ele. Na maioria das vezes, neste ponto, se você tentar se comprometer totalmente com Janna, ela irá instantaneamente pressionar R para derrubá-lo. Por mais irritante que isso seja queimar seu ult, é uma vitória absoluta, já que qualquer chance de um teamfight ou skirmish abrir, se ela não tiver R para brincar, ela instantaneamente perde todo o valor para proteger seus carregamentos de seus ataques.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Janna’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Janna e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Janna’s role within the game is essentially to play around her teams and people with her Q, E and R abilities, with the hopes of protecting and denying any engage champions from touching her carries. As Renekton, typically we want to look for her to either use Q or R in a fight before hard committing ourselves onto their carries, but as we’re most likely giga fed and play a more frontline based position, as we need her to force out her R within a fight. If you successfully do this you can easily waste a portion of her kit, allowing your teammates to jump on her carries or allow you to easily one shot them with flash or having your dashes available. Alternatively, you can look to make picks with red trinket before a fight and use a higher damage play style to instantly nuke targets before any objectives or even Janna if she crosses through towards you.
tips.contentPt: O papel de Janna dentro do jogo é essencialmente brincar com suas equipes e pessoas com suas habilidades Q, E e R, com a esperança de proteger e impedir que qualquer campeão engage toque em seus carregadores. Como Renekton, normalmente queremos que ela use Q ou R em uma luta antes de nos comprometermos fortemente com seus carregamentos, mas como provavelmente estamos muito alimentados e jogamos em uma posição mais baseada na linha de frente, precisamos que ela force seu R dentro de uma luta. Se você fizer isso com sucesso, poderá facilmente desperdiçar uma parte do kit dela, permitindo que seus companheiros de equipe pulem em seus carregadores ou permitindo que você atire facilmente neles com Flash ou tenha seus ataques disponíveis. Alternativamente, você pode fazer escolhas com bugiganga vermelha antes de uma luta e usar um estilo de jogo de maior dano para destruir alvos instantaneamente antes de qualquer objetivo ou até mesmo Janna se ela passar em sua direção.

level1ExplanationEn: Start E for fast level 1 trades with E1 > 3 AAs (PTA) > E2 disengage.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Janna e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Janna with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Janna.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Janna's disengage crowd control.

videoTitle: Blitzcrank Support vs Jarvan IV - KR Master Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Jarvan is a pretty free match up to deal with as Renekton, as Jarvan's simplistic and easy to outplay kit provides Renekton the ability to kill Jarvan at will. Level 1, try to avoid Jarvan's passive autos with grasp and his W, as these provide him early damage to help him assert dominance. By level 2, Renekton can simply take W and look for heavy trades as soon as Jarvan walks into range. Post level 3, Renekton can force trades on Jarvan to heavily burst him down, or he can side step Jarvan's engages, countering him back with a heavy trade and potential kill window from that. Jarvan's only real purpose within the game is to look for picks with his team, so make sure to ping his whereabouts to avoid giving his team any potential assistance. In teamfights we can simply nuke Jarvan before he's able to do much, but preferably focusing his main carries is more important for the game.
summaryPt: Jarvan é um confronto bastante livre para lidar como Renekton, já que o kit simplista e fácil de superar de Jarvan fornece a Renekton a habilidade de matar Jarvan à vontade. level 1, tente evitar os automáticos passivos de Jarvan com Grasp e seu W, pois eles fornecem a ele dano inicial para ajudá-lo a afirmar o domínio. Por level 2, Renekton pode simplesmente pegar W e procurar por trocas pesadas assim que Jarvan entrar no alcance. Postar level 3, Renekton pode forçar trocas em Jarvan para derrubá-lo fortemente, ou ele pode evitar os combates de Jarvan, contra-atacando com uma troca pesada e uma potencial janela de morte a partir disso. O único propósito real de Jarvan no jogo é procurar escolhas com seu time, então certifique-se de avisar seu paradeiro para evitar dar qualquer assistência potencial ao seu time. Em teamfights podemos simplesmente atacar Jarvan antes que ele seja capaz de fazer muito, mas de preferência focar em seus ataques principais é mais importante para o jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Jarvan you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Jarvan lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Respect Jarvan’s Passive + Q Shred - Jarvan’s early laning phase consists of him abusing grasps and passive procs for damage, or using his Q to poke out and trade with auto attacks. Make sure when fighting Jarvan that you always avoid trading into his Q damage and armour shred passive, on top of also denying him any auto attack trades without your W. If you play to keep your HP up and play around your abilities, Jarvan will not be able to do a single thing. 

(5) Abuse Renekton W Shield Break - Renekton’s W shield break is a really great tool into Jarvan, as you’re able to consistently break his shields and counter his overall shield heavy playstyles with some of his bruiser builds. As long as you’re using empowered W on his shield timing, Jarvan will never be able to out trade Renekton in a 1v1.

(6) Respect Jarvan’s Gank Setup - Jarvan’s overall gank setup is pretty great with the right jungler, as he applies a lot of utility against targets with his overall armour shred, knock up, W slow and his R lockdown. Try to hold your dashes against Jarvan, wait for him to E > Q and side step it, if he tries to ult use your E1 or E2 to dash out of it to avoid getting caught.

(7) 3 Points Q > W Max - W Max vs Jarvan is a giant counter option towards his overall playstyle, as if he opts towards his bruiser shield build with his W, Eclipse and Fimbulwinter, Renekton will be able to consistently nuke through all his shields with the consistent amount of W’s he is able to obtain within a fight.

(8) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Jarvan’s overall objective when it comes towards the mid to late game, is essentially to make play making opportunities using his E Q and R combos, or adding in flash to help him easily combo towards out of access targets. Jarvan’s reliability as a pick through the game severely weakens when more champions access HP, Armour Shred or Mobility, so as you’re getting into the game, utilising playstyles such as W max continuously creates problems in him trying to stick towards targets. When playing vs Jarvan, try to avoid fights where the enemy has the player advantage, as he thrives off the ability to make picks and plays in greater numbers. When teamfighting vs Jarvan, you’re most likely able to easily cut down his resistances using Empowered E and W’s, to weaken his accessibility to front line within front to back fights. Playing to jump and distract his backline is another great option vs Jarvan, as his commitments are setting up engages with his teammates following them. If you’re able to build correctly you will be able to easily stick onto his carries and potentially nuke or slow them down, as within that time your team can successfully kill Jarvan and look to advance against his team within the fight.

Ao jogar contra Jarvan, evite lutas onde o inimigo tenha a vantagem do jogador, pois ele aproveita a capacidade de fazer escolhas e jogar em maior número. Quando teamfighting vs Jarvan, você provavelmente será capaz de Cut Down facilmente suas resistências usando Empowered E e W's, para enfraquecer sua acessibilidade à linha de frente em lutas de frente para trás. Jogar para pular e distrair sua defesa é outra ótima opção contra Jarvan, já que seus compromissos são estabelecer engajamentos com seus companheiros que os seguem. When playing vs Jax, try not to fight him with his passive fully stacked from the wave, as his ability to hard win trades is very apparent with the additional attack speed. When jax walks in with E, we should use our E to avoid Jax from landing his stun. Later on, we can time our E as soon as Jax Q's into us, providing us the ability to burn Jax's mana and CDs. Short trades with Q are very important, as well as using our W as soon as Jax uses his E. By level 6, try to avoid heavy trades vs Jax with full HP and R up, instead play the wave on your side and look for kills as soon as Jax misplays and has no R up. Renekton can rush Eclipse if he's hard winning the match up, or he can go Black Cleaver for consistency and insurance to deal with Jax's heavy armour in teamfights. Renekton's skirmishing and teamfighting power is a lot more influential than Jax's, so make sure to play around your teammates and for objectives. Jax will be stronger within 1v1's after Triforce, so make sure to get your teammates to help you shut him down in side lane before fighting for any major objectives.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q/E Start - When playing vs Jax level 1, the lane can go two different ways. Jax can either come out of bushes and force a hard trade with Lethal Tempo, or he can start hitting the wave for his grasp, following with him forcing a grasp trade with his E. As Renekton, we need to play accordingly into his play pattern, as we can prevent Jax getting the upper hand early. If Jax has lethal tempo, or if he simply tries to come out of the bush and force his auto attack and E trades, try to skill E and simply dash out of it. Doing this prevents Jax from getting his stun off, as well as being able to proc his auto attacks. Following this scenario, simply wait for him to shove the wave and play for level 2/3 to obtain lane control. 

If Jax doesn’t cheese from the bushes, you can walk into the middle of the lane and take Q start. Jax in this situation most likely will have grasp, meaning he will try to auto the wave then look for his trade with his grasp auto and E. Renekton with Q start can simply overpower Jax, in his ability to poke him down and push for level 2 faster than he can. Do note that spacing plays a GIANT part in avoiding Jax’s early power; make sure to Q right at the edge of your indicator to hit him, try to trade short and play to push with Q, try to also kite jax into a position where your minions will attack him after his E. As long as you preserve HP and reach level 2 before him you essentially win and gain lane control. 

(2) Play Around Jax Passive / Avoid Extended Trades - Jax’s passive is a core component to play around in the match up, as misplaying into his passive will leverage Jax the strength he needs to win every trade and fight vs Renekton. Usually Jax looks to stack passive on a pushing wave, followed by him comboing you if you walk up into his range. The trick to playing around Jax to avoid this, is to always pay attention to his passive stacks. Simply if Jax has passive stacks, don’t fight and just use E to escape his Q engage combo. If Jax doesn’t have stacks, make sure to sit on the wave and punish him if he comes close. Wait out his E, then look to punish him with your combo and E2 out. Furthermore, look to do your trades once your wave starts to slow push from your side; this is beneficial as you’re closer to your side of the map, preventing jax from overstacking passive and allowing for extended trades. 

(3) Respect And Outplay Jax E - Jax E is a giant counter towards Renekton, as he can completely avoid Renekton’s damage and stun, making it a giant power move in 1v1’s. Jax’s E is 17 seconds rank 1 CD, which is crucial for remembering within the match up. If Jax opens up with E you then have 17 seconds afterwards to punish Jax, make sure to hard combo him then look to disengage right after. Sometimes Jax won’t open up with E, in which he will use it mid trade of his combo. If he does this, you can try to time your W right away and disengage if he’s constantly trading with this pattern. 

Sometimes when E’ing away, Jax will also try to E > Q onto your E1 or E2 to try and chase up towards you. Make sure when dashing from Jax E, you hold E2 until he uses his Q animation, as doing this will escape his E stun and also allow you to maintain HP. Also make sure to always hold your W until you know what pattern he is doing, as this is a core way of understanding how to effectively use it. 

(4) W Stun Buffer Vs Jax E - I thought it would also be worth mentioning that you can actually stun Jax E, however you need to have giant balls to do this as it’s very risky in nature. Right at the end of Jax’s E frame, you can right click right at the end of it, to actually stun and deal all 3 of your W hits back at Jax, allowing you to stun him and punish his E. The great thing about this, is that you can ALWAYS do this, as long as Jax uses his E for the full 2 seconds. Problem is Jax can recast his E a second earlier, making this a very risky read unless he is fully committing, where he will use E for every second he can. Use this knowledge wisely and outplay with caution. 

(5) Abuse Empowered Q/E - Playing off your Empowered Q and E are essentially for a lot of portions of the game. As W’ing is hard until Jax E’s, we must rely on using our Q to poke down Jax, allowing us to outsustain and steadily get his HP down. Using Q like this will force Jax into recalling, or leave him troubled under his tower against Renekton’s quick Q waveclear. Later on in the game, Jax R is absolutely disgusting with his overall armour stacking, in which using empowered E to shred a giant portion of that is important for 1v1’ing, or playing around our team when playing vs Jax.   

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing wave on our side is very important vs Jax as it provides safety in nullifying Jax’s extended trades, as well as giving us the perfect room to trade into Jax. Use this side of the map to abuse slow pushes, then wait out until Jax pushes back in order to force him back on your side of the map.

(7) Avoid Fighting Jax R - NEVER FIGHT JAX R. Simply as that, this ability has been buffed and it provides him an insane amount of stats and damage in a pure 1v1. Try to utilise your double dashes to completely escape his all in, as burning his R is a giant resource to allow you to handle him within the lane. Alternatively, we can use empowered E to shred his R if it’s a winnable fight, however this isn’t always consistent as an option, so make sure to assess wisely. 

(8) Abuse Renekton R Powerspike - This is practically always needed vs Jax post 6, as our own stats can help us completely stat check Jax if we’re already ahead, or if we played well enough in an even state. Jax R is still to be avoided in a pure 1v1, however Renekton R can turn the fight if you’re kiting out and playing with minions or ignite to win the 1v1.

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or Stridebreaker - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Jax’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid game, Jax’s overall power level reaches a critical mass when it comes to side laning power, meaning our full attention to fight or trade with Jax is simply non-existent. Once Jax gets Triforce and Sunderered, he can essentially hard win 90% of 1v1’s with Renekton if he has R up, as his low CDs and hard hybrid damage completely gaps Renekton in side lane. With that said, our only role is trying to wave clear and look for plays with our team when he’s isolated. Shutting down Jax is a giant advantage on the map, as he is not able to split push turrets and you’re able to roam or fight for map based objectives. Renekton’s overall strength over Jax is his skirmishing and teamfighting power, so finding opportunities to snowball is essential for beating Jax.

Within teamfights try to either focus Jax’s carries if you’re fed enough to kill them and tank their damage, or play to protect your carries from Jax’s engage with your empowered W’s and your empowered E shred.
detailedNotesRawPt:
