videoTitle: TOP Renekton vs Karthus - NA Grandmaster Patch 25.S2.1
summaryEn: Karthus is a very easy match up for Renekton, as Karthus's lack of mobility prevents him from being able to escape Renekton's jaws of death. When playing vs Karthus, try to always avoid being hit by his Q by always moving side to side. Whenever you have E up, you can try to force heavy trades to instantly kill Karthus on demand. If Karthus takes exhaust try to hold your damage until it wears off, Karthus will typically use exhaust if he's on low HP. Karthus cannot really do much against Renekton to snowball, however he's always able to use his R to get kills within the game. Try to ping or warn your teammates of his R to prevent him getting free kills. Within teamfights, Renekton can essentially do anything he wants, however try to avoid instantly killing Karthus before any other major carries, as his damage passive allows him to apply additional damage after he is dead.
summaryPt: Karthus é um confronto muito fácil para Renekton, pois a falta de mobilidade de Karthus o impede de escapar das garras da morte de Renekton. Ao jogar contra Karthus, tente sempre evitar ser atingido por seu Q movendo-se sempre de um lado para o outro. Sempre que você tiver E ativado, você pode tentar forçar trocas pesadas para matar Karthus instantaneamente sob demanda. Se Karthus levar Exhaust tente segurar seu dano até que ele desapareça, Karthus normalmente usará Exhaust se estiver com HP baixo. Karthus não pode fazer muito contra Renekton a snowball, no entanto, ele sempre é capaz de usar seu R para matar dentro do jogo. tente fazer ping ou avise seus companheiros de equipe sobre seu R para evitar que ele consiga mortes gratuitas. Dentro de teamfights, Renekton pode essencialmente fazer o que quiser, no entanto, evite matar Karthus instantaneamente antes de qualquer outro carregamento principal, já que seu dano passivo permite que ele aplique dano adicional depois de morrer.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Karthus you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Karthus lose a lot more. 

(3) Avoid Karthus Q Poke - Karthus’s main way of playing the game is simply using his Q to land damage onto his target. Try to utilise your movement side to side to avoid his damage, while also making him waste mana in the process. You can also use your dashes to easily avoid his damage, then look to one shot him while he is stuck in his Q cast animation. Another thing to note, is that Karthus Q does more damage when the target is isolated, so make sure to avoid tanking Q’s when you’re away from the wave. 

(4) Respect Karthus Passive - Whenever you kill Karthus, remember to respect his passive as it can easily obtain him kills if you’re low. Preventing Karthus from getting any gold is essential, so make sure to never hand him over any free gold or he will use it to hard snowball the game with his R. 

(5) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Respect Karthus R - Karthus R can help him obtain lots of kills through the game, as he can use it to deal damage to enemies from across the map. When playing vs Karthus, you can’t really do a lot to stop him from getting kills unless he ults right in front of you, in which you can cancel his R with your W. Overall, try to be wary of low HP plays as his R can easily help him trade 1 for 1 against you in these moments. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Karthus’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Karthus’s role in the game will always exist based upon his R, and how much of a clutch ability it is for him to come back. With that said, buying MR or getting your team to get MR is pretty good in order to survive his overall damage and allow you to easily win fights. Karthus’s power is utilising his passive in teamfights, but we can take that overall power away by allowing ourselves to split push in side lane. Karthus can’t really stop Renekton solo from tanking towers, meaning he always puts himself in harm's way to die to an easy one shot combo. Killing Karthus first in skirmishes or bringing him away from the teamfights will always result in an easier way to play the game, as long as your team doesn’t coin flip a fight until he is dead. When it comes to teamfights, simply play towards your overall win condition of killing his main carries. Wasting your damage on Karthus in a teamfight is usually int because of his passive, so make sure to kill his other carries as they hold a lot more value in these situations.

tips.titlePt: Evite Karthus Q poke
tips.contentEn: Karthus’s main way of playing the game is simply using his Q to land damage onto his target. Try to utilise your movement side to side to avoid his damage, while also making him waste mana in the process. You can also use your dashes to easily avoid his damage, then look to one shot him while he is stuck in his Q cast animation. Another thing to note, is that Karthus Q does more damage when the target is isolated, so make sure to avoid tanking Q’s when you’re away from the wave.
tips.contentPt: A principal maneira de jogar de Karthus é simplesmente usar seu Q para causar dano em seu alvo. Tente utilizar seu movimento de um lado para o outro para evitar danos, ao mesmo tempo que faz com que ele desperdice mana no processo. Você também pode usar seus travessões para evitar facilmente o dano e, em seguida, dar one-shot nele enquanto ele está preso em sua animação de lançamento de Q. Outra coisa a se notar é que Karthus Q causa mais dano quando o alvo está isolado, então evite tankar Q's quando estiver longe da wave.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Karthus Passive
tips.contentEn: Whenever you kill Karthus, remember to respect his passive as it can easily obtain him kills if you’re low. Preventing Karthus from getting any gold is essential, so make sure to never hand him over any free gold or he will use it to hard snowball the game with his R.
tips.contentPt: Sempre que você matar Karthus, lembre-se de respeitar sua passiva, pois ela pode facilmente matá-lo se você estiver com pouca habilidade. Impedir que Karthus obtenha ouro é essencial, então certifique-se de nunca entregar a ele nenhum ouro grátis ou ele o usará para dificultar snowball o jogo com seu R.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Early Game do Renekton
tips.contentEn: In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.
tips.contentPt: Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes desde o início até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Pesadas (Heavy Trades)
tips.contentEn: Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Karthus R
tips.contentEn: Karthus R can help him obtain lots of kills through the game, as he can use it to deal damage to enemies from across the map. When playing vs Karthus, you can’t really do a lot to stop him from getting kills unless he ults right in front of you, in which you can cancel his R with your W. Overall, try to be wary of low HP plays as his R can easily help him trade 1 for 1 against you in these moments.
tips.contentPt: Karthus R pode ajudá-lo a obter muitas mortes durante o jogo, pois pode usá-lo para causar dano a inimigos em todo o mapa. Ao jogar contra Karthus, você realmente não pode fazer muito para impedi-lo de matar, a menos que ele dê ult bem na sua frente, no qual você pode cancelar seu R com seu W. No geral, tenha cuidado com jogadas com HP baixo, pois seu R pode facilmente ajudá-lo a trocar 1 por 1 contra você nesses momentos.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Karthus’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Karthus e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Karthus’s role in the game will always exist based upon his R, and how much of a clutch ability it is for him to come back. With that said, buying MR or getting your team to get MR is pretty good in order to survive his overall damage and allow you to easily win fights. Karthus’s power is utilising his passive in teamfights, but we can take that overall power away by allowing ourselves to split push in side lane. Karthus can’t really stop Renekton solo from tanking towers, meaning he always puts himself in harm's way to die to an easy one shot combo. Killing Karthus first in skirmishes or bringing him away from the teamfights will always result in an easier way to play the game, as long as your team doesn’t coin flip a fight until he is dead. When it comes to teamfights, simply play towards your overall win condition of killing his main carries. Wasting your damage on Karthus in a teamfight is usually int because of his passive, so make sure to kill his other carries as they hold a lot more value in these situations.
tips.contentPt: O papel de Karthus no jogo sempre existirá com base em seu R e no quanto de habilidade de embreagem ele representa para voltar. Com isso dito, comprar MR ou fazer com que sua equipe obtenha MR é muito bom para sobreviver ao dano geral e permitir que você vença lutas facilmente. O poder de Karthus está utilizando sua passiva em teamfights, mas podemos eliminar esse poder geral nos permitindo dividir o push na rota lateral. Karthus realmente não consegue impedir Renekton sozinho de tankar torres, o que significa que ele sempre se coloca em perigo para morrer em um combo fácil de one-shot. Matar Karthus primeiro em skirmishes ou afastá-lo de teamfights sempre resultará em uma maneira mais fácil de jogar, desde que seu time não jogue a moeda na luta até que ele esteja morto. Quando se trata de teamfights, simplesmente jogue de acordo com sua condição geral de vitória de matar seus carregadores principais. Desperdiçar seu dano em Karthus em um teamfight geralmente é int por causa de sua passiva, então certifique-se de matar seus outros carregadores, pois eles têm muito mais valor nessas situações.

level1ExplanationEn: Start E for fast level 1 trades with E1 > 3 AAs (PTA) > E2 disengage.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Karthus e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Karthus with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Karthus.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Karthus's disengage crowd control.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Kassadin - KR Master Patch 26.11
summaryEn: Kassadin is a very free match up for Renekton, as Renekton can completely zone him off the minion wave and force any kills at will. Renekton raw damage completely destroys Kassadin's attempts at being able to play safe, allowing Renekton to always freeze the wave to deny Kassadin any attempts of being able to scale. Once Kassadin reaches level 6, Renekton can still hard abuse his 6 sec CD R with his 2 dashes, allowing him to go for one shots and punish Kassadin for aggressive posturing. All Kassadin can do is look for free kills out of roams, or lane swap to help him farm in side lane. Try to always ping his whereabouts on the map if he tries to roam, as well as asking to swap with your other laner if you want to keep putting Kassadin behind. Within the later stages, Kassadin will scale into a beast at level 16, however Renekton's W lock down is enough to always force Kassadin into terrible circumstances.
summaryPt: Kassadin é um confronto muito livre para Renekton, já que Renekton pode desviá-lo completamente do lacaio wave e forçar qualquer morte à vontade. O dano bruto de Renekton destrói completamente as tentativas de Kassadin de ser capaz de jogar com segurança, permitindo que Renekton sempre freeze o wave negue a Kassadin qualquer tentativa de escalar. Uma vez que Kassadin atinge level 6, Renekton ainda pode abusar fortemente de seu CD R de 6 segundos com seus 2 travessões, permitindo-lhe dar one-shot e punir Kassadin por postura agressiva. Tudo o que Kassadin pode fazer é procurar mortes gratuitas em roaming ou trocar de pista para ajudá-lo a farmar na side lane. tente sempre avisar seu paradeiro no mapa se ele tentar roam, além de pedir para trocar com seu outro laner se quiser continuar colocando Kassadin para trás. Nos estágios posteriores, Kassadin se transformará em uma fera no nível 16, no entanto, o bloqueio W de Renekton é suficiente para sempre forçar Kassadin a circunstâncias terríveis.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Kassadin you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Kassadin lose a lot more.

(3) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(4) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(5) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(6) Ping Kassadin Roams - Kassadin can’t really do anything towards Renekton within the laning phase, so try to actively ping Kassadin’s attempts to roam as that’s his only win condition in being able to snowball kills. When pinging Kassadin’s roams, try to abuse your wave clear and try to take plates while he isn’t in the lane. 

(7) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kassadin while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kassadin within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.   

(8) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Typically within this match up, Kassadin should already be giga behind within the game, as his overall laning ability is far too weak to be able to safely play within the early game. Kassadin’s overall job within the mid game, is trying to farm up in side lane with the objective of farming towards his core level 16 powerspike, on top of his core burst and mana heavy items. Within this stage, you should try to abuse your lead by spreading it across the map and trying hard to end the game as fast as possible. Attempt to be at every objective, tower secure, skirmish and look to abuse your lead within teamfights. If you throw any gold or grief your timer in the game, Kassadin will slowly come back and eventually hard snowball out of control. When it comes to side lane, Renekton can easily handle Kassadin within the side lane as his overall power and items are simply too much for Kassadin to handle. Try to look for isolated kills on Kassadin, then look to hard split or join up for teamfights. When teamfighting, you can essentially ignore Kassadin if he’s weak and just focus on his team’s main carries, as once they’re out of the game Kassadin will most likely not be able to do anything. If Kassadin is fed, try to look for a stun on Kassadin’s R engage, as that is always enough to completely shut down Kassadin within a fight.

(5) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(6) Ping Kassadin Roams - Kassadin realmente não pode fazer nada em relação a Renekton dentro da fase de rotas (laning phase), então tente executar ping ativamente nas tentativas de Kassadin para roam, pois essa é sua única condição de vitória para ser capaz de snowball matar. Ao fazer ping nos roamings de Kassadin, tente abusar de sua liberação de wave e tente pegar placas enquanto ele não estiver na pista. 

(7) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Kassadin enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você facilmente snowball e desligue permanentemente Kassadin em todas as fases do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto.   

(8) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Normalmente neste confronto, Kassadin já deve estar giga atrás no jogo, já que sua habilidade geral de laning é muito fraca para poder jogar com segurança dentro do early game. O trabalho geral de Kassadin dentro do mid game é tentar farmar na rota lateral com o objetivo de farmar em direção ao seu nível básico 16 powerspike, além de seu burst principal e itens pesados ​​de mana. Nesta fase, você deve tentar abusar de sua liderança, espalhando-a pelo mapa e tentando terminar o jogo o mais rápido possível. Tente atingir todos os objetivos, torre segura, skirmish e faça com que abuse de sua liderança em teamfights. Se você jogar algum ouro ou prejudicar seu cronômetro no jogo, Kassadin retornará lentamente e, eventualmente, snowball ficará fora de controle. Quando se trata de rota lateral, Renekton pode facilmente lidar com Kassadin dentro da rota lateral, já que seu poder geral e seus itens são simplesmente demais para Kassadin lidar. tente procurar mortes isoladas em Kassadin, então procure hard split ou junte-se para teamfights. Quando teamfighting, você pode essencialmente ignorar Kassadin se ele estiver fraco e focar apenas nos ataques principais de seu time, já que uma vez que eles estejam fora do jogo, Kassadin provavelmente não será capaz de fazer nada. Se Kassadin for alimentado, procure um atordoamento no R engage de Kassadin, pois isso é sempre suficiente para desligar completamente Kassadin dentro de uma luta.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Katarina you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Katarina lose a lot more. 

(3) Track Katarina daggers - Katarina’s whole gameplay revolves around playing off her daggers, which she can create using her Q or W. When using these a dagger will drop onto the ground, allowing Katarina the ability to dash or deal damage when walking onto them. Make sure to always be aware of where she is using them, as this can help provide you the foresight of where she will go towards. If you’re low in the lane, Katarina will look to E onto her Q dagger to deal damage or look for a kill. If Katarina is low or you engage, she will use her W dagger to reposition herself away with her movement speed, or use her E to blink back towards the dagger. If you can read the situation and see how she plays off them, you will be able to easily cut her off or prevent her engage combos. 

(4) Understand Katarina E - Now that we covered her dagger playstyle and how she uses her E, it’s also important to understand she can also E onto minions and enemies. Katarina E when picking up a dagger also refunds 78%>96% CD based on level, meaning that she can potentially always have her blink the later the game gets. Katarina’s E, while seemingly strong, is actually entirely dependent on the wave states. When each wave arrives within the lane, Katarina can instantly blink towards her own minions, meaning if she gets ganked she can easily avoid it with a simple click of a button. However, this only applies if the wave is crossing past the turret, meaning if the wave is met in the middle of the lane, Katarina simply cannot easily reach her tower, making her a sitting duck in the process when it comes to Renekton. Renekton can easily force trades onto Katarina within this wave state, so make sure to wait for the wave when it’s in the middle or on your side to prevent Katarina from escaping. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(8) Ping Katarina Roams - Katarina’s strongest part of her kit is based within her low CD and resets, making her a very dangerous skirmish based champion. Katarina will function towards looking for low HP targets to help her snowball her potential dark seal stacks, while trying to reset her CDs for additional damage within the fights. As Renekton, we want to always prevent Katarina with the ability to roam by making sure we spam ping constantly when she’s not in the lane, as well as perma shoving as soon as she’s gone. Playing to maker her miss XP and gold, on top of obtaining plates is very important in these situations, as even in the worst case we get something if Katarina manages to. 

(9) Cancel Katarina R With W - Katarina’s R is a very dangerous ability with how much damage it is able to do, on top of it applying on hit effects, as well as its own ability to set up her crazy reset ADHD playstyle. While it’s a very crazy ability, Renekton W is by far one of her biggest counters with how easily he can stun her and cancel it out completely. With that said, try to always hold your W within low HP situations or teamfights, as you will be able to instantly cancel it out, allowing you to set up easy kills individually or with your own team. 

(10) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Katarina while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Katarina within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.  

(11) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Katarina’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Katarina’s strengths through the mid to late game, are trying to create chaotic and advantageous skirmishes or teamfights, essentially baiting out the enemy abilities with her high mobility, while searching for the right time to jump in and abuse her kit. Katarina’s probability of insta winning teamfights completely depends on how much you and your team prioritises her. A few big mistakes to avoid vs Katarina, are ignoring Katarina within the fights, allowing her to get off her R and resets to win fights. Another mistake is ignoring her roams and rotations, allowing her to pick off free kills and snowball for free. To play against Katarina you need to always pay attention and spam ping her whereabouts on the map, to prevent her getting free kills to snowball. Within teamfights, try to always look for Katarina with the intention of holding your stun. Once Katarina shows up, try to instantly prioritise W’ing her when she jumps into your team, as doing this allows you to instantly lock her down allowing you and your team to easily shut her down.

With that said, try to always hold your W within low HP situations or teamfights, as you will be able to instantly cancel it out, allowing you to set up easy kills individually or with your own team.
tips.contentPt: O R de Katarina é uma habilidade muito perigosa com a quantidade de dano que ela é capaz de causar, além de aplicar efeitos de acerto, bem como sua própria habilidade de configurar seu estilo de jogo de TDAH de reinicialização maluca. videoTitle: THIS RENEKTON PLAYSTYLE COMPLETELY OUTSCALES KAYLE! | Renekton Vs Kayle Commentary
summaryEn: Renekton completely destroys Kayle early, providing him a clear objective of trying to deny her as much gold as he can to prevent her inevitable scaling threat. Renekton's only threat from Kayle early consists of her level 1, where she will try to force a fight with her lethal tempo and Q start. Renekton simply should play for his level 2 powerspike, which allows him to skill W or E, allowing him to completely burst or kill Kayle if she's playing wrecklessly. Post level 3, Renekton needs to always play the wave states on his side of the map, as he can abuse Kayle's low range from being able to touch the minion wave. Each time Kayle steps up, Renekton can force double dash trades, using his heavy damage to easily out trade and punish Kayle for stepping up. Each time Kayle is low near her tower, Renekton can force tower dives against her. If Kayle has R, Renekton can fake tower diving by walking into her with or without W active, allowing him to easily bait her R to dive her by the next minion wave. After stomping Kayle, Renekton should try to roam the map and use his lead to hard win the mid game. Failing to end before level 16 and 3 items, Kayle will completely uturn the game and force her stong damage to win the game.
summaryPt: Renekton destrói completamente Kayle cedo, proporcionando a ele um objetivo claro de tentar negar a ela tanto ouro quanto puder para evitar sua inevitável ameaça crescente. A única ameaça de Renekton no início de Kayle consiste em seu level 1, onde ela tentará forçar uma luta com seu ritmo letal e Q start. Renekton simplesmente deveria jogar por seu level 2 powerspike, o que lhe permite usar W ou E, permitindo que ele burst completamente ou mate Kayle se ela estiver jogando sem problemas. Após level 3, Renekton precisa sempre jogar os estados wave em seu lado do mapa, pois ele pode abusar do alcance baixo de Kayle ao poder tocar o lacaio wave. Cada vez que Kayle avança, Renekton pode forçar trocas duplas, usando seu grande dano para facilmente eliminar a troca e punir Kayle por avançar. Cada vez que Kayle está baixo perto de sua torre, Renekton pode forçar mergulhos na torre contra ela. Se Kayle tiver R, Renekton pode fingir tower diving entrando nela com ou sem W ativo, permitindo que ele facilmente atraia seu R para dive pelo próximo lacaio wave. Depois de pisar em Kayle, Renekton deve tentar roam o mapa e usar sua liderança para vencer com facilidade o mid game. Se não terminar antes dos itens de nível 16 e 3, Kayle irá virar completamente o jogo e forçar seu forte dano para vencer o jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Kayle Level 1 - Kayle’s level 1 is one of Kayle’s misunderstood strengths, as she can easily out duel you with either Lethal Tempo or PTA. Kayle can actually hard bully Renekton level 1, meaning sometimes we might have to defensively take W just to keep her at bay. By level 2 and 3 Renekton can play the lane normally, but make sure before reaching that point you space adequately and avoid trading auto attacks at all costs. 

(2) Level 1 Q or W Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. Q start is preferred if Kayle isn’t posturing aggressively, allowing you to hit the wave and reach level 2 before her. If Kayle is aggressive posturing, skill W to AA > W her, into moving towards your side of the minion wave. Wait back for W, then look for an empowered W trade if she tries again. 

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Kayle you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Kayle lose a lot more. 

(4) Abuse Kayle’s Early Game - Renekton can practically do whatever he wants to Kayle once he reaches level 3, so make sure you play specifically to keep waves on your side, while looking for heavy trades and aiming to tower dive her when she is low. Alternatively, playing to deny her and set her back is very important, to which you should always aim for this instead of playing for hard pushes and trying to search for kills. If you freeze vs Kayle, the kills will most often come to you.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent. 

(7) Rush Tier 2 Boots - A good Kayle will most likely rush boots into Renekton, making her overall trading and kiting ability a lot more infuriating if you’re playing strictly for item rush. I personally prefer building boots, as my combat ability is only improved once building them. As long as I can stay on top of Kayle that’s ultimately what matters, as Renekton’s base damage with abilities and R is also enough to still give me damage to successfully kill her. 

(8) Respect And Punish Kayle R - When playing against Kayle, it’s very important to understand the pattern of how she uses her R. Kayle will either R when she’s in her enemies kill range, if she’s trying to protect and peel for her carries, or use her R to block any major damage abilities. As Renekton, we’re able to bait out her R in a low of ways, as we can successfully mind game her by either: Baiting a trade against her with our E when she’s low HP, allowing us to bait her R then hold our damage until it goes away. Or. Walking up to Kayle on low HP activating our W, baiting out her R before we use our own W. Later on, Kayle may instantly use it at full HP when you dash onto her, in which you should hold your abilities, then use them right after her R cast ends. 

(9) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kayle while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kayle within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle. Overall, W max allows you to stun Kayle longer to prevent her auto attacking playstyle, allowing you to have more duelling power in the ability to fight Kayle in longer periods of the game.

(10) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Kayle’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Kayle’s overall power within the game solely depends on how good your laning phase was, as if you play it correctly you will be able to hard put Kayle behind, to the point where she is unable to join any fights or play towards any objectives. Renekton’s overall goal within the Kayle match up is simply hard putting her behind, then using his early game lead to completely dominate the map, with the objective of ending the game before Kayle scales. Within most cases, regardless of her lead Kayle will always try hard to farm towards her level 16 and Deathcap powerspike, as at this stage she will be literally god tier level of powerful. If Kayle is split pushing, try to either kill her with your fed lead or get your team to jump onto her before any major objectives, as this will allow you to prevent her using her late game advantage. Within teamfights, try to either one shot Kayle as fast as you can, otherwise she will try to use ult and then auto attack with it active. Try to get your teammates to fully commit to Kayle, by playing off your flash W with the intention of all jumping on her. Alternatively, if Kayle isn’t there in the fights, you should try to instantly look to fight as not having Kayle in these situations is absolutely gigantic. Overall, Kayle’s late game can be hard to manage, so do your best to find winning plays and play to kill her in isolation, or play to kill her team and secure Baron.

Contanto que eu possa ficar no controle de Kayle, isso é o que importa, já que o dano base de Renekton com habilidades e R também é suficiente para ainda me causar dano para matá-la com sucesso.

tips.titlePt: Respeite And Punish Kayle R
tips.contentEn: When playing against Kayle, it’s very important to understand the pattern of how she uses her R. Kayle will either R when she’s in her enemies kill range, if she’s trying to protect and peel for her carries, or use her R to block any major damage abilities. As Renekton, we’re able to bait out her R in a low of ways, as we can successfully mind game her by either: Baiting a trade against her with our E when she’s low HP, allowing us to bait her R then hold our damage until it goes away. Or. Walking up to Kayle on low HP activating our W, baiting out her R before we use our own W. Later on, Kayle may instantly use it at full HP when you dash onto her, in which you should hold your abilities, then use them right after her R cast ends.
tips.contentPt: Ao jogar contra Kayle, é muito importante entender o padrão de como ela usa seu R. Kayle usará R quando estiver no alcance de abate de seus inimigos, se estiver tentando proteger e peel para seus carregamentos, ou usará seu R para bloquear qualquer habilidade de dano maior. Como Renekton, somos capazes de atrair seu R de várias maneiras, já que podemos fazer um jogo mental com sucesso: Atraindo uma troca contra ela com nosso E quando ela está com HP baixo, permitindo-nos atrair seu R e segurar nosso dano até que ele desapareça. Ou. Caminhando até Kayle com HP baixo, ativando nosso W, atraindo seu R antes de usarmos nosso próprio W. Mais tarde, Kayle pode usá-lo instantaneamente com HP total quando você correr para ela, no qual você deve manter suas habilidades e usá-las logo após o término do lançamento de R.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kayle while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kayle within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle. Overall, W max allows you to stun Kayle longer to prevent her auto attacking playstyle, allowing you to have more duelling power in the ability to fight Kayle in longer periods of the game.
tips.contentPt: Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Kayle enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você facilmente snowball e desligue permanentemente Kayle em todas as fases do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto. No geral, W max permite que você atordoe Kayle por mais tempo para evitar seu estilo de jogo de ataque automático, permitindo que você tenha mais poder de duelo na habilidade de lutar contra Kayle em períodos mais longos do jogo.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Kayle’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Kayle e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Kayle’s overall power within the game solely depends on how good your laning phase was, as if you play it correctly you will be able to hard put Kayle behind, to the point where she is unable to join any fights or play towards any objectives. Renekton’s overall goal within the Kayle match up is simply hard putting her behind, then using his early game lead to completely dominate the map, with the objective of ending the game before Kayle scales. Within most cases, regardless of her lead Kayle will always try hard to farm towards her level 16 and Deathcap powerspike, as at this stage she will be literally god tier level of powerful. If Kayle is split pushing, try to either kill her with your fed lead or get your team to jump onto her before any major objectives, as this will allow you to prevent her using her late game advantage. Within teamfights, try to either one shot Kayle as fast as you can, otherwise she will try to use ult and then auto attack with it active. Try to get your teammates to fully commit to Kayle, by playing off your flash W with the intention of all jumping on her. Alternatively, if Kayle isn’t there in the fights, you should try to instantly look to fight as not having Kayle in these situations is absolutely gigantic. Overall, Kayle’s late game can be hard to manage, so do your best to find winning plays and play to kill her in isolation, or play to kill her team and secure Baron.
tips.contentPt: O poder geral de Kayle no jogo depende apenas de quão boa foi sua fase de rotas (laning phase), já que se você jogar corretamente você será capaz de deixar Kayle para trás, a ponto de ela não conseguir mais participar de nenhuma luta ou jogar em direção a qualquer objetivo. O objetivo geral de Renekton dentro do confronto Kayle é simplesmente colocá-la para trás e depois usar sua liderança early game para dominar completamente o mapa, com o objetivo de terminar o jogo antes que Kayle escale. Na maioria dos casos, independentemente de sua liderança, Kayle sempre se esforçará para farmar até seu nível 16 e Deathcap powerspike, já que neste estágio ela estará literalmente no nível de deus de poderosa. Se Kayle for split push, tente matá-la com seu líder alimentado ou faça com que sua equipe salte sobre ela antes de qualquer objetivo principal, pois isso permitirá que você evite que ela use sua vantagem late game. Dentro de teamfights, tente one-shot de Kayle o mais rápido que puder, caso contrário ela tentará usar ult e então auto attack com ela ativa. Tente fazer com que seus companheiros de equipe se comprometam totalmente com Kayle, jogando com seu Flash W com a intenção de todos pularem sobre ela. Alternativamente, se Kayle não estiver presente nas lutas, você deve tentar lutar imediatamente, pois não ter Kayle nessas situações é absolutamente gigantesco. No geral, o late game de Kayle pode ser difícil de gerenciar, então faça o seu melhor para encontrar jogadas vencedoras e jogue para matá-la isoladamente, ou jogue para matar seu time e proteger Baron.

cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Kayle's disengage crowd control.

tips.titlePt: Pressão Total de Rota e Zoneamento Inicial
tips.contentEn: Kayle is weak in the early game, so actively seek trades from Level 1 to build up your Fury. Use your Q skill to restore health and seize lane priority. Harass Kayle to prevent her from stacking her Zeal.
tips.contentPt: Kayle é a campeã mais frágil dos níveis 1 ao 5. Congele a rota (freeze), force trocas com E e W e negue o máximo de experiência e ouro possível.

tips.titlePt: Dives Fáceis Antes do Nível 6
tips.contentEn: Once Kayle transforms into a ranged champion at Level 6, quickly close the gap with E-E, then stun her with an empowered W and burst her down. It's crucial to bait out Kayle's W healing skill.
tips.contentPt: Antes da Ultimate de invulnerabilidade no nível 6, Kayle não tem ferramentas de escape contra o combo de burst do Renekton sob a torre.

videoTitle: RENEKTON vs KAYN (RHAAST) FULL BUILD FIGHT
summaryEn: Kayn is a really free match up for Renekton, as Renekton's raw damage can completely overpower each time Kayn tries to fight. Kayn's objective into Renekton is to try and farm early passive stacks for his Rhaast, which while is his gameplan is also suicide. Renekton can brute force kills on Kayn at will if he tries to walk up towards him, only with Kayn's level 1 being a minior threat towards Renekton. Once Renekton snowballs hard enough, he's able to buy Eclipse and Executioners, allowing him to easily kill Kayn's Rhaast form, as well as continuing his top side snowball. After winning lane, Renekton can look to use his lead around his teammates, providing him the ability to play for objectives and win teamfights.
summaryPt: Kayn é um confronto realmente gratuito para Renekton, já que o dano bruto de Renekton pode dominar completamente cada vez que Kayn tenta lutar. O objetivo de Kayn em Renekton é tentar farmar stacks passivos iniciais para seu Rhaast, que embora seja seu plano de jogo, também é suicídio. Renekton pode matar Kayn com força bruta à vontade se ele tentar caminhar em sua direção, apenas com o level 1 de Kayn sendo uma ameaça menor para Renekton. Uma vez que Renekton se torna uma bola de neve forte o suficiente, ele é capaz de comprar Eclipse e Executores, permitindo-lhe matar facilmente a forma Rhaast de Kayn, bem como continuar com seu lado superior snowball. Depois de vencer a rota, Renekton pode usar sua liderança em torno de seus companheiros de equipe, proporcionando-lhe a capacidade de jogar pelos objetivos e vencer teamfights.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Kayn Level 1 - Kayn is an absolute psycho of a champion, whose entire goal and identity is trying to force fights off CD until he gains his form. Top lane Kayn, can either play to proxy level 1, or he can play to instantly fight you with Q start and Conqueror. To stop Kayn from proxying level 1, walk with your minion wave level 1 to prevent him from doing this, as if Kayn does show up, you can take W start and try to force a kill onto him. When the lane normally starts, Renekton can’t really fight Kayn level 1 due to his lower CD on Q, as well as his overall wave clear and damage to reach level 2 before Renekton. As Renekton, try to sit back and take short AA Q trades if he engages. If Kayn is playing safe, try to abuse hitting level 2 first to help you force a level 2 fight. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Kayn you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Kayn lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Take Advantage of Kayn’s Power INT - Kayn will 100% try to prema fight you off CD to get stacks, so make sure to fully hone into heavy trades and look to kill him on repeat if he tries this. Once you’re able to sustain a lead, you can try to zone him off his minion wave behind his turret, allowing you to proxy or force kills on him if he doesn’t use W within the wall.

(5) Cancel Kayn’s W - Kayn’s W earlier on before his form can be cancelled, leaving him in terrible situations when he’s trying to escape through the walls. As Renekton, whenever he’s trying to fight us for stacks, Kayn will try to run away and heal within the wall to prevent him being at death’s door. However if we hold our W, we can use this to completely cancel his W to stop him from escaping, leaving us the ability to easily stat check and kill him in the rest of a fight.

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(8) Respect Rhaast Powerspike - After Kayn completely sprints it down, he will be able to obtain his Rhaast form, allowing him to sustain much more effectively through combat, as well as having more damage and obtaining a knock up to help him win fights. Renekton at this point should already be strong enough to fight him, however if you’re not utilising Ignite then make sure to take Executioner’s to completely gut his healing through a fight. Do note that once Kayn R’s with his Rhaast form, he can also heal up towards his full HP bar, making it SUPER necessary to have healing reduction.

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(10) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kayn while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kayn within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.  

(11) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Once Kayn reaches the later stages of the game, Kayn will want to play for chaotic skirmishes around his team, using his Rhaast form to initiate with his knock up, as well as abuse his high sustain playstyle. Kayn does a lot of damage at these stages based around his Q’s target maximum HP damage, as well as having very low CDR to spam in the process. As Renekton, your overall goal is trying to utilise healing reduction against Kayn, while playing off our W max playstyle to constantly stun and lock Kayn into place. The less CC we have, the harder it will be to shut down Kayn, so make sure to opt into maxing your W to make the game a lot easier. Overall, try to avoid fights without your full team members, try to pick off or kill easy targets within the fight before trying to fully commit against Kayn. If we’re playing to frontline and protect our team, try to stun lock him down and use empowered E to shred any potential armour he also has against your team.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Rhaast Powerspike
tips.contentEn: After Kayn completely sprints it down, he will be able to obtain his Rhaast form, allowing him to sustain much more effectively through combat, as well as having more damage and obtaining a knock up to help him win fights. Renekton at this point should already be strong enough to fight him, however if you’re not utilising Ignite then make sure to take Executioner’s to completely gut his healing through a fight. Do note that once Kayn R’s with his Rhaast form, he can also heal up towards his full HP bar, making it SUPER necessary to have healing reduction.
tips.contentPt: Depois que Kayn correr completamente, ele será capaz de obter sua forma Rhaast, permitindo-lhe se sustentar com muito mais eficácia durante o combate, além de sofrer mais danos e conseguir um nocaute para ajudá-lo a vencer as lutas. Renekton neste ponto já deve ser forte o suficiente para lutar contra ele, no entanto, se você não estiver utilizando Ignite, certifique-se de usar o Executioner para destruir completamente sua cura durante uma luta. Observe que uma vez que Kayn R está com sua forma Rhaast, ele também pode Heal aumentar sua barra de HP completa, tornando SUPER necessário ter redução de cura.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kayn while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kayn within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.
tips.contentPt: Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Kayn enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você facilmente snowball e desligue permanentemente Kayn em todas as fases do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto.

tips.titleEn: Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Once Kayn reaches the later stages of the game, Kayn will want to play for chaotic skirmishes around his team, using his Rhaast form to initiate with his knock up, as well as abuse his high sustain playstyle. Kayn does a lot of damage at these stages based around his Q’s target maximum HP damage, as well as having very low CDR to spam in the process. As Renekton, your overall goal is trying to utilise healing reduction against Kayn, while playing off our W max playstyle to constantly stun and lock Kayn into place. The less CC we have, the harder it will be to shut down Kayn, so make sure to opt into maxing your W to make the game a lot easier. Overall, try to avoid fights without your full team members, try to pick off or kill easy targets within the fight before trying to fully commit against Kayn. If we’re playing to frontline and protect our team, try to stun lock him down and use empowered E to shred any potential armour he also has against your team.
tips.contentPt: Assim que Kayn atingir os estágios finais do jogo, Kayn vai querer jogar de forma caótica skirmishes em torno de sua equipe, usando sua forma Rhaast para iniciar seu arremesso, além de abusar de seu estilo de jogo de alta sustentação. Kayn causa muitos danos nesses estágios com base no dano máximo de HP alvo de seu Q, além de ter um CDR muito baixo para spam no processo. Como Renekton, seu objetivo geral é tentar utilizar a redução de cura contra Kayn, enquanto joga com nosso estilo de jogo W max para atordoar e travar constantemente Kayn no lugar. Quanto menos CC tivermos, mais difícil será desligar Kayn, então certifique-se de optar por maximizar seu W para tornar o jogo muito mais fácil. No geral, tente evitar lutas sem os membros completos de sua equipe, tente eliminar ou matar alvos fáceis dentro da luta antes de tentar se comprometer totalmente contra Kayn. Se estivermos jogando na linha de frente e protegendo nosso time, tente atordoá-lo e use Empowered E para destruir qualquer armadura potencial que ele também tenha contra seu time.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Kennen - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.16
summaryEn: Kennen is a pretty difficult match up, as his range and mobility provide him the ability to keep Renekton at range. Despite it being somewhat difficult, Renekton can use Second Wind and Doran's Shield to help him out sustain Kennen's damage, as well as providing Renekton more trading opportunities. Something Renekton can do, is that he can use his E to double dash onto Kennen, allowing him to time his W onto Kennen's W animation, providing Renekton the ability to deal damage and look for his main source of damage. Renekton's first major buys can be either Mercury Treads to avoid being stunned as long, or he can buy straight into damage, allowing him to easily deal with Kennen. Once Renekton has Mercs and is successfully playing around his passive, Kennen cannot really do much if Renekton jumps onto him. Kennen's main role within the game is simply looking to flash R, so make sure to watch every flank point and make sure to stun Kennen before he jumps into range of your team.
summaryPt: Kennen é um confronto bastante difícil, pois seu alcance e mobilidade proporcionam a ele a capacidade de manter Renekton ao alcance. Apesar de ser um tanto difícil, Renekton pode usar Second Wind e Doran's Shield para ajudá-lo a sustentar o dano de Kennen, além de fornecer mais oportunidades de trocas para Renekton. Algo que Renekton pode fazer é usar seu E para avançar duas vezes em Kennen, permitindo que ele cronometre seu W na animação W de Kennen, proporcionando a Renekton a habilidade de causar dano e procurar sua principal fonte de dano. As primeiras compras importantes de Renekton podem ser Mercury Treads para evitar ficar atordoado por muito tempo, ou ele pode comprar diretamente para o dano, permitindo-lhe lidar facilmente com Kennen. Uma vez que Renekton tenha Mercs e esteja brincando com sua passiva com sucesso, Kennen não poderá fazer muito se Renekton pular sobre ele. A função principal de Kennen dentro do jogo é simplesmente buscar Flash R, então certifique-se de observar cada ponto de flanco e atordoar Kennen antes que ele salte ao alcance de sua equipe.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Kennen you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Kennen lose a lot more. 

(3) Play For Sustain Early - Kennen’s early power can definitely deter Renekton from many aggressive trades, due to playing around Kennen’s stun as well as respecting Kennen’s overall burst damage if he lands his abilities. To make the lane a lot easier, make sure to build D Shield and take Second Wind to help you sustain through his damage. Going both of these allows you to provide more trading patterns within the laning phase.

(4) Respect Kennen Stun Passive - The way Kennen’s stun works, is that he can apply 3 stacks of his passive towards a target, allowing him to stun them 1.25 seconds as well as gaining back 25 energy. This is a core element to play around Kennen, as if Renekton typically dashes into Kennen. Kennen can use his Q E W, or passive stun auto, Q, W to help him disengage and stun Renekton before he’s able to trade any damage back. As Renekton, we need to play around his passive stacks, as once he uses his stun auto we can look to trade against Kennen if we’re quick enough with our timing. Alternatively, we can also try to bait his abilities using our short click movement, to walk in and out to bait Q’s to prevent him from having an additional stack for his passive if we dash onto him.

(5) Punish Kennen W - Kennen’s W allows him to speed away from his targets, on top of allowing him to do deal damage and apply a passive stack. His W is usually his core ability that prevents Renekton from getting satisfactory trades. However, if we’re able to dodge Kennen Q and avoid his passive stun auto, we can look to double dash onto Kennen from the minion wave, allowing us to land on top of him while in his W animation, presenting the opportunity to W AA Q him, giving us a decent amount of damage, while allowing us to setup future kill trades onto him. Being able to stun Kennen within his W, also allows us to cut his overall timing of escape, preventing him from being able to kite us, while presenting the ability to kill him in post 6 fights. 

(5) Use Minions Effectively - This point essentially means we can use minions to weave in between to avoid Kennen’s Q’s, or use them to make him auto attack a low HP minion with his passive. If we’re able to use the minions to our advantage, we can also create trading or all in opportunities to help us kill Kennen within the lane.

(6) Rush Mercury Treads - Mercury Treads rush allows us to make the lane a whole lot easier, as we’re able to easily break out of Kennen’s stun, lower his overall AP damage and provide us with the mobility to stick onto Kennen within fights. When we also trade CC in fights, Renekton’s able to escape Kennen’s stuns a lot faster making him pretty uncontestable within fights.

(7) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(8) Respect Kennen R CC Combo - Kennen’s R is absolutely massive for a game changing play, as it’s pretty OP within skirmishes or teamfights. Kennen R allows him to apply AoE damage and stuns across a fight, also synergising with his passive to potentially reach double stuns off on a single target. When playing around it in lane, try to use your mercury treads to counter his incoming stuns. You can also bait Kennen R by using E1 to engage, then use E2 to instantly disengage if either of you are lower HP in the lane. Within later stages of the game, try to ward or spot flank attempts with Kennen’s TP to stop him from utilising a max value R.

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(10) Go Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Hexdrinker to lower Kennen’s overall damage and have a MR shield. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Kennen’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Kennen’s whole mid to late game objective, is playing for TP or opposite side flank engages. Kennen’s whole identity is trying to amass a CS lead within the side lane, trying to build towards rocket belt, shadowflame and deathcap, with the intention of looking for a TP or roam play, allowing him to flank from behind and land a giant AoE R, to nuke his opposing targets. Kennen’s overall playability resides in being able to get into the centre of fights, meaning if you can stop him with your stun before he enters the fight, this will cut his chances of being able to be relevant within the fights. When it comes to direct teamfights, try to always watch where Kennen’s position is, then once Kennen tries to engage, try to block his path by using your W and R to block his ability to directly get into range. If you’re able to protect your teammates from his flank, you will essentially win the fight from your utility and damage potential. After Kennen has no R, try to play around either protecting your carries from any other remaining damage, or look to flash or dash onto his backline with the intention of killing his carries.

(11) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Todo o objetivo do meio para late game de Kennen é jogar para TP ou o flanco oposto se envolve. Toda a identidade de Kennen é tentar acumular uma vantagem de CS na side lane, tentando construir em direção a rocket belt, shadowflame e deathcap, com a intenção de procurar uma jogada de TP ou roam, permitindo-lhe flanquear por trás e acertar um AoE R gigante, para destruir seus alvos adversários. A jogabilidade geral de Kennen reside em ser capaz de chegar ao centro das lutas, ou seja, se você puder detê-lo com seu atordoamento antes que ele entre na luta, isso reduzirá suas chances de ser relevante nas lutas. Quando se trata de direcionar teamfights, tente sempre observar onde está a posição de Kennen, então, quando Kennen tentar engage, tente bloquear seu caminho usando seu W e R para bloquear sua capacidade de entrar diretamente no alcance. Se você for capaz de proteger seus companheiros de equipe do flanco dele, você essencialmente vencerá a luta por sua utilidade e potencial de dano. Depois que Kennen não tiver R, tente proteger seus carregadores de qualquer outro dano restante, ou obtenha Flash ou ataque sua linha de fundo com a intenção de matar seus carregadores.
