Quando também trocamos CC nas lutas, Renekton é capaz de escapar dos atordoamentos de Kennen muito mais rápido, tornando-o bastante incontestável nas lutas.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Rápidas (Short Trades)
tips.contentEn: E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash.
tips.contentPt: E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Kennen R CC Combo
tips.contentEn: Kennen’s R is absolutely massive for a game changing play, as it’s pretty OP within skirmishes or teamfights. Kennen R allows him to apply AoE damage and stuns across a fight, also synergising with his passive to potentially reach double stuns off on a single target. When playing around it in lane, try to use your mercury treads to counter his incoming stuns. You can also bait Kennen R by using E1 to engage, then use E2 to instantly disengage if either of you are lower HP in the lane. Within later stages of the game, try to ward or spot flank attempts with Kennen’s TP to stop him from utilising a max value R.
tips.contentPt: O R de Kennen é absolutamente enorme para um jogo que muda o jogo, já que é bastante OP em skirmishes ou teamfights. Kennen R permite que ele aplique dano AoE e atordoamento durante uma luta, também em sinergia com sua passiva para potencialmente atingir atordoamentos duplos em um único alvo. Ao brincar na rota, tente usar seus Mercury's Treads para conter os atordoamentos recebidos. Você também pode atrair Kennen R usando E1 para engage e, em seguida, usar E2 para disengage instantaneamente se algum de vocês tiver menos HP na pista. Nas fases posteriores do jogo, tente ala ou flanco localizado com TP de Kennen para impedi-lo de utilizar um valor máximo de R.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titleEn: Go Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane
tips.titlePt: Vá Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano
tips.contentEn: Go Hexdrinker to lower Kennen’s overall damage and have a MR shield. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Kennen’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Hexdrinker para diminuir o dano geral de Kennen e tenha um escudo MR. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Kennen e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Kennen’s whole mid to late game objective, is playing for TP or opposite side flank engages. Kennen’s whole identity is trying to amass a CS lead within the side lane, trying to build towards rocket belt, shadowflame and deathcap, with the intention of looking for a TP or roam play, allowing him to flank from behind and land a giant AoE R, to nuke his opposing targets. Kennen’s overall playability resides in being able to get into the centre of fights, meaning if you can stop him with your stun before he enters the fight, this will cut his chances of being able to be relevant within the fights. When it comes to direct teamfights, try to always watch where Kennen’s position is, then once Kennen tries to engage, try to block his path by using your W and R to block his ability to directly get into range. If you’re able to protect your teammates from his flank, you will essentially win the fight from your utility and damage potential. After Kennen has no R, try to play around either protecting your carries from any other remaining damage, or look to flash or dash onto his backline with the intention of killing his carries.
tips.contentPt: Todo o objetivo médio a late game de Kennen é jogar para TP ou o flanco do lado oposto se envolve. Toda a identidade de Kennen é tentar acumular uma vantagem de CS dentro da side lane, tentando construir em direção a rocket belt, shadowflame e deathcap, com a intenção de procurar uma jogada de TP ou roam, permitindo-lhe flanquear por trás e acertar um AoE R gigante, para destruir seus alvos adversários. A jogabilidade geral de Kennen reside em ser capaz de chegar ao centro das lutas, ou seja, se você puder detê-lo com seu atordoamento antes que ele entre na luta, isso reduzirá suas chances de ser relevante nas lutas. Quando se trata de direcionar teamfights, tente sempre observar onde está a posição de Kennen, então, quando Kennen tentar engage, tente bloquear seu caminho usando seu W e R para bloquear sua capacidade de entrar diretamente no alcance. Se você for capaz de proteger seus companheiros de equipe do flanco dele, você essencialmente vencerá a luta por sua utilidade e potencial de dano. Depois que Kennen não tiver R, tente proteger seus carregadores de qualquer outro dano restante, ou obtenha Flash ou ataque sua linha de fundo com a intenção de matar seus carregadores.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de E. Use E1 para encurtar a distância e trocar 3 AAs + PTA, recuando com E2 antes que ele acumule 3 marcas de atordoamento.
level1ExplanationEn: Start E. Dash in with E1, 3 AAs with PTA and dash out with E2 before stun stacks build up.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Kennen e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Kennen with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Kennen.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Kennen's disengage crowd control.

tips.titlePt: Baitar o Impulso do Relâmpago (E)
tips.contentEn: Kennen's E is his only escape and engage tool. Try to bait it out before attempting a trade. A Kennen without E is vulnerable to Renekton's dash.
tips.contentPt: O E de Kennen concede velocidade extrema para fugir. Force o gasto do E dele com avanço falso e busque o all-in com Flash + W enquanto a habilidade estiver em recarga.

tips.titleEn: Interrupting Kennen's Stun with Empowered W
tips.titlePt: Interrompendo a Mobilidade com W Fortalecido
tips.contentEn: Kennen applies marks with his abilities to stun. Use Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator)'s 1.5-second stun to interrupt Kennen's ability combos or ultimate engage.
tips.contentPt: O atordoamento de 1.5s do W Fortalecido trava Kennen no lugar, impedindo-o de acumular marcas da passiva em você.

videoTitle: Renekton Daily Commentary - Day 62 - Renekton Vs Kha'Zix
summaryEn: Kha'Zix is a complete troll pick into Renekton, as Renekton's way of playing will constantly take away from Kha'Zix assassin style of playstyle. Kha'Zix's core stats are simply too weak to fight Renekton, however if Renekton has no cooldowns and is fighting in isolation, Kha'zix can do a lot of damage to help him secure his kills. Make sure to always be around minions or your team when fighting Kha'Zix, as he won't be able to utilise his isolation passive. Through the rest of the game, his only role will be trying to pick off any squishy targets, in which we counteract this by focusing him as soon as he appears in vision.
summaryPt: Kha'Zix é uma escolha completa de troll para Renekton, já que a maneira de jogar de Renekton irá constantemente diminuir o estilo de jogo do assassino de Kha'Zix. As stats principais de Kha'Zix são simplesmente fracas demais para lutar contra Renekton, no entanto, se Renekton não tiver cooldowns e estiver lutando isolado, Kha'Zix pode causar muitos danos para ajudá-lo a garantir suas mortes. Certifique-se de estar sempre perto de lacaios ou de sua equipe ao lutar contra Kha'Zix, pois ele não poderá utilizar seu passivo de isolamento. Durante o resto do jogo, sua única função será tentar eliminar quaisquer alvos frágeis, no qual neutralizaremos isso focando-o assim que ele aparecer em visão.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Kha'Zix Isolation Passive - Kha’Zix’s main strength within duels is abusing his passive, which allows him to deal bonus damage based on his targets being isolated. Alongside this, Kha’Zix’s auto attack also slows and deals bonus damage every time he goes out of vision through using bushes, or using his R. When fighting Kha’Zix early, try to prevent being away from your minions as he’s unable to abuse his isolation damage, giving him essentially no damage to really compete against Renekton.

(2) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Kha’Zix you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Kha’Zix lose a lot more. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Ping Kha'Zix Roams - Kha’Zix cannot really achieve much into Renekton, so he’s most likely choice to play the game is to look for skirmishes or roam towards mid lane. Kha’Zix’s damage can always be impactful if he’s able to isolate his targets, therefore providing him a comeback condition in being able to snowball the game. Try to always ping Kha’Zix’s roam attempts whenever he isn’t in the lane, and if your jungler is trying to skirmish for a river or grubs, make sure to prioritise those objectives to help you snowball through top side of the map.

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kha’Zix while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kha’Zix within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.  

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Kha’Zix’s main role towards the game, is using his assassin based playstyle to help him burst down carry targets to help him gain objective or tower priority. Kha’Zix’s whole playstyle simply works around his stealth, using his R to set up his engages towards a target, or playing on fog of war waiting for people to walk into his isolated range. As Renekton, his damage doesn’t really offer us any problematic situations, however for our teammates it’s very much in our best interest to make sure we stick to them in any mid game objective timers. Using wards to spot out his initial flank positions is very important, or being able to use red trinkets will help us locate his movements. Typically if Kha’Zix breaks stealth, we can use our W to stun Kha’Zix in place, allowing us to easily one shot him with how squishy he is. Overall, being that he’s a top lane Kha’Zix, his overall power level will be a lot weaker than he would be in the jungle, however we should play with the intent to always protect our teammates from his play making potential as that’s enough to help him obtain objectives for his team.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite Kha'Zix Passivo de Isolamento - A principal força de Kha’Zix nos duelos é abusar de seu passivo, o que lhe permite causar dano bônus com base no isolamento de seus alvos. Além disso, o auto attack de Kha’Zix também desacelera e causa dano bônus toda vez que ele sai de vista usando arbustos ou seu R. Ao lutar contra Kha’Zix cedo, evite ficar longe de seus lacaios, pois ele é incapaz de abusar de seu dano de isolamento, dando-lhe essencialmente nenhum dano para realmente competir contra Renekton.

(2) level 1 Q ou E Start - Como mencionado em outras notas, jogar Q e E requer jogadas diferentes, porém neste confronto você pode essencialmente fazer qualquer uma delas e ter um bom sucesso. Com isso dito, experimente os pontos fortes de level 1 e procure uma morte de level 2. 

(3) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de destruir Kha’Zix, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de morte, para que você possa fazer Kha’Zix perder muito mais. 

(4) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(5) Trocas pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners lhe apresentarem a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a finalizar seu oponente.

(6) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(7) Ping Kha'Zix Roams - Kha'Zix realmente não consegue alcançar muito em Renekton, então sua escolha mais provável para jogar é procurar skirmishes ou roam na faixa intermediária. O dano de Kha’Zix sempre pode ser impactante se ele for capaz de isolar seus alvos, proporcionando-lhe assim uma condição de retorno para ser capaz de snowball o jogo. Tente sempre fazer ping nas tentativas de roam de Kha’Zix sempre que ele não estiver na rota, e se seu caçador estiver tentando skirmish por um rio ou larvas, certifique-se de priorizar esses objetivos para ajudá-lo snowball na parte superior do mapa.

(8) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Kha'Zix enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você snowball facilmente e desligue Kha'Zix permanentemente em todos os estágios do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto.  

(9) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - O papel principal de Kha'Zix no jogo é usar seu estilo de jogo baseado em assassino para ajudá-lo burst a carregar alvos para ajudá-lo a obter o objetivo ou a prioridade da torre. Todo o estilo de jogo de Kha’Zix simplesmente gira em torno de sua furtividade, usando seu R para preparar seus ataques em direção a um alvo ou jogando na névoa de guerra esperando que as pessoas entrem em seu alcance isolado. Como Renekton, seu dano realmente não nos oferece nenhuma situação problemática, no entanto, para nossos companheiros de equipe, é do nosso interesse garantir que os cumpramos em qualquer cronômetro de objetivo de mid game. Usar proteções para identificar suas posições iniciais nos flancos é muito importante, ou ser capaz de usar bugigangas vermelhas nos ajudará a localizar seus movimentos. Normalmente, se Kha’Zix quebrar a furtividade, podemos usar nosso W para atordoar Kha’Zix no lugar, permitindo-nos facilmente acertar one-shot nele com o quão mole ele é. No geral, sendo ele um Kha’Zix da rota superior, seu nível de poder geral será muito mais fraco do que seria na selva, no entanto, devemos jogar com a intenção de sempre proteger nossos companheiros de seu potencial de jogo, pois isso é suficiente para ajudá-lo a obter objetivos para sua equipe.

Overall, being that he’s a top lane Kha’Zix, his overall power level will be a lot weaker than he would be in the jungle, however we should play with the intent to always protect our teammates from his play making potential as that’s enough to help him obtain objectives for his team.
tips.contentPt: O papel principal de Kha’Zix no jogo é usar seu estilo de jogo baseado em assassino para ajudá-lo a burst carregar alvos para ajudá-lo a obter o objetivo ou a prioridade da torre. videoTitle: Viego vs Kindred & Renekton
summaryEn: Kindred is a pretty horrible laner all things considered, hence why as a top laner she is very easy to deal with compared to her jungle counterpart. Just like Bel'Veth, Kindred's overall scaling entirely depends on getting jungle camps and consistent kills, something she is not really able to get within the top lane. Renekton can basically do whatever he wants to her in this match up, as he can simply freeze wave states then look to force his trades as soon as she walks into range. To make the match up really easy, you can go Doran's Shield and Second Wind to help remove her ranged advantage within the match up. Kindred's only saving grace within the game is using her R within high profile teamfights. Make sure to hold your damage last second until her R goes off, allowing you to easily kill her or her team as soon as the R wears off.
summaryPt: Kindred é uma laner horrível, considerando tudo, por isso, como top laner, ela é muito fácil de lidar em comparação com sua contraparte da selva. Assim como Bel'Veth, o escalonamento geral de Kindred depende inteiramente de conseguir acampamentos na selva e mortes consistentes, algo que ela realmente não é capaz de conseguir na rota superior. Renekton pode basicamente fazer o que quiser com ela neste confronto, pois ele pode simplesmente freeze wave afirma e então conseguir forçar suas trocas assim que ela entrar no alcance. Para tornar o confronto realmente fácil, você pode usar Doran's Shield e Second Wind para ajudar a remover a vantagem de longo alcance dela no confronto. A única graça salvadora de Kindred dentro do jogo é usar seu R em teamfights de alto perfil. Certifique-se de segurar o dano no último segundo até que o R apague, permitindo que você mate facilmente ela ou sua equipe assim que o R passar.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Kindred you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Kindred lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Kindred's Poke - Kindred’s poke isn’t as relevant as other marksmen picks within the top lane, however with PTA and her Q, Kindred is able to offer some resistance against Renekton within the lane. Make sure to use D Shield and Second Wind to take off her damage, while providing you the sustain to constantly fight whenever your abilities come up.

(4) Play Around Kindred's Passive Mark - Kindred as a laner absolutely sucks, however if there is some cheese strat where she roams in your jungle to get marks, make sure to ward points within your jungle to prevent her roaming for stacks or killing your jungler. Again, this is highly unlikely to happen, but if they’re playing Kindred top then expect the unexpected.

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Respect Kindred R - Kindred’s R is the only saving grace within the match up for Kindred, as she can counter any Renekton one shot combos by using her R on herself or low HP targets. As Renekton, if we do have the damage we can essentially one shot Kindred fast enough in our stun, however if we don’t have the damage then avoid looking for flash W’s without it being a guaranteed kill onto your target. When Kindred has ulted, make sure to hold your abilities up until she or her targets exit the ult, allowing us to finish off our target effectively.

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Kindred’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Kindred’s overall utility and power within the laning phase should be a lot weaker compared to her jungle playstyle, due to the fact her ability to get passive stacks is severely limited being in a solo lane. WIth that said, we should try to abuse our early advantage to completely dominate and win the game before she gets to scale. Kindred’s main strength is looking for targets while grouped with her team, as this allows her to obtain her marked stacks, on top of being able to use her R utility to protect and win the teamfights. As mentioned, when it comes to team fights simply play with your advantage to engage on her and her backline, with the intent of one shotting any of her carries or making her burn her R for your team. I personally don’t think there’s really a way to mess up against Kindred when she’s severely behind as a laner, so as long as you ping her movements and prevent her getting free picks, then Kindred will never be a problem.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Kindred, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Kindred perca muito mais. 

(3) Respeite o poke de Kindred - o poke de Kindred não é tão relevante quanto as escolhas de outros atiradores na top lane, no entanto, com PTA e seu Q, Kindred é capaz de oferecer alguma resistência contra Renekton dentro da pista. Certifique-se de usar D Shield e Second Wind para eliminar o dano dela, ao mesmo tempo que fornece sustentação para lutar constantemente sempre que suas habilidades surgirem.

(4) Brinque com a marca passiva de Kindred - Kindred como um laner é absolutamente uma droga, no entanto, se houver alguma estratégia de queijo onde ela vagueia em sua selva para obter marcas, certifique-se de proteger pontos dentro de sua selva para evitar que seu roaming acumule ou mate seu caçador. Novamente, é altamente improvável que isso aconteça, mas se eles estiverem jogando Kindred no topo, espere o inesperado.

(5) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(6) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(7) Trocas pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

(8) Respeite Kindred R - O R de Kindred é a única graça salvadora no confronto para Kindred, já que ela pode contra-atacar qualquer combo de one-shot de Renekton usando seu R em si mesma ou em alvos com baixo HP. Como Renekton, se tivermos o dano, podemos essencialmente dar one-shot Kindred rápido o suficiente em nosso atordoamento, no entanto, se não tivermos o dano, evite procurar por Flash W's sem que seja uma morte garantida para o seu alvo. Quando Kindred tiver ultado, certifique-se de manter suas habilidades até que ele ou seus alvos saiam da ult, permitindo-nos acabar com nosso alvo de forma eficaz.

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Kindred e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(10) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - A utilidade geral e o poder de Kindred na fase de rotas (laning phase) devem ser muito mais fracos em comparação com seu estilo de jogo na selva, devido ao fato de sua capacidade de obter pilhas passivas ser severamente limitada em uma rota solo. Dito isto, devemos tentar abusar da nossa vantagem inicial para dominar completamente e vencer o jogo antes que ele chegue à escala. O principal ponto forte de Kindred é procurar alvos enquanto está agrupado com sua equipe, pois isso permite que ela obtenha seus stacks marcados, além de poder usar sua utilidade R para proteger e vencer o teamfights. Como mencionado, quando se trata de lutas de equipe, simplesmente jogue com sua vantagem para engage nela e em sua linha de fundo, com a intenção de acertar qualquer um de seus carregadores ou fazê-la queimar seu R para sua equipe. Eu pessoalmente não acho que haja realmente uma maneira de atrapalhar Kindred quando ela está muito atrás como laner, então contanto que você monitore seus movimentos e evite que ela receba escolhas grátis, então Kindred nunca será um problema.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Kled - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.10
summaryEn: Kled is an even match up that requires great movement to help abuse his linear style kit, allowing Renekton to brute force and win out any trades against him. Within the lane, try to walk side to side to dodge Kled's Q, as this prevents him poking Renekton down and setting up his E > Q onto Renekton. When fighting Kled, make sure your abilities are up at all times, as if he engages you can simply use W to disengage away from him, or you can deal heavy trades and force him off of his mount. Once Kled is off his mount, try to play around your W timer to allow you to finish off the kill and prevent Kled from getting back to his mount. Never W Kled on his last bit of mount HP, as your W will lose all value. Post 6 Renekton will overpower Kled within 1v1's, only presenting Kled the ability to look from roams with his R to maximise his champion ability. Try to always spam ping Kled's whereabouts and his path to potentially R. As long as we can correctly avoid Kled's R flanks, as well as protecting our teammates and using our W correctly, Kled won't be able to do much against Renekton.
summaryPt: Kled é um confronto equilibrado que requer grande movimentação para ajudar a abusar de seu kit de estilo linear, permitindo que Renekton use força bruta e vença qualquer troca contra ele. Dentro da pista, tente andar de um lado para o outro para desviar do Q de Kled, pois isso evita que ele poking Renekton caia e coloque seu E > Q em Renekton. Ao lutar contra Kled, certifique-se de que suas habilidades estejam sempre em alta, pois se ele atacar você pode simplesmente usar W para recuar e dar disengage dele, ou você pode lidar com trocas pesadas e forçá-lo a descer de sua montaria. Assim que Kled estiver desmontado, tente usar seu cronômetro W para permitir que você finalize a matança e evite que Kled volte para sua montaria. Nunca W Kled em seu último HP de montaria, pois seu W perderá todo o valor. Post 6 Renekton irá dominar Kled dentro de 1v1, apresentando apenas Kled a habilidade de olhar de roaming com seu R para maximizar sua habilidade de campeão. tente sempre enviar spam para o paradeiro de Kled e seu caminho para potencialmente R. Contanto que possamos evitar corretamente os flancos R de Kled, bem como proteger nossos companheiros de equipe e usar nosso W corretamente, Kled não será capaz de fazer muito contra Renekton.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Kled with your Q, while playing for push try to avoid Kled’s Q then look towards auto attacking and Q’ing him off the wave. On level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Kled, or look for the kill if it's there.

(2) Avoid Kled Q Poke - Kled’s Q throws a chain at his target, allowing him to attach and deal damage towards his target. Once the tether completes, the chain will pull back his target, dealing more damage and slowing them for 2.5 seconds. Kled’s Q goes from 11 to 7 seconds, presenting the ability to hard punish Kled if he misses. Most of the time, Kled will have a pattern when he tries to throw out his Q; Kled will throw Q if you’re walking towards him in a straight line, walking towards low HP minions or when Kled engages with his E. To avoid his Q, we can use short clicks to walk in and out, helping us to feint against Kled to bait out his Q if we’re walking up to him or any minions. Walking side to side also helps when vs Kled Q, as his Q hitbox will narrowly miss Renekton’s. Renekton can also use his E to dodge Kled’s Q, or he can use his E then side step to help him dodge it. If Kled misses Q, this most likely will present you the ability to all in.

(3) Respect Kled’s Dismount - Kled’s dismounted form is always worth respecting, as his quick ability to gain his mount back in an extended fight, allows him to completely cheese and turn around the fights. Doing extended trades with Kled is usually a bad idea, as his ability to regain W from auto attacking his targets, as well as getting back onto his mount usually leads to losing conditions. Renekton should always play around his abilities no matter what, as these will give him the ability to easily finish Kled and prevent him from getting back to his mount. A big tip against Kled whenever he is low and about to demount, is that you should always hold your W. Holding W allows you to use it in his demounted form, allowing you to finish off Kled with your high damage and stun, preventing Kled from being able to get his mount back. Do note, that if you use W on the last bit of HP of his mount, Kled will remove the rest of your W damage, severely taking away the damage you need to finish him off. 

(4) Avoid Kled W Hits - Kled’s W is another high profile ability we need to worry about when fighting him. Kled W allows his next 4 auto attacks to become empowered, providing 150% bonus attack speed, bonus physical damage and targets maximum HP as damage. Once Kled uses his W, he can lower the CD by 0.5 seconds for each minion hit, while hitting champions lowers Kled’s W by 1.5 seconds for each hit. Kled W is an absolutely high damage ability, so once Kled uses it by hitting minions, we should take advantage of the 13 second CD by forcing a quick trade. Once we use our abilities, we should disengage and avoid trading until they’re back up. Before fighting Kled try to pay attention to his glowing weapon, as that will indicate whether or not he has his W up. 

(5) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Respect Kled Roams - Kled’s roaming ability paired with his ult, allows Kled to be an absolutely giant threat within skirmishes and teamfights. If Kled manages to use his ult correctly, he can easily create many winning opportunities with his fast flanking ability in combination with his team. When playing vs Kled, try to always track his position on the map. If Kled is missing after shoving a wave or resetting back to base, make sure to ping your teammates to play back. Kled naturally falls off in his overall scaling ability, so making sure he gets nothing for his roams is very important. Once Kled is out of the lane, make sure to abuse his roams or backtimer by hard shoving the wave. Alternatively, shoving in waves can also help waste his R to help him get back to the lane, removing his strong ability to roam outside of the lane.

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Kled while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kled within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle. Maxing W also allows you to take extended fights against Kled, providing additional stuns to further nullify Kled. 

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(10) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Kled’s overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

Kled within the mid game, will try to always look for wave crashes into roam timers. Kled will try to use R for most of his engages by using his R in the following ways: Kled will use R to flank behind the enemy team in teamfights, he will use his R against any isolated squishy targets, or he will use R to allow his team to easily initiate. Try to always look to disengage if you hear Kled R, as being able to avoid his R location will allow you and your team to escape his advantageous skirmish attempt. If you’re alone, use the R sound queue to avoid being caught out by him and his team. videoTitle: DJFrytek Renekton vs Kog'Maw - Unranked to Challenger
summaryEn: Kog'Maw is surprisingly difficult within the first few levels within the laning phase, due to his W damage and unexpected playstyle. Against Kog'Maw, try to start Doran's Shield and Second Wind with your intention of playing for level 3. Once you reach level 3, try to look for heavy burst trades with your Fury and try to use your E2 to always disengage back. By Level 6's and Plated Steel Caps rush, Kog'Maw will lose a lot of his damage and ability to fight Renekton, allowing Renekton to easily kill Kog'Maw on repeat. Kog'Maw's only scaling benefit is essentially trying to get his late game items, allowing him to become a machine that deals a ton of damage. As long as you can play to put him behind early through calculated trades and ganks, Kog'Maw won't be able to really do much within the game to match Renekton's strengths.
summaryPt: Kog'Maw é surpreendentemente difícil nos primeiros níveis da fase de rotas (laning phase), devido ao dano do W e ao estilo de jogo inesperado. Contra Kog'Maw, tente começar Doran's Shield e Second Wind com a intenção de jogar por level 3. Ao chegar em level 3, procure trocas pesadas de burst com seu Fury e tente usar seu E2 para sempre disengage voltar. Com o ataque de level 6 e Plated Steel Caps, Kog'Maw perderá muito de seu dano e capacidade de lutar contra Renekton, permitindo que Renekton mate facilmente Kog'Maw na repetição. O único benefício de escalonamento de Kog'Maw é essencialmente tentar obter seus itens late game, permitindo que ele se torne uma máquina que causa muitos danos. Contanto que você possa jogar para colocá-lo para trás desde o início através de trocas calculadas e ganks, Kog'Maw não será capaz de fazer muito dentro do jogo para igualar os pontos fortes de Renekton.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Alcove Strat - Level 1 try to rush into the topside alcove with E start to avoid being zoned off the wave level 1. Being zoned off leaves Renekton in a terrible position, however being in the alcove prevents losing XP and losing any necessary HP. Once you achieve the first wave of XP, try to leave the alcove safely through bushes and walk towards your side of the wave state.

(2) Play For Level 3 Kill Angle - Once you reach level 3, Renekton will be able to utilise his fast and high damage combos against Kog’Maw. While Renekton has the ability to start trading against Kog’maw, do keep in mind that Kog’Maw will always win extended trades until you have your ult. Try to keep your HP up and stay out of range, while playing for fast combos until Kog’Maw is 30%HP for lethal range. 

(3) Respect Kog'Maw's Poke - Kog’Maw’s poke is surprisingly good most stages of the game, due to his W’s max HP damage and his naturally high attack speed playstyle. When fighting Kog’maw we want to try and avoid fighting extended trades, as he’s able to sustain heavy damage the longer we fight vs his lethal tempo and W activation. Playing with D Shield and Second wind, while playing with the intent to do quick in and out combos, will allow us to prevail in being able to eventually kill him and outsustain his damage. Try to also avoid fights with his W activated, as his overall damage will be a lot higher compared to without. 

(4) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(5) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Rushing Plated Steelcaps will allow you to tank against Kog’Maw’s on hit damage, allowing you to take longer fights and present you the opportunity to kill Kog’Maw with your R powerspike. Having the mobility from boots also allows your E speed to increase, on top of providing you mobility to stay on top of Kog’Maw, or allow you to stay out of his range. 

(7) Play For Ganks - Kog’Maw is by no means an easy lane with how cheesy and flexible his item and build choices can be. Kog’Maw’s biggest weakness is his lack of mobility into solo laning, making top lane an overall nightmare choice when the wave is pushed towards his opponent's tower. Make sure to exploit Kog’Maw’s weakness by pinging your jungler to gank, then try to force the initiation with your dashes and stun them for your jungler to one shot. Once getting a kill or two on Kog’Maw, you will be able to easily snowball and kill Kog’Maw at will. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Kog'Maw's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Kog’Maw’s role within the mid to late game, is playing as a scaling on hit tank carry, allowing him to melt anything that even comes close to him. Kog’Maws’s ability to stack bork, rageblade into tank items can be very annoying and borderline unplayable to play against as Renekton. Our overall objective is trying our hardest to hard snowball the early stages of the game, then utilising our lead and overall power to hard carry teamfights and secure every objective we can. Within these stages before Kog’Maw powerspikes with his later scaling build, Renekton can reliably one shot him as well as being able to build versatile items through the game to help increase his chances of closing out the game. If Kog’Maw is farming within the side lane, Renekton can try to play within bushes and look to one shot him repetitively with his lead, or he can force hard pushes if Kog’Maw decides to leave the lane. While Kog’Maw is also trying to scale towards getting his items in side lane, Renekton can use his lead to roam in the enemy jungle and look for one shot plays to kill his jungler, or use that time to flank enemies within the mid lane. In teamfights, try to play to kill Kog’Maw, as Kog’Maw’s high damage and shred can pose a lot of issues in being able to take extended fights. Try to use your flash or dashes, to access onto Kog’Maw, while using your W and full combo right after. If you can eliminate Kog’Maw from the fights, his team will lose a lot of utility and damage in being able to shut down the Renekton pick.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Alcove Strat - level 1 tente correr para a alcova superior com início E para evitar ser zoneado para fora da wave level 1. Depois de atingir o primeiro wave de XP, tente sair da alcova com segurança através dos arbustos e caminhe em direção ao seu lado do estado wave.

(3) Respeite poke de Kog'Maw - poke de Kog’Maw é surpreendentemente bom na maioria das fases do jogo, devido ao dano máximo de HP de seu W e seu estilo de jogo de velocidade de ataque naturalmente alta. Ao lutar contra Kog’maw, queremos tentar evitar trocas prolongadas, já que ele é capaz de suportar danos pesados ​​quanto mais tempo lutamos contra seu ritmo letal e ativação do W. Jogar com D Shield e Second Wind, enquanto jogamos com a intenção de fazer combos rápidos de entrada e saída, nos permitirá prevalecer e sermos capazes de matá-lo e suster seu dano. Tente também evitar lutas com seu W ativado, pois seu dano geral será muito maior comparado a sem ele. 

(4) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(5) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(6) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Rushing Plated Steelcaps permitirá que você tanke contra Kog'Maw on-hit o dano, permitindo que você enfrente lutas mais longas e lhe dará a oportunidade de matar Kog'Maw com seu R powerspike. Ter a mobilidade das botas também permite que sua velocidade E aumente, além de fornecer mobilidade para ficar em cima de Kog'Maw ou permitir que você fique fora do alcance dele. 

(7) Jogue por ganks – Kog’Maw não é de forma alguma um caminho fácil, considerando o quão cafonas e flexíveis suas opções de itens e build podem ser. A maior fraqueza de Kog’Maw é sua falta de mobilidade na rota solo, tornando a rota superior uma escolha geral de pesadelo quando o wave é empurrado em direção à torre de seu oponente. Certifique-se de explorar a fraqueza de Kog’Maw enviando ping para seu caçador para gank, então tente forçar a iniciação com seus avanços e atordoá-los para seu caçador com one-shot. Depois de matar Kog’Maw, você será capaz de facilmente snowball e matar Kog’Maw à vontade. 

(8) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base de Renekton e stats de seu R permitem que Renekton stat check complete seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Kog'Maw e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(10) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - O papel de Kog’Maw entre meados e late game é atuar como um escalador no carregamento do tanque atingido, permitindo que ele derreta qualquer coisa que chegue perto dele. A habilidade de Kog’Maws de estacar bork e raveblade em itens de tanque pode ser muito irritante e quase impossível de jogar contra Renekton. Nosso objetivo geral é tentar ao máximo snowball nos estágios iniciais do jogo e, em seguida, utilizar nossa liderança e poder geral para carregar teamfights e garantir todos os objetivos que pudermos. Nesses estágios antes de Kog’Maw powerspikes com sua build de escalonamento posterior, Renekton pode atirar nele com segurança, além de ser capaz de construir itens versáteis ao longo do jogo para ajudar a aumentar suas chances de encerrar o jogo. Se Kog’Maw estiver farmando na side lane, Renekton pode tentar brincar dentro dos arbustos e acertar one-shot nele repetidamente com sua liderança, ou ele pode forçar empurrões fortes se Kog’Maw decidir sair da pista. Embora Kog’Maw também esteja tentando escalar para colocar seus itens na rota lateral, Renekton pode usar sua liderança para roam na selva inimiga e procurar jogadas de one-shot para matar seu caçador, ou usar esse tempo para flanquear os inimigos na rota intermediária. Em teamfights, tente jogar para matar Kog’Maw, já que o alto dano e fragmentação de Kog’Maw podem representar muitos problemas para ser capaz de enfrentar lutas prolongadas. tente usar seu Flash ou travessões para acessar Kog’Maw, enquanto usa seu W e combo completo logo em seguida. Se você conseguir eliminar Kog’Maw das lutas, seu time perderá muita utilidade e dano ao conseguir desligar a escolha Renekton.

summaryEn: LeBlanc's first few levels can cause Renekton early problems if he tanks the majority of her damage. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - LeBlanc’s high damage and kill focused gameplay, will force her to try and do short trades to help burst down Renekton until he’s in LeBlanc’s lethal range. Generally this lane can be hard in the beginning, however Renekton can abuse D Shield and Second Wind to help sustain against LeBlanc’s early aggression. The main objective early is trying to keep your HP up and utilise your sustain playstyle, until you’re able to reach level 3 to return back aggression.

(2) Abuse Renekton Empowered Q - Renekton’s Q is a core ability to poke back against LeBlanc, allowing us to whittle down her HP and sustain within the minion wave. Each time LB looks to dash into you, you can use Q to return back early damage, while hitting her and the minion wave to help you push. Eventually, we can look to use our E > Q trades to help force her W away, or use it to help us wave clear fast.

(3) Respect LeBlanc’s Combo - LeBlanc’s combos can do a lot of damage if you allow her to hit all her abilities onto you, allowing her to easily burst you down with your lack of magic resist early. LeBlanc’s typical combos are AA > Q > W > W Back, or Q > E > W, eventually using R to have an extra dash to help one shot her target. Playing with the intent of rushing magic resist can work wonders vs LeBlanc, completely taking away her overall damage. You can rush Hexdrinker or Mercury Treads to help you through the lane, as these items can help take away her damage and allow you to be more offensive within the lane.

(4) Abuse LeBlanc’s W - LeBlanc’s W allows her to dash and deal damage towards her target, allowing her to also instantly cast W back to her original location. LeBlanc’s W can be very annoying within the game, as she can waste your time chasing her or force heavy damage trades. While this does create a struggle for other champions, Renekton can actually hard counter LeBlanc if he times W correctly. Renekton can instantly W LeBlanc if she chooses to dash onto him, allowing him to chain combo on top of a stunned LeBlanc, or if LeBlanc recasts W fast enough, Renekton W will still stun and deal damage back to her. Overall LeBlanc has to be very cautious when using W, as a single Renekton W is enough for him to force a kill onto her. Make sure to quickly spam W as soon as LeBlanc tries to dash on you with her typical combo. 

(5) Abuse LeBlanc’s W Cooldown - To add onto punishing LeBlanc, Renekton can play to abuse her W’s 15 to 11 seconds cooldown. If LeBlanc aimlessly plays to deal damage in the lane, Renekton can use her W downtime to force a fight with his E and look to heavily trade her. LeBlanc’s squishy stats cannot sustain Renekton’s combos, creating an all in angle as soon as he reaches her, or forcing her back to base to miss out on minions and lose map control. 

It should also be said that you should not really try to force fights before she uses her W, as LeBlanc can simply dash out of your engage, while being able to use her W back and land her Q or E onto you, making you lose the trade overall. Situationally, using your dash first is only good if you want to play to mana burn her or burn her dash before a major fight. 

(6) Avoid LeBlanc’s Clone - LeBlanc’s clone can help confuse and troll her enemies, allowing her to control it after being bursted, forcing her enemies to use ignite or their remaining damage onto it. When fighting LeBlanc, it’s important to track her overall positioning and what she does next. For example, if LeBlanc was bursted by Renekton and she stands still in the position you did your damage, she most likely will bait you to chase the clone, then look to dash right after away. Tracking LeBlanc’s clone at times can definitely be difficult, leading her to cheese away from her deaths, however if you manage to ignite LeBlanc before you burst her into her passive, you will be able to easily track her, as her real form will have the ignite symbol above its head. Overall try to use logic, as well as your own ignite to track where she is. 

(7) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. Try to do combos when LeBlanc’s W or R is on cooldown, as this will allow you to have a clear trading window that will severely help you in beating LeBlanc.

(8) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(9) Ping LB Roams - LeBlanc’s biggest power within the match up is simply trying to out roam you, with her objective trying to assassinate your squishy teammates on the map. LeBlanc’s high mobility from her W and R, allow her to easily gap close and provide the damage she needs to snowball out of control. Our job is simply trying to spam ping her roam attempts, while trying to crash our wave state into her side of the map. Doing this allows us to punish her by obtaining gold from plates, while also making her lose out on gold and xp. Never try to give LeBlanc wave priority, otherwise she will perma roam until she’s able to get the kills she needs. 

(10) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(11) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple LeBlanc's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - LeBlanc’s role through the mid to late game, will play with the intent of looking to assassinate any squishy or low HP targets, using cunning and stealthy approach to look for the right angles and timings to one shot her targets. LeBlanc’s playstyle highly depends on having a good early game, as her natural ability falls off the later the game gets, due to people building sustain and having more ways to defend against her damage. Typically as long as you can ping LeBlanc’s roams and prevent her from snowballing the laning Phase, LeBlanc will always struggle into finding her position within the game. When it comes to teamfights or skirmishes, try to hold your W for any of LeBlanc’s engages into your team, as one single stun will leave her killable for you and your team. Renekton can typically one shot LeBlanc doing either W > R > Q > AA or W > R > E > Q > AA, as these combos allow you to abuse LeBlanc while she’s stunned, taking away her ability to survive the rest of the fight or forcing her to completely disengage away from the fights. As long as you can protect your carries from getting one shot by her, LeBlanc will not be able to play her role as an assassin.
