cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Lissandra.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Lissandra's disengage crowd control.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Lucian - KR Master Patch 13.13
summaryEn: The Lucian match up can be pretty difficult at first, due to heavy ranged lane bully playstyle, as well as his abundance of mobility based tools. Within the early stages of the game, Lucian can be very hard to abuse with his early game strengths, however Renekton's job should be trying to play a sustain based playstyle with items such as Doran's Shield and Second Wind, as well as using his first few levels to keep up his HP. Renekton's objective is trying to rush Plated Steelcaps and reaching level 6. Once Renekton reaches these conditions within the game, Lucian's damage and heavy harass playstyle falls off, allowing Renekton to have more playability within the later early and mid stages of the game. Once Renekton has boots and his R, he can force and win fights against Lucian with ease, allowing him to side lane and play teamfights more effectively.
summaryPt: O confronto com Lucian pode ser bastante difícil no início, devido ao estilo de jogo pesado do valentão nas rotas de longo alcance, bem como à sua abundância de ferramentas baseadas em mobilidade. Nos estágios iniciais do jogo, Lucian pode ser muito difícil de abusar de seus pontos fortes de early game, no entanto, o trabalho de Renekton deveria ser tentar jogar um estilo de jogo baseado em sustentação com itens como Doran's Shield e Second Wind, bem como usar seus primeiros níveis para manter seu HP. O objetivo de Renekton é tentar apressar Plated Steelcaps e chegar a level 6. Uma vez que Renekton atinge essas condições dentro do jogo, o dano e o estilo de jogo de assédio pesado de Lucian diminuem, permitindo que Renekton tenha mais jogabilidade nos estágios iniciais e intermediários do jogo. Uma vez que Renekton tenha botas e seu R, ele pode forçar e vencer lutas contra Lucian com facilidade, permitindo que ele saia da rota lateral e jogue teamfights de forma mais eficaz.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Lucian Poke - Lucian’s early poke damage can be pretty high due to his fast damage combos, in combination with his double hit passive, making him a very offensive early lane bully. When playing into Lucian, we want to make sure we can always keep our HP up, until we reach our level 3 or 6 powerspike. To help us make the lane a lot easier, playing D Shield and Second Wind allows us to easily sustain against his damage, while helping us reach our lane powerspikes a lot easier.

(2) Respect Lucian's E Mobility - Lucian’s overall mobility can be pretty high, as he’s able to use his dashes to help him instantly dash away, on top of using his auto attacks and passive to help him reduce his dash cooldown. Later on in the game, Lucian can also buy Navori to help him get even more dashes within fights. With that said, try to play around his E by abusing him with your own dash combos if he uses it towards you, or if you’re trying to force a fight, try to double dash towards him to follow is E location, allowing you to get into range and unload on your damage if he’s in lethal range. 

(3) Play For Manaburn - Lucian’s high mana use playstyle allows him to quickly burn mana at a fast rate, forcing him to buy essence reaver as a first item. Before he’s able to purchase essence reaver, Renekton can utilise his high HP sustain playstyle to help him burn out Lucian’s mana. Using Second Wind and D Shield, alongside basic empowered Q combos allows Lucian to expend a lot of mana to use his abilities against Renekton, allowing him to eventually force kill trades on Lucian without him being able to defend or fight against it.

(4) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Plated Steelcaps allows Renekton to negate Lucain’s damage with ease, while providing additional movement speed to stick onto him. Overall, rushing Plated Steelcaps allows Renekton to completely face tank Lucian’s damage, taking away Lucian’s overall ability to ever kill Renekton post level 6.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Lucian’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Lucian’s overall role within the mid to late game is usually playing around split pushing within the side lane, until he’s able to get his core crit items to help him deal mass DPS within teamfights. Lucian’s playstyle is usually benefited when playing around enchanters, which entirely depends on his support's overall pick if he’s able to abuse that to his advantage. Being that Lucian was picked solo lane, his overall playability highly depends on getting towards his 4th-5th item spikes before being able to offer any major damage. With that said, we should try to use our overall early to mid game power to help us take over the map, while Lucian’s main focus is scaling through obtaining items. When it comes to side laning, our item spikes will allow us to easily deal with Lucian through most fighting situations. Within teamfights, try to avoid being gunned down by his R, as it allows him to easily melt his targets the later the game gets. Make sure to catch Lucian out of position when he dashes in towards his targets, as his playstyle requires him to get into close quarter range to use his damage, making it an easy target for Renekton to shut down.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite Lucian poke - O dano inicial de poke de Lucian pode ser bastante alto devido aos seus combos de dano rápido, em combinação com seu golpe duplo passivo, tornando-o um valentão muito ofensivo na rota inicial. Ao jogar em Lucian, queremos ter certeza de que sempre conseguiremos manter nosso HP alto, até chegarmos a level 3 ou 6 powerspike. Para nos ajudar a tornar a rota muito mais fácil, jogar D Shield e Second Wind nos permite resistir facilmente ao dano dele, ao mesmo tempo que nos ajuda a chegar à nossa rota powerspikes com muito mais facilidade.

(2) Respeite a mobilidade E de Lucian - a mobilidade geral de Lucian pode ser bastante alta, já que ele é capaz de usar seus avanços para ajudá-lo a fugir instantaneamente, além de usar seu auto attacks e passivo para ajudá-lo a reduzir o tempo de recarga do avanço. Mais tarde no jogo, Lucian também pode comprar Navori para ajudá-lo a obter ainda mais avanço nas lutas. Com isso dito, tente brincar com o E dele, abusando dele com seus próprios combos de corrida se ele usar em sua direção, ou se você estiver tentando forçar uma luta, tente correr duas vezes em direção a ele para seguir a localização do E, permitindo que você entre no alcance e descarregue seu dano se ele estiver no alcance letal. 

(3) Play For Manaburn - O estilo de jogo de alto uso de mana de Lucian permite que ele queime mana rapidamente, forçando-o a comprar o Essence Reaver como primeiro item. Antes que ele possa comprar o Essence Reaver, Renekton pode utilizar seu estilo de jogo de alto HP para ajudá-lo a queimar a mana de Lucian. Usar Second Wind e D Shield, junto com combos básicos de Empowered Q permite que Lucian gaste muita mana para usar suas habilidades contra Renekton, permitindo que ele eventualmente force trocas de morte em Lucian sem que ele seja capaz de defender ou lutar contra isso.

(4) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Plated Steelcaps permite que Renekton negue o dano de Lucain com facilidade, ao mesmo tempo que fornece velocidade de movimento adicional para acertá-lo. No geral, correr Plated Steelcaps permite que Renekton enfrente completamente o dano do tanque Lucian, tirando a capacidade geral de Lucian de matar Renekton após level 6.

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(7) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base e stats de seu R de Renekton permitem que Renekton stat check completamente seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

(8) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Lucian e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O papel geral de Lucian no meio até late game geralmente é brincar de empurrar dividido na rota lateral, até que ele consiga obter seus principais itens críticos para ajudá-lo a lidar com DPS em massa dentro de teamfights. O estilo de jogo de Lucian geralmente é beneficiado ao jogar com encantadores, o que depende inteiramente da escolha geral de seu suporte, se ele for capaz de abusar disso em seu benefício. Sendo que Lucian foi escolhido na rota solo, sua jogabilidade geral depende muito de atingir seus picos de itens do 4º ao 5º antes de ser capaz de causar qualquer dano maior. Dito isso, devemos tentar usar nosso poder geral inicial de mid game para nos ajudar a assumir o controle do mapa, enquanto o foco principal de Lucian é escalar por meio da obtenção de itens. Quando se trata de rotas laterais, nossos picos de itens nos permitirão lidar facilmente com Lucian na maioria das situações de luta. Dentro de teamfights, tente evitar ser atingido por seu R, pois isso permite que ele derreta facilmente seus alvos quanto mais tarde o jogo chegar. Certifique-se de pegar Lucian fora de posição quando ele avançar em direção a seus alvos, pois seu estilo de jogo exige que ele fique próximo para usar seu dano, tornando-o um alvo fácil para Renekton desligar.

Sendo que Lucian foi escolhido na rota solo, sua jogabilidade geral depende muito de atingir seus picos de itens do 4º ao 5º antes de ser capaz de causar qualquer dano maior. Dito isso, devemos tentar usar nosso poder geral inicial de mid game para nos ajudar a assumir o controle do mapa, enquanto o foco principal de Lucian é escalar por meio da obtenção de itens. Quando se trata de rotas laterais, nossos picos de itens nos permitirão lidar facilmente com Lucian na maioria das situações de luta. Dentro de teamfights, tente evitar ser atingido por seu R, pois isso permite que ele derreta facilmente seus alvos à medida que o jogo avança. Certifique-se de pegar Lucian fora de posição quando ele avançar em direção a seus alvos, pois seu estilo de jogo exige que ele fique próximo para usar seu dano, tornando-o um alvo fácil para Renekton desligar.

videoTitle: Renekton vs Lulu Top - KR Grandmaster 8/2/9 Patch 10.25 Gameplay // [롤] 레넥톤 vs 룰루 탑
summaryEn: Lulu is practically a free match up for Renekton to snowball against, as her weak stats and laning ability provide Renekton a free pass to easily win lane. While Lulu is a free match up, there are a few scenarios where she can be very annoying to deal with. Preferably when fighting Lulu within solo lane, try to play the wave off your side of the map as you can easily set up kills, while also not having to worry about her polymorph preventing you from killing her. Within the mid to late game, Lulu can be a great asset towards saving carries, so make sure to either nuke your chosen target before she gets into range to save them, or focus her within or before a fight to prevent her from using her high utility.
summaryPt: Lulu é praticamente um confronto livre para Renekton a snowball contra, já que suas stats fracas e habilidade de laning fornecem a Renekton um passe livre para vencer facilmente a lane. Embora Lulu seja um confronto livre, existem alguns cenários em que pode ser muito chato lidar com ela. De preferência, ao lutar contra Lulu na rota solo, tente jogar o wave fora do seu lado do mapa, pois você pode facilmente configurar mortes, ao mesmo tempo que não precisa se preocupar com a polimorfose dela impedindo você de matá-la. Entre meados e late game, Lulu pode ser um grande trunfo para salvar carregamentos, então certifique-se de detonar seu alvo escolhido antes que ele chegue ao alcance para salvá-los, ou concentrá-lo dentro ou antes de uma luta para impedi-lo de usar sua alta utilidade.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Lulu level 1, you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Lulu lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Respect Lulu W - Lulu doesn’t really offer any resistance against Renekton’s strong laning and champion power, meaning you’re able to force as heavy trades as you can. Do note that Lulu can use her W to help stop Renekton’s trades, or force him to think twice before making a play onto one of her teammates. With that said, try to take fights at the right time, otherwise Lulu W can force some awkward situations if you’re not paying much attention to the situation you’re in. Before diving a Lulu, make sure to bait her W first by walking into her, then use your full combo as soon as her W has worn off. 

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) Respect Lulu's R - Just like Lulu’s W, her R allows her to gain additional HP and increase the size of her or her target she uses it on. When fighting Lulu, you can easily get her R out by forcing any fight post 6. Her R is only a worry within teamfights, as she will use it to provide additional peeling power towards her carries, preventing you from potentially one shotting the target you have jumped on. With that said, the best way to deal with her R is coordinating your team to all jump on one high profile target to force and waste her R, or simply bait a fight then look to disengage away from the ulted target. Overall Lulu’s R will only have high value if she’s doing well, as well as her main carries, so play accordingly and respect R if you’re trying to fight against multiple people.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Lulu's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Lulu solo lane doesn’t really achieve much by herself, hence why as a pick she will mainly be around her carries to help enhance their overall carry potential. Lulu’s kit is perfect for denying Renekton’s gameplay, making it a frustrating pick if she’s able to have a good team to play around it. Lulu’s overall sidelining ability is a giant weak point within the game, due to her lack of damage and wave clearing ability, allowing Renekton to do whatever he wants within those parts of the map. When it comes to skirmishes and teamfights, Renekton’s role is to initiate as a frontliner to force big fights and use his bruiser stats to help soak damage and disrupt the enemy back line. Lulu’s lack of ability to act as a front liner severely hurts her comp's chances of winning fights, allowing Renekton to have higher quality moments in a fight than Lulu is able to provide. As previously mentioned, we need to be careful with how we approach Lulu’s carry targets, as she’s able to W and R against us. To combat this, we need to either instantly kill Lulu and bait her to use her R on herself, or as a team we need to collectively jump onto her target to remove them from the game. As soon as her team loses her main win condition carry, Renekton will be able to keep dominating fights and easily win the game.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Lulu level 1, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Lulu perca muito mais. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Respeite Lulu W - Lulu realmente não oferece nenhuma resistência contra o forte poder de laning e campeão de Renekton, o que significa que você é capaz de forçar trocas tão pesadas quanto possível. Observe que Lulu pode usar seu W para ajudar a impedir as trocas de Renekton ou forçá-lo a pensar duas vezes antes de fazer uma jogada contra um de seus companheiros de equipe. Com isso dito, tente lutar na hora certa, caso contrário Lulu W pode forçar algumas situações embaraçosas se você não estiver prestando muita atenção à situação em que está. Antes de diving a Lulu, certifique-se de atrair seu W primeiro caminhando até ela, então use seu combo completo assim que seu W passar. 

(5) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(6) Trocas pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a finalizar seu oponente.

(7) Respeite o R de Lulu - Assim como o W de Lulu, seu R permite que ela ganhe HP adicional e aumente o tamanho do alvo em que ela o usa. Ao lutar contra Lulu, você pode facilmente tirar seu R forçando qualquer posto de luta 6. Seu R é apenas uma preocupação dentro de teamfights, já que ela o usará para fornecer poder de descascamento adicional para seus carregadores, evitando que você atire no alvo em que você pulou. Com isso dito, a melhor maneira de lidar com seu R é coordenar sua equipe para que todos pulem em um alvo de alto perfil para forçar e desperdiçar seu R, ou simplesmente provocar uma briga e então obter recuar e dar disengage do alvo final. No geral, o R de Lulu só terá alto valor se ela estiver indo bem, assim como seus ataques principais, então jogue de acordo e respeite R se estiver tentando lutar contra várias pessoas.

(8) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Lulu e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Lulu solo lane não alcança muito por si só, por isso, como escolha, ela estará principalmente perto de seus carregadores para ajudar a aumentar seu potencial geral de carregamento. O kit de Lulu é perfeito para negar a jogabilidade de Renekton, tornando-o uma escolha frustrante se ela conseguir ter uma boa equipe para contornar isso. A capacidade geral de marginalização de Lulu é um grande ponto fraco dentro do jogo, devido à sua falta de dano e capacidade de limpeza de wave, permitindo que Renekton faça o que quiser nessas partes do mapa. Quando se trata de skirmishes e teamfights, o papel de Renekton é iniciar como linha de frente para forçar grandes lutas e usar suas stats de bruisers para ajudar a absorver danos e interromper a linha de defesa inimiga. A falta de habilidade de Lulu de atuar como linha de frente prejudica gravemente as chances de seu comp vencer lutas, permitindo que Renekton tenha momentos de maior qualidade em uma luta do que Lulu é capaz de proporcionar. Como mencionado anteriormente, precisamos ter cuidado ao abordar os alvos de carry de Lulu, já que ela é capaz de usar W e R contra nós. Para combater isso, precisamos matar Lulu instantaneamente e atraí-la para usar seu R em si mesma ou, como equipe, precisamos pular coletivamente em seu alvo para removê-lo do jogo. Assim que seu time perder sua principal condição de vitória, Renekton será capaz de continuar dominando as lutas e vencer o jogo facilmente.

videoTitle: RENEKTON VS LUX TOP GAMEPLAY DIAMOND IV
summaryEn: Lux can be pretty easy to deal with as Renekton as long as you avoid tanking her main abilities, as this allows her to set up her high damage combos or allows her to chunk Renekton out before he can go in for the kill. Essentially your early objective is to play to avoid her damage, while looking for empowered W combos for your engages. Renekton can use his W around the same time he lands on Lux while snared, allowing him to return damage back and set up his combos. Preferably you want to always avoid being hit by Lux's Q, as this will be her main source of peel that will either allow her to get away or find kills. Killing Lux is generally pretty easy, so make sure to ping her whereabouts and try to prevent her from picking up easy kills from either hard shoving, or spam pinging where she is on the map.
summaryPt: Lux pode ser muito fácil de lidar como Renekton, desde que você evite tankar suas habilidades principais, pois isso permite que ela configure seus combos de alto dano ou que ela destrua Renekton antes que ele possa matar. Essencialmente, seu objetivo inicial é jogar para evitar o dano dela, enquanto procura combos Empowered W para seus combates. Renekton pode usar seu W ao mesmo tempo em que pousa em Lux enquanto está preso, permitindo que ele devolva o dano e configure seus combos. De preferência, você sempre deseja evitar ser atingido pelo Q de Lux, pois esta será sua principal fonte de peel que permitirá que ela fuja ou encontre mortes. Matar Lux geralmente é muito fácil, então certifique-se de fazer um ping em seu paradeiro e tente evitar que ela pegue mortes fáceis por empurrões fortes ou por ping de spam onde ela está no mapa.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Lux you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Lux lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Lux Poke - Lux’s damage at all points in the game can always hurt, as her ability to easily apply her E, as well as follow up with her Q and passive damage, allows her to deal a lot of damage towards her targets. Being hit by Lux’s stun is usually a death sentence post 6, due to how ridiculous Lux’s damage is. To play vs Lux, we can opt into going D Shield and Second Wind to sustain against her damage if we want to play safe. Lux’s abilities are also pretty easy to avoid, as they’re used within a predictable manner. To easily avoid her abilities, try to use short clicks to move in and out of range, meaning if you’re walking up to her or minions, make sure to click back or to side step any incoming abilities. Once Lux misses her Q or E, Renekton can look to heavily trade against her, forcing a kill or forcing her to recall and waste summoners. 

(4) Avoid Lux Q - Lux’s Q allows her to chain all her damage together, making it a critical ability to always avoid. As previously mentioned, we can use our clicking ability to side step Lux’s Q, although if we’re slowed by Lux’s E or any other abilities, Lux’s ability to land her Q becomes a lot easier. If we’re in situations where we cannot dodge Lux’s incoming Q, we should always try to E instantly out of the way, otherwise Lux will potentially one shot us depending on how strong she is. Within the lane, we can also use our dashes to dodge her incoming Q, allowing us to easily reach her and kill her at will. If we play creatively with our E, we can try to use our E as soon as Lux walks into range of last hitting a minion, or we can face our character’s position away, then use our E to quickly double dash behind her. When dashing in this manner, you’re able to avoid Lux’s incoming Q, as she will most likely mistime her ability to use Q, allowing you to land on top of her and easily out damage her.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.

Tente sempre evitar os combos de Lux a todo custo, certifique-se de usar também bugigangas azuis ou sentinelas bem posicionadas para ajudar a rastrear seus movimentos e evitar ser pego por ela.

(9) Construa Mercury Treads, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Use Mercury Treads para reduzir o dano geral de Lux e a duração de CC. Malphite cannot out damage Renekton’s outsustaining power, forcing Malphite to waste a lot of mana and setting himself up for an early Renekton kill.

(3) Respect Malphite W - Malphite’s W allows his next auto attack to become empowered, dealing high physical damage on his first auto and slightly lower increased damage on his remaining hits. Whenever Malphite uses W, we want to avoid trying to trade deeply with him, as Malphite’s auto attacks hurt an absolute ton in combination with his attack speed slow on E. Try to always disengage from Malphite if he uses his W and E onto you, providing you the ability to keep your HP up and our plan to mana burn Malphite. 

(4) Avoid Malphite E - One of the most common reasons Malphite is able to out damage Renekton, is based around the fact people try to fight Malphite while they are attack speed slowed. Malphite’s E slows from 30% to 50% attack speed, which can stack multiplicatively with Frozen Heart’s 20%. Overall Malphite’s ability to negate our total attack speed, prevents us from being able to trade auto attacks against him. There are two ways we can play around Malphite’s E; we can either use short clicks to walk in and out and bait him to cast his E if we walk into his range, or we can use only our abilities to trade, using our E2 to instantly escape fighting him. The overall objective with these types of trades into malphite, is to allow ourselves to easily burn his mana, providing the ability to look for an all in or force him to base. 

(5) Play For Manaburn - As I recently mentioned, playing for mana burn is our most viable way of sustaining a lead over Malphite. Malphite naturally counters our ability to snowball over him, due to his high armour stacking and his annoying mechanics that lower our overall ability to obtain kills over him. Using our techniques of Doran’s Shield and Second Wind, short movements to bait abilities and using our short combos to bait out any abilities of his, will provide us with the result of easily wasting his mana, allowing us to force his recalls to help proxy, take plates or crash minion waves. Don’t try to aim for the kill in this lane, aim to have a high CS lead, as well as removing his mana and presence as a result. 

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to  proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Abuse Renekton Empowered E - Renekton’s Empowered E allows him to help shred Malphite’s total armour, synergising with Black Cleaver to help take away Malphite’s unkillable Aura. As the game progresses, using Empowered E is 100% essential for taking away his armour within teamfights. Having the ability to remove 300+ Armour is absolutely crazy value for Renekton, hence why using this is always super important for you and your teammates.

(8) Abuse Renekton’s R Powerspike - Whenever you’re trying to fight Malphite, you must always have your R available if you want to provide that outcome. Renekton’s R magic damage combined with his armour shred and high AD damage, allows him to find early kills on Malphite as long as he plays it well. Malphite can always hold his own within 1v1’s, allowing him to get over confident against Renekton’s R, eventually losing the fight or wasting his R. If you manage to take away Malphite’s R, that’s always a win for you and your team, so make sure to notify your team whenever he doesn’t have it.

(9) Respect Malphite R - Malphite’s R is an absolutely giant play making tool, allowing him to win an entire fight alone from the overall utility or high damage it can provide. Typically, we want to always avoid fights that are held within choke points, as it will easily provide the potential for a 5 man knock up with how tight the terrain is. Try to always avoid fighting Malphite clumped up, make sure to spread out and protect the ulted target if you have the chance to. Otherwise as previously mentioned, try to find ways to force his ults in a 1v1, then look to find a skirmish or teamfight while he has his R down. 

(10) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, or Black Cleaver - Go Hexdrinker to lower Malphite’s overall damage and have a MR shield. /  Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. Go Black Cleaver to hard counter Malphite, allowing you to easily fight and apply armour shred for yourself and the rest of your team.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Malphite’s playstyle within the mid to late game, consists of stacking heavy armour to counter any AD threats, as well as using his R as a big initiation tool to help him catch out his main targets. Malphite’s overall presence is always annoying to deal with as Renekton, as he’s able to easily access anyone in the game with his R, while he’s practically nearly unkillable if he’s drafted into a heavy AD comp. When playing against Malphite, typically we want to make sure he’s away from our teammates at all costs, meaning we want to hard crash waves on his side of the map. Keeping Malphite away from your team is priority, allowing you to also look for fights with your R and Black Cleaver powerspike, forcing Malphite to potentially waste ult for any upcoming objectives. Whenever you get rid of his R, you’re able to force objectives or fights with your team, as naturally you will be able to make more play making opportunities than Malphite can within a fight. Within teamfights, try to ignore Malphite unless he’s the last target left. Killing Malphite is just a waste of time, so make sure to focus his carries and remove them from the game. When you’re forced to fight Malphite, make sure to use your empowered E to shred his abundance of armour, as well as stacking your Black Cleaver to allow all your teammates to do additional damage against the Malphite.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Malzahar - KR Master Patch 25.21
summaryEn: Malzahar is one of the easiest match ups you can lane into as Renekton, as Renekton can force his will on Malzahar any time within the laning phase. Malzahar's passive doesn't really do much for himself here, as Renekton E or Tiamat can easily proc his passive, allowing him to dive onto Malzahar without him having much resistance back. Malzahar's only strength into Renekton is being able to lock him down with his R, which is more problematic within teamfights or ganks. Try to always ward around or track your enemies before fully committing onto him, as Malzahar R is basically irrelevant for 1v1's as long as he has no team around.
summaryPt: Malzahar é uma das partidas mais fáceis em que você pode jogar como Renekton, já que Renekton pode forçar sua vontade em Malzahar a qualquer momento durante a fase de rotas (laning phase). A passiva de Malzahar realmente não faz muito por ele aqui, já que Renekton E ou Tiamat podem facilmente processar sua passiva, permitindo que ele dive em Malzahar sem que ele tenha muita resistência de volta. A única força de Malzahar em Renekton é ser capaz de prendê-lo com seu R, o que é mais problemático em teamfights ou ganks. Tente sempre proteger ou rastrear seus inimigos antes de se comprometer totalmente com ele, já que Malzahar R é basicamente irrelevante para 1v1, desde que ele não tenha equipe por perto.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Malzahar you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Malzahar lose a lot more. 

(3) Play Around Malzahar Passive - Playing around Malzahar passive is the core element within this match up, as playing around it correctly will allow you to easily one shot him as much as you want. Malzahar passive is around 30 to 12 seconds depending on his level, overall being so much higher within the early stages of the game. Malzahar’s shield provides him the ability to block all CC related ability, while providing himself with 90% damage reduction, lasting up to 0.25 seconds as soon as he’s in combat with an enemy. When playing around Malzahar shield, we can use our E1 to dash on top of him to help us remove his shield. Once dashing onto Malzahar, we must hold our damage until the shield wears off, allowing us to then use our remaining abilities to help hard commit towards an all in, providing malzahar with 0 self peel to survive against our damage. Items such as Tiamat can also help break Malzahar’s passive, providing you another way to remove his passive. 

(4) Avoid Malzahar’s E Damage - Malzahar’s E allows him to apply a DoT, allowing him to spread it to each individual target as long as it kills. Malzahar will use this to help him kill minions within the wave, using it to also help him play from range. Malzahar’s E early won’t provide him with the damage and clear potential that he has later on in the game, allowing you to punish him if he walks up close to the minion wave. If Malzahar tries to apply his E, try to stand away from any low HP minions to avoid spreading it to you. When looking for trading opportunities, try to force your fights as soon as Malzahar comes close to E the minion wave.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(7) Respect Malzahar R - Malzahar R allows him to suppress his targets in place, removing the ability to move or use any abilities. Malzahar will mainly use his R to suppress targets that are low HP, targets trying to force fights on to him, or using his R around his teammates. Renekton’s high base HP and purchasable MR stats, allowing him to easily tank his R and remove any worries of Malzahar solo killing him. The only worry we have is when he uses it on us within a teamfight. With that said, try to avoid positions where Malzhar can catch you with his team and try to build items like Kaenic or Jak’Sho to help you tank against his incoming damage. Do note, that if you’re 1v1 against Malzahar, you can use W buffering to help cancel his R cast. You can do this by spam clicking on Malzahar just before he’s about to use R, which typically is hard to tell with his instant animation.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Malzahar’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid to late game, Malzahar’s role is solely focused on locking down any potential threats to him and his team, using his R to completely take his target out of the fight. Malzhar will play to zone off his enemies, using his silence to deny enemies abilities, or use his E to help burn his targets or apply a slow from items such as Rylai’s. As Renekton, typically before any major fights, our objective should be trying to catch Malazhar after he shoves a wave within the side lane. If we are able to take away Malzahar from any fights via crashing waves or killing him, Malzahar’s lack of presence will allow us to easily win fights. Within teamfights, our role is essentially to disrupt the enemy back line by trying to jump onto any carries, or allow ourselves to bait out abilities for our team. Malzahar will typically look to R Renekton if he’s fed, providing his team the set up to help shut him down. Dealing with Malzahar R is usually pretty difficult, hence why I recommend building defensive items after your early snowball phase, as you’re able to front line effectively while removing Malzahar or his team's damage towards you. If Malzahar holds R for any other of your teammates, try to interrupt his cast by using your stun on him, allowing you to free your teammate from his R and furthermore removing his main teamfighting power.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Malzahar, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Malzahar perca muito mais. 

(3) Brincar com Malzahar Passivo - Brincar com Malzahar passivo é o elemento central neste confronto, já que brincar corretamente permitirá que você atire nele com facilidade o quanto quiser. A passiva de Malzahar dura cerca de 30 a 12 segundos dependendo do seu nível, sendo no geral muito maior nos estágios iniciais do jogo. O escudo de Malzahar fornece a ele a capacidade de bloquear todas as habilidades relacionadas a CC, ao mesmo tempo que proporciona 90% de redução de dano, durando até 0,25 segundos assim que ele estiver em combate com um inimigo. Ao brincar com o escudo Malzahar, podemos usar nosso E1 para correr em cima dele e nos ajudar a remover seu escudo. Depois de avançar para Malzahar, devemos segurar nosso dano até que o escudo desapareça, permitindo-nos então usar nossas habilidades restantes para ajudar a nos comprometermos com um all in, fornecendo Malzahar com 0 self peel para sobreviver contra nosso dano. Itens como Tiamat também podem ajudar a quebrar a passiva de Malzahar, fornecendo outra maneira de remover sua passiva. 

(4) Evite o dano E de Malzahar - O E de Malzahar permite que ele aplique um DoT, permitindo que ele o espalhe para cada alvo individual, desde que mate. Malzahar usará isso para ajudá-lo a matar lacaios dentro da wave, usando-o também para ajudá-lo a jogar à distância. O E de Malzahar no início do jogo não fornecerá a ele o dano e o potencial claro que ele terá mais tarde no jogo, permitindo que você o castigue se ele se aproximar do lacaio wave. Se Malzahar tentar aplicar seu E, tente ficar longe de qualquer lacaio com HP baixo para evitar espalhá-lo para você. Ao procurar oportunidades de trocas, tente forçar suas lutas assim que Malzahar se aproximar do E o minion wave.

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(7) Respeite Malzahar R - Malzahar R permite que ele suprima seus alvos no local, removendo a capacidade de se mover ou usar quaisquer habilidades. Malzahar usará seu R principalmente para suprimir alvos com baixo HP, alvos que o impeçam de lutar contra ele ou usará seu R perto de seus companheiros de equipe. O alto HP base de Renekton e stats de MR compráveis, permitindo que ele tanke facilmente seu R e elimine qualquer preocupação de Malzahar matá-lo sozinho. A única preocupação que temos é quando ele usa isso em nós dentro de um teamfight. Com isso dito, evite posições onde Malzhar possa pegá-lo com sua equipe e tente construir itens como Kaenic ou Jak’Sho para ajudá-lo a resistir ao dano recebido. Observe que se você for 1v1 contra Malzahar, você pode usar W buffering para ajudar a cancelar seu lançamento de R. Você pode fazer isso clicando em spam em Malzahar pouco antes de ele usar R, o que normalmente é difícil de dizer com sua animação instantânea.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Malzahar e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Entre meados e late game, o papel de Malzahar é exclusivamente focado em bloquear quaisquer ameaças potenciais a ele e sua equipe, usando seu R para tirar completamente seu alvo da luta. Malzhar jogará para afastar seus inimigos, usando seu silêncio para negar habilidades aos inimigos, ou usará seu E para ajudar a queimar seus alvos ou aplicar lentidão de itens como o de Rylai. Como Renekton, muitas vezes antes de qualquer luta importante, nosso objetivo deve ser tentar pegar Malazhar depois que ele enfiar uma wave na side lane. Se conseguirmos tirar Malzahar de qualquer luta via crashing waves ou matá-lo, a falta de presença de Malzahar nos permitirá vencer lutas facilmente. Dentro de teamfights, nosso papel é essencialmente atrapalhar a linha de defesa inimiga, tentando pular em qualquer carregador ou nos permitir atrair habilidades para nossa equipe. Malzahar normalmente obterá R Renekton se ele estiver alimentado, fornecendo à sua equipe a configuração para ajudar a desligá-lo. Lidar com Malzahar R geralmente é muito difícil, por isso recomendo construir itens defensivos após a fase inicial de snowball, já que você é capaz de atacar a linha de frente de maneira eficaz enquanto remove o dano de Malzahar ou de sua equipe contra você. Se Malzahar detém R para qualquer outro de seus companheiros de equipe, tente interromper seu lançamento usando seu atordoamento nele, permitindo que você liberte seu companheiro de equipe de seu R e, além disso, removendo seu poder principal teamfighting.

videoTitle: Renekton vs Maokai TOP - KR CHALLENGER Patch 14.23
summaryEn: Maokai is a very easy and free match up for Renekton, as his weak laning and tanking ability lets him down throughout the match up. As Renekton we can utilise runes such as Conqueror, and items such as Black Cleaver and Blade of the Ruined King to easily deal with his HP and armour stacking build. Renekton will typically always dominate Maokai super easily with R up, however Maokai's main strength relies within his teamfigthing and heavy CC prowess, making him a threat if not taken seriously. As long as you don't coinflip 1v3 or 4 fights into his CC and play consistent with your teammates and side lane pressure, Maokai can't really do anything.
summaryPt: Maokai é um confronto muito fácil e gratuito para Renekton, já que sua fraca habilidade de laning e tank o deixa na mão durante todo o confronto. Como Renekton podemos utilizar runas como Conqueror e itens como Black Cleaver e Blade of the Ruined King para lidar facilmente com seu HP e acúmulo de armadura. Renekton normalmente sempre dominará Maokai super facilmente com R ativo, no entanto, a principal força de Maokai depende de sua luta em equipe e de sua grande destreza em CC, tornando-o uma ameaça se não for levado a sério. Contanto que você não jogue 1v3 ou 4 lutas em seu CC e jogue de forma consistente com seus companheiros de equipe e a pressão da rota lateral, Maokai realmente não pode fazer nada.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Level 1 Q start allows you to poke Maokai within the wave, allowing you to secure level 2 priority, as well as allowing you to abuse Conqueror and your auto attacks and Q to force him low off the wave. By level 2, you can typically kill him if he’s low enough from punishing his weak start.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Maokai you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Maokai lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Maokai’s Q - Maokai’s Q is the only tool that can really help him within the match up, as he can use it to cancel your E if you mistime your dash, or use it to help him space away from you if you walk up to him. When playing against Maokai, whenever he uses his Q on the minions or fails the Q knock back, you’re able to utilise a heavy combo onto him, forcing him in a terrible situation. When you’re comboing against Maokai, try to always stay in front of him, to avoid being knocked back towards your side of the map. If Maokai is unable to keep you off of him, he is typically a free kill most of the time. 

(4) Respect Saplings - Saplings aren’t really that problematic since his E and item nerfs, however it should be said that if he is strong on a patch, try to always avoid directly walking into the bushes. You can walk towards a bush to bait a sapling, allowing you to walk out of range if you have the movement speed or dashes to waste his sapling. Removing his saplings can be important to remove his gank protection within the top lane, so make sure to check the bush before your jungler walks towards it. 

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) Respect Maokai’s R - Maokai is a very free match up, however his R can be a great tool to help catch you or your teammates out, making it a very threatening ability. Against Maokai R, you can typically try to use your dash to dash off your minions, monsters or enemies to help you escape his R range. Escaping his R disallows him to apply his heavy CC kit, removing the only main danger of his kit. Do note that Maokai ult stuns longer the longer it travels, so if you’re on top of the starting position of his R, you will break out a lot faster, allowing you to tank it then use your dashes to escape bad situations. 

(10) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Maokai’s only hope against Renekton, is trying to utilise his heavy CC kit in being able to set up plays for his teammates, while trying to hard CC any of your carries from being able to play teamfights. Typically against Maokai, the main thing we should do is try to jump on his own carries and try to one shot them. Maokai cannot go alone and engage on your team without his carries damage, otherwise he will be isolated and most likely shredded against the right comp and itemisation from your team. With that said, typically the win condition is just to try and remove as many of his carries as fast as possible. If he tries to focus and lock you down, ensure that your team is in position to help fight back, allowing you to use your defensive stats to help soak up any incoming damage and win the fight. Within the mid game, make sure your team isn’t also walking alone into the fog of war, as Maokai will try to get his engages using that to his advantage.

Observe que Maokai ult atordoa por mais tempo quanto mais ele viaja, então se você estiver no topo da posição inicial de seu R, você irá sair muito mais rápido, permitindo que você tanke e use seus ataques para escapar de situações ruins.

(11) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - A única esperança de Maokai contra Renekton é tentar utilizar seu kit pesado CC para poder preparar jogadas para seus companheiros de equipe, enquanto impede hard CC que qualquer um de seus carregadores seja capaz de jogar teamfights. Normalmente contra Maokai, a principal coisa que devemos fazer é tentar pular em seus próprios carregadores e tentar one-shot neles. Maokai não pode ir sozinho e engage em sua equipe sem causar danos, caso contrário ele será isolado e provavelmente destruído contra a composição e itemização corretas de sua equipe. Com isso dito, normalmente a condição de vitória é apenas tentar remover o máximo de carregamentos o mais rápido possível. Se ele tentar focar e prender você, certifique-se de que sua equipe esteja em posição para ajudar a revidar, permitindo que você use suas stats defensivas para ajudar a absorver qualquer dano recebido e vencer a luta. Dentro do mid game, certifique-se de que sua equipe também não esteja caminhando sozinha na névoa da guerra, pois Maokai tentará realizar seus combates usando isso a seu favor.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Mel - KR Grandmaster Patch 25.24
summaryEn: Mel is an absolutely abhorrent match up, due to the fact her high range, damage and self peel is absolutely a nightmare for Renekton to fight his engages. Renekton must rely on Mel running into him, as well as misusing her W for Renekton to leverage an advantage. I recommend rushing Mercury Treads and either Stridebreaker or Maw, as her high damage and annoying kit makes it absolutely terrible to go any other items. Typically we must dash into Mel, then wait for Mel to use her W before we intiate any other damage, otherwise Mel W can block our entire combo and leave us empty handed. Try to also angle all in's after she uses E, as if you dash in she will simply stun and walk away for free. This is a terrible match up, so make sure to play off your teammates to leverage the advantages you need to get past her annoyingly defensive kit.
summaryPt: Mel é um confronto absolutamente horrível, já que seu alto alcance, dano e auto peel são absolutamente um pesadelo para Renekton lutar contra seus combates. Renekton deve confiar que Mel o encontrará, bem como usar indevidamente seu W para Renekton para obter vantagem. Eu recomendo apressar Mercury Treads e Stridebreaker ou Maw, já que seu alto dano e kit irritante tornam absolutamente terrível usar qualquer outro item. Normalmente devemos atacar Mel e esperar que Mel use seu W antes de iniciar qualquer outro dano, caso contrário Mel W pode bloquear todo o nosso combo e nos deixar de mãos vazias. tente também inclinar all in depois que ela usar E, como se você entrasse, ela simplesmente atordoaria e iria embora de graça. Este é um confronto terrível, então certifique-se de jogar contra seus companheiros de equipe para aproveitar as vantagens necessárias para superar seu irritante kit defensivo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Mel’s poke heavy playstyle and range makes it very difficult for Renekton to lane into her. Her overall kit and tools are designed to counter initiator style champions such as Renekton, therefore requiring Renekton to play around his team or look for specific opportunities to fight Mel. All Renekton can really do early is buy D Shield and Second Wind, as these will provide you the ability to sustain your HP and survive any early aggression from Mel. If Renekton maintains his HP from playing correctly, Renekton will be able to utilise teamplay assistance to help him fight against Mel within the lane. 

(2) Respect Mel’s Passive - Mel’s passive allows her to store damage in the forms of stacks, allowing her to build up damage through her stacks to help her execute her target. If the overall stacks of damage exceed the target's current HP, it will instantly execute her target on her next auto attack or ability. Make sure to avoid consistent poke against Mel, as her overall damage will threaten you towards recalling and missing minion waves, or securing a kill onto you.  

(3) Avoid Mel’s Q - Mel’s Q will throw out a barrage of projectiles, allowing her to poke from range to apply her damage and passive stacks, while also preventing her opponents from being able to walk close towards her. To dodge her Q’s, try to understand the pattern in how she is using it. Eventually when you figure it out, try to use short clicks to bait out her Q before you walk towards her. Mel’s Q ranges from 10 to 6 seconds at rank 5, so make sure to abuse it by trading within its down time, or simply farm minions until she’s able to get her Q back. 

(4) Respect And Abuse Mel’s W - Mel’s W allows her to shield against all incoming damage abilities, allowing her to avoid any damage within the 0.75 seconds cast time, while also projecting any incoming abilities back towards her enemies. Mel’s W can completely counter Renekton’s fast combos, as once he’s able to get into range she can simply use her W to block all of his damage. As Renekton, if we manage to jump onto Mel, we should hold all of our damage until her W goes away, allowing us to unload on Mel’s HP and potentially kill her in the process. Within the laning phase, trying to trade with Mel can feel impossible alongside dealing with her E. However, Mel’s W CD is 35 to 23 seconds at rank 5, providing you 2 potential E trades to abuse her while her W is down, giving you a clear window to play around after she uses it within the lane.  

(5) Avoid Mel’s E - Mel’s E is a giant counter towards Renekton’s engages, due to her easily being able to throw it out towards Renekton’s E direction. Because Renekton’s E is so telegraphed, it allows Mel to always have an answer to keep Renekton at bay. Instead, we need to either bait Mel E out by walking towards her, or use our E more creatively, to where we can double dash as fast as we can to land behind her, dodging her E in the process. Overall, the second way is a lot more riskier within mid lane, so make sure to do it when you’re receiving a gank, or Mel has W on CD and she steps up towards your range.

(6) Rush Mercury Treads - Mercury Treads are very helpful into Mel, due to being able to help tank against her heavy AP damage, as well as providing you the CC to escape her E faster. When buying Mercs, you’re able to take more fights into Mel, lowering the overall risk of her being able to kill you. 

(7) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(8) Play For Team - Playing against Mel is very hard with Renekton’s lack of range and high CDs, meaning the only consistent way we have to make an impact is playing around our team. Playing the wave on our side, allows Mel to potentially overstep and create a ganking opportunity. If we’re able to out push Mel via her recall timer or her willingness to let ourselves push, Renekton can try to roam towards other lanes or objectives to help him gain some kind of advantage. Overall there’s not a lot of things we can do if Mel is good, or if she has heavy team presence playing around her, so make sure to play stable and just make sure you make it to the mid game without inting.  

(9) Respect Mel’s R - Once Mel has her R, her passive is available to store even more damage towards executing her targets, allowing Mel to do an insane amount of burst damage towards non magic resist targets. Within the later stages of the game, Renekton should opt into a Kaenic alongside his Mercury Treads, to help him tank against her overall AP damage. If Renekton is able to survive against her high damage combos while avoiding the threat of her R, Renekton will be able to provide more playmaking potential, as well as being able to bait out her W for his team or present himself a kill opportunity onto Mel if the opportunity arises itself. 

(10) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Hexdrinker to lower Mel’s overall damage and have a MR shield. / Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Mel’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Mel’s overall playstyle within the mid to late game, consists of playing from long range to apply her passive stacks, using her kit to help extend the fights while eventually looking to use her R to obliterate any stacked targets. Keeping fights long vs Mel is always a terrible idea, as Renekton’s role is to look to jump into carries and try to end the fights as fast as possible. Mel’s ability to extend the fights from her W and E can cause a lot of trouble, however if Renekton builds the right items, he can try to dash in and bait out Mel’s abilities before she’s able to use them any other time within a fight. Getting rid of her W allows your team to focus her as a target, allowing you to easily shut down Mel if she’s in range, or it can provide Renekton with the ability to use the rest of his damage to successfully kill Mel. When playing into Mel, trying to also set up plays within the fog of war is also essentially, using your red trinkets and control wards to create vision denial while waiting for her to walk towards a bush. As long as you can keep Mel away from fights, or force early kills on her before objectives, this will allow you to have success and avoid Mel’s annoying playstyle within those points of the game.

Make sure to avoid consistent poke against Mel, as her overall damage will threaten you towards recalling and missing minion waves, or securing a kill onto you.

Certifique-se de evitar poke consistente contra Mel, pois o dano geral dela irá ameaçá-lo de chamar de volta e perder o lacaio waves, ou garantir uma morte em você.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage over Millio by using your Q to hard shove the first two waves. You cannot really kill Millio before level 3, as his Q can help knock you back if you try to get close into range. Make sure to play for the wave bounce on your side, then look to be creative with your kill opportunities with E. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once having the wave positioned on your side after letting the waves bounce, you can attempt to kill him when he’s overextended on your side of the map. To avoid Millio from ruining your engage, try to look for a double dash when he least expects it, by looking away with your character position, then trying to double dash as soon as he moves forward, with the intent of landing behind and dodging his Q. Once you’re in this position, try to do as much damage as you can before you get him into lethal range. Once he is low, you can try to look for a flash play and try to finish off his remainder of his HP. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Respect Millio Q - Milios’s Q is a very annoying ability at all times, essentially because he can remove any access we have in being able to reach him. Milio’s Q is 10 seconds CD, providing him the ability to counter our 16 second CD dash. While this does create some issues, we can just try walking up to him to help us bait his Q. Walking up to him, especially when buying movement speed, will allow us to get into range or bait his Q before we’re able to reach him. If he does this, we can then use our E and look to punish his Q down time by forcing a giant trade. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Respect Millio R - Milio does absolutely nothing when it comes to playing vs Renekton, however his R ability can really cuck Renekton in being able to kill his carries. Milio R will free any of his allies, using his cleanse to remove any CC effects, alongside healing his allies from 150 > 350+ HP. When playing around Milio R, we have to reserve our flash combos until we get his R down. We can usually bait his R in a fight, if we try to use our W onto his main priority targets. This will then force him to instantly R, allowing us to quickly disengage and depart us from continuing a fight. Most often, we want to wait for our own teammates to bait his R out before we use our W, so make sure to play around his R CD then look for any fights that you can.

(7) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Millio’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(8) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - As previously mentioned, Millio doesn’t really ever pose a threat towards Renekton within any 1v1 circumstances, providing Renekton a free match up for him to essentially take whatever he wants within the top side. The only strength Millio has over Renekton, is his own ability to try and stop you from killing his carry targets. Nothing really changes in terms of teamfighting knowledge from what I talked about with his R, however our main strengths that come into these style of match ups is using our overall top lane lead then applying it into the rest of the map. When sidelaning, Renekton can essentially do whatever he wants as he’s able to take any side lane tower without the threat of Millio really bothering him. Just make sure when you’re side laning that you avoid fighting multiple people, as giving up any free gold with the lead is always bad. Try to play off trinkets, then push or take fights accordingly.

Para evitar que Millio estrague seu engage, tente procurar um avanço duplo quando ele menos esperar, desviando o olhar com a posição de seu personagem, e então tentando um avanço duplo assim que ele avançar, com a intenção de pousar atrás e desviar de seu Q. Uma vez nesta posição, tente causar o máximo de dano que puder antes de colocá-lo no alcance letal. Quando ele estiver baixo, você pode tentar uma jogada de Flash e tentar acabar com o restante de seu HP. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Respeite Millio Q - O Q de Milios é uma habilidade muito chata em todos os momentos, essencialmente porque ele pode remover qualquer acesso que tenhamos para poder alcançá-lo. O Q de Milio é de 10 segundos CD, proporcionando a ele a capacidade de contra-atacar nosso avanço de 16 segundos CD. Embora isso crie alguns problemas, podemos apenas tentar caminhar até ele para nos ajudar a atrair seu Q. Caminhar até ele, especialmente ao comprar velocidade de movimento, nos permitirá entrar no alcance ou atrair seu Q antes que possamos alcançá-lo. Se ele fizer isso, podemos usar nosso E e punir seu tempo de inatividade do Q, forçando uma troca gigante. 

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

Milio R libertará qualquer um de seus aliados, usando seu Cleanse para remover quaisquer efeitos de CC, além de curar seus aliados de 150 > 350+ HP. Ao jogar com Milio R, temos que reservar nossos combos de Flash até conseguirmos o R dele. Geralmente podemos atrair seu R em uma luta, se tentarmos usar nosso W em seus principais alvos prioritários. Isso irá forçá-lo a R imediatamente, permitindo-nos disengage rapidamente e nos impedir de continuar a luta. (8) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - Como mencionado anteriormente, Millio nunca representa uma ameaça para Renekton em nenhuma circunstância 1v1, proporcionando a Renekton um confronto livre para ele essencialmente pegar o que quiser no lado superior. A única força que Millio tem sobre Renekton é sua própria habilidade de tentar impedi-lo de matar seus alvos de carregamento. Nada realmente muda em termos de conhecimento de teamfighting em relação ao que falei com seu R, no entanto, nossos principais pontos fortes nesse estilo de confrontos é usar nossa liderança geral na rota superior e aplicá-la no resto do mapa. Apenas certifique-se de evitar lutar contra várias pessoas quando estiver na rota lateral, pois desistir de qualquer ouro grátis com a liderança é sempre ruim. Tente jogar com bugigangas e, em seguida, empurre ou aceite as lutas de acordo.

videoTitle: Brand Support vs Miss Fortune - KR Master Patch 26.16
summaryEn: Miss Fortune is super easy as a range match up, as she has no real self peel tools to stop Renekton from engaging in and one shotting her on demand. As Renekton, simply play for E and W off CD, then dash in and look to kill her within 1 or 2 combos. Renekton can also easily tower dive MF with W and R available, so make sure to play off your kits strengths and punish her weak pick within the lane. Try to make sure to respect her R within teamfights, make sure to jump on her before she uses it or kill her before a fight to ensure she cannot use it.
summaryPt: Miss Fortune é super fácil como um confronto de alcance, já que ela não tem ferramentas reais de peel para impedir que Renekton se envolva e atire nela sob demanda. Como Renekton, simplesmente jogue para E e W em CD, então corra e consiga matá-la em 1 ou 2 combos. Renekton também pode facilmente tower dive MF com W e R disponíveis, então certifique-se de usar os pontos fortes de seu kit e punir sua escolha fraca dentro da pista. Tente respeitar seu R dentro de teamfights, certifique-se de pular sobre ela antes que ela o use ou matá-la antes de uma luta para garantir que ela não possa usá-lo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Miss Fortune you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Miss Fortune lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Miss Fortune’s Q - MF’s Q, allows her to do a decent amount of damage towards her target, while executed minions will bounce her Q to the opposite side target dealing bonus damage. Make sure to avoid standing behind low HP minions, as MF Q can chunk your HP out. If MF doesn’t bounce her Q onto you, she won’t really have any real resistance against Renekton to beat him. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) Avoid Miss Fortune’s R - MF’s R can do a giant amount of damage no matter what build she goes, therefore being a core ability we need to avoid in crucial fights. When MF is 1v1, she cannot really utilise a good R against Renekton due to his dashes, as well his ability to easily cancel her R with his W. MF will typically use R if you’re running away from her, or she will hold it for any skirmishes or teamfights, using to zone or shred any slowed or stunned targets. If you can always avoid fighting in her R, she won’t be able to really leverage anything on to you or your teammates. 

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Miss Fortune's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Solo lane MF is absolutely horrible as a pick, especially into Renekton that can essentially kill her with any fight at will. MF’s only hope of being a useful pick will be based around her using her R properly, to help provide an abundance of damage towards any stunned or clumped up targets. Most often MF will use her R absolutely horribly unless the team comp suits her, so make sure to always respect the enemies potential CC comps around MF R, otherwise she will be able to have maximum value. Within team fights, try to instantly dash onto MF and look to one shot her instantly with your overall damage and combo. MF cannot ever defend against Renekton’s damage, so make sure to abuse her lack of self peel and use it to instantly eliminate her from the fight. If MF is already so behind, you can just opt into killing other important targets on her team.

Se você sempre puder evitar lutar no R dela, ela não será capaz de realmente alavancar nada para você ou seus companheiros de equipe.

Na maioria das vezes, MF usará seu R de forma absolutamente horrível, a menos que a composição da equipe seja adequada para ela, então certifique-se de sempre respeitar as composições potenciais de inimigos CC em torno de MF R, caso contrário, ela poderá ter valor máximo.
