Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Olaf R
tips.contentEn: Olaf’s R is a giant powerspike tool to help him duels, providing anti CC resistance through his R. When fighting Olaf with R, we typically should aim to double dash away as soon as he uses it. When fighting Olaf, we also want to make sure we fight him on our side of the map, otherwise Olaf can run us down with his Q slow and R uptime, to help him overpower and kill Renekton. Make sure to break freezes with your jungler, or force him to Q the wave and use E to dash away from him. Once fighting Olaf, use short trades to bait out his R, then look to E2 out on our side of the map. If we are fed, we can typically brute force trades with R available against Olaf R. Make sure to play off your strengths to take away Olaf’s power.
tips.contentPt: O R de Olaf é uma ferramenta powerspike gigante para ajudá-lo a duelar, fornecendo resistência anti CC através de seu R. Ao lutar contra Olaf com R, normalmente devemos tentar fugir duas vezes assim que ele o usar. Ao lutar contra Olaf, também queremos ter certeza de que lutaremos contra ele do nosso lado do mapa, caso contrário, Olaf pode nos atropelar com seu Q lento e tempo de atividade de R, para ajudá-lo a dominar e matar Renekton. Certifique-se de quebrar o congelamento com seu caçador ou forçá-lo a Q o wave e usar E para fugir dele. Depois de lutar contra Olaf, use trocas curtas para atrair seu R e, em seguida, procure E2 em nosso lado do mapa. Se estivermos alimentados, normalmente podemos fazer trocas de força bruta com R disponível contra Olaf R. Certifique-se de usar seus pontos fortes para tirar o poder de Olaf.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Olaf while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Olaf within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.
tips.contentPt: Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Olaf enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você facilmente snowball e desligue permanentemente Olaf em todas as fases do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto.

tips.titleEn: Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Olaf’s overall role weakens through the game, making him a very early game reliant champion in being able to snowball. Olaf’s overall objective will be trying to snowball kills through the lane, while looking to skirmish every chance he gets. If Olaf is unable to do either, Olaf’s overall relevancy will not be apparent unless your team is actively griefing fights around him. Try to make sure to still ping Olaf’s movements at all times, to avoid him using his Q utility for his teammates. If you’re ahead of Olaf, try to utilise your power within the side lane to fight him at will. Make sure to avoid Olaf’s teams from collapsing on you by actively warding and looking at the map. If Olaf is ahead, try to farm back in the game while actively pushing back against pushes. Try to also get your teammates to focus on Olaf if he’s fed in side lane, as this will free up map pressure and create a shut down opportunity to get back in the game. When playing teamfights, try to either peel off Olaf using your empowered E to shred his armour, or use your W to help burst him down. Overall, Olaf will try to engage first with his Q and R, so make sure to burst him down as fast as you can with your team, then look to fight the rest of his team when he is dead.
tips.contentPt: O papel geral de Olaf enfraquece ao longo do jogo, tornando-o um campeão muito early game dependente de ser capaz de snowball. O objetivo geral de Olaf será impedir que snowball mate na pista, enquanto busca skirmish sempre que puder. Se Olaf não for capaz de fazer isso, a relevância geral de Olaf não será aparente, a menos que sua equipe esteja ativamente sofrendo as lutas ao seu redor. Tente fazer ping nos movimentos de Olaf o tempo todo, para evitar que ele use seu utilitário Q para seus companheiros de equipe. Se você estiver à frente de Olaf, tente utilizar seu poder na side lane para combatê-lo à vontade. Certifique-se de evitar que as equipes de Olaf caiam sobre você, protegendo ativamente e olhando para o mapa. Se Olaf estiver à frente, tente voltar ao jogo enquanto revida ativamente contra os empurrões. Tente também fazer com que seus companheiros de equipe se concentrem em Olaf se ele for alimentado na rota lateral, pois isso liberará a pressão no mapa e criará uma oportunidade de desligamento para voltar ao jogo. Ao jogar teamfights, tente peel em Olaf usando seu Empowered E para destruir sua armadura, ou use seu W para ajudá-lo a derrubar burst. No geral, Olaf tentará engage primeiro com seu Q e R, então certifique-se de burst derrubá-lo o mais rápido que puder com seu time, e então procure lutar contra o resto de seu time quando ele estiver morto.

level1ExplanationPt: Start Reativo: Se você puder bater nos minions primeiro, pegue Q e desvie dos machados para pegar nível 2. Se Olaf zonear de Q nos bushes, pegue E para trocar e desengajar.
level1ExplanationEn: Reactionary Start: Start Q to push if dodging Qs. If Olaf zones from bush, skill E to trade 3 AAs with PTA and dash away.
winConditionPt: Controle a wave para criar freezes e force trocas curtas com E > W > Q > E; no mid-game use o E2 Fortalecido para triturar até 35% da armadura de Olaf.
winConditionEn: Control the wave for freezes and execute short E > W > Q > E trades; use Empowered E2 in mid-game to shred Olaf's armor by 35%.
cautionPt: Evite trocas prolongadas onde Olaf possa escalar dano com Aperto dos Mortos-Vivos ou itens de armadura pesada (Coração Congelado / Armadura de Espinhos).
cautionEn: Avoid prolonged trades where Olaf scales damage with Grasp or heavy armor items (Frozen Heart / Thornmail).

tips.titlePt: Entendendo o Pico de Fúria e a Ultimate do Olaf
tips.contentEn: Olaf's ultimate (R) grants him CC immunity and increased combat power, rendering Renekton's W (stun) ineffective when Olaf uses his ultimate. Try to engage in trades with W when Olaf's ultimate is on cooldown.
tips.contentPt: Olaf ganha muita velocidade de ataque e roubo de vida quando está com pouca vida. Não prolongue trocas; foque em dano explosivo (burst) para finalizá-lo de uma vez.

tips.titlePt: Sustentação com Q Fortalecido e Trocas Curtas
tips.contentEn: Olaf frequently attempts sustained trades with his Q (Undertow) and E (Reckless Swing). Renekton should utilize the healing effect of his empowered Q (Cull the Meek) to enhance his lane sustain and withstand Olaf's poke.
tips.contentPt: Use o Q com 50+ de Fúria na wave para curar grandes quantias de vida e desengaje com o duplo E antes que Olaf acerte machados consecutivos.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Orianna - EUW Master Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Orianna attempts to zone Renekton away using Ball placement (Q/W) and Clockwork Windup passive basic attacks. Start E at level 1 to punish her low base durability with sudden gap-close trades (E1 > auto attacks > E2 disengage). Build Doran's Shield and Mercury's Treads to shrug off her poke and slow zones. At levels 3 and 6, utilize double dashes through the wave to instantly reach her, reserving your Empowered W to shred her Command: Protect (E) shield and eliminate her before she can reposition.
summaryPt: Orianna na rota solo tenta manter Renekton distante com o controle de zona de sua Esfera (Q/W) e ataques básicos passivos reforçados. No nível 1, comece com E para punir o posicionamento dela através de trocas com PTA/Conquistador (E1 > auto-ataques > E2 para recuar). Construa Doran's Shield e Passos de Mercúrio para amortecer o poke e desacelerações de Orianna. No nível 3 e 6, utilize o avanço duplo do E nos minions para fechar a distância num piscar de olhos, guardando o W Fortalecido para estilhaçar o escudo protetor da esfera dela e deletá-la com um all-in rápido.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) This may not always work in high MMR, however if you’re playing in lower MMR or simply want to try something different, then I recommend this - Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2. Eventually if Ori is low enough, you can look to force a level 2 kill with W.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Orianna you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Orianna lose a lot more. 

(3) Play For Sustain Early - Orianna’s high poke and lane bully playstyle within the early game, allows her to easily chunk down and keep Renekton at bay, preventing Renekton from being able to obtain any further kills if she plays well enough. When laning into Orianna, make sure to buy D Shield and Second Wind to help you outsustain against her damage, forcing Orianna to waste her mana, allowing Renekton to mana burn her into potentially killing her or forcing an early reset. Killing Orianna is always hard solo, so make sure you play for the small victories.

(4) Avoid Orianna Q - Orianna’s Q allows her to move her ball towards a location, dealing damage to all targets hit with the Q. Tracking Orianna’s Q is essential to baiting out certain abilities or forcing your own trades. To avoid being hit by it, you can utilise short clicks to move in and out of her range, allowing you to side step her incoming Q, dodging her potential Q > W or R in the process. Orianna typically uses her Q when you’re standing in her radius, walking towards her, or walking towards minions. With that said, try to spot how she uses her Q, then look to side step it and force a trade against her to punish her ball location. Doing this allows you to overpower Orianna’s advantage within the lane, forcing her to lose mana to bring back her ball, or allowing you to one shot her if you have enough damage. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Rush Hexdrinker - Depending on the lane and game situation, sometimes I will rush Hexdrinker if I want to survive against her burst damage. Orianna’s high burst damage can hit like a truck if she’s fed, hence why having the Hexdrinker allows you to prevent her from killing you within the lane. Regardless, try to avoid Orianna getting any kills by giving up losing skirmishes or teamfights.

(8) Respect Orianna R - Orianna’s R is quite possibly one of the best ultimates in the entire game, due to her high skill ceiling of how she’s able to use it. When playing around Orianna R, try to avoid stacking up with your teammates, as her over value to mass CC and burst her enemies is absolutely high. If Orianna is fed, building magic resist against her damage is absolutely necessary if you want to be able to reach her. Make sure before any fights that you communicate if Orianna has R. If Orianna does not have R, her overall chances of carrying fights is a lot lower with how much utility her R has. 

(9) Play For Teammates - Solo killing Orianna is definitely hard if they’re playing optimally, hence why focusing and playing around your teammates matters a lot more than playing for yourself. Renekton’s high damage, tanky and utility based approach, allows him to be a great asset towards helping his team. As Renekton, you should either set up plays using optimal wave management to help your teammates gank your lane, or you should utilise your high wave clear to help you look for roams and play for any major objectives. Make sure to understand your win conditions within the game, protecting any high profile carries or disrupting or denying enemy threats.

(10) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Orianna’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Orianna’s role within the mid to late game, is using her long range to help her poke and peel around her secondary carries, while looking for the perfect R to help change the tides of a fight. Orianna’s overall damage and potential for team fights is absolutely crazy, so make sure to avoid fighting her in disadvantageous positions; those include tight spaces and chokepoints, fighting clumped together with your team or walking into fog of war vs her. Any chance Orianna gets to use her R in these moments is catastrophic, so try to avoid being in them as much as possible. Renekton’s overall objective within the mid game, is making sure he can look for picks against Orianna, using her jungle or waiting in bushes to help assassinate her. If Renekton cannot kill Orianna but manages to get her R, this will allow you and your team to have a much easier position in being able to teamfight. Within teamfights, try to spread out against Orianna and look to find an engage onto her, using your double dashes or flash to land on top of her. Once you’re fighting Orianna, try to get her to waste her R on you or try to kill her before she’s able to use it.

Com isso dito, observe como ela usa seu Q, depois dê um passo lateral e force uma troca contra ela para punir a localização da bola. (6) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(7) Rush Hexdrinker - Dependendo da pista e da situação do jogo, às vezes irei apressar Hexdrinker se quiser sobreviver ao dano de burst dela. O alto dano de burst de Orianna pode atingir como um caminhão se ela estiver alimentada, por isso ter o Hexdrinker permite que você evite que ela mate você dentro da pista. Independentemente disso, tente evitar que Orianna mate alguma coisa desistindo de perder skirmishes ou teamfights.

(8) Respeite Orianna R - O R de Orianna é possivelmente um dos melhores ultimates de todo o jogo, devido ao seu alto limite de habilidade de como ela é capaz de usá-lo. Ao jogar com Orianna R, evite acumular com seus companheiros de equipe, já que o supervalor dela para massa CC e burst seus inimigos é absolutamente alto. Se Orianna for alimentado, construir resistência mágica contra o dano dela é absolutamente necessário se você quiser alcançá-la. Antes de qualquer luta, certifique-se de comunicar se Orianna tem R. Se Orianna não tem R, suas chances gerais de realizar lutas são muito menores dependendo da utilidade de seu R. 

(9) Jogue para companheiros de equipe - Matar sozinho Orianna é definitivamente difícil se eles estiverem jogando de maneira ideal, por isso focar e brincar com seus companheiros de equipe é muito mais importante do que jogar sozinho. A abordagem de alto dano, tanque e utilidade de Renekton permite que ele seja um grande trunfo para ajudar sua equipe. Como Renekton, você deve configurar jogadas usando o gerenciamento ideal de wave para ajudar seus companheiros de equipe gank em sua rota, ou você deve utilizar sua alta limpeza de wave para ajudá-lo a procurar roamings e jogar para quaisquer objetivos principais. Certifique-se de compreender suas condições de vitória no jogo, protegendo qualquer ataque de alto perfil ou interrompendo ou negando ameaças inimigas.

(10) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Orianna e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(11) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O papel de Orianna no meio até late game é usar seu longo alcance para ajudá-lo poke e peel em seus carregamentos secundários, enquanto procura o R perfeito para ajudar a mudar o rumo de uma luta. O dano geral e o potencial de Orianna para lutas em equipe são absolutamente loucos, então evite lutar contra ela em posições desvantajosas; isso inclui espaços apertados e pontos de estrangulamento, lutar em grupo com sua equipe ou caminhar na névoa da guerra contra ela. Qualquer chance de Orianna usar seu R nesses momentos é catastrófica, então evite estar neles tanto quanto possível. O objetivo geral de Renekton dentro de mid game é garantir que ele possa procurar escolhas contra Orianna, usando sua selva ou esperando em arbustos para ajudar a assassiná-la. Se Renekton não puder matar Orianna, mas conseguir obter seu R, isso permitirá que você e sua equipe tenham uma posição muito mais fácil para conseguir teamfight. Dentro de teamfights, tente se espalhar contra Orianna e procure encontrar um engage nela, usando seus travessões duplos ou Flash para pousar em cima dela. Quando você estiver lutando contra Orianna, tente fazer com que ela desperdice seu R com você ou tente matá-la antes que ela possa usá-lo.

Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Rápidas (Short Trades)
tips.contentEn: E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash.
tips.contentPt: E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash.

tips.titlePt: Rush de Hexdrinker
tips.contentEn: Depending on the lane and game situation, sometimes I will rush Hexdrinker if I want to survive against her burst damage. Orianna’s high burst damage can hit like a truck if she’s fed, hence why having the Hexdrinker allows you to prevent her from killing you within the lane. Regardless, try to avoid Orianna getting any kills by giving up losing skirmishes or teamfights.
tips.contentPt: Dependendo da pista e da situação do jogo, às vezes irei apressar Hexdrinker se quiser sobreviver ao dano de burst dela. O alto dano de burst de Orianna pode atingir como um caminhão se ela estiver alimentada, por isso ter o Hexdrinker permite que você evite que ela mate você na pista. Independentemente disso, tente evitar que Orianna mate alguma coisa desistindo de perder skirmishes ou teamfights.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Orianna R
tips.contentEn: Orianna’s R is quite possibly one of the best ultimates in the entire game, due to her high skill ceiling of how she’s able to use it. When playing around Orianna R, try to avoid stacking up with your teammates, as her over value to mass CC and burst her enemies is absolutely high. If Orianna is fed, building magic resist against her damage is absolutely necessary if you want to be able to reach her. Make sure before any fights that you communicate if Orianna has R. If Orianna does not have R, her overall chances of carrying fights is a lot lower with how much utility her R has.
tips.contentPt: O R de Orianna é possivelmente um dos melhores ultimates de todo o jogo, devido ao seu alto limite de habilidade de como ela é capaz de usá-lo. Ao jogar com Orianna R, evite acumular com seus companheiros de equipe, pois o supervalor dela para massa CC e burst seus inimigos é absolutamente alto. Se Orianna for alimentado, construir resistência mágica contra o dano dela é absolutamente necessário se você quiser alcançá-la. Antes de qualquer luta, certifique-se de comunicar se Orianna tem R. Se Orianna não tem R, suas chances gerais de realizar lutas são muito menores dependendo da utilidade de seu R.

tips.titlePt: Jogue para companheiros de equipe
tips.contentEn: Solo killing Orianna is definitely hard if they’re playing optimally, hence why focusing and playing around your teammates matters a lot more than playing for yourself. Renekton’s high damage, tanky and utility based approach, allows him to be a great asset towards helping his team. As Renekton, you should either set up plays using optimal wave management to help your teammates gank your lane, or you should utilise your high wave clear to help you look for roams and play for any major objectives. Make sure to understand your win conditions within the game, protecting any high profile carries or disrupting or denying enemy threats.
tips.contentPt: Matar sozinho Orianna é definitivamente difícil se eles estiverem jogando de maneira ideal, por isso focar e brincar com seus companheiros de equipe é muito mais importante do que jogar sozinho. A abordagem de alto dano, tanque e utilidade de Renekton permite que ele seja um grande trunfo para ajudar sua equipe. Como Renekton, você deve configurar jogadas usando o gerenciamento ideal de wave para ajudar seus companheiros de equipe gank em sua rota, ou você deve utilizar sua alta limpeza de wave para ajudá-lo a procurar roamings e jogar para quaisquer objetivos principais. Certifique-se de compreender suas condições de vitória no jogo, protegendo qualquer ataque de alto perfil ou interrompendo ou negando ameaças inimigas.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Orianna’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Orianna e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Orianna’s role within the mid to late game, is using her long range to help her poke and peel around her secondary carries, while looking for the perfect R to help change the tides of a fight. Orianna’s overall damage and potential for team fights is absolutely crazy, so make sure to avoid fighting her in disadvantageous positions; those include tight spaces and chokepoints, fighting clumped together with your team or walking into fog of war vs her. Any chance Orianna gets to use her R in these moments is catastrophic, so try to avoid being in them as much as possible. Renekton’s overall objective within the mid game, is making sure he can look for picks against Orianna, using her jungle or waiting in bushes to help assassinate her. If Renekton cannot kill Orianna but manages to get her R, this will allow you and your team to have a much easier position in being able to teamfight. Within teamfights, try to spread out against Orianna and look to find an engage onto her, using your double dashes or flash to land on top of her. Once you’re fighting Orianna, try to get her to waste her R on you or try to kill her before she’s able to use it.
tips.contentPt: O papel de Orianna no meio até late game é usar seu longo alcance para ajudá-lo poke e peel em seus carregamentos secundários, enquanto procura o R perfeito para ajudar a mudar o rumo de uma luta. O dano geral e o potencial de Orianna para lutas em equipe são absolutamente loucos, então evite lutar contra ela em posições desvantajosas; isso inclui espaços apertados e pontos de estrangulamento, lutar em grupo com sua equipe ou caminhar na névoa da guerra contra ela. Qualquer chance de Orianna usar seu R nesses momentos é catastrófica, então evite estar neles o máximo possível. O objetivo geral de Renekton dentro de mid game é garantir que ele possa procurar escolhas contra Orianna, usando sua selva ou esperando em arbustos para ajudar a assassiná-la. Se Renekton não puder matar Orianna, mas conseguir obter seu R, isso permitirá que você e sua equipe tenham uma posição muito mais fácil para conseguir teamfight. Dentro de teamfights, tente se espalhar contra Orianna e procure encontrar um engage nela, usando seus travessões duplos ou Flash para pousar em cima dela. Quando você estiver lutando contra Orianna, tente fazer com que ela desperdice seu R com você ou tente matá-la antes que ela possa usá-lo.

level1ExplanationEn: Start E for fast level 1 trades with E1 > 3 AAs (PTA) > E2 disengage.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Orianna e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Orianna with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Orianna.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Orianna's disengage crowd control.

videoTitle: Renekton vs Ornn
summaryEn: Ornn is a premier tank with high innate durability and heavy percentage damage from Bellows Breath (W) Brittle procs. At level 1, push with Q for the level 2 advantage while side-stepping his breath to avoid Brittle auto attacks. Use your E mobility to evade his Q pillar and Searing Charge (E) knockup. Renekton's ultimate counter to Ornn's armor stacking is utilizing Empowered E2 (Dice) to shred 35% of Ornn's total armor, pairing with Black Cleaver or Blade of the Ruined King to melt him in side lanes.
summaryPt: Ornn é um dos tanques mais resistentes da rota do topo, capaz de criar itens na rota e aplicar dano percentual com Quebradiço (W). No nível 1, use o Q para empurrar a onda e buscar a vantagem de nível 2, desviando do Fogo Fátuo (W) para não sofrer o auto-ataque com Quebradiço. Em trocas, desvie da ruptura (Q) e do pilar de Ornn com o seu E. O grande diferencial do Renekton no meio do jogo é utilizar o E2 Fortalecido (Cortar) para triturar até 35% da armadura colossal de Ornn, combinado com Cutelo Negro ou Espada do Rei Destruído para derreter a vida massiva dele em duelos na rota lateral.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Ornn with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Ornn and set up a potential level 2 or 3 kill.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Killing Ornn usually requires chunking him out within the first two waves, allowing you to use the 3rd and 4th wave bounce to push the wave on your side of the map to look for a kill angle. Ornn in these situations cannot really do much, so as long as you’re patient and play for this scenario, you will most likely be able to leverage a solo kill or a free gank opportunity. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Waveclear - A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game. 

(4) Respect Ornn Brittle Passive - Ornn’s brittle allows him to apply a debuff onto his target, allowing his next auto attack to do 10% to 18% of the target’s maximum HP in magic damage. Ornn’s brittle targets that are CC’d, take 30% seconds longer to escape any CC. When playing into Ornn, we must always avoid taking his Brittle stack passive, coming from his W or his R. Try to always Ornn’s auto attack or abilities when you have a brittle stack, as he can also proc his brittle from his CC. Once successfully avoiding Ornn’s brittle passive, Ornn will not be able to have the damage or survivability to potentially help him beat Renekton.

(5) Avoid Ornn W - Ornn’s W is another important ability we must avoid, as his W can deal 12 to 16% of his target’s maximum HP as magic damage, allowing him to absolutely shred the HP of any HP stacking champion. An easy way we can avoid Ornn’s W, is if Ornn is walking towards us in melee range, we can use our E to E into him or to the side of his cast, removing his ability to utilise his total damage of his W or avoiding all the damage completely. We can also use our E to force trades then side step to the side, allowing us to walk behind him as he uses W. Abusing these two ways to avoid his W is very crucial for having the upper hand in 1v1’s against him. 

(6) Avoid Ornn Knockups - Ornn has an abundance of knock ups ranging across his kit. His Q is a slight displacement that can allow him to slightly nudge you towards him or away from him. His E allows him to knock up targets as long as they’re next to any terrain, this also includes terrain such as his Q or any other champion made terrain. Ornn’s R also knocks up if you get hit by the 2nd part of his R. Overall, avoiding standing next to walls, towers or his Q is absolutely essential as his ability to use his entire kit when you’re stunned is practically a death sentence. If you’re trying to kill Ornn under a tower wait for him to use E by waking in and out towards him, allowing you to bait his E and force the tower dive.  

(7) Abuse Empowered Q/E - Renekton’s Empowered Q and E are both very important tools when fighting Ornn, as they enable Renekton to overpower and deal with Ornn within most stages of the game. Renekton’s Q allows Renekton to outsustain Ornn within the lane, using it to poke away and easily wave clear against him in the process, creating reset opportunities or the ability to help fix wave states. Renekton’s empowered E allows him to shred through Ornn’s total armour, helping him or his teammates apply more damage to help kill him faster. 

(8) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(10) Respect And Outplay Ornn’s R - Ornn’s R is terrific ability that allows him to mass knock up and apply brittle onto all his targets. Ornn’s R playmaking ability is absolutely insane, allowing him to easily win and turn fights with the press of a button. However, Ornn’s R can be interrupted within his R2 cast, denying him from knocking back his Ram towards his targets. If you or your team are able to cancel his R, this will weaken his overall ability to create playmaking opportunities to carry the fights. Renekton within 1v1’s or teamfights can stun Ornn before he’s able to use R2. Just make sure that you time your W half a second  before it reaches Ornn’s character model, otherwise he will still be able to use it. Try to avoid his R at all costs with your own dash, flash or using your W stun. 

(11) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Ornn’s role within the mid to late game, is utilising his heavy frontline cc playstyle to help protect teammates and initiate fights. Ornn’s scaling is always pretty relevant due to his maximum HP damage, his abundance of CC and his ability to upgrade his teammates items, furthermore increasing his HP, armour and magic resist by 30% when upgrading his whole team's items. Ornn compared to most tanks is one of the more deadlier ones, due to his huge variety of mechanics and aspects within his kit, hence making him a difficult match up later on. As Renekton, it’s very important to always try and keep Ornn within the side lane, as his playstyle to shove and roam with a high value R is always a threatening scenario. Simply try to hard crash waves, then look to try and rotate before Ornn’s able to. Alternatively, you can try to force fights if Ornn is isolated, allowing you to 1v1 him with items such as Black Cleaver and Shojin. If you’re able to remove Ornn’s R at any point within a fight, this is a gigantic moment to abuse as it takes away a lot of Ornn’s power. When it comes to teamfights, typically you want to take them if Ornn has no R or isn’t present within the fights, as this typically allows Renekton to do whatever he wants. If Ornn is within the fight, try to cancel his R at all costs. Make sure to dash onto him with your stun, then time your W to cancel his R2 cast, allowing you to prevent your team being mass CC’d by his team. Cancelling his R is absolutely crucial to avoid disastrous teamfights, as well as preventing his brittle being abused by his teammates CC. If you’re able to deny Ornn from using R, then you can change your overall motives towards shutting down any of his carries, or if your team is focusing on him then you can use your Black Cleaver and Empowered E shred to help cut down his overall armour. Overall, as long as Ornn doesn’t have R or cannot cast his R2, his overall pick will lose a ton of value.

Abusar dessas duas maneiras de evitar seu W é muito crucial para ter vantagem em 1v1 contra ele. 

(6) Evite Knockups de Ornn - Ornn tem uma abundância de Knockups em seu kit. Seu Q é um leve deslocamento que pode permitir que ele empurre você levemente em sua direção ou para longe dele. Seu E permite que ele derrube alvos desde que estejam próximos a qualquer terreno, isso também inclui terrenos como seu Q ou qualquer outro terreno criado por um campeão. O R de Ornn também derruba se você for atingido pela 2ª parte de seu R. No geral, evitar ficar próximo a paredes, torres ou seu Q é absolutamente essencial, pois sua habilidade de usar todo o seu kit quando você está atordoado é praticamente uma sentença de morte. Se você está tentando matar Ornn sob uma torre, espere que ele use E entrando e saindo em sua direção, permitindo que você atraia seu E e force o tower dive.  

(7) Abuso de Empowered Q/E - Empowered Q e E de Renekton são ferramentas muito importantes ao lutar contra Ornn, pois permitem que Renekton domine e lide com Ornn na maioria dos estágios do jogo. O Q de Renekton permite que Renekton supere Ornn dentro da rota, usando-o para poke se afastar e facilmente wave se livrar dele no processo, criando oportunidades de reset ou a capacidade de ajudar a corrigir estados de wave. O Empowered E de Renekton permite que ele destrua a armadura total de Ornn, ajudando ele ou seus companheiros de equipe a aplicar mais dano para ajudar a matá-lo mais rápido. 

(8) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(9) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(10) Respeite e superação R de Ornn - R de Ornn é uma habilidade incrível que lhe permite derrubar em massa e aplicar frágil em todos os seus alvos. A habilidade de criação de jogo R de Ornn é absolutamente insana, permitindo que ele vença e vire lutas facilmente com o apertar de um botão. No entanto, o R de Ornn pode ser interrompido dentro de seu lançamento de R2, impedindo-o de empurrar seu Ram em direção aos seus alvos. Se você ou sua equipe conseguirem cancelar seu R, isso enfraquecerá sua capacidade geral de criar oportunidades de jogo para conduzir as lutas. Renekton dentro de 1v1 ou teamfights pode atordoar Ornn antes que ele possa usar R2. Apenas certifique-se de cronometrar seu W meio segundo antes que ele alcance o modelo de personagem de Ornn, caso contrário ele ainda poderá usá-lo. tente evitar o R ​​dele a todo custo com seu próprio avanço, Flash ou usando seu atordoamento W.

Quando se trata de teamfights, normalmente você deseja pegá-los se Ornn não tiver R ou não estiver presente nas lutas, pois isso normalmente permite que Renekton faça o que quiser. Isso pode ajudá-lo a obter redefinições de tempo perfeitas ou permitir que ele proxy waves ajude a aumentar sua vantagem de ouro, ao mesmo tempo que refém o top laner inimigo sob sua própria torre. Ser capaz de limpar rapidamente também força o inimigo a contestar o ataque, permitindo que você queime mana facilmente e crie posições vantajosas a partir dele. Abuse dessa força para evitar situações ruins de rota ou aumentar seu poder geral no jogo.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Ornn Brittle Passive
tips.contentEn: Ornn’s brittle allows him to apply a debuff onto his target, allowing his next auto attack to do 10% to 18% of the target’s maximum HP in magic damage. Ornn’s brittle targets that are CC’d, take 30% seconds longer to escape any CC. When playing into Ornn, we must always avoid taking his Brittle stack passive, coming from his W or his R. Try to always Ornn’s auto attack or abilities when you have a brittle stack, as he can also proc his brittle from his CC. Once successfully avoiding Ornn’s brittle passive, Ornn will not be able to have the damage or survivability to potentially help him beat Renekton.
tips.contentPt: A fragilidade de Ornn permite que ele aplique um debuff em seu alvo, permitindo que seu próximo auto attack cause 10% a 18% do HP máximo do alvo em dano mágico. Os alvos frágeis de Ornn que são CC’d levam 30% segundos a mais para escapar de qualquer CC. Ao jogar em Ornn, devemos sempre evitar pegar seu stack Brittle passivo, vindo de seu W ou seu R. Tente sempre auto attack ou habilidades de Ornn quando você tiver um stack frágil, pois ele também pode processar seu brittle a partir de seu CC. Depois de evitar com sucesso a passiva frágil de Ornn, Ornn não será capaz de ter o dano ou a capacidade de sobrevivência para potencialmente ajudá-lo a vencer Renekton.

tips.titlePt: Evite Ornn W
tips.contentEn: Ornn’s W is another important ability we must avoid, as his W can deal 12 to 16% of his target’s maximum HP as magic damage, allowing him to absolutely shred the HP of any HP stacking champion. An easy way we can avoid Ornn’s W, is if Ornn is walking towards us in melee range, we can use our E to E into him or to the side of his cast, removing his ability to utilise his total damage of his W or avoiding all the damage completely. We can also use our E to force trades then side step to the side, allowing us to walk behind him as he uses W. Abusing these two ways to avoid his W is very crucial for having the upper hand in 1v1’s against him.
tips.contentPt: O W de Ornn é outra habilidade importante que devemos evitar, já que seu W pode causar 12 a 16% do HP máximo de seu alvo como dano mágico, permitindo que ele destrua totalmente o HP de qualquer campeão de acúmulo de HP. Uma maneira fácil de evitar o W de Ornn é se Ornn estiver caminhando em nossa direção em alcance corpo a corpo, podemos usar nosso E a E nele ou ao lado de seu elenco, removendo sua capacidade de utilizar o dano total de seu W ou evitando todo o dano completamente. Também podemos usar nosso E para forçar trocas e depois dar um passo lateral para o lado, permitindo-nos andar atrás dele enquanto ele usa W. Abusar dessas duas maneiras de evitar seu W é muito crucial para ter vantagem em 1v1 contra ele.

tips.titlePt: Evite batidas Ornn
tips.contentEn: Ornn has an abundance of knock ups ranging across his kit. His Q is a slight displacement that can allow him to slightly nudge you towards him or away from him. His E allows him to knock up targets as long as they’re next to any terrain, this also includes terrain such as his Q or any other champion made terrain. Ornn’s R also knocks up if you get hit by the 2nd part of his R. Overall, avoiding standing next to walls, towers or his Q is absolutely essential as his ability to use his entire kit when you’re stunned is practically a death sentence. If you’re trying to kill Ornn under a tower wait for him to use E by waking in and out towards him, allowing you to bait his E and force the tower dive.
tips.contentPt: Ornn tem uma abundância de batidas em seu kit. Seu Q é um leve deslocamento que pode permitir que ele empurre você levemente em sua direção ou para longe dele. Seu E permite que ele derrube alvos desde que estejam próximos a qualquer terreno, isso também inclui terrenos como seu Q ou qualquer outro terreno criado por um campeão. O R de Ornn também derruba se você for atingido pela 2ª parte de seu R. No geral, evitar ficar próximo a paredes, torres ou seu Q é absolutamente essencial, pois sua habilidade de usar todo o seu kit quando você está atordoado é praticamente uma sentença de morte. Se você está tentando matar Ornn sob uma torre, espere que ele use E entrando e saindo em sua direção, permitindo que você atraia seu E e force o tower dive.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Q/E Fortalecido
tips.contentEn: Renekton’s Empowered Q and E are both very important tools when fighting Ornn, as they enable Renekton to overpower and deal with Ornn within most stages of the game. Renekton’s Q allows Renekton to outsustain Ornn within the lane, using it to poke away and easily wave clear against him in the process, creating reset opportunities or the ability to help fix wave states. Renekton’s empowered E allows him to shred through Ornn’s total armour, helping him or his teammates apply more damage to help kill him faster.
tips.contentPt: Os Empowered Q e E de Renekton são ferramentas muito importantes ao lutar contra Ornn, pois permitem que Renekton domine e lide com Ornn na maioria dos estágios do jogo. O Q de Renekton permite que Renekton supere Ornn dentro da rota, usando-o para poke se afastar e facilmente wave se livrar dele no processo, criando oportunidades de reset ou a capacidade de ajudar a corrigir estados de wave. O Empowered E de Renekton permite que ele destrua a armadura total de Ornn, ajudando ele ou seus companheiros de equipe a aplicar mais dano para ajudar a matá-lo mais rápido.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: Respeite And Outplay Ornn’s R
tips.contentEn: Ornn’s R is terrific ability that allows him to mass knock up and apply brittle onto all his targets. Ornn’s R playmaking ability is absolutely insane, allowing him to easily win and turn fights with the press of a button. However, Ornn’s R can be interrupted within his R2 cast, denying him from knocking back his Ram towards his targets. If you or your team are able to cancel his R, this will weaken his overall ability to create playmaking opportunities to carry the fights. Renekton within 1v1’s or teamfights can stun Ornn before he’s able to use R2. Just make sure that you time your W half a second  before it reaches Ornn’s character model, otherwise he will still be able to use it. Try to avoid his R at all costs with your own dash, flash or using your W stun.
tips.contentPt: O R de Ornn é uma habilidade incrível que lhe permite derrubar em massa e aplicar fragilidade em todos os seus alvos. A habilidade de criação de jogo R de Ornn é absolutamente insana, permitindo que ele vença e vire lutas facilmente com o apertar de um botão. No entanto, o R de Ornn pode ser interrompido dentro de seu lançamento de R2, impedindo-o de empurrar seu Aríete em direção aos seus alvos. Se você ou sua equipe conseguirem cancelar seu R, isso enfraquecerá sua capacidade geral de criar oportunidades de jogo para conduzir as lutas. Renekton dentro de 1v1 ou teamfights pode atordoar Ornn antes que ele possa usar R2. Apenas certifique-se de cronometrar seu W meio segundo antes que ele alcance o modelo de personagem de Ornn, caso contrário ele ainda poderá usá-lo. tente evitar o R ​​dele a todo custo com seu próprio avanço, Flash ou usando seu atordoamento W.

tips.titleEn: Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Ornn’s role within the mid to late game, is utilising his heavy frontline cc playstyle to help protect teammates and initiate fights. Ornn’s scaling is always pretty relevant due to his maximum HP damage, his abundance of CC and his ability to upgrade his teammates items, furthermore increasing his HP, armour and magic resist by 30% when upgrading his whole team's items. Ornn compared to most tanks is one of the more deadlier ones, due to his huge variety of mechanics and aspects within his kit, hence making him a difficult match up later on. As Renekton, it’s very important to always try and keep Ornn within the side lane, as his playstyle to shove and roam with a high value R is always a threatening scenario. Simply try to hard crash waves, then look to try and rotate before Ornn’s able to. Alternatively, you can try to force fights if Ornn is isolated, allowing you to 1v1 him with items such as Black Cleaver and Shojin. If you’re able to remove Ornn’s R at any point within a fight, this is a gigantic moment to abuse as it takes away a lot of Ornn’s power. When it comes to teamfights, typically you want to take them if Ornn has no R or isn’t present within the fights, as this typically allows Renekton to do whatever he wants. If Ornn is within the fight, try to cancel his R at all costs. Make sure to dash onto him with your stun, then time your W to cancel his R2 cast, allowing you to prevent your team being mass CC’d by his team. Cancelling his R is absolutely crucial to avoid disastrous teamfights, as well as preventing his brittle being abused by his teammates CC. If you’re able to deny Ornn from using R, then you can change your overall motives towards shutting down any of his carries, or if your team is focusing on him then you can use your Black Cleaver and Empowered E shred to help cut down his overall armour. Overall, as long as Ornn doesn’t have R or cannot cast his R2, his overall pick will lose a ton of value.
tips.contentPt: A função de Ornn no meio até late game é utilizar seu estilo de jogo de linha de frente pesado CC para ajudar a proteger companheiros de equipe e iniciar lutas. O escalonamento de Ornn é sempre bastante relevante devido ao seu dano máximo de HP, sua abundância de CC e sua capacidade de atualizar os itens de seus companheiros de equipe, além de aumentar seu HP, armadura e resistência mágica em 30% ao atualizar os itens de toda a sua equipe. Ornn comparado à maioria dos tanques é um dos mais mortíferos, devido à sua enorme variedade de mecânicas e aspectos dentro de seu kit, tornando-o um confronto difícil mais tarde. Como Renekton, é muito importante sempre tentar manter Ornn na rota lateral, já que seu estilo de jogo é shove e roam com um R de alto valor é sempre um cenário ameaçador. Simplesmente tente com força crash waves e, em seguida, tente girar antes que Ornn consiga. Alternativamente, você pode tentar lutas forçadas se Ornn estiver isolado, permitindo que você 1v1 ele com itens como Black Cleaver e Shojin. Se você conseguir remover o R ​​de Ornn em qualquer ponto de uma luta, este é um momento gigantesco para abusar, pois tira muito poder de Ornn. Quando se trata de teamfights, normalmente você deseja pegá-los se Ornn não tiver R ou não estiver presente nas lutas, pois isso normalmente permite que Renekton faça o que quiser. Se Ornn estiver na luta, tente cancelar seu R a todo custo. Certifique-se de atacar ele com seu atordoamento e, em seguida, cronometre seu W para cancelar seu lançamento de R2, permitindo que você evite que sua equipe seja atacada em massa por sua equipe. Cancelar seu R é absolutamente crucial para evitar o desastroso teamfights, bem como evitar que seu frágil seja abusado por seus companheiros de equipe CC. Se você for capaz de negar que Ornn use R, então você pode mudar seus motivos gerais para desligar qualquer um de seus carregadores, ou se sua equipe estiver se concentrando nele, você pode usar seu fragmento Black Cleaver e Empowered E para ajudar Cut Down em sua armadura geral. No geral, contanto que Ornn não tenha R ou não possa lançar seu R2, sua escolha geral perderá muito valor.

level1ExplanationEn: Start Q to poke opponent and shove wave for level 2 power spike.
winConditionPt: Controle a wave para criar freezes e force trocas curtas com E > W > Q > E; no mid-game use o E2 Fortalecido para triturar até 35% da armadura de Ornn.

cautionEn: Avoid prolonged trades where Ornn scales damage with Grasp or heavy armor items (Frozen Heart / Thornmail).

tips.titlePt: Cuidado com o W (Fôlego do Fole) Imparável
tips.contentEn: Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) grants him Unstoppable status. If Renekton uses W (Ruthless Predator) to stun Ornn while he is casting W, it can be nullified. It is better to apply the stun after Ornn's W ends.
tips.contentPt: O W de Ornn torna-o imune a controle de grupo durante o sopro. Não use o W de Renekton no meio da animação dele; espere o sopro terminar.

tips.titlePt: Evite Trocas Longas Contra Efeitos Frágil
tips.contentEn: Ornn is strong in burst trades and can ignore Renekton's CC with his W ability. Since Renekton's strength in short trades is ineffective, you should avoid prolonged fights and hit-and-run tactics.
tips.contentPt: Evite ser atingido pela aplicação de Frágil. Entre, execute o combo rápido de W + Q e saia com o segundo E para evitar ser atordoado no pilar.

abilityMaxOrder: Q > E > W or Q3 > W > E
videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Pantheon - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.16
summaryEn: Pantheon possesses relentless early aggression through low-cooldown Comet Spears (Q) and an explosive level 2-3 empowered stun combo. Respect his early spear range during level 1 and conserve your health pool. The pivotal mechanic is playing around Aegis Assault (E): never discharge your Empowered W or Q directly into his frontal invulnerability shield. Either dash behind him with E or wait out the shield before unloading your full burst. Post-6 with Dominus (R) and Plated Steelcaps, Renekton heavily outscales and stat-checks Pantheon in duels.
summaryPt: Pantheon é um oponente extremamente agressivo no início, graças ao baixo tempo de recarga da Lança Meteórica (Q) e ao all-in de nível 2-3. No nível 1, respeite o alcance do Q dele e evite trocas desfavoráveis. O segredo para vencer o confronto é gerenciar a Égide Impenetrável (E) de Pantheon: nunca solte seu W Fortalecido ou Q na frente do escudo invulnerável dele. Aguarde o término do E de Pantheon ou use o dash do E do Renekton para passar para trás dele e desferir o combo completo. Após o nível 6 com o Dominus (R) e Botas Galvanizadas, Renekton supera amplamente Pantheon em estatísticas de combate direto.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Pantheon’s early game is practically a nightmare for Renekton early, as his low Q CD and overall damage completely supersedes Renekton’s early aggression. Pantheon’s ability to stack towards an empowered ability also makes it a lot harder to contest, mainly due to Renekton’s hard to stack passive into low CD and high damage champions such as Pantheon himself. Within the early game, playing with D Shield and Second Wind will allow you to outsustain his early damage, giving you the sustain needed to survive until your first back. If you’re able to keep your health up by playing out of range, while side stepping or avoiding any of his empowered attacks, this will present you the ability to look for fights back against Pantheon. 

(2) Avoid Pantheon Q - Pantheon’s Q allows him to poke in a line against his targets, allowing him to safely apply damage outside of Renekton’s Q range. Pantheon’s Q when lightly tapped is around 6 seconds early, allowing him to spam it and synergise around his other abilities to help reach his empowered Q faster. When playing vs Pantheon, we must always try to avoid his Q, as this can allow us to look for our trades as soon as he wastes his empowered Q. To dodge his Q, simply use short in and out clicks of his range, allowing you to potentially bait his Q and avoid his damage in the process. We can also use side to side clicks to help us easily evade his Q, giving us another angle to avoid his damage. 

(3) Avoid Pantheon Stun Combo - Pantheon’s W allows him to stun his target for 1 second by jumping on to them, allowing him to generate a stack of his passive. When empowered, Pantheon’s W allows him to deal 3 additional hits after his stun, applying any on hit effects such as PTA, Conqueror or item passives. Pantheon W engage will most often be his way to deal high damage trades, as he’s quickly able to apply his damage and force out extended trades. As Renekton, we should make sure to play around his W by preventing ourselves from walking into his range, denying Pantheon’s ability to chunk us out. If Pantheon uses his empowered stack, Renekton can look to trade right after and force him to use regular W and lose out on additional damage. Pantheon will most likely use W when Renekton dashes in, so make sure to use your E2 to further gap close on him if you’re stronger, or simply use E2 to dash back after baiting his stun. Post level 6, Renekton will be able to use Pantheon’s W engages as his own detriment, allowing him to easily stay in range and force Pantheon’s own E out. 

(4) Respect And Outplay Pantheon E - Pantheon’s E allows him to block all incoming damage from the opposite angle of him, allowing him to hard peel against any heavy damage attacks such as Renekton’s W. When his E is empowered, Pantheon gains additional HP, armour and magic resist, while also gaining 60% movement speed after using it. Pantheon’s E is a core ability to play around, as one bad E will put his ability on a 22 second CD, providing you the ability to look for fights after it's on CD. Most of the time, if Renekton engages onto Pantheon, Pantheon will stun you then use his E if you’re trying to E2 towards him, or if you’re walking up with W activated. Most of the time, you hard punish Pantheon’s own E after he jumps on you, as he will do is regular W > AAx3 > Q > AA > E - This trading pattern provides him a regular damage combo, however Renekton can use his E in close range, to help E behind him, allowing him to unload on the rest of his damage. We usually exploit this around the level 6 mark, as our ability to use our R will entirely help us stat check and beat Pantheon throughout the rest of the game. 

(5) Rush Plated Steel Caps - Plated Steelcaps are a giant buy into Pantheon, as it allows you to negate his auto attack and empowered W hit damage with Plated’s 10% reduction passive, as well as providing you additional armour and movement speed to help play around Pantheon’s damage. This is by far the safest approach you can take into the Pantheon lane, as this match up is basically playable from level 6 in combination with our R powerspike. 

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. When playing vs Pantheon, make sure to wait for his abilities to be on CD before doing these, or use short combos like E Q E to help force Pantheon’s abilities out and waste his  mana. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Ping Pantheon’s R - Pantheon’s R is pretty great for creating skirmishing and flanking opportunities, allowing him to easily engage on his target of choice to help secure kills or one shot in the process. Pantheon R is a giant ultimate, which can entirely dictate certain scenarios within the game. If Pantheon is missing, try to always respect the ability for him to R. If you’re shoving up a wave, try to hold your E to help you disengage away from Pantheon’s R. If Pantheon is missing without a trace, make sure to always spam ping your overextended or low HP teammates of his potential R, allowing them to have time to walk away and avoid being caught out. If Pantheon uses his ult anywhere else on the map, try to abuse that by crashing your wave to take plates, while also denying his ability to receive gold and XP. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or Death's Dance - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go Death’s Dance to help take away his 1v1 power, allowing you to stat check and survive against his damage in an extended fight. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Pantheon’s overall power falls off within the later stages of the game, however his ability to create flanking angles or catch out targets is a giant strong point towards his role within the game. Trying to always take smart fights is pretty essential against Pantheon, so any deep skirmishes where your team is unable to follow you, or your own teammates will be severely punished if Pantheon manages to join the fight. Try to always take fights the correct fights, by playing around team members when a major fight or objective breaks out, or avoid being over extended on the enemies side of the map if there is no vision. As long as you can deny Pantheon getting any kills, while playing smart enough where he cannot use his kit, Pantheon will not really have an answer for this style of gameplay. Within the side lane, Renekton’s power surpasses Pantheon’s kit if he’s able to stay even or get ahead, allowing him to easily make work out of Pantheon within the mid to late game. Renekton’s overall teamfighting role also works a lot better into Pantheon, as Renekton can fulfill many different roles within a teamfight that Pantheon simply cannot do. For instance, bruiser Renekton can protect carries, be a frontliner or a back line diver, while Pantheon is suited towards being a diver style champion. Within teamfights, try to immediately protect any of your win conditions from Pantheon’s engage, using your stun to help lock him down, as well as using your R or empowered E to shred any of his armour to help him become easily one shottable. If pantheon is omega weak, you can simply just force fight his backline and kill any of his high profile targets.

A capacidade de Pantheon de acumular em direção a uma habilidade fortalecida também torna muito mais difícil contestá-lo, principalmente devido à dificuldade de acumular passivo de Renekton em campeões de baixo CD e de alto dano, como o próprio Pantheon. tips.titlePt: Jogue por Sustain no Early Game
tips.contentEn: Pantheon’s early game is practically a nightmare for Renekton early, as his low Q CD and overall damage completely supersedes Renekton’s early aggression. Pantheon’s ability to stack towards an empowered ability also makes it a lot harder to contest, mainly due to Renekton’s hard to stack passive into low CD and high damage champions such as Pantheon himself. Within the early game, playing with D Shield and Second Wind will allow you to outsustain his early damage, giving you the sustain needed to survive until your first back. If you’re able to keep your health up by playing out of range, while side stepping or avoiding any of his empowered attacks, this will present you the ability to look for fights back against Pantheon.
tips.contentPt: O early game de Pantheon é praticamente um pesadelo para Renekton no início, já que seu baixo Q CD e dano geral substituem completamente a agressão inicial de Renekton. A capacidade de Pantheon de acumular em direção a uma habilidade fortalecida também torna muito mais difícil contestá-lo, principalmente devido à dificuldade de acumular passivo de Renekton em campeões de baixo CD e de alto dano, como o próprio Pantheon. Dentro do early game, jogar com D Shield e Second Wind permitirá que você sustente o dano inicial, dando-lhe a sustentação necessária para sobreviver até sua primeira volta. Se você conseguir manter sua saúde jogando fora do alcance, evitando qualquer um de seus ataques fortalecidos, isso lhe dará a capacidade de procurar lutas contra Pantheon.

tips.titlePt: Evite Pantheon Q
tips.contentEn: Pantheon’s Q allows him to poke in a line against his targets, allowing him to safely apply damage outside of Renekton’s Q range. Pantheon’s Q when lightly tapped is around 6 seconds early, allowing him to spam it and synergise around his other abilities to help reach his empowered Q faster. When playing vs Pantheon, we must always try to avoid his Q, as this can allow us to look for our trades as soon as he wastes his empowered Q. To dodge his Q, simply use short in and out clicks of his range, allowing you to potentially bait his Q and avoid his damage in the process. We can also use side to side clicks to help us easily evade his Q, giving us another angle to avoid his damage.
tips.contentPt: O Q de Pantheon permite que ele poke em linha reta contra seus alvos, permitindo que ele aplique dano com segurança fora do alcance do Q de Renekton. O Q de Pantheon, quando tocado levemente, chega cerca de 6 segundos mais cedo, permitindo que ele envie spam e sinergize com suas outras habilidades para ajudar a alcançar seu Empowered Q mais rápido. Ao jogar contra Pantheon, devemos sempre tentar evitar seu Q, pois isso pode nos permitir buscar nossas trocas assim que ele desperdiçar seu Empowered Q. Para se esquivar de seu Q, basta usar cliques curtos dentro e fora de seu alcance, permitindo que você potencialmente atraia seu Q e evite seu dano no processo. Também podemos usar cliques laterais para nos ajudar a escapar facilmente de seu Q, dando-nos outro ângulo para evitar seu dano.

tips.titlePt: Evite Pantheon Combo de Atordoamento
tips.contentEn: Pantheon’s W allows him to stun his target for 1 second by jumping on to them, allowing him to generate a stack of his passive. When empowered, Pantheon’s W allows him to deal 3 additional hits after his stun, applying any on hit effects such as PTA, Conqueror or item passives. Pantheon W engage will most often be his way to deal high damage trades, as he’s quickly able to apply his damage and force out extended trades. As Renekton, we should make sure to play around his W by preventing ourselves from walking into his range, denying Pantheon’s ability to chunk us out. If Pantheon uses his empowered stack, Renekton can look to trade right after and force him to use regular W and lose out on additional damage. Pantheon will most likely use W when Renekton dashes in, so make sure to use your E2 to further gap close on him if you’re stronger, or simply use E2 to dash back after baiting his stun. Post level 6, Renekton will be able to use Pantheon’s W engages as his own detriment, allowing him to easily stay in range and force Pantheon’s own E out.
tips.contentPt: O W de Pantheon permite que ele atordoe seu alvo por 1 segundo saltando sobre ele, permitindo que ele gere uma pilha de sua passiva. For instance, bruiser Renekton can protect carries, be a frontliner or a back line diver, while Pantheon is suited towards being a diver style champion. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - When laning vs Poppy, Q start is most preferred as it allows you to push for level 2 against her, while allowing you to whittle down her HP in the process. Renekton should try to avoid Poppy’s Q level 1, with the intention of tagging Poppy and the minion wave with Q. Once you reach level 2, Renekton can skill E to let him force a heavy trade, allowing him to set up a level 2 or 3 kill. 

(2) Respect Poppy's Passive - Poppy’s passive allows her to chunk out her opponents HP with her magic damage and grasp auto attack, while providing a shield on the ground in the process. Once obtaining the shield through minion kills with her passive or picking it up from the ground, Poppy can tank up to 11% to 20% of her maximum HP as a shield. As Renekton, we can utilise our empowered W to completely break the shield, which usually is possible if she decides to walk up into our range with her shield. If Poppy uses her passive attack to apply damage onto us, we can actively move towards the shield to help deny her from getting her shield, losing her ability to safely trade against us. 

(3) Avoid Poppy Q's Damage - Poppy’s Q damage allows her to do 2 part damage, totalling up to 200% bonus AD and 18% of the target's maximum HP as damage. Poppy’s Q is a serious ability to avoid at all times, which is certainly possible if we utilise short clicks to click in and out between her. Doing this will allow you to bait out her Q, thinking you’re walking into her range, but instead you will click back out forcing Poppy to miss her Q and waste her mana in the process. This is a core technique to abuse vs Poppy, as you can abuse it going towards the minion wave or simply walking into her. The more you do this, Poppy will lose out on mana, on top of the fact she won’t have the damage to be able to fight Renektin. 

(4) Avoid Poppy E Stun - Poppy’s E stun can also be very annoying, as it sets up her entire kit to lock her targets down, as well having the ability to deny any of Renekton’s dashes in the process. When playing against Poppy, you never want to position near any mountain terrain or structures, as this will provide her the free ability to get her stun off. As long as you play in the middle and actively play on the opposite side of Poppy to the wall, Poppy will never be able to get a stun off, making it very frustrating and impossible for her to do anything.

(5) Hold Renekton E For Poppy W - This is arguably the reason why people think Poppy is a hard counter match up, however just like all her other abilities, this is simply just another mind game ability that requires you to hold your E before her W. Poppy will simply always W if Renekton telegraphs his dash towards her, making dash trades very risky. Instead, we can actually do either of the following to make things a lot easier. Renekton dashes require more creativity, which we can simply do by looking away from Poppy, then surprising Poppy with an E1 when she walks towards his range, which most often forces Poppy to W after the dash, allowing us to hold E2 until it goes on CD. Another thing we can do is simply walk towards Poppy, with the intention of using our other match up fundamental tips to help us bait her W. Poppy will typically W if she thinks she is under threat, so make sure that when you avoid her Q and E usages, you utilise your Conqueror autos, Q and W, to help you stat check and force her to W.

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Respect Poppy R - Poppy’s R can be a great tool to lock her targets down harder with the additional CC, or it can be used to knock her enemies completely away from fights. When playing vs Poppy, poppy will typically use her R aggressively if Renekton is low and within a killable range. However, if Poppy is low and Renekton is pushing for a kill, Poppy will charge her R to knock away Renekton from killing her. As Renekton, we can try to reposition away from her R using our flash to avoid being knocked out of range, or we can trust our movement to avoid Poppy R if we’re at a safe distance to do so. Overall try to respect her R and prevent her using it properly within these situations. Another thing to note, is that Renekton W can break Poppy’s R wind up animation to put it back on CD.

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) 3 Points Q > W Max - This can depend on how well you do in the lane, but if you’re snowballing vs Poppy then make sure to max W after 3 points Q to help you dominate and provide more damage against her in 1v1’s. W max is pretty good here as you’re able to consistently apply damage onto Poppy without relying on using your E, which if Poppy is being stubborn can backfire on you if you’re relying on your W’s long CD. 

(10) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Poppy’s objective within the mid game is to play around her team, using her disruption and engage heavy kit to help her succeed within these stages of the game. As Renekton, our role is to use our side pressure to our advantage, meaning if we get the chance to 1v1 Poppy, we certainly can do that. Mainly, you want to make sure you’re crashing waves with the intent of roaming towards your team to make picks, preoccupying Poppy in the process to take away her skirmishing power. If Poppy can’t be there to defend her carries in these crucial moments, Poppy will not really be able to do anything else useful. Within teamfights, Poppy will mainly start the fight first with her E, usually using most of her abilities in the process. Typically we want to avoid taking fights in terrain based areas, in which fighting in the wide open will prevent Poppy from having success with her kit. Poppy’s priority is mainly trying to dogpile on your team's win conditions, so make sure to abuse this by focusing her backline to take away her overall damage potential with her team. If Poppy doesn’t protect her team in these moments, she will simply grief and have no one to help follow her.

Quando você alcançar level 2, Renekton pode usar a habilidade E para deixá-lo forçar uma troca pesada, permitindo que ele configure um level 2 ou 3 mortes.
