videoTitle: Senna Top vs Renekton - EUW Master Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Senna boasts immense attack range and soul scaling, but possesses one of the lowest base HP pools in League of Legends. Start E at level 1 to jump on her directly (E1 > PTA autos > E2 back). Sidestep her Last Embrace (W) root with your dash, and at level 3+, commit Flash + Empowered W to delete her in a single burst window. Rush Plated Steelcaps and Lethality/Eclipse to crush her in lane.
summaryPt: Senna possui alcance longo e coleta de almas com a passiva, mas é uma das campeãs mais frágeis de todo o jogo. No nível 1, inicie com E para realizar a estratégia de gap-close imediato (E1 nos minions > auto-ataques com PTA > recuo com E2). Desvie do Abraço da Escuridão (W) de Senna com a agilidade dos seus dashes e, no nível 3+, use o Flash + W Fortalecido para deletá-la instantaneamente. Compre Botas Galvanizadas e itens de Letalidade/Eclipse para eliminá-la em uma única rotação.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Senna you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Senna lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Abuse Senna’s Passive Scaling - When playing Senna you essentially utilise your passive souls to help you scale. providing a crazy infinite scaling playstyle that can be very difficult to beat much later in the game. The problem for Senna however, is that her passive souls work a lot more differently than they do as a support, as she earns much less stacks farming due to riot’s balancing. With that said, Renekton can easily abuse Senna within the lane due to her squishy stats and slower scaling presence, making it a very free match up in the process. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.  

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent. 

(7) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Senna’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(8) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Senna’s real objective as a pick is to essentially scale through the game using her passive souls to provide additional stats, in the advantage of infinitely scaling her range and overall stat power. When Senna is played in solo lane her chances of scaling are severely less, due to the reason she gains less passive stacks from farming. With that said, Senna is practically an easy target to abuse most stages, allowing you to do whatever you want. When it comes to teamfights, Senna will try to abuse her ranged auto attacks and Q to help poke her enemies down, while also having R to secure any low HP kills or shield her teammates. As Renekton we can easily nuke Senna if we focus onto her with our damage, however it should be said that nuking her other carries in the game are way more important due to how much more relevancy they will have over Senna.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Play For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Play For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Senna, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Senna perca muito mais. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Abuse do escalonamento passivo de Senna - Ao jogar Senna você essencialmente utiliza suas almas passivas para ajudá-lo a escalar. proporcionando um estilo de jogo louco e de escala infinita que pode ser muito difícil de vencer muito mais tarde no jogo. O problema para Senna, entretanto, é que suas almas passivas funcionam de maneira muito mais diferente do que como suporte, já que ela ganha muito menos stacks farmando devido ao balanceamento de Riot. Dito isso, Renekton pode facilmente abusar de Senna dentro da rota devido às suas stats fracas e presença de escalonamento mais lento, tornando-o um confronto muito livre no processo. 

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.  

(6) Trocas pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente. 

(7) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Senna e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(8) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O verdadeiro objetivo de Senna como escolha é essencialmente escalar ao longo do jogo usando suas almas passivas para fornecer stats adicionais, com a vantagem de escalar infinitamente seu alcance e poder de stats geral. Quando Senna é jogado na rota solo, suas chances de escalar são muito menores, devido ao motivo pelo qual ela ganha menos acúmulos passivos com o cultivo. Dito isso, Senna é praticamente um alvo fácil para abusar da maioria dos estágios, permitindo que você faça o que quiser. Quando se trata de teamfights, Senna tentará abusar de seu auto attacks e Q de longo alcance para ajudar poke a derrubar seus inimigos, ao mesmo tempo que terá R para garantir qualquer morte com HP baixo ou proteger seus companheiros de equipe. Como Renekton podemos facilmente destruir Senna se nos concentrarmos nela com nosso dano, no entanto, deve-se dizer que destruir seus outros carregamentos no jogo é muito mais importante devido à relevância que eles terão sobre Senna.

videoTitle: SERAPHINE GOT SHANEL FROM RENEKTON???
summaryEn: Seraphine attempts to waveclear from extreme range using passive notes and Beat Drop (E). Start E at level 1 to exploit her sluggish base movement speed with immediate PTA trades. At level 3+, gap close through the wave with E, use Empowered W to immediately destroy her Surround Sound (W) shield, and burst her with Q + Ignite. Renekton easily dominates this lane and snowballs with ease.
summaryPt: Seraphine tenta limpar a onda de longe com notas musicais e o E (Surto de Som). No nível 1, comece com E para aplicar trocas rápidas com PTA e punir o baixo movimento base dela. Ao atingir o nível 3, feche a distância com E nos minions, use o W Fortalecido para quebrar instantaneamente o escudo do Som Envolvente (W) dela e descarregue o combo com Q + Ignite. O confronto é extremamente favorável para Renekton, que pode transformar a rota em um snowball imparável.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Seraphine you're most likely able to kill her with Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Seraphine lose a lot more. 

(3) Avoid Seraphine Poke - Seraphine’s early ability spam can hurt quite a lot, while allowing her to have a decent amount of waveclear and safety options in the lane vs Renekton. Despite this Renekton still can easily kill Seraphine if he’s keeping his HP up, while taking the correct fights. Use D Shield and Second Wind to easily bypass her poke early, try to also use your early sustain advantage and quick combos to help burn through her HP and mana, allowing you to set up kills or force her to recall. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent. 

(7) Avoid Seraphine R - Seraphine’s R is essentially a much better version of Sona’s R, which if used correctly can be a massive tool in being able to win fights for Seraphine’s team. When playing against Seraphine, you only need to really worry about her R if you’re grouped up with your team or her team is moving towards her. In 1v1’s Seraphine R isn’t enough to stop Renekton from killing her, but if you are worried about the enemies CC threat you can simply buy Mercury Treads to counter her.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Seraphine’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Seraphine’s overall role within the game is to play around her main carries and act as a neutraliser against engage champions, using her R and W utility to help her team win the fights. Typically against Seraphine we want to avoid clumping up against her R, otherwise it will easily present her team a free win within the fights. Avoid fighting in tight spaces too, as Seraphine R will easily hit the narrow pathways of choke points. As Renekton try to utilise your shield break W against her shielded carries and look to play for one shot engages with flash, allowing you to avoid her stun passive and giving you a free entry point. After killing the main carries in a teamfight, you can then try to nuke Seraphine, which is relatively easy once you eliminate her main carries from the fight. When trying to push against Seraphine it can be difficult with how strong her wave clear can be, with that said try to get Baron and look to end the game with the buff to prevent her and her team one shotting the waves.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Seraphine, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Seraphine perca muito mais. 

(3) Evite Seraphine poke - O spam de habilidade inicial de Seraphine pode prejudicar bastante, ao mesmo tempo que permite que ela tenha uma quantidade razoável de waveclear e opções de segurança na pista contra Renekton. Apesar disso, Renekton ainda pode facilmente matar Seraphine se ele mantiver seu HP alto, enquanto enfrenta as lutas corretas. Use D Shield e Second Wind para contornar facilmente seu poke mais cedo, tente também usar sua vantagem de sustentação inicial e combos rápidos para ajudar a queimar seu HP e mana, permitindo que você configure mortes ou forçá-la a se lembrar. 

(4) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Trocas Pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a finalizar seu oponente. 

(7) Evite Seraphine R - O R de Seraphine é essencialmente uma versão muito melhor do R de Sona, que se usado corretamente pode ser uma ferramenta enorme para poder vencer lutas para a equipe de Seraphine. Ao jogar contra Seraphine, você só precisa realmente se preocupar com o R dela se estiver agrupado com seu time ou se o time dela estiver se movendo em direção a ela. Em Seraphine R de 1v1 não é suficiente para impedir Renekton de matá-la, mas se você está preocupado com a ameaça CC do inimigo, você pode simplesmente comprar Mercury Treads para combatê-la.

(8) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Seraphine e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano. 

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O papel geral de Seraphine no jogo é brincar com seus carregadores principais e agir como um neutralizador contra campeões engage, usando sua utilidade R e W para ajudar seu time a vencer as lutas. Normalmente, contra Seraphine, queremos evitar colidir com seu R, caso contrário, isso facilmente dará ao seu time uma vitória grátis nas lutas. Evite lutar em espaços apertados também, pois Seraphine R atingirá facilmente os caminhos estreitos dos pontos de estrangulamento. Como Renekton tente usar seu escudo para quebrar W contra seus carregadores protegidos e obter jogo para one-shot, você se envolve com Flash, permitindo que você evite seu atordoamento passivo e lhe dando um ponto de entrada livre. Depois de matar os carregadores principais em um teamfight, você pode então tentar o nuke Seraphine, o que é relativamente fácil quando você elimina seus carregadores principais da luta. Ao tentar empurrar contra Seraphine pode ser difícil com o quão forte sua limpeza de wave pode ser, com isso dito, tente pegar o Barão e conseguir terminar o jogo com o buff para evitar que ela e sua equipe acertem o waves.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Sett - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.09
summaryEn: Sett is a ferocious lane bully with heavy right-hook damage, Facebreaker (E) stuns, and a massive Haymaker (W) grit shield. At level 1, avoid extended slugfests and poke at max range with Q. The critical counter-play: NEVER take true damage from the center of Sett's Haymaker (dash laterally with E). Furthermore, when Sett pops his full grit shield, Renekton's Empowered W completely breaks 100% of the shield instantaneously, turning the fight into a decisive Renekton victory.
summaryPt: Sett é um valentão de rota com forte dano físico, atordoamento no Quebra-Crânio (E) e escudo colossal com Casca Grossa (W). No nível 1, evite trocas longas contra os socos duplos dele; comece de Q para pokear na distância máxima ou de W para responder all-in. A grande chave tática deste confronto: NUNCA tome o dano verdadeiro no centro do W de Sett (esquive lateralmente com o E). Além disso, quando Sett ativar o W e ganhar a barra inteira de escudo cinza, use o W Fortalecido do Renekton para quebrar 100% do escudo dele instantaneamente, virando a luta a seu favor de forma esmagadora.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. Level 1 with Q you can win against Sett with Conqueror, as you’re able to abuse your AD and low Q CD to kill him. You can also play with E start with PTA, with the intention of looking to trade 3 autos and PTA proc, using your 2nd E to disengage. Make sure to utilise your spacing well, try not to also get hit with his E stun in between minions, as this will allow Sett to heavily trade. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2/3 kill. 

(2) Avoid Extended Trades - Sett typically will overpower Renekton within the early portions of the game when it comes to extended trades, as his Q allows his 2nd auto attack to deal additional damage, on top of his Q and E abilities allowing for auto resets and the ability to stun. Utilise your abilities when it comes to trades, try to wait for Sett to pull then look to short trade with AA Q AA W AA E Out. Try to always emphasize using empowered W through trades, and if Sett tries to W early, use your empowered W to break his shield.    

(3) Respect Sett E - Sett E is essentially his only ability that can allow him to force trades, meaning he is very reliant on his E in order to get the correct trading patterns. Before Sett uses E, he will look to either Q then run towards you to pull you towards him, or he will play within his minion wave to use E to help him stun his targets longer. As Renekton, there’s a few ways we can use to play around his E. If Sett runs up into range, we can use our E within to escape his pull, losing him his main ability to apply damage onto us. We can also use W last within our quick combos with either E1 engages or walking up to him. Using W last in combos is important as Sett holds E to cancel Renekton’s disengage, so using W into disengaging with E will allow us to get away from him without being able to pull us back. Overall you just need to play accordingly towards the situation, eventually Renekton post level 6 will be able to consistently tank Sett’s damage without caring too much about his E.

(4) Respect And Avoid Sett’s W - Sett’s W is known for its BS damage, to which when playing vs him we should never sit in front of it and tank it. Against Sett we need to always be moving around him, so constantly click around when fighting him and use our dashes to avoid his E if possible. Alternatively, we can also use our own W to shield break against his W and hard punish Sett if he’s low, which can be the difference in being able to win or lose against him. Utilise W effectively against Sett’s W and he will never have a chance to win vs Renekton. It should also be worth noting Sett can use W flash to surprise kills, so try to avoid staying in low HP range and look to flash if you know he’s going to do it. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) Respect Sett R - Sett’s R can be a great tool in being able to set up giant teamfighting plays with his R into W combo, which can absolutely be cataclysmic if played right. As Renekton, we don’t really need to worry about his R in 1v1, however being near a wall allows his R to deal more damage, on top of being able to position into his W. You can try to buffer your W within his R, by right clicking on the frame of his R, which allows you to input your damage and stun through his R, allowing you to reposition away from his W or killing him on the spot.

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - W max absolutely destroys Sett’s ability to play against Renekton, as Renekton’s perma stuns allow him to consistently burst out and kill Sett within 2 trades worth of W. Later on Renekton can consistently break through his Sterak’s and W shields, while denying any other attempts for Sett trying to engage onto his team. No matter if you’re playing to in side lane or teamfights, W max provides more play making opportunities to always overpower Sett as a pick. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid to late game, Renekton as a champion is always able to be more versatile against Sett, allowing him to peel or engage for his team. Sett’s role is usually tailored towards looking for a big R, using his R on the tankiest teammate to provide more damage. Once using his R, he will use his W once he charges up his bar, which he will use in that range or look to use W flash. As Renekton, if Sett is behind we can look towards jumping on his carries to distract from Sett’s weak engage, while allowing our teammates to effectively play front to back. If Sett is strong, we should look to hold our W for his W shield, as this will allow us to easily shut him down for our team. Make sure to avoid being Sett’s R target and try to space away from him and your team when he has R up.

If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

Typically Shaco R doesn’t pose much of a problem for Renekton, however if you’re diving Shaco without his Q, make sure to ping or ignite Shaco first, as this will track onto the real Shaco, allowing you to easily one shot the real one. While AP is similar, Shaco’s overall power comes from how good his box and R usage is, which overall can lead to a lot of clutch and annoying plays. When playing Renekton vs Shaco, Shaco by default should not even exist within the game, however when navigating towards objectives or lanes, make sure to take red trinket to counter his box placement and play around denying them with your Q. Within teamfights, focusing AP shaco shouldn’t really be an option as he will do as much as he can to waste your time, which instead you could use to nuke his team. summaryEn: Shen aims to win trades by dragging Twilight Assault (Q) through you for enhanced damage and blocking autos with Spirit's Refuge (W). At level 1, watch his sword placement to prevent spirit blade drag-throughs. The essential rule: NEVER cast Renekton's W while Shen's W zone is active, as your stun will be completely blocked. Aguarde o círculo de defesa dele sumir, aplique o W Fortalecido para estourar o escudo da passiva dele e dê trocas com Q. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Avoid Shen Q Trades - Shen’s Level 1 can be pretty spooky as he’s able to abuse his Q trades to overpower Renekton, allowing Shen to zone Renekton from the wave. Level 1, if Shen drags his Q over to your side of the map, simply avoid standing in line with Shen and his sword, as he will get additional attack speed and slow his target. Try to walk in and out of him and the minions to bait his Q, then look to trade with Q after his passive and Q goes on CD. Overall you can play to let him push ,then wait for wave bounce to start asserting better trades.  

(2) Abuse Empowered Q / E Trades - Shen’s overall weak points against Renekton, is Shen’s lack of waveclear in comparison to Renekton’s. Renekton can cheat tempo plays by using his Q and E wave clear to easily shove waves, while also allowing himself to proxy and play for his powerspikes. Typically Renekton out performs Shen in the 1v1 at level 6, so playing for level 6 or playing exclusively for empowered Q and later E trades, will help you cut down Shen’s HP and resistances to allow for 1v1’s. 

(3) Avoid W'ing Shen W - Shen’s W allows him to block all auto attacks including Renekton’s W, allowing him to peel damage off himself or his carries. When trading vs Shen, we can usually bait his W by walking into him, which he will automatically W when you begin to auto attack, or you can E in and force his W out, followed by using E2 to disengage. Shen’s W is 16 seconds, so after he uses it we can abuse it with more heavy trades with our W.

(4) Avoid Shen E - Shen E is a great ability towards his gank setup or for forcing his trades, his trades consist of E > Q Auto Attacks, while using his W to block any incoming damage. Try to use short in and out clicks to bait Shen to E towards you, once he misses abuse him with your auto attacks and abilities back accordingly. When playing around Shen’s side of the map, be aware he will use his E to also force ganks or use it when you’re near his tower. Try to also use your E to avoid his E if you’re unable to side step it. 

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Abuse Renekton's R Spike - Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(7) Ping And Punish Shen R - Shen R is a pretty disgusting ability when it comes to countering skirmishes or teamfights, meaning when playing vs Shen we need to make sure we play accordingly around it. When laning vs Shen you can either cancel his R with your W, or you can let him TP across the map. If you can trust your team and look at the overall situation bot with confidence in letting him TP, you can let him R bot then look to abuse your wave clear and look for plates.Sometimes, if a fight looks too close where his impact can decide the fate of a bot lane fight, you could play to cancel his R with your W. W’ing Shen R isn’t always worth even if he does get something from it, as he can funnel plates and force Shen to either TP back or miss gold and XP. If you don’t want Shen to R, you can also play to consistently crash the waves into his turret, which prevents him from R’ing without missing XP and gold.

When it comes to skirmishes and playing around your team, typically on picks Shen will try to use R to protect his teammates, with that said we can hold our empowered W to nuke the overall shield they will get. Against Shen, typically you want to bait out fights to force his R, or jump on your target with the intention of killing them before Shen arrives. 

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - Q or W max is completely fine, however if you want to play vs Shen and play to kill him in side lane then I would recommend W max. W max allows you to break his passive shield consistently, while allowing you to have the self peel and damage to beat him in extended trades.

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Shen’s scaling through the game is very up and down, depending on how good his team is overall. Within an even game, Shen can offer the necessary utility needed to win fights and change the overall game. As mentioned, the main way we can play into Shen, is either abusing our side laning power to force tower pushes and scale towards our powerspikes, or we can play to look for picks utilising our W shield break and overall damage to kill targets before Shen can R. Overall, mid to late game is very hard and you just have to trust your judgement, as fights can easily be hard countered by Shen’s R and W. If there’s ever a chance to bait out Shen’s R then take the opportunity, Shen with no R is absolutely free to do whatever you want in the game. In actual fights, try to peel and protect your main carries, use your empowered W’s and E to shred Shen’s resistances and peel him away from your carries. If Shen does R early in the fight, you can look to one shot his carries after his R to ensure you kill his main source of damage and win the fights.

Normalmente Renekton supera Shen no 1v1 em level 6, então jogar para level 6 ou jogar exclusivamente para Empowered Q e trocas E posteriores, irá ajudá-lo a Cut Down Shen HP e resistências para permitir 1v1.

tips.titlePt: Evite W'ing Shen W
tips.contentEn: Shen’s W allows him to block all auto attacks including Renekton’s W, allowing him to peel damage off himself or his carries. When trading vs Shen, we can usually bait his W by walking into him, which he will automatically W when you begin to auto attack, or you can E in and force his W out, followed by using E2 to disengage. Shen’s W is 16 seconds, so after he uses it we can abuse it with more heavy trades with our W.
tips.contentPt: O W de Shen permite que ele bloqueie todos os auto attacks, incluindo o W de Renekton, permitindo que ele cause peel de dano a si mesmo ou a seus carregadores. Quando trocas vs Shen, geralmente podemos atrair seu W caminhando até ele, o que ele fará W automaticamente quando você começar a auto attack, ou você pode entrar E e forçar seu W para fora, seguido de usar E2 para disengage. O W do Shen é de 16 segundos, então depois que ele usar podemos abusar dele com trocas mais pesadas com o nosso W.

tips.titlePt: Evite Shen E
tips.contentEn: Shen E is a great ability towards his gank setup or for forcing his trades, his trades consist of E > Q Auto Attacks, while using his W to block any incoming damage. Try to use short in and out clicks to bait Shen to E towards you, once he misses abuse him with your auto attacks and abilities back accordingly. When playing around Shen’s side of the map, be aware he will use his E to also force ganks or use it when you’re near his tower. Try to also use your E to avoid his E if you’re unable to side step it.
tips.contentPt: Shen E é uma ótima habilidade para sua configuração gank ou para forçar suas trocas, suas trocas consistem em E > Q auto attacks, enquanto usa seu W para bloquear qualquer dano recebido. tente usar cliques curtos de entrada e saída para atrair Shen para E em sua direção, uma vez que ele erra, abuse dele com seu auto attacks e habilidades de volta de acordo. Ao jogar no lado do mapa de Shen, esteja ciente de que ele usará seu E também para forçar ganks ou usá-lo quando você estiver perto de sua torre. Tente também usar seu E para evitar o E dele se você não conseguir evitá-lo.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Abuse de Renekton's R Spike
tips.contentEn: Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de chegar a level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check consistentemente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: Pingar e punir Shen R
tips.contentEn:
Shen R is a pretty disgusting ability when it comes to countering skirmishes or teamfights, meaning when playing vs Shen we need to make sure we play accordingly around it. When laning vs Shen you can either cancel his R with your W, or you can let him TP across the map. If you can trust your team and look at the overall situation bot with confidence in letting him TP, you can let him R bot then look to abuse your wave clear and look for plates.Sometimes, if a fight looks too close where his impact can decide the fate of a bot lane fight, you could play to cancel his R with your W. W’ing Shen R isn’t always worth even if he does get something from it, as he can funnel plates and force Shen to either TP back or miss gold and XP. If you don’t want Shen to R, you can also play to consistently crash the waves into his turret, which prevents him from R’ing without missing XP and gold.

When it comes to skirmishes and playing around your team, typically on picks Shen will try to use R to protect his teammates, with that said we can hold our empowered W to nuke the overall shield they will get. Against Shen, typically you want to bait out fights to force his R, or jump on your target with the intention of killing them before Shen arrives.
tips.contentPt:
Shen R é uma habilidade bastante nojenta quando se trata de contra-atacar skirmishes ou teamfights, ou seja, ao jogar contra Shen, precisamos ter certeza de que jogaremos de acordo com isso. Ao laning vs Shen você pode cancelar o R ​​dele com seu W, ou você pode deixá-lo TP atravessar o mapa. Se você pode confiar em sua equipe e olhar para a situação geral do bot com confiança em deixá-lo TP, você pode deixá-lo R bot, em seguida, abusar de seu wave limpar e procurar por placas. Às vezes, se uma luta parecer muito próxima onde seu impacto pode decidir o destino de uma luta de bot lane, você pode jogar para cancelar seu R com seu W. W'ing Shen R nem sempre vale a pena, mesmo que ele consiga algo com isso, pois ele pode canalizar placas e forçar Shen para TP voltar ou perder ouro e XP. Se você não quiser Shen para R, você também pode jogar para crash consistentemente o waves em sua torre, o que o impede de R’ing sem perder XP e ouro.

Quando se trata de skirmishes e de jogar com seu time, normalmente nas escolhas Shen tentará usar R para proteger seus companheiros de equipe, com isso dito, podemos segurar nosso Empowered W para destruir o escudo geral que eles obterão. Contra Shen, normalmente você deseja provocar lutas para forçar seu R ou pular em seu alvo com a intenção de matá-lo antes que Shen chegue.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: Q or W max is completely fine, however if you want to play vs Shen and play to kill him in side lane then I would recommend W max. W max allows you to break his passive shield consistently, while allowing you to have the self peel and damage to beat him in extended trades.
tips.contentPt: Q ou W max é perfeitamente adequado, no entanto, se você quiser jogar contra Shen e jogar para matá-lo na rota lateral, eu recomendaria W max. W max permite que você quebre seu escudo passivo de forma consistente, ao mesmo tempo que permite que você tenha peel e dano para vencê-lo em trocas estendidas.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Shen’s scaling through the game is very up and down, depending on how good his team is overall. Within an even game, Shen can offer the necessary utility needed to win fights and change the overall game. As mentioned, the main way we can play into Shen, is either abusing our side laning power to force tower pushes and scale towards our powerspikes, or we can play to look for picks utilising our W shield break and overall damage to kill targets before Shen can R. Overall, mid to late game is very hard and you just have to trust your judgement, as fights can easily be hard countered by Shen’s R and W. If there’s ever a chance to bait out Shen’s R then take the opportunity, Shen with no R is absolutely free to do whatever you want in the game. In actual fights, try to peel and protect your main carries, use your empowered W’s and E to shred Shen’s resistances and peel him away from your carries. If Shen does R early in the fight, you can look to one shot his carries after his R to ensure you kill his main source of damage and win the fights.
tips.contentPt: A escalação de Shen ao longo do jogo varia muito, dependendo de quão boa é sua equipe no geral. Dentro de um jogo equilibrado, Shen pode oferecer a utilidade necessária para vencer lutas e mudar o jogo geral. Como mencionado, a principal maneira de jogar em Shen é abusar de nosso poder de rota lateral para forçar empurrões de torre e escalar em direção ao nosso powerspikes, ou podemos jogar para procurar escolhas utilizando nossa quebra de escudo W e dano geral para matar alvos antes que Shen possa R. No geral, do meio para late game é muito difícil e você só precisa confiar em seu julgamento, já que as lutas podem ser facilmente combatidas pelos R e W de Shen. Se você tiver a chance de atrair o R de Shen, aproveite a oportunidade, Shen sem R é absolutamente livre para fazer o que quiser no jogo. Em lutas reais, tente peel e proteja seus carregadores principais, use seus Empowered W e E para destruir as resistências de Shen e peel afastá-lo de seus carregamentos. Se Shen fizer R no início da luta, você pode obter one-shot após seu R para garantir que você mate sua principal fonte de dano e vença as lutas.

videoTitle: DJFrytek Renekton vs Shyvana - Unranked to Challenger
summaryEn: Top lane Shyvana relies on landing Flame Breath (E) marks to shred max HP in melee trades. Renekton holds overwhelming early game priority: start Q to control the wave and secure level 2. Dodge her E skillshot with your dash and punish her with Empowered W + Q rotations. At level 6, match her dragon form with Dominus (R) and shred her passive armor with Empowered E2.
summaryPt: Shyvana na rota superior depende do Hálito Flamejante (E) para aplicar marcas percentuais e queimar em trocas corpo a corpo. No início da partida, Renekton possui vantagem absoluta de pressão: comece com Q para empurrar a onda e buscar o nível 2 rápido. Desvie do projétil do E de Shyvana com o seu E e castigue-a com trocas curtas de W Fortalecido + Q. No nível 6, use o Dominus (R) para igualar o aumento de vida do R de Shyvana e use o E2 Fortalecido para triturar a armadura passiva dela.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Shyvana with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Shyvana. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Shyvana, you're most likely able to kill her with Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Shyvana lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Shyvana's Damage - Shyvana's early damage comes in the form of her E, which allows her to mark her target for 5 seconds providing additional on hit damage, attack speed and synergy with her Q and W trading power. While Shyvana’s laning damage isn’t overbearing, it should still be respected and you should aim to play around your abilities to ensure you don’t over trade into her overall strengths. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants within the early stage of the game. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Respect Shyvana R - Shyvana’s real powerspike comes in the form of her R, which allows her to empower all her abilities to a stronger state, on top of also having an absolute nuke of an ability with her E. Her E becomes a giant AoE one shot tool depending on her build, allowing her to easily nuke targets or provide giant dueling damage with her burn. Overall, once Shyvana ults and depending on her build, it’s usually best to avoid fighting her till it goes on CD. Shyvana without her R is pretty useless as the game goes on, so make sure to always abuse fights on her when she has no R up. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Shyvana while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Shyvana within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.  

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game Teamfighting Tips - Shyvana is an underrated and strange pick in her ability to go heavy AP as her main purpose of playstyle, or she can opt into a hybrid damage playstyle with Riftmaker and Shojin, allowing her to be absolutely crazy in her dueling and splitpushing power. Depending on what playstyle she plays it’s important to value her strengths, with the intention of playing around it. When she’s going her hybrid build, Renekton typically cannot 1v1 her unless he has BoTRK and some MR resistances, however if she is splitpushing I’d usually recommend getting your team to help shut her down, as shutting her down solo can be rather difficult depending on how strong she is. If Shyvana has her AP build, she will opt into playing around teamfights and skirmishes with her one shot build, allowing her to instantly nuke targets and win the fights off that alone. Try to avoid fighting Shyvana being present, or try to bait her R then look to wait until its on CD. Shyvana as mentioned is very ult dependent to have playability, so make sure to get rid of it then look to abuse when she doesn’t have it anymore. Within teamfights, try to nuke the Shyvana or peel her away from your team, as her high damage and burst can completely change a fight. If you get to jump onto Shyvana, make sure to one shot her as fast as you can. Once killing Shyvana, the enemy will lose out on a ton of burst damage or front lining power, allowing you to carry and play the rest of the fights with ease.

Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Shyvana R
tips.contentEn: Shyvana’s real powerspike comes in the form of her R, which allows her to empower all her abilities to a stronger state, on top of also having an absolute nuke of an ability with her E. Her E becomes a giant AoE one shot tool depending on her build, allowing her to easily nuke targets or provide giant dueling damage with her burn. Overall, once Shyvana ults and depending on her build, it’s usually best to avoid fighting her till it goes on CD. Shyvana without her R is pretty useless as the game goes on, so make sure to always abuse fights on her when she has no R up.
tips.contentPt: O verdadeiro powerspike de Shyvana vem na forma de seu R, que permite que ela capacitar todas as suas habilidades para um estado mais forte, além de também ter uma habilidade nuclear absoluta com seu E. Seu E se torna uma ferramenta AoE gigante de one-shot dependendo de sua build, permitindo que ela destrua facilmente alvos ou forneça dano de duelo gigante com sua queimadura. No geral, uma vez que Shyvana ulta e dependendo de sua build, geralmente é melhor evitar lutar contra ela até que continue em CD. Shyvana sem seu R é bastante inútil conforme o jogo avança, então certifique-se de sempre abusar das lutas com ela quando ela não tiver R ativo.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Shyvana while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Shyvana within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.
tips.contentPt: Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Shyvana enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você facilmente snowball e desligue permanentemente Shyvana em todas as fases do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

tips.titlePt: mid game teamfighting Dicas
tips.contentEn: Shyvana is an underrated and strange pick in her ability to go heavy AP as her main purpose of playstyle, or she can opt into a hybrid damage playstyle with Riftmaker and Shojin, allowing her to be absolutely crazy in her dueling and splitpushing power. Depending on what playstyle she plays it’s important to value her strengths, with the intention of playing around it. When she’s going her hybrid build, Renekton typically cannot 1v1 her unless he has BoTRK and some MR resistances, however if she is splitpushing I’d usually recommend getting your team to help shut her down, as shutting her down solo can be rather difficult depending on how strong she is. If Shyvana has her AP build, she will opt into playing around teamfights and skirmishes with her one shot build, allowing her to instantly nuke targets and win the fights off that alone. Try to avoid fighting Shyvana being present, or try to bait her R then look to wait until its on CD. Shyvana as mentioned is very ult dependent to have playability, so make sure to get rid of it then look to abuse when she doesn’t have it anymore. Within teamfights, try to nuke the Shyvana or peel her away from your team, as her high damage and burst can completely change a fight. If you get to jump onto Shyvana, make sure to one shot her as fast as you can. Once killing Shyvana, the enemy will lose out on a ton of burst damage or front lining power, allowing you to carry and play the rest of the fights with ease.
tips.contentPt: Shyvana é uma escolha subestimada e estranha em sua habilidade de usar AP pesado como seu principal objetivo de estilo de jogo, ou ela pode optar por um estilo de jogo de dano híbrido com Riftmaker e Shojin, permitindo que ela seja absolutamente louca em seu poder de duelo e ataque dividido. Dependendo do estilo de jogo que ela joga é importante valorizar seus pontos fortes, com a intenção de brincar com isso. Quando ela está usando sua build híbrida, Renekton normalmente não pode 1v1 ela, a menos que ele tenha BoTRK e algumas resistências de MR, no entanto, se ela estiver fazendo splitpush, eu geralmente recomendo que sua equipe ajude a desligá-la, já que desligá-la sozinha pode ser bastante difícil, dependendo de quão forte ela é. Se Shyvana tiver seu acúmulo de AP, ela optará por brincar com teamfights e skirmishes com seu acúmulo de one-shot, permitindo que ela destrua alvos instantaneamente e vença as lutas apenas com isso. tente evitar lutar contra Shyvana estando presente, ou tente iscar seu R e então espere até que esteja em CD. Shyvana como mencionado é muito dependente de ter jogabilidade, então certifique-se de se livrar dele e então provoque abusos quando ela não o tiver mais. Dentro de teamfights, tente detonar Shyvana ou peel para longe de seu time, pois seu alto dano e burst podem mudar completamente uma luta. Se você conseguir pular para Shyvana, certifique-se de atirar nela o mais rápido que puder. Depois de matar Shyvana, o inimigo perderá uma tonelada de dano de burst ou poder de linha de frente, permitindo que você carregue e jogue o resto das lutas com facilidade.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Singed - VN Challenger Patch 25.17
summaryEn: Singed aims to proxy farm waves and bait Renekton into chasing his Poison Trail (Q). The timeless rule: NEVER chase Singed directly in his poison cloud. Start Q or W at level 1 to defend the wave and punish early proxy attempts. Trade smartly: E onto his flank, AA + Empowered W + Q, then E2 backward toward your minions. Build Mercury's Treads and Black Cleaver to neutralize his Mega Adhesive (W) slow.
summaryPt: Singed busca criar caos correndo na frente com o Rastro de Veneno (Q) e arremessar Renekton com o Lançar (E). A regra universal contra Singed: NUNCA persiga Singed em linha reta dentro do veneno. No nível 1, comece com Q ou W para controlar a onda e impedir que ele faça proxy livre atrás das torres. Em trocas, use o E para alcançar o lado de Singed, aplique AA + W Fortalecido + Q e use o E2 para recuar em direção aos seus minions. Compre Passos de Mercúrio e Cutelo Negro para mitigar a lentidão do Mega-Adesivo (W) e vencê-lo facilmente no split push.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Defend First Minion Wave - While more uncommon these days, Singed can still potentially proxy level 1 depending on if he takes Ghost to help him be annoying and kite out with his poison damage active. To stop Singed from proxying with success, you can walk with your minion wave level 1 to prevent him from proxying, while giving you the opportunity to kill him if he tries this strategy. 

(2) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Singed with your Q, Singed will try to actively push for level 2 to take his E, so with that try to contest wave push while trading back with auto attacks if he comes close. Keep in mind, if he runs into you he will proc his poison alongside his Conqueror rune, allowing him to do a lot of damage within the process. Try to actively space backwards and keep your HP through good kiting, then posture more aggressively when reaching level 2. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Singed at any point through level 1 and 2, you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Singed lose a lot more. 

(3) DONT CHASE SINGED - Singed can be a very boring and inactive lane if he knows what he is doing, so if Singed tries to proxy on repeat, just ignore it and focus on getting minions until someone is around to help you stop him. Singed can be very negative in his ability to slow with W, fling you the opposite direction, as well as getting slow based items like Rylai’s to perma slow and make you irrelevant. Focus on amassing a giant farm score, with the intention of joining grubs or any skirmishes on your side of the map. Alternatively, you can also proxy back on his side of the map if you want to counter his tempo advantage of killing waves, as this will help you match recall timers with Singed. 

(4) Ping Singed’s Movements - Singed being the annoying champion that he is, will try to actively proxy into roaming in your jungle or running mid lane. With that said, try to always ping where he is so your teammates can play accordingly towards it. Without pinging, Singed will be able to constantly gank and join fights when your team least expects it. Don’t try to chase Singed, simply farm and keep your gold and XP up. 

(5) Respect Singed W - If Singed is in lane, try to avoid shoving up and being in his tower range, as he can W towards his tower looking to E you into it. Try to keep wave states towards the middle, as Singed cannot fling you towards his tower and you will be able to get more productive trades against him. Do note that Singed W can also prevent you from E’ing or using your flash, so try to actively walk out of it or bait it out with short clicks to put it onto CD. 

(6) Respect And W Buffer His E - A trick you can do into Singed, is using your W into his E frame, preventing Singed from maximising on his fling to kite you out effectively. If doing this successfully, you can E right after his fling to help you stay on top and trade back against him.

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 
(8) Avoid Fighting Singed R - Singed R allows him to get an abundance of stats, allowing him to be a lot stronger within fights. Most often if Singed R’s, try to play to disengage if he’s near full HP, as his stats are simply too strong for Renekton to even deal with. If Singed is low, you can look to killing him, but be aware he also gains additional HP regen. 

(9) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Hexdrinker to lower Singed's overall damage and have a MR shield. / Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Singed’s role is to essentially be an annoying plague every chance he gets, meaning he will look to constantly skirmish with his movement speed in trying to force and obtain kills. Beating Singed entirely counts on preventing his plays with pings, or communicating his roams. If you’re able to gain a giant farm lead, you will be able to use it to help you kill the rest of his teammates. Playing with TP is very helpful in this match up, as you’re able to farm in side lane and look for active plays on the map. It’s very important to use TP effectively as that will help you find relevancy within all stages of the game. When it comes to teamfights, try to focus onto Singed’s carries as his default role will be trying to engage onto your own. The Difference between Renekton and Singed, is that Renekton’s damage and utility is a lot higher than what Singed can provide, allowing you to easily play teamfights with more flexibility. Try to avoid Singed making the first move, as typically Singed succeeds if he Ghosts up towards an unsure team, allowing him to set up his plays right away.

Se você conseguir obter uma liderança de fazenda gigante, poderá usá-la para ajudá-lo a matar o resto de seus companheiros de equipe. Jogar com TP é muito útil nesse confronto, pois você pode farmar na rota lateral e procurar jogadas ativas no mapa. É muito importante usar TP de forma eficaz, pois isso o ajudará a encontrar relevância em todas as fases do jogo. Quando se trata de teamfights, tente se concentrar nos carrys de Singed, pois a função padrão dele será tentar engage para o seu próprio. A diferença entre Renekton e Singed é que o dano e a utilidade de Renekton são muito maiores do que o que Singed pode fornecer, permitindo que você jogue teamfights facilmente com mais flexibilidade. Tente evitar que Singed faça o primeiro movimento, já que normalmente Singed tem sucesso se ele se aproximar de um time inseguro, permitindo que ele prepare suas jogadas imediatamente.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Sion - KR Challenger Patch 26.03
summaryEn: Sion stacks immense bonus health while looking to charge Decimating Smash (Q) channels. Renekton is a premier hard counter to Sion: start Q at level 1 for wave priority. The defining counter-play: whenever Sion channels his Q axe swing, instantly stun him with Renekton's W to CANCEL his channel on the spot! Furthermore, Empowered W instantly breaks Sion's Soul Furnace (W) shield before detonation. With Black Cleaver and BoTRK, Renekton dominates Sion throughout the entire game.
summaryPt: Sion é um tanque de alta vida que busca empurrar a rota com o Golpe Demolidor (Q) e escalar com a passiva do W. Renekton é um dos maiores counters de Sion: comece com Q no nível 1 para empurrar para o nível 2. A mecânica que anula completamente Sion: sempre que ele começar a canalizar o Q com o machado no chão, use o W do Renekton para atordoá-lo e CANCELAR a canalização na hora! Além disso, o W Fortalecido quebra 100% do escudo do W de Sion antes que ele possa detoná-lo. Com Cutelo Negro e Espada do Rei Destruído, Renekton domina Sion do início ao fim da partida.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Level 1 Strats - Sion has a few strats he can pull out level 1, which can help him get an early advantage, or allow him to be super annoying that can help him cheese through the first minutes of the game. Sion level 1 can try to proxy, which while a lot weaker nowadays, can still be a play he can do if he’s psycho enough. With that said, try to hold vision by standing in tri bush level 1 on red side, or cover the blue side path above the blue buff to spot out Sion. Once the minion wave spawns, walk towards the wave and protect it in case Sion found another way to enter, as doing this will weaken his chances of being able to proxy without dying. 

Sion can also start Q and hide in the middle bush, allowing him to get a disgustingly range Q that can chunk out a lot of your HP. Try to respect this, by either positioning away from his Q hit box indicator and farming the first 3 minions with Q, or if you have time, pull the wave towards the right hand side of the lane by aggroing minions first, then dragging it away from the bush, leaving Sion with no range to hit you with Q.

(2) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. Take E if Sion misses Q early and plays aggressively, then look for E AAx3 E Trade. Take Q if Sion skills W, then play for level 2 push into fighting him with E up. 

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Sion level 1, you're most likely able to kill him with Your W, Dash or Flash up. Always try to kill him near his tower, otherwise Sion can TP back and ruin your kill tempo. 

(4) Respect Sion Passive - Sion’s passive is always an insidious killer, as disrespecting it can leave him getting kills or ruining your tempo advantage completely. Sion’s deaths don’t really affect him as much as other champions, due to the fact his death timer starts ticking once Sion is in passive, allowing him to use his passive to his fullest, then instantly reviving right after. With that said when you’re trying to kill Sion, make sure to always get kills on his side of the map, as if you’re unable to shove the waves in after killing Sion can absolutely destroy your chances of hard abusing him, allowing him to TP to get the wave back, or running back in time to freeze a wave onto you or getting all the CS back without missing anything. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Play Around Proxy - Sion players most often will always look for any chance to proxy, as Renekton typically hard counters in straight fights. Something Sion will usually do to enter his proxy, is that he will crash the wave then look towards walking past the tier 1 tower, or he will try to ult past you to reach your minion waves. As Renekton, we need to hold the minion wave outside of our tower, while preventing him from directly R’ing past by holding our E to potential dash and block his access. Sometimes Sion can go through the other side of the walls and start proxying, in which if your jungler or support is around, you can attempt to kill him before he tries to assert any tempo advantage over you. Alternatively, if no one is on your side of the map, you should just ignore him and play for farm by killing the minions in your wave, or proxying back against him to prevent his tempo advantage. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.  

(8) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Depending on how much you have put Sion behind, Sion’s performance will vary within the next phase of the game. Typically Sion will aim to split push and farm stacks for his passive, while trying to scale into his Thanos style playstyle. As Renekton, once we have finished BoTRK we will be able to actively fight and melt Sion within the side lane, on top of using our empowered E to help shred through his resistances. Any chance you get to kill Sion is always a big moment, as he cannot use his frontlining powers within a team fight, as well as being able to split push and take towers. Most often, if you’re ahead of Sion you want to try and dominate the map and use your lead to carry fights, however if Sion is hard split pushing you can use your mid laner or scaling adc to take waves, while you’re able to use your lead on the map. Within teamfights, try to ignore sion and focus on his carries first. Sion’s damage isn’t that much until he scales through his items in the later stages of the game, but  even with that said ,your role should always focus on destroying his carries.

(4) Respeite Sion Passivo - O passivo de Sion é sempre um assassino traiçoeiro, pois desrespeitá-lo pode fazer com que ele mate ou arruine completamente sua vantagem de ritmo. As mortes de Sion não o afetam tanto quanto os outros campeões, devido ao fato de seu cronômetro de morte começar a contar quando Sion estiver na passiva, permitindo que ele use sua passiva ao máximo e revivendo instantaneamente logo em seguida. Com isso dito, quando você está tentando matar Sion, certifique-se de sempre matar no lado dele do mapa, como se você não fosse capaz de enfiar o waves depois de matar Sion pode destruir totalmente suas chances de abusar dele, permitindo que ele TP recupere o wave, ou volte no tempo para freeze uma wave em você ou pegue todos os CS volta sem perder nada. 

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Brincar proxy - Os jogadores de Sion na maioria das vezes sempre procurarão qualquer chance de proxy, já que Renekton normalmente contra-ataca forte em lutas diretas. Algo que Sion normalmente fará para entrar em seu proxy, é que ele crash o wave e então olhará para passar pela torre de nível 1, ou ele tentará passar por você para alcançar seu lacaio waves. Como Renekton, precisamos manter o lacaio wave fora de nossa torre, enquanto evitamos que ele passe diretamente pelo R, mantendo nosso E para uma investida potencial e bloqueando seu acesso. Às vezes, Sion pode passar pelo outro lado das paredes e iniciar proxying, onde se seu caçador ou suporte estiver por perto, você pode tentar matá-lo antes que ele tente reivindicar qualquer vantagem de tempo sobre você. Alternativamente, se ninguém estiver do seu lado do mapa, você deve simplesmente ignorá-lo e jogar para farm matando os lacaios em seu wave ou proxying contra ele para evitar sua vantagem de tempo. 

(7) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.  

(8) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - Dependendo de quanto você colocou Sion para trás, o desempenho de Sion irá variar na próxima fase do jogo. Normalmente, Sion terá como objetivo dividir os stacks de push e farm para sua passiva, enquanto tenta escalar seu estilo de jogo ao estilo Thanos. Assim como Renekton, assim que terminarmos BoTRK seremos capazes de lutar ativamente e derreter Sion na rota lateral, além de usar nosso Empowered E para ajudar a destruir suas resistências. Qualquer chance de matar Sion é sempre um grande momento, já que ele não pode usar seus poderes de linha de frente em uma luta em equipe, além de ser capaz de dividir push e tomar torres. Na maioria das vezes, se você está à frente de Sion, você quer tentar dominar o mapa e usar sua liderança para realizar lutas, no entanto, se Sion for hard split push, você pode usar seu mid laner ou scaling adc para pegar waves, enquanto você é capaz de usar sua liderança no mapa. Dentro de teamfights, tente ignorar Sion e focar primeiro em seus carregamentos. O dano de Sion não é tanto até que ele escale seus itens nas fases posteriores do jogo, mas mesmo com isso dito, seu papel deve sempre se concentrar em destruir seus carregadores.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Depending on how much you have put Sion behind, Sion’s performance will vary within the next phase of the game. Typically Sion will aim to split push and farm stacks for his passive, while trying to scale into his Thanos style playstyle. As Renekton, once we have finished BoTRK we will be able to actively fight and melt Sion within the side lane, on top of using our empowered E to help shred through his resistances. Any chance you get to kill Sion is always a big moment, as he cannot use his frontlining powers within a team fight, as well as being able to split push and take towers. Most often, if you’re ahead of Sion you want to try and dominate the map and use your lead to carry fights, however if Sion is hard split pushing you can use your mid laner or scaling adc to take waves, while you’re able to use your lead on the map. Within teamfights, try to ignore sion and focus on his carries first. Sion’s damage isn’t that much until he scales through his items in the later stages of the game, but  even with that said ,your role should always focus on destroying his carries.
tips.contentPt: Dependendo de quanto você colocou Sion para trás, o desempenho de Sion irá variar na próxima fase do jogo. Normalmente, Sion terá como objetivo dividir os stacks de push e farm para sua passiva, enquanto tenta escalar seu estilo de jogo ao estilo Thanos. Como Renekton, assim que terminarmos BoTRK seremos capazes de lutar ativamente e derreter Sion na rota lateral, além de usar nosso Empowered E para ajudar a destruir suas resistências. Qualquer chance de matar Sion é sempre um grande momento, já que ele não pode usar seus poderes de linha de frente em uma luta em equipe, além de ser capaz de dividir push e tomar torres. Na maioria das vezes, se você está à frente de Sion, você quer tentar dominar o mapa e usar sua liderança para realizar lutas, no entanto, se Sion for hard split push, você pode usar seu mid laner ou scaling adc para pegar waves, enquanto você é capaz de usar sua liderança no mapa. Dentro de teamfights, tente ignorar Sion e focar primeiro em seus carregamentos. O dano de Sion não é tanto até que ele escale seus itens nas fases posteriores do jogo, mas mesmo com isso dito, seu papel deve sempre se concentrar em destruir seus carregadores.
