tips.titlePt: Interromper o Golpe Demolidor (Q) com o W
tips.contentEn: Sion's Q (Decimating Smash) has a long wind-up and is very powerful. When Sion charges his Q, interrupt him with Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) stun to gain a trade advantage.
tips.contentPt: Quando Sion carregar o machado do Q, atordoe-o imediatamente com o W de Renekton para cancelar a canalização e anular todo o dano dele.

tips.titlePt: Destruir o Escudo da Fornalha da Alma com W Fortalecido
tips.contentEn: Sion's W (Soul Furnace) shield can be destroyed by Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator). When Sion uses his W, accumulate 50 Fury to use empowered W to neutralize his shield and deal damage.
tips.contentPt: O W de Sion concede um escudo de vida máxima. O W Fortalecido destrói o escudo antes que ele consiga detonar o dano mágico em área.

videoTitle: MVP ★ DK Career Sivir 21/10/8 vs Renekton BRO Casting ⚔️ Challenger S16 KR ⚔️ Warden Sivir Gameplay
summaryEn: Solo lane Sivir offers waveclear with Boomerang Blade (Q) and defense through Spell Shield (E). Start E at level 1 for instant PTA gap-close trades. The crucial interaction: bait or pop her Spell Shield using Q AoE or E1 dash before landing your Empowered W stun. Stripped of her spell shield, Sivir has zero defense against Renekton's Dominus (R) all-in burst.
summaryPt: Sivir na rota solo possui bom alcance com a Lâmina Bumerangue (Q) e defesa com o Escudo de Feitiço (E). No nível 1, comece com E para trocas agressivas imediatas (E1 > auto-ataques > E2). O detalhe crucial do confronto: quebre o Escudo de Feitiço (E) de Sivir com o dano em área do Q ou com o primeiro dash do E antes de soltar o W Fortalecido. Sem o escudo, Sivir não tem como escapar do atordoamento e sucumbe instantaneamente ao dano letal de Renekton com Dominus (R) e Ignite.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Sivir level 1, you're most likely able to kill her with Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Sivir lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Play To Manaburn - Sivir’s overall playstyle requires her to expend a lot of mana to try and contest push, or defend against Renekton’s combos. Typically, we can easily burn her mana if we force freezes to burn Sivir’s W and Q, or we can try and force trades onto Sivir to make her panic burn abilities. Furthermore, we can do whatever we want in this match up as long as we’re playing optimally and looking to abuse her high mana or low mana states accordingly.

(5) Hold Abilities Vs Spell Shield - Sivir’s W provides her with HP back if she successfully blocks an ability, with the advantage of also avoiding Renekton’s stun and first W damage hit. Typically within any fights against Svir, instead of using W right away, simply wait out her W until it wears off, or use your E/Q to break her spell shield to allow you to stun Sivir with ease. Overall if you play around her W she will always become a very easy target to kill. 

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.  

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Sivir's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Sivir as a champion is pretty horrible in my opinion, her only real strength is essentially being a utility ADC with her movement speed and AoE mid range damage. Sivir’s real win condition is trying to farm up towards 30-40 minutes before having any real presence within the game, in which as Renekton you should try and abuse your early to mid game advantage as much as possible. Try to use your power to perma kill Sivir, then look to roam towards any major objectives that spawn on the map, eventually your aim is to pick up baron and use it to push towards a victory against Sivir. Within fights, as long as you don’t W Sivir in her spell shield you should be able to kill her with ease, however you should try and assess who the enemy carries are before opting into killing Sivir.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Sivir level 1, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Sivir perca muito mais. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Jogue com Manaburn - O estilo de jogo geral de Sivir exige que ela gaste muita mana para tentar contestar o push ou se defender dos combos de Renekton. Normalmente, podemos facilmente queimar sua mana se forçarmos o congelamento para queimar o W e Q de Sivir, ou podemos tentar forçar trocas em Sivir para fazer suas habilidades de pânico queimarem. Além disso, podemos fazer o que quisermos neste confronto, desde que estejamos jogando de forma otimizada e buscando abusar de seus estados de mana alta ou baixa de acordo.

(5) Hold Abilities Vs Spell Shield - O W de Sivir fornece a ela HP de volta se ela bloquear uma habilidade com sucesso, com a vantagem de também evitar o atordoamento e o primeiro dano de W de Renekton. Normalmente, em qualquer luta contra Svir, em vez de usar o W imediatamente, simplesmente espere o W dela acabar ou use seu E/Q para quebrar o escudo de feitiço dela e permitir que você atordoe Sivir com facilidade. No geral, se você brincar com o W dela, ela sempre se tornará um alvo muito fácil de matar. 

(6) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.  

(7) Trocas pesadas - Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de simplesmente pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a finalizar seu oponente.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Sivir e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano. 

(9) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - Sivir como campeã é horrível na minha opinião, sua única força real é essencialmente ser um ADC utilitário com sua velocidade de movimento e dano de médio alcance AoE. A verdadeira condição de vitória de Sivir é tentar farmar até 30-40 minutos antes de ter qualquer presença real no jogo, em que como Renekton você deve tentar abusar de sua vantagem inicial para mid game tanto quanto possível. Tente usar seu poder para matar permanentemente Sivir e, em seguida, obter roam para quaisquer objetivos principais que surjam no mapa. Eventualmente, seu objetivo é pegar o barão e usá-lo para avançar em direção à vitória contra Sivir. Nas lutas, contanto que você não tenha W Sivir em seu escudo de feitiço, você poderá matá-la com facilidade, no entanto, você deve tentar avaliar quem é o inimigo antes de optar por matar Sivir.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Skarner - KR Challenger Patch 26.06
summaryEn: Top lane Skarner relies on boulder throws (Q) and terrain burrow charges (E). Start Q at level 1 to secure early wave dominance and level 2 priority. Use your E dash to sidestep his charging path when he charges through walls. Break his W shield with Empowered W and shred his bonus armor with Empowered E2 (Dice). Stay clear of enemy turret range at level 6 to avoid getting dragged under tower by Impale (R).
summaryPt: Skarner no topo traz controle de grupo com pedras arremessadas (Q) e avanço através do terreno (E). No nível 1, comece com Q para pokear e empurrar a onda para pegar o nível 2 primeiro. Desvie da trajetória de Skarner quando ele carregar com o E nas paredes usando o dash do seu E. Use o W Fortalecido para punir os escudos que Skarner gerar com o W e utilize o E2 Fortalecido para reduzir a armadura pesada dele. Mantenha-se afastado de torres inimigas no nível 6 para não ser arrastado pelo Impalar (R) de Skarner.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Skarner with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Skarner. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Skarner you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Skraner lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Waveclear - A giant advantage Renekton has within this match up, is his overall ability to easily clear minion waves. This can help him achieve perfect tempo resets, or allow him to proxy waves to help increase his gold lead, while also hostaging the enemy top laner under their own tower. Being able to fast clear also forces the enemy into contesting push, allowing you to easily mana burn and create advantageous positions from it. Abuse this strength to cheat out bad laning situations, or increase your overall power within the game. 

(4) Avoid Skarner E - Skarner’s E is the only ability outside of his R that you need to worry about, as Skarner E can help him stun his targets towards a wall or push them towards his tower. Overall, Skarner E can be dangerous, however it’s only dangerous if we’re hard pushing towards his side of the map. As long as we keep the wave in the middle or towards our tower, Skarner cannot really abuse his E offensively, on top of the fact Renekton can also time his W stun right at the impact of his stun to instantly cancel his E ability. 

(5) Abuse Renekton’s W Shieldbreak - Skarner’s fighting power relies on using Grasp, Q damage and using his W shield, to mitigate against incoming damage. As Renekton, we can easily counter Skarner’s W ability with our own, as we can instantly break his shield and burst him down in the process. Use this within skirmishes or teamfights, to help shred his shield to allow you and your team to do more damage to him.

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) Avoid Skarner's Full CC Combo - Once Skarner has R, Skarner is able to do some very disgusting CC combos. These combos can be R > E > Q / W Slow or E > R -  The purpose of these combos allows him to drag his enemies under towers or towards his team. Skarner’s main purpose within the game is to play off utilising his heavy CC for his teammates, allowing him to easily lock down his targets in combination with his teams CC and damage. Try to avoid these at all costs, by using your E or Flash to dodge his incoming R, or try to avoid getting hit by his E by using your own E. If Skarner never locks you down then you won’t be able to die vs him. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - As previously mentioned, Skarner’s main role as a pick is to tank for his team, while providing heavy CC in order to catch out his enemies, while using his R and E to drag people towards his teams. If he can always provide vision towards any blind spots, Skarner will struggle trying to use his E through the wall or generally struggle to get the angles he needs to flank for his team. Through fights, Skarner will try to get a huge R off with his flash, or simply try to walk up towards your team. If you avoid Skarner’s R, you can use your W to lock him in place, preventing him from being able to move any ulted targets towards his team. Generally, all you need to do to really beat him is utilising your stuns and empowered E shred to shred through his abundance of armour, as well as stopping him from getting any max value E’s or R’s through a teamfight.

summaryEn: Smolder is an infinite-scaling marksman reliant on stacking Super Scorcher Breath (Q). Renekton must play relentlessly aggressive from levels 1 to 6 to deny his stacks: start E at level 1 for heavy PTA trades. When Smolder takes flight with Flap, Flap, Flap (E), chase him down with double E dashes and lock him with Empowered W. (1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Smolder level 1, you're most likely able to kill him with Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Smolder lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Respect Smolder's Passive - Smolder’s passive is essentially the highlight of this match up, as playing incorrectly around denying his passive stacks will leave him completely outscaling you by the 25-30 minute mark. Smolder will obtain stacks by attacking his opponent with his abilities or killing minions with his Q. As Renekton we want to deny smolder by intentionally leaving the wave on our side, with the aim of dashing in and bursting him down each time he is over extended. If you play this way Smolder will struggle to scale and always leave himself for Renekton’s lethal combos. Try your best to end the game as fast as you can after you obtain a lead, otherwise he will comeback hard once he hits 225 stacks.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) Respect Smolder's R - Smolder’s R isn’t as hard hitting or impactful as other ults, but nevertheless it can help him a lot when it comes to healing against targets or dealing the right amount of damage to secure kills. Try not to be fighting Smolder with low HP when he has R, as he can easily wipe out your remaining HP. As long as you’re not low, you don’t really have to worry much about his R.

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Smolder's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Smolder’s overall scaling is definitely to be feared each step we head into the late game, however for Smolder it takes a lot of time to reach that. Depending on how good you played at putting him behind, Smolder won’t be able to be present within most mid game skirmishes or teamfights, due to the fact he would rather look to stack within the side lane. As Renekton abusing this period in the game is essential to overcoming Smolder’s stacking win condition, meaning that we should try to take every objective and teamfights, doing this will leave his team struggling while he is trying to regain his strength. If there’s no objectives or plays on the map, you can try to just repetitively kill Smolder with a heavy damage or slow based build, which is relatively easy as long as you avoid dying to multiple people around him. In teamfights, simply jump on him and try to cancel his E ability with your stun to stop him from escaping. Smolder when behind or even is pretty easy to kill as Renekton, however if he does have lots of stacks then be very wary of your positioning. Try to get your team to all focus Smolder if he is a threat, with that you will be able to easily shut him down with a W Flash, so make sure to look out for this as a play.

With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.
tips.contentPt: Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes desde o início até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Smolder's Passive
tips.contentEn: Smolder’s passive is essentially the highlight of this match up, as playing incorrectly around denying his passive stacks will leave him completely outscaling you by the 25-30 minute mark. Smolder will obtain stacks by attacking his opponent with his abilities or killing minions with his Q. As Renekton we want to deny smolder by intentionally leaving the wave on our side, with the aim of dashing in and bursting him down each time he is over extended. If you play this way Smolder will struggle to scale and always leave himself for Renekton’s lethal combos. Try your best to end the game as fast as you can after you obtain a lead, otherwise he will comeback hard once he hits 225 stacks.
tips.contentPt: A passiva de Smolder é essencialmente o destaque deste confronto, já que jogar incorretamente negando seus stacks passivos fará com que ele supere você completamente na marca de 25-30 minutos. Smolder obterá stacks atacando seu oponente com suas habilidades ou matando lacaios com seu Q. Como Renekton queremos negar Smolder deixando intencionalmente o wave do nosso lado, com o objetivo de avançar e bursting derrubá-lo cada vez que ele estiver estendido demais. Se você jogar dessa maneira, Smolder terá dificuldade para escalar e sempre se deixará levar pelos combos letais de Renekton. Tente o seu melhor para terminar o jogo o mais rápido possível depois de obter a liderança, caso contrário ele retornará com força quando atingir 225 stacks.

tips.titlePt: Mantenha a Wave do seu Lado
tips.contentEn: Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.
tips.contentPt: Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Pesadas (Heavy Trades)
tips.contentEn: Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Smolder's R
tips.contentEn: Smolder’s R isn’t as hard hitting or impactful as other ults, but nevertheless it can help him a lot when it comes to healing against targets or dealing the right amount of damage to secure kills. Try not to be fighting Smolder with low HP when he has R, as he can easily wipe out your remaining HP. As long as you’re not low, you don’t really have to worry much about his R.
tips.contentPt: O R de Smolder não é tão forte ou impactante quanto outras ults, mas mesmo assim pode ajudá-lo muito quando se trata de curar alvos ou causar a quantidade certa de dano para garantir mortes. Tente não lutar contra Smolder com HP baixo quando ele tiver R, pois ele pode facilmente acabar com seu HP restante. Contanto que você não esteja baixo, você realmente não precisa se preocupar muito com o R dele.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Smolder's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Smolder e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Smolder’s overall scaling is definitely to be feared each step we head into the late game, however for Smolder it takes a lot of time to reach that. Depending on how good you played at putting him behind, Smolder won’t be able to be present within most mid game skirmishes or teamfights, due to the fact he would rather look to stack within the side lane. As Renekton abusing this period in the game is essential to overcoming Smolder’s stacking win condition, meaning that we should try to take every objective and teamfights, doing this will leave his team struggling while he is trying to regain his strength. If there’s no objectives or plays on the map, you can try to just repetitively kill Smolder with a heavy damage or slow based build, which is relatively easy as long as you avoid dying to multiple people around him. In teamfights, simply jump on him and try to cancel his E ability with your stun to stop him from escaping. Smolder when behind or even is pretty easy to kill as Renekton, however if he does have lots of stacks then be very wary of your positioning. Try to get your team to all focus Smolder if he is a threat, with that you will be able to easily shut him down with a W Flash, so make sure to look out for this as a play.
tips.contentPt: A escala geral de Smolder é definitivamente deve ser temida a cada passo que avançamos em late game, no entanto, para Smolder leva muito tempo para chegar a isso. Dependendo de quão bem você jogou em colocá-lo para trás, Smolder não poderá estar presente na maioria dos mid game skirmishes ou teamfights, devido ao fato de que ele prefere obter stack na rota lateral. Como Renekton abusar deste período no jogo é essencial para superar a condição de vitória estacada de Smolder, o que significa que devemos tentar pegar todos os objetivos e teamfights, fazer isso deixará seu time lutando enquanto ele tenta recuperar suas forças. Se não houver objetivos ou jogadas no mapa, você pode tentar matar Smolder repetidamente com um dano pesado ou uma build lenta, o que é relativamente fácil, desde que você evite morrer para várias pessoas ao seu redor. Em teamfights, simplesmente pule sobre ele e tente cancelar sua habilidade E com seu atordoamento para impedi-lo de escapar. Smolder quando atrás ou mesmo é muito fácil de matar como Renekton, no entanto, se ele tiver muitos stacks, tenha muito cuidado com seu posicionamento. Tente fazer com que seu time se concentre totalmente em Smolder se ele for uma ameaça, com isso você poderá derrotá-lo facilmente com um W Flash, então certifique-se de olhar para isso como uma jogada.

videoTitle: Sona Top vs Renekton - EUW Master Patch 10.10
summaryEn: Sona lacks the base defensive stats to endure Renekton's physical burst. Start E at level 1 for instantaneous PTA trades. At level 3+, any double dash E combo with Empowered W and Q will result in an instant solo kill or force her Flash. Freeze the wave, deny her entirely, and translate your massive lane advantage into jungle invades.
summaryPt: Sona é uma campeã frágil que não tem ferramentas para resistir à investida física de Renekton. No nível 1, inicie com E para realizar a troca clássica de PTA (E1 > 3 auto-ataques > E2). A partir do nível 3, qualquer avanço de E1 + E2 com W Fortalecido e Q resulta em abate imediato ou força o Flash dela. Aproveite a facilidade da rota para criar um freeze, negar 100% do farm dela e snowballar a partida com invasões na selva inimiga.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try To Cheese PTA Proc or Conq With E1 > 3 Auto's > Disengage With E2. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Sona level 1, you're most likely able to kill her with Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Sona lose a lot more. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Respect Sona's Passive - Sona’s passive allows her to obtain an empowered attack after reaching 3 stacks of her passive. Her Q allows her to have bonus damage, her W applies damage reduction and her E massively slows her targets. As Renekton, understanding how she uses her empowered auto attack depends on her current form, in which if she doesn’t damage reduce our combo with her W attack, then we are easily available to one shot her on demand. There’s really not much to this lane outside of understanding this, so respect her W form for dives and you should have no problem.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) Respect Sona's R - Sona’s R can be a pretty good ability if timed right through her team’s CC, allowing her to lock down any targets within front of her. Typically within the lane, Sona’s R doesn’t really do anything to Renekton outside of preventing him from potentially tower diving her if he’s low, but aside from that you can literally ignore her R as an ability until teamfights. 

(8)Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Sona's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Sona’s role within the mid game is to essentially play around her main carries, trying to consistently peel her carries with her W and E, as well as also trying to form picks with her R. As Renekton, we can easily nuke through targets around Sona, so opting into a full damage build will essentially render Sona completely useless when trying to play around her target. Renekton can either focus her main carry, or try to one shot her from the fight if she is available, so overall you can just play the situation on whatever you think is best and matters the most of that situation within the game.

Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a finalizar seu oponente.

(7) Respeite o R de Sona - o R de Sona pode ser uma habilidade muito boa se cronometrado diretamente através do CC de sua equipe, permitindo que ela bloqueie qualquer alvo à sua frente. Normalmente dentro da rota, o R de Sona realmente não faz nada para Renekton além de impedi-lo de potencialmente tower diving ela se ele estiver baixo, mas fora isso você pode literalmente ignorar o R ​​dela como uma habilidade até teamfights. 

(8) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Sona e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O papel de Sona dentro do mid game é essencialmente brincar com seus carregamentos principais, tentando consistentemente peel seus carregamentos com seu W e E, bem como também tentando escolhas de forma com seu R. Como Renekton, podemos facilmente destruir alvos ao redor de Sona, então optar por uma build de dano total essencialmente tornará Sona completamente inútil ao tentar brincar. seu alvo. Renekton pode focar seu carry principal ou tentar one-shot nela da luta se ela estiver disponível, então no geral você pode apenas jogar a situação no que achar melhor e mais importante para aquela situação dentro do jogo.

summaryEn: Soraka aims to poke from afar with Starcall (Q) heals and place Equinox (E) silence zones. Start E at level 1 for aggressive PTA trades. When diving in at level 3+, step out of her silence pool before the root triggers. Rush early anti-heal (Executioner's Calling) and burst her with Empowered W + Ignite before her regeneration kicks in.
summaryPt: Soraka tenta jogar recuada acertando o Q (Chamado Estelar) para se curar e usando o Silêncio (E) para interromper combos. No nível 1, comece com E para trocas agressivas com PTA. Ao realizar trocas no nível 3+, saia rapidamente da poça de silêncio (E) de Soraka usando seus dashes antes de ficar enraizado. Compre Corta-Cura precoce (Golpe do Carrasco) e feche itens de letalidade para explodi-la com W Fortalecido + Ignite sem dar chance de cura.

Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent. 

(7) Respect Soraka R -  Soraka’s R can be quite the game changing ability if she’s able to provide it, as it can massively heal her teammates on top of also removing any grievous wounds applied onto targets. Soraka R is a giant ability so if you’re able to remove that from her by trying to force dives then disengaging, or just generally look for kill trades, then this will present a giant advantage across kills on the map. 

(8) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Soraka's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Soraka’s power through the mid to late game stages is on par with a lot of late game carries in general, due to her insane healing potential out of her kit. Renekton’s role against Soraka is to essentially hard focus her within the fight, as your damage and catch potential is way too high for Soraka to deal with. Picking Soraka in solo lane is also very hard to pilot without a front liner to protect her, so abuse her comps disadvantage to force an engage solely onto her to easily win the fight.

Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Soraka R é uma habilidade gigante, então se você for capaz de removê-la dela tentando mergulhos forçados e depois desengatando, ou apenas procurando por trocas de morte, então isso apresentará uma vantagem gigante entre mortes no mapa. 

(8) Construa Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Soraka e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

O papel de Renekton contra Soraka é essencialmente focá-la fortemente na luta, já que seu potencial de dano e captura é muito alto para Soraka lidar. Escolher Soraka na rota solo também é muito difícil de pilotar sem uma linha de frente para protegê-la, então abuse de sua desvantagem de composição para forçar um engage apenas sobre ela para vencer facilmente a luta.

videoTitle: Renekton ADC vs Swain - EUW Master Patch 26.16
summaryEn: Swain relies on landing Nevermove (E) roots and stacking soul fragments. Start E at level 1 to dodge his root return and punish him with PTA autos. In level 3+ trades, dodge his E with your dashes and lock him with Empowered W. At level 6 when Swain triggers Demonic Ascension (R), kite out of his drain zone with E, wait out his ultimate, and re-engage with Dominus (R) and anti-heal for an easy kill.

Nas trocas de nível 3+, desvie do Nevermove de Swain usando seus dashes e trave-o com W Fortalecido. No nível 6, quando Swain ativar a Ascensão Demoníaca (R), não faça trocas estendidas dentro do círculo dele sem necessidade: use o E para recuar, aguarde o R dele expirar e retorne com Dominus (R) e all-in mortal com Corta-Cura.

(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Swain level 1, you're most likely able to kill him With Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Swain lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Swain Q - Swain’s main poking tool within the lane is his Q ability, which he can use to strike enemies in a cone in front of him. Typically Swain Q costs a lot of mana early, so any chance he uses Q will expend a lot of his mana. Try to use short in and out clicks to bait his Q’s, allowing you to easily bait it out then punish right after with an E combo, as long as he also misses his E. 

(4) Avoid Swain E - Swain E essentially sets up his entire combo pattern as he can E > W > Q, allowing him to stun and burst his target down, on top of also gaining passive stacks for landing E and W. Swain E is typically easy to avoid, as you can also bait it out using short in and out clicks like I previously mentioned, to help you bait his E into you getting a free chance to combo him after he misses. Swain E is 12 seconds at rank 1, so typically wait until he uses it, which is either when you walk up to CS minions, walking towards him, or dashing towards him - Which you can side step or use E2, to avoid his E stun when dashing onto him. 

(5) Avoid Swain W - Swain W is generally a hard ability for him to hit, outside of being locked in his E root, or looking at the item shop without noticing his W. Overall make sure to avoid ever being hit by W, otherwise Swain obtains free HP stacks from hitting his ability, as well as marking you on the map for everyone to see your location. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) Respect Swain R - Once Swain obtains R, he’s able to use this to consistently DPS and heal against his targets, while also being able to maintain his R for as long as he’s in combat. Another thing to note is that he can constantly apply his item effects, such as Rylai’s or Deathfire Torch. When Renekton has R, Swain can’t really overpower Renekton in the 1v1’s, so make sure to use your ultimate as soon as Swain does, then play around your empowered abilities and healing reduction to utilities of ignite or executioners to overpower him. Alternatively, you can always bait out Swain R and dash out right after, as this puts his CD onto a long CD and prevents him from being able to skirmish or teamfight effectively. 

(9) Build Executioner’s, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Executioner’s to apply grievous wounds to lower Swain’s overall healing, make sure to get it if you’re not playing Ignite. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Swain's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Swain’s main strengths are reaching his core items of which usually depend on his overall playstyle. Some Swain players prefer Rylai’s rush into Fimblewinter, to help them front line and tank for their team. While others prefer  Deathfire Torch into Liandries, honing in on their ability to shred HP using their AoE damage R. Overall, Swain functions the same way, as typically you want to avoid any fights against Swain while trying to actively poke him out before he gets close, or bait his R into disengaging. Typically baiting out Swain R in solo queue is hard, but you can side lane within the mid game to help you force a trade against him, allowing you to bait out the R before any fights. But, if you’re going to do this, make sure to do it when his teammates aren’t nearby, otherwise they will easily be able to shut you down and regret that decision. When it comes to teamfights, try to shut down Swain’s carries first as Swain’s damage is only issue the longer the fights get, which typically happens if people try to focus on Swain first. Once Swain’s carries are dead, try to turn on swain and make sure to apply your healing reduction onto him to make him easily killable.

Tente usar cliques curtos de entrada e saída para atrair seus Qs, permitindo que você os atraia facilmente e depois castigue logo em seguida com um combo E, desde que ele também erre seu E.

tips.titlePt: Evite Swain E
tips.contentEn: Swain E essentially sets up his entire combo pattern as he can E > W > Q, allowing him to stun and burst his target down, on top of also gaining passive stacks for landing E and W. Swain E is typically easy to avoid, as you can also bait it out using short in and out clicks like I previously mentioned, to help you bait his E into you getting a free chance to combo him after he misses. Swain E is 12 seconds at rank 1, so typically wait until he uses it, which is either when you walk up to CS minions, walking towards him, or dashing towards him - Which you can side step or use E2, to avoid his E stun when dashing onto him.
tips.contentPt: Swain E essencialmente configura todo o seu padrão de combo como ele pode E> W> Q, permitindo que ele atordoe e burst seu alvo para baixo, além de também ganhar stacks passivos para acertar E e W. Swain E normalmente é fácil de evitar, já que você também pode atraí-lo usando cliques curtos de entrada e saída como mencionei anteriormente, para ajudá-lo a atrair seu E para que você tenha uma chance grátis de combo com ele depois que ele errar. Swain E dura 12 segundos no nível 1, então normalmente espere até que ele o use, que é quando você caminha até os lacaios CS, caminhando em direção a ele ou correndo em direção a ele - o que você pode dar um passo lateral ou usar E2, para evitar seu atordoamento E ao correr para ele.

tips.titlePt: Evite Swain W
tips.contentEn: Swain W is generally a hard ability for him to hit, outside of being locked in his E root, or looking at the item shop without noticing his W. Overall make sure to avoid ever being hit by W, otherwise Swain obtains free HP stacks from hitting his ability, as well as marking you on the map for everyone to see your location.
tips.contentPt: Swain W geralmente é uma habilidade difícil de acertar, exceto por ficar preso em sua raiz E ou olhar para a loja de itens sem perceber seu W. No geral, certifique-se de evitar ser atingido por W, caso contrário, Swain obtém pilhas de HP grátis on-hit sua habilidade, além de marcá-lo no mapa para que todos vejam sua localização.

tips.titlePt: Mantenha a Wave do seu Lado
tips.contentEn: Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.
tips.contentPt: Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Rápidas (Short Trades)
tips.contentEn: E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash.
tips.contentPt: E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Swain R
tips.contentEn: Once Swain obtains R, he’s able to use this to consistently DPS and heal against his targets, while also being able to maintain his R for as long as he’s in combat. Another thing to note is that he can constantly apply his item effects, such as Rylai’s or Deathfire Torch. When Renekton has R, Swain can’t really overpower Renekton in the 1v1’s, so make sure to use your ultimate as soon as Swain does, then play around your empowered abilities and healing reduction to utilities of ignite or executioners to overpower him. Alternatively, you can always bait out Swain R and dash out right after, as this puts his CD onto a long CD and prevents him from being able to skirmish or teamfight effectively.
tips.contentPt: Depois que Swain obtiver R, ele será capaz de usá-lo para DPS e Heal consistentemente contra seus alvos, ao mesmo tempo em que será capaz de manter seu R enquanto estiver em combate. Outra coisa a notar é que ele pode aplicar constantemente os efeitos de seus itens, como Rylai ou Deathfire Torch. Quando Renekton tem R, Swain não pode realmente dominar Renekton nos 1v1, então certifique-se de usar seu ultimate assim que Swain o fizer, então brinque com suas habilidades fortalecidas e redução de cura para utilitários de Ignite ou executores para dominá-lo. Alternativamente, você sempre pode atrair Swain R e sair correndo logo em seguida, pois isso coloca seu CD em um CD longo e o impede de ser capaz de skirmish ou teamfight efetivamente.

tips.titleEn: Build Executioner’s, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Executioner’s, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Executioner’s to apply grievous wounds to lower Swain’s overall healing, make sure to get it if you’re not playing Ignite. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Swain's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá para o Executioner para aplicar ferimentos graves para diminuir a cura geral de Swain, certifique-se de obtê-lo se não estiver jogando Ignite. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Swain e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Swain’s main strengths are reaching his core items of which usually depend on his overall playstyle. Some Swain players prefer Rylai’s rush into Fimblewinter, to help them front line and tank for their team. While others prefer  Deathfire Torch into Liandries, honing in on their ability to shred HP using their AoE damage R. Overall, Swain functions the same way, as typically you want to avoid any fights against Swain while trying to actively poke him out before he gets close, or bait his R into disengaging. Typically baiting out Swain R in solo queue is hard, but you can side lane within the mid game to help you force a trade against him, allowing you to bait out the R before any fights. But, if you’re going to do this, make sure to do it when his teammates aren’t nearby, otherwise they will easily be able to shut you down and regret that decision. When it comes to teamfights, try to shut down Swain’s carries first as Swain’s damage is only issue the longer the fights get, which typically happens if people try to focus on Swain first. Once Swain’s carries are dead, try to turn on swain and make sure to apply your healing reduction onto him to make him easily killable.
tips.contentPt: Os principais pontos fortes de Swain são alcançar seus itens principais, que geralmente dependem de seu estilo de jogo geral. Alguns jogadores de Swain preferem a corrida de Rylai para Fimblewinter, para ajudá-los na linha de frente e tanques para seu time. Enquanto outros preferem Deathfire Torch em Liandries, aprimorando sua capacidade de destruir HP usando seu dano AoE R. No geral, Swain funciona da mesma maneira, já que normalmente você deseja evitar qualquer luta contra Swain enquanto tenta ativamente poke ele antes que ele se aproxime, ou atrai seu R para se desligar. Normalmente atrair Swain R na fila solo é difícil, mas você pode usar a rota lateral dentro de mid game para ajudá-lo a forçar uma troca contra ele, permitindo que você atraia o R antes de qualquer luta. Mas, se você for fazer isso, certifique-se de fazê-lo quando os companheiros de equipe dele não estiverem por perto, caso contrário, eles poderão facilmente desligá-lo e se arrepender da decisão. Quando se trata de teamfights, tente desligar os carregamentos de Swain primeiro, pois o dano de Swain só aumenta à medida que as lutas se prolongam, o que normalmente acontece se as pessoas tentarem focar em Swain primeiro. Assim que os carregadores de Swain estiverem mortos, tente ligar Swain e certifique-se de aplicar sua redução de cura nele para torná-lo facilmente matável.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Sylas - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Sylas is a volatile skirmisher who relies on hitting Abduct (E2) chains and healing with Kingslayer (W). Start Q at level 1 for wave priority or W to punish early aggression. The pivotal counter-play: use your E dash to dodge his E2 chains. If Sylas misses E2, he loses the trade entirely. Punish his engage with Empowered W and build early anti-heal (Executioner's) or Merc Treads to counter Kingslayer healing.
summaryPt: Sylas é um duelista mágico que depende de acertar o E2 (Abdução) e curar com o W (Regicida). No nível 1, comece com Q para obter vantagem de onda ou com W para punir avanços precoces dele. O ponto crítico contra Sylas: use o seu E para desviar das correntes do E2 dele. Se Sylas errar o E2, ele perde a maior parte do dano e mobilidade da troca. Guarde seu W Fortalecido para punir a aproximação dele e compre Golpe do Carrasco ou Passos de Mercúrio para cortar a cura massiva do Regicida (W).
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. Level 1 with Q you can also kill Sylas if he is trying to be aggressive. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Sylas level 1, you're most likely able to kill him With Your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Sylas lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Sylas W - Sylas W is a big game changer, as Sylas W allows him to heal more based off his missing HP. With that said, make sure when you’re going for your lethal trades, you apply ignite or healing reduction right at the start of the combo, as he will actively be trying to heal as much as he can. Make sure to also respect Sylas Flash W if you’re low, as he can sustain a lot harder at those points than Renekton can. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent. 

(7) Respect Sylas R Steal - Sylas R isn’t so much a problem when it comes to Renekton, but it’s definitely a problem if he steals your teammates ult, which entirely depends on how good it is for the game. For example, if Sylas can steal a Malphite or Soraka R, it can be entirely game changing for a fight with how much utility both provide. Make sure Sylas doesn’t use your team’s high priority R’s within a fight, try to bait them out when fighting him in side lane, or wait till it expires. If Sylas steals Renekton R it basically does absolutely nothing, instead you can force a fight onto him and stat check him harder than he can with your own R. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.  

(9) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Sylas while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Sylas within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.  

(10) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - As previously mentioned, Sylas’s only playability through the game is trying to take a high value R, to help his teammates chances of being able to win a fight. Sylas already struggles hard in a Renekton match up, so most likely his only chance of being relevant is entirely if he gets a good R. That being said, if Sylas is drafted and there’s absolutely 0 R’s for him to take, then he will overall be a lot more useless. But if Sylas does get a good R, try to avoid its desired advantage in the situation its good for, e.g. Malzahar R to stun lock you down, or Kayle R to protect against lethal combos. Within teamfights, Sylas will most likely try to focus down any target carries, by using his R for an engage or trying to straight up jump on them with his E. As Renekton. We can peel against his engage with our W stun, then look to one shot him right after with our team.
