Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Sylas R Steal
tips.contentEn: Sylas R isn’t so much a problem when it comes to Renekton, but it’s definitely a problem if he steals your teammates ult, which entirely depends on how good it is for the game. For example, if Sylas can steal a Malphite or Soraka R, it can be entirely game changing for a fight with how much utility both provide. Make sure Sylas doesn’t use your team’s high priority R’s within a fight, try to bait them out when fighting him in side lane, or wait till it expires. If Sylas steals Renekton R it basically does absolutely nothing, instead you can force a fight onto him and stat check him harder than he can with your own R.
tips.contentPt: Sylas R não é tanto um problema quando se trata de Renekton, mas é definitivamente um problema se ele roubar a ult de seus companheiros de equipe, o que depende inteiramente de quão bom é para o jogo. Por exemplo, se Sylas pode roubar um Malphite ou Soraka R, isso pode mudar totalmente o jogo para uma luta com a quantidade de utilidade que ambos fornecem. Certifique-se de que Sylas não use os Rs de alta prioridade do seu time em uma luta, tente iscá-los ao lutar com ele na rota lateral ou espere até que expire. Se Sylas roubar Renekton R, basicamente não faz absolutamente nada, em vez disso, você pode forçar uma luta contra ele e stat check com mais força do que ele pode com seu próprio R.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Sylas while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Sylas within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle.
tips.contentPt: Este estilo de jogo permite que você tenha W's constantemente para ajudá-lo a permanecer em Sylas enquanto abusa de suas altas taxas de dano, permitindo que você facilmente snowball e desligue permanentemente Sylas em todas as fases do jogo. Certifique-se de colocar 3 pontos em sua limpeza inicial de wave e poke e, em seguida, obtenha o máximo de W no restante de seus pontos. Depois de concluído, maximize seu E para obter mobilidade adicional para ajudar a permitir seu estilo de jogo que abusa do atordoamento de perto.

tips.titleEn: Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: As previously mentioned, Sylas’s only playability through the game is trying to take a high value R, to help his teammates chances of being able to win a fight. Sylas already struggles hard in a Renekton match up, so most likely his only chance of being relevant is entirely if he gets a good R. That being said, if Sylas is drafted and there’s absolutely 0 R’s for him to take, then he will overall be a lot more useless. But if Sylas does get a good R, try to avoid its desired advantage in the situation its good for, e.g. Malzahar R to stun lock you down, or Kayle R to protect against lethal combos. Within teamfights, Sylas will most likely try to focus down any target carries, by using his R for an engage or trying to straight up jump on them with his E. As Renekton. We can peel against his engage with our W stun, then look to one shot him right after with our team.
tips.contentPt: Como mencionado anteriormente, a única jogabilidade de Sylas durante o jogo é tentar obter um R de alto valor, para aumentar as chances de seus companheiros de equipe vencerem uma luta. Sylas já luta muito em um confronto Renekton, então provavelmente sua única chance de ser relevante é inteiramente se ele obtiver um bom R. Dito isto, se Sylas for draftado e houver absolutamente 0 R’s para ele aceitar, então ele será no geral muito mais inútil. Mas se Sylas obtiver um bom R, tente evitar a vantagem desejada na situação para a qual é bom, por exemplo. Malzahar R para atordoar você, ou Kayle R para proteger contra combos letais. Dentro de teamfights, Sylas provavelmente tentará focar em qualquer alvo carregado, usando seu R para um engage ou tentando pular direto sobre eles com seu E. Como Renekton. Podemos peel contra seu engage com nosso atordoamento W, e então dar one-shot nele logo em seguida com nossa equipe.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de W para aplicar dano concentrado com PTA e atordoar oponentes agressivos no nível 1.
level1ExplanationEn: Start W to stun aggressive opponents and trade with PTA.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Sylas e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Sylas with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Sylas.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Sylas's disengage crowd control.

tips.titlePt: Pressão Constante no Início da Rota
tips.contentEn: Sylas has weak early game stats and poor wave clear. Utilize Q and W for trades in levels 1-3 to gain a health advantage and create a CS lead.
tips.contentPt: Sylas sofre contra o dano físico constante de Renekton no early game. Force trocas frequentes para deixá-lo com vida baixa e forçar o gasto de mana no W.

tips.titlePt: Maximize o Uso do W Fortalecido e Corta-Cura
tips.contentEn: Sylas's W provides good sustain with its missing health-based healing. Use Renekton's Empowered W (three attacks, shield break, 1.5-second stun) to nullify Sylas's healing and gain an advantage in trades.
tips.contentPt: O W Fortalecido de Renekton remove os escudos de Sylas e, com Feridas Dolorosas (Ignite/Carrasco), anula a cura de virada do W dele.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Syndra - KR Grandmaster Patch 25.24
summaryEn: Solo lane Syndra zones with Dark Spheres and Scatter the Weak (E) knockbacks. Start E at level 1 for instant PTA trades. At level 3+, use your first E dash to bait her E knockback, then follow up with E2 or Flash to close the gap and execute with Empowered W + Q. Build Mercury's Treads and Hexdrinker to survive her level 6 burst and dominate the lane.
summaryPt: Syndra na rota solo mantém distância com esferas sombrias e o empurrão do Dispersar os Fracos (E). No nível 1, inicie com E para realizar a troca com PTA (E1 > auto-ataques > E2). Nas trocas do nível 3+, use o primeiro dash do E para forçar o empurrão (E) de Syndra; em seguida, use o segundo dash (E2) ou Flash para alcançá-la e execute-a com W Fortalecido + Q. Construa Passos de Mercúrio e Hexdrinker para anular o burst de poder de Syndra no nível 6.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Syndra you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Syndra lose a lot more. 

(3) Play For Sustain Early - Outside of being able to potentially cheese her level 1, Syndra regains lane strength once reaching level 3, by being able to peel Renekton away with her E to prevent any hard trades. When also laning vs Syndra, her low CD poke from her Q allows her to be aggressive and set up her aggressive E and W trades, making her very oppressive. To make matters easier, try to take D Shield and Second Wind to help you sustain, allowing you to mana burn her before Lost Chapter to provide you with any play making opportunities when she’s on low mana. 

(4) Respect Syndra BALLS - Respecting Syndra’s big BALLS and tracking where they’re placed is the main skill element of this match up. Depending on where Syndra positions her balls she is able to consistently stun Renekton using her E, on top of utilising her W to slow and provide consistent range damage against Renekton. Try to use short in and out clicks between minions and her, to help bait out her Q. When you’re low and fighting her, try to also respect her using Q to help her obtain extra damage for her R. Overall if you can rush Mercury Treads and play for sustain, Syndra won’t really be able to kill you if you’re playing it well.

(5) Bait Out Syndra E - Being able to kill Syndra entirely depends on how she uses her E within the lane. As mentioned, Syndra can knock back and stun Renekton as long as she pushes a ball back into you with her E, stunning for up to 1.25 seconds. If Syndra uses E without her ball hitting into you, it can only knock you back, presenting the opportunity to E and capitalise on her missed stun. Syndra can usually be killed if she misplays, but also keep in mind she will only E if you dash into her. If she uses E for any other reason to be aggressive, you can look to fight right after it. Potentially if you can mind game her enough, you can E1 or use both dashes, quick enough to dodge her own E. 

(7) Rush Mercury Treads - Mercury Treads are very important within the Syndra lane as you’re able to consistently tank her damage, use mobility to each dodge her Q and W abilities, as well as coming out of her stun a lot faster with the tenacity. Overall Mercury Treads really hard counter Syndra, providing you the ability to have more plays leading to eventual kills. Syndra can’t really win 1v1’s without peeling back and playing to burst, so once she misses on any abilities or has no room to run, make sure to abuse this and fight her at will.

(8) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 
(9) Play For Ganks - Syndra can be really hard to fight in isolation, especially if you’re laning against her mid lane, so make sure to play the wave on your side to force her to overextend for ganks. Syndra can only have one target to stun, so no matter what you may always be able to get her flash if you and your jungler play it optimally. Getting her flash is also gigantic in the lane, as Syndra has no mobility to really defend herself against any flash plays you can pull out onto her. 

(10) Respect Syndra R - Syndra is a great tool to burst down her enemies when they’re low, as Syndra R also scales off how many balls she has present around her, as well her R providing an execute if she has 100 passive stacks. Try to avoid being around Syndra whenever you’re low, as it provides a free opportunity to kill you with her R. Try to also protect your teammates if Syndra is trying to use R on them, by jumping onto her and preventing her from getting any closer.

(10) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Hexdrinker to lower Syndra’s overall damage and have a MR shield. / - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Syndra’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Syndra’s role with the mid game is to play off her range and catch ability, to either deter enemies from straight up engaging onto her or her team, or using her E to catch anyone that’s mispositioned or in front of her. Syndra’s general presence always makes it very awkward to directly approach her, especially within teamfighting scenarios with her E. As Renekton, our preferred scenario is being able to catch out Syndra, with either our team’s AoE or ranged sun abilities, using our flash W to gap close against her, or using fog of war to flank behind Syndra or using it to catch her off guard. Ultimately, if we’re not doing these things teamfights will be very hard to directly take, meaning our best way to play the game is trying to play around our team with the intent of being creative with our picks. When teamfighting, as mentioned try to engage on Syndra with your flash W or solely wait until her E’s on CD before looking for an angle to fight. If you can remove Syndra from the fight, this will increase your changes of winning while stopping Syndra from using R on your teammates or using stuns to ruin your engages.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Syndra, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-la com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Syndra perca muito mais. 

(3) Jogue para sustentar cedo - Além de ser capaz de potencialmente destruir seu level 1, Syndra recupera a força da pista ao atingir level 3, sendo capaz de peel Renekton sair com seu E para evitar qualquer troca difícil. Quando também está na rota contra Syndra, seu CD poke baixo de seu Q permite que ela seja agressiva e configure suas trocas E e W agressivas, tornando-a muito opressiva. Para tornar as coisas mais fáceis, tente pegar D Shield e Second Wind para ajudá-lo a se sustentar, permitindo que você queime mana antes do Capítulo Perdido para lhe fornecer qualquer oportunidade de fazer jogadas quando ela estiver com pouca mana. 

(4) Respeitar as BOLAS do Syndra - Respeitar as BOLAS grandes do Syndra e rastrear onde elas são colocadas é o principal elemento de habilidade deste confronto. Dependendo de onde Syndra posiciona suas bolas, ela é capaz de atordoar Renekton de forma consistente usando seu E, além de utilizar seu W para desacelerar e fornecer dano de alcance consistente contra Renekton. Tente usar cliques curtos de entrada e saída entre os lacaios e ela, para ajudar a atrair seu Q. Quando você estiver baixo e lutando contra ela, tente também respeitá-la usando Q para ajudá-la a obter dano extra para seu R. No geral, se você puder apressar Mercury Treads e jogar para sustentar, Syndra não será realmente capaz de matá-lo se você estiver jogando bem.

(5) Bait Out Syndra E - Ser capaz de matar Syndra depende inteiramente de como ela usa seu E dentro da pista. Como mencionado, Syndra pode repelir e atordoar Renekton desde que ela empurre uma bola de volta para você com seu E, atordoando por até 1,25 segundos. Se Syndra usar E sem que a bola acerte você, ele só poderá derrubá-lo, apresentando a oportunidade para E e capitalizar seu atordoamento perdido. Syndra geralmente pode ser morto se ela jogar errado, mas também tenha em mente que ela só irá E se você colidir com ela. Se ela usar E por qualquer outro motivo para ser agressiva, você poderá lutar logo depois. Potencialmente, se você conseguir controlá-la o suficiente, você pode E1 ou usar os dois traços, rápido o suficiente para se esquivar de seu próprio E. 

(7) Rush Mercury Treads - Mercury Treads são muito importantes na pista Syndra, pois você é capaz de tankar seu dano de forma consistente, usar mobilidade para se esquivar de suas habilidades Q e W, bem como sair de seu atordoamento muito mais rápido com a tenacidade. No geral, Mercury Treads contra-ataca muito forte Syndra, proporcionando a você a capacidade de ter mais jogadas levando a eventuais mortes. Syndra realmente não pode vencer 1v1 sem recuar e jogar para burst, então, quando ela perder alguma habilidade ou não tiver espaço para correr, certifique-se de abusar disso e lutar contra ela à vontade.

(8) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 
(9) Jogar por ganks - Syndra pode ser muito difícil de lutar isoladamente, especialmente se você estiver na rota intermediária dela, então certifique-se de jogar o wave ao seu lado para forçá-la a se estender demais para ganks. Syndra só pode ter um alvo para atordoar, então não importa o que aconteça, você sempre poderá acertar o Flash dela se você e seu caçador jogarem de maneira ideal. Pegar seu Flash também é gigantesco na pista, já que Syndra não tem mobilidade para realmente se defender contra qualquer jogada de Flash que você possa fazer contra ela. 

(10) Respeite Syndra R - Syndra é uma ótima ferramenta para burst derrubar seus inimigos quando eles estão baixos, já que Syndra R também reduz quantas bolas ela tem ao seu redor, assim como seu R fornecendo uma execução se ela tiver 100 pilhas passivas. Tente evitar ficar perto de Syndra sempre que estiver com pouca energia, pois oferece uma oportunidade gratuita de matá-lo com seu R. Tente também proteger seus companheiros de equipe se Syndra estiver tentando usar R neles, pulando sobre ela e impedindo-a de se aproximar.

(10) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane - Vá Hexdrinker para diminuir o dano geral de Syndra e tenha um escudo MR. / - Vá Eclipse para potência consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Syndra e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

(11) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - O papel de Syndra com o mid game é jogar fora de seu alcance e habilidade de captura, para impedir que os inimigos se envolvam diretamente com ela ou sua equipe, ou usar seu E para pegar qualquer um que esteja mal posicionado ou na frente dela. A presença geral de Syndra sempre torna muito estranho abordá-la diretamente, especialmente em cenários de teamfighting com seu E. Como Renekton, nosso cenário preferido é ser capaz de pegar Syndra, com a AoE de nossa equipe ou habilidades solares de longo alcance, usando nosso Flash W para se aproximar dela, ou usando névoa de guerra para flanquear atrás de Syndra ou usá-la para pegá-la desprevenida. No final das contas, se não fizermos essas coisas, teamfights será muito difícil de aceitar diretamente, o que significa que nossa melhor maneira de jogar é tentar jogar com nossa equipe com a intenção de sermos criativos em nossas escolhas. Quando teamfighting, como mencionado, tente engage em Syndra com seu Flash W ou apenas espere até que seu E esteja em CD antes de procurar um ângulo para lutar. Se você puder remover Syndra da luta, isso aumentará suas chances de vitória e impedirá que Syndra use R em seus companheiros de equipe ou use atordoamentos para arruinar seus combates.

tips.contentPt: Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Jogue para Ganks
tips.contentEn: Syndra can be really hard to fight in isolation, especially if you’re laning against her mid lane, so make sure to play the wave on your side to force her to overextend for ganks. Syndra can only have one target to stun, so no matter what you may always be able to get her flash if you and your jungler play it optimally. Getting her flash is also gigantic in the lane, as Syndra has no mobility to really defend herself against any flash plays you can pull out onto her.
tips.contentPt: Syndra pode ser muito difícil de lutar isoladamente, especialmente se você estiver na rota intermediária dela, então certifique-se de jogar o wave ao seu lado para forçá-la a se estender demais para ganks. Syndra só pode ter um alvo para atordoar, então não importa o que aconteça, você sempre poderá acertar o Flash dela se você e seu caçador jogarem de maneira ideal. Pegar seu Flash também é gigantesco na pista, já que Syndra não tem mobilidade para realmente se defender contra qualquer jogada de Flash que você possa fazer contra ela.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Syndra R
tips.contentEn: Syndra is a great tool to burst down her enemies when they’re low, as Syndra R also scales off how many balls she has present around her, as well her R providing an execute if she has 100 passive stacks. Try to avoid being around Syndra whenever you’re low, as it provides a free opportunity to kill you with her R. Try to also protect your teammates if Syndra is trying to use R on them, by jumping onto her and preventing her from getting any closer.
tips.contentPt: Syndra é uma ótima ferramenta para burst derrubar seus inimigos quando eles estão baixos, já que Syndra R também reduz quantas bolas ela tem ao seu redor, assim como seu R fornece uma execução se ela tiver 100 pilhas passivas. tente evitar ficar perto de Syndra sempre que estiver com pouca energia, pois isso oferece uma oportunidade gratuita de matá-lo com o R dela. Tente também proteger seus companheiros de equipe se Syndra estiver tentando usar R neles, pulando sobre ela e impedindo-a de se aproximar.

tips.contentEn: Go Hexdrinker to lower Syndra’s overall damage and have a MR shield. / - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Syndra’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Hexdrinker para diminuir o dano geral de Syndra e tenha um escudo MR. / - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Syndra e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Syndra’s role with the mid game is to play off her range and catch ability, to either deter enemies from straight up engaging onto her or her team, or using her E to catch anyone that’s mispositioned or in front of her. Syndra’s general presence always makes it very awkward to directly approach her, especially within teamfighting scenarios with her E. As Renekton, our preferred scenario is being able to catch out Syndra, with either our team’s AoE or ranged sun abilities, using our flash W to gap close against her, or using fog of war to flank behind Syndra or using it to catch her off guard. Ultimately, if we’re not doing these things teamfights will be very hard to directly take, meaning our best way to play the game is trying to play around our team with the intent of being creative with our picks. When teamfighting, as mentioned try to engage on Syndra with your flash W or solely wait until her E’s on CD before looking for an angle to fight. If you can remove Syndra from the fight, this will increase your changes of winning while stopping Syndra from using R on your teammates or using stuns to ruin your engages.
tips.contentPt: O papel de Syndra com o mid game é usar seu alcance e habilidade de captura, para impedir que os inimigos se envolvam diretamente com ela ou sua equipe, ou usar seu E para pegar qualquer um que esteja mal posicionado ou na frente dela. A presença geral de Syndra sempre torna muito estranho abordá-la diretamente, especialmente em cenários teamfighting com seu E. Como Renekton, nosso cenário preferido é ser capaz de pegar Syndra, com a AoE de nossa equipe ou habilidades solares de longo alcance, usando nosso Flash W para se aproximar dela, ou usando névoa de guerra para flanquear atrás de Syndra ou usá-la para pegá-la desprevenida. No final das contas, se não fizermos essas coisas, teamfights será muito difícil de aceitar diretamente, o que significa que nossa melhor maneira de jogar é tentar jogar com nossa equipe com a intenção de sermos criativos em nossas escolhas. Quando teamfighting, como mencionado, tente engage em Syndra com seu Flash W ou apenas espere até que seu E esteja em CD antes de procurar um ângulo para lutar. Se você puder remover Syndra da luta, isso aumentará suas chances de vitória e impedirá que Syndra use R em seus companheiros de equipe ou use atordoamentos para arruinar seus combates.

videoTitle: Khan Top Renekton vs Tahm Kench lol KR solo rank Full Game 15.20 | 칸 레넥톤 vs 탐 켄치
summaryEn: Tahm Kench is an oppressive tank duelist with Thick Skin (E) grey health shields and Tongue Lash (Q) slows. Start Q at level 1 to push for level 2, standing behind your minion wave to block his Q tongue lashes. Avoid extended slugfests that allow him to stack 3 passive stacks. Renekton's ultimate counter-play: when Tahm Kench activates his massive E grey health shield, Renekton's Empowered W instantly breaks 100% of the shield, securing winning duels with Black Cleaver.
summaryPt: Tahm Kench é um dos tanques mais duráveis e opressivos no 1v1 devido à sua Vida Cinza (E) e lentidão da Língua-Chicote (Q). No nível 1, empurre a onda com Q para buscar o nível 2 e fique sempre atrás dos seus minions para bloquear o Q dele. Evite trocas prolongadas onde Tahm Kench possa acumular 3 marcas da passiva e devorar você. A grande arma do Renekton contra Tahm Kench é o W Fortalecido: quando Tahm Kench ativar o escudo cinza gigante com o E, use o W Fortalecido para estilhaçar 100% do escudo instantaneamente, virando o duelo a seu favor com Cutelo Negro.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Tahm Kench with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Tahm Kench. Try to actively avoid taking Tahm’s Q, by playing off the edge of your Q and minions 

(2) Abuse Renekton's Waveclear - Renekton’s biggest strength vs Tahm Kench is using his Q and E wave clear towards his advantage. Renekton’s wave clear remains a big problem for Tahm Kench, as Renekton is able to easily proxy, force recall timers or build waves, into resetting on Tahm Kench. Tahm’s lack of wave clear makes it super hard for him to contest pushes, as well matching Renekton’s item leads he gets from returning to lane. Make sure to use your advantage to always get the upper hand on Tahm Kench, allowing you to force him into lane longer and preventing him from resetting without losing gold or xp.

(3) Respect Tahm Passive - Tahm Kench’s passive is a core element to avoid within the match up, as he’s able to stun his target with his Q or eat them up using his R. When playing vs Tahm, try to always avoid tanking more than 1 or 2 hits, while making sure to walk back and kite him towards your minion wave. Doing this will allow you to have minions trade against his damage, on top of avoiding his potential benefits while being on his side of the map.

(4) Respect And Avoid Tahm's Q - Tahm’s Q is where most of his power resides, as he’s able to deal considerable magic damage towards his target as well as being able to heal based on his missing HP. When fighting Tahm, you typically want to try and abuse him after he uses his Q, as he’s unable to sustain or synergise his Q with his 3 passive stacks. Make sure to utilise minions to block his Q, or move side to side to avoid getting hit by his Q. 

(5) Abuse Empowered Q / E - Within this match up, using empowered Q and E are both very important for dealing with Tahm Kench. Using your empowered Q will help you out sustain, poke or shove minion waves at uncontestable power, while Renekton’s E helps later on in the game to help shred Tahm’s Armour, while synergising with your BoTRK, Black Cleaver or Eclipse items. Make sure to use both within the game to help you poke or shred against Tahm’s resistances. 

(6) Respect Tahm's Gank Setup - Tahm Kench has pretty great gank setup with his kit, as he’s able to land his Q then look to use his W as a knock up. Try to always ward or track where the jungler is, as this provides a lot of impact towards Tahm Kench in being able to kill Renekton. Make sure to also use your E to avoid Tahm Kench’s W, while also using your movement to side step any Q’s he tries to throw.

(7) Respect Tahm Kench’s R - Tahm’s R allows him to eat and reposition his opponent away from his side of the map, allowing his R to be a great tool in denying his opponents to run away or allowing him to finish off kills. Make sure to always avoid being eaten by his R if you don’t have R, as his power to stat check is increased through his access to having R. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Tahm Kench’s overall role within the mid to late game is to either push side lanes with his heart steel build and early advantage, or play around his team with the playstyle of protecting his main carries. Renekton’s role against Tahm Kench should involve building items such as BoTRK or Eclipse to help him health shred his higher HP builds, as well as allowing Renekton to fight him within the side lane. In the event Tahm Kench gets an early advantage, Renekton will need his team to help him shut him down within fights, as this provides Renekton the ability to successfully shut him down. If Renekton gets ahead early, Tahm Kench cannot match Renekton’s heavy snowballing and versatile gameplay. Within teamfights, Tahm Kench will try to either hard focus Renekton’s squishy carries, or he will play to protect his main carry with R. Our job is to either protect our carries from his engages, using our W and Empowered E shred to help apply the utility needed to shut him down. Or, we can try to look to jump on his carries, however try to let Tahm Kench make the move on your team before you commit to doing this. Overall, this match up entirely depends on Tahm Kench’s overall positioning, which if he plays aggressive we can exploit this by killing his carries before he’s able to use R on them.

summaryEn: Taliyah seeks to kite with Threaded Volley (Q) and Unraveled Earth (E) minefields. Start E at level 1 with Doran's Shield for early sustain. (2) Avoid Taliyah Q Poke - Taliyah’s Q’s CD and high damage completely deters Renekton from being able to do much in lane, with that said all we can do is play around her minions and try to avoid any Q’s by walking side to side and utilising good movement. (4) Respect Taliyah's E - By far one of the most horrible abilities to play vs in the game, as her E can completely cancel your dash and stun you into her one shot. (5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Be aware of her pick potential with her team, try not to overextend without knowing where she or her team is. Within teamfights let her use her E first, in which you can abuse this right after by jumping onto her with your dashes or flash. Overall, your objective ranges between avoiding skirmishes or walking into fog of war territories vs Taliyah, while trying to look for picks and playing to protect your win conditions.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Talon - KR Master Patch 25.22
summaryEn: Talon possesses lethal early bleed damage if he lands both parts of Rake (W). Dodge the return arc of his W at level 1 to deny his 3-stack bleed. The matchup heavily favors Renekton: whenever Talon uses Noxian Diplomacy (Q) into melee range, instantly stun him with Empowered W + Q. No nível 1, comece com Q ou W e desvie do retorno do W de Talon para não tomar 3 marcas. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Talon's Passive - Talon’s passive is a big reason why he is named the first blood king, however if you properly play around it you can also show Talon why Renekton is the king of top laning. As long as you never provide Talon any stacks, from avoiding his W and Q procs, he won’t be able to squeeze out the trades he wants, resulting in a very hard match up for Talon overall. 

(2) Level 1 Q or E Start - As mentioned through other notes, playing off Q and E both require different plays, however in this match up you can essentially do either of them and have pretty good success. With that said, play around the strengths of level 1 and look for a level 2 kill. 

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Talon you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Talon lose a lot more. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Ping Talon's Roams - Talon’s main cause of concern is his excellent roaming ability, in which he is able to quickly traverse the map with his high movement speed builds and his E ability. Try to always ping Talon’s movements as much as possible, as this will completely deny any opportunities to pick off kills, preventing him from snowballing the map and getting his team ahead.

detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Taric's Level 1 Cheese - Taric’s level 1 cheese is one of the most crazy and psychotic things I’ve seen. Taric can essentially cheese level 1 taking his E stun, then repeatedly auto attacking you down till it resets from his on hit passive. Taric can hard cheese most melee match ups in the game with this, so make sure to avoid fighting level 1 and play to hit your level 2/3 spikes.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you reach your level 2 and 3 powerspike, you’rte essentially able to start fighting Taric within the lane. One you chunk him out you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Taric lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Taric's E Spam - As previously mentioned, Taric’s E spam can be a decider factor for 1v1’s, so try not to stand toe to toe unless you’re able to reposition away from his E stun. If you miss the stun you’re more than likely to always win fights, so try and play for that and look to abuse its CD. 

(4) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(7) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to easily deal with Taric, in the ability to perma stun lock him down within 1v1’s. This playstyle essentially makes it so Taric cannot do anything, which he already couldn’t do past level 1. So for more dueling and overall play potential in the side lane, you should abuse this as hard as you can. 

(8) Respect Taric's R - Taric’s R is the only tool later on in the game you have to really play around, as his R is available to save and completely change all forms of teamfights if he gets the chance to use it properly. When playing against Taric, try to burn it out and either kill him or the targets fast enough before they use the ult, or simply disengage and burn it out before a major objective. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Taric’s overall focus as a champion is to play around his strong carries using his abilities to sustain, stun or provide invulnerability. As Renekton, you should try to abuse your strong side laning potential to take all the towers you can against Taric, as he isn’t available to really provide any resistance against that. Within teamfights, as previously mentioned, playing around his R is vital in being able to win or lose. Trying to nuke his carries is very important before they get his R, otherwise depending on the champion, they will be able to hard 1v1 and create a lot of difficulties in trying to kill them. Simply play with the aim to use your full damage to kill his carries, so that his R loses all value in being able to win fights. Alternatively, playing to bait out R into a disengage is also just as good as you’re able to get a free ability within the threat of overtrading into his R.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Pesadas (Heavy Trades)
tips.contentEn: Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Sendo que Renekton carrega muitos danos altos, Renekton é capaz de pular em seu alvo quase à vontade. Sempre que seus laners apresentarem a você a habilidade de pular sobre eles, simplesmente aproveite a oportunidade para burst eles o máximo que puder. Se você ainda não os matou, use suas opções de freezing ou sua habilidade tower diving para ajudá-lo a acabar com seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: This playstyle allows you to easily deal with Taric, in the ability to perma stun lock him down within 1v1’s. This playstyle essentially makes it so Taric cannot do anything, which he already couldn’t do past level 1. So for more dueling and overall play potential in the side lane, you should abuse this as hard as you can.
tips.contentPt: Este estilo de jogo permite que você lide facilmente com Taric, na capacidade de atordoá-lo permanentemente e prendê-lo dentro de 1v1. Esse estilo de jogo essencialmente faz com que Taric não possa fazer nada, o que ele já não poderia fazer depois de level 1. Portanto, para mais duelos e potencial de jogo geral na rota lateral, você deve abusar disso o máximo que puder.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Taric's R
tips.contentEn: Taric’s R is the only tool later on in the game you have to really play around, as his R is available to save and completely change all forms of teamfights if he gets the chance to use it properly. When playing against Taric, try to burn it out and either kill him or the targets fast enough before they use the ult, or simply disengage and burn it out before a major objective.
tips.contentPt: O R de Taric é a única ferramenta mais tarde no jogo que você realmente precisa experimentar, já que seu R está disponível para salvar e alterar completamente todas as formas de teamfights se ele tiver a chance de usá-lo corretamente. Ao jogar contra Taric, tente queimá-lo e matá-lo ou aos alvos rápido o suficiente antes de usarem o ult, ou simplesmente disengage e queimá-lo antes de um objetivo principal.

tips.titleEn: Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK
tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK

tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Taric’s overall focus as a champion is to play around his strong carries using his abilities to sustain, stun or provide invulnerability. As Renekton, you should try to abuse your strong side laning potential to take all the towers you can against Taric, as he isn’t available to really provide any resistance against that. Within teamfights, as previously mentioned, playing around his R is vital in being able to win or lose. Trying to nuke his carries is very important before they get his R, otherwise depending on the champion, they will be able to hard 1v1 and create a lot of difficulties in trying to kill them. Simply play with the aim to use your full damage to kill his carries, so that his R loses all value in being able to win fights. Alternatively, playing to bait out R into a disengage is also just as good as you’re able to get a free ability within the threat of overtrading into his R.
tips.contentPt: O foco geral de Taric como campeão é brincar com seus fortes carregadores usando suas habilidades para sustentar, atordoar ou fornecer invulnerabilidade. Como Renekton, você deve tentar abusar de seu forte potencial de rotas laterais para tomar todas as torres que puder contra Taric, já que ele não está disponível para realmente fornecer qualquer resistência contra isso. Dentro de teamfights, como mencionado anteriormente, brincar com seu R é vital para poder ganhar ou perder. tentar destruir seus carrys é muito importante antes que eles consigam seu R, caso contrário, dependendo do campeão, eles serão capazes de dar hard 1v1 e criar muitas dificuldades em tentar matá-los. Basta jogar com o objetivo de usar todo o seu dano para matar seus carregadores, para que seu R perca todo o valor em poder vencer lutas. Alternativamente, jogar para atrair R para um disengage também é tão bom quanto você é capaz de obter uma habilidade gratuita sob a ameaça de overtrading em seu R.

videoTitle: How To Counter And DESTROY Teemo | Renekton Vs Teemo | Commentary #10
summaryEn: Teemo aims to make the lane miserable through Toxic Shot (E) harass, Move Quick (W) kiting, and Blinding Dart (Q). Start Doran's Shield with Second Wind to absorb early poke. The crucial rule against Teemo: NEVER cast Renekton's W while blinded by Teemo's Q, as your stun will completely miss. Instead, dash in with E1 > E2 onto Teemo > absorb the blind while using Q for sustain > then land your Empowered W the exact millisecond the blind expires. Build Mercury's Treads and Hexdrinker/Eclipse to dominate the lane.
summaryPt: Teemo tenta transformar a rota em um pesadelo com veneno passivo (E), velocidade de movimento (W) e o Tiro Cegante (Q). No nível 1, use Doran's Shield e Ventos Revigorantes, evitando tomar dano de graça. A chave tática contra Teemo: NUNCA use o W do Renekton enquanto estiver sob o efeito de Cegueira (Q) de Teemo, pois o atordoamento será desperdiçado. Faça a aproximação com E1 no minion > E2 no Teemo > absorva o dardo cegante > use o Q para dano e cura > e, assim que a cegueira terminar, desfira o W Fortalecido para deletá-lo. Compre Passos de Mercúrio e Hexdrinker/Eclipse para dominar o confronto.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect His Passive - Level 1,  Teemo will most typically hide in the centre of the lane trying to utilise his invisible passive. Play with caution, and let him come out first and let his attack speed buff fall off. 

(2) (1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you start E and chunk out Teemo, you're most likely able to kill him With Flash up. Teemo is very squishy early, the only thing to really note is that if you're going for your lethal trade, make sure to hold W after he blinds, so once you're out of blind you can one shot him with an empowered W and secure the kill. 

(4) Play Around Teemo Blind - Teemo blind is Teemo's only saving grace in the match up. If he blinds you, he can return a lot of auto attacks and kite you out while you're taking a lot of damage. Usually you try to keep your HP up by doing short trades with E > Q > AA or E > Q > E, then eventually when his HP is lower and his mana is overall lower, you can look for the kill by holding W after his blind. 

(5) Quick Trades - Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > E Q E - Depending on if Teemo wastes blind, like the last point just do quick E Q trades to chip off his HP, then look for a longer trade once he is in lethal range around 30-40% HP. 

(6) Rush Mercury Treads - Going Mercs into Teemo is practically a free win as you're able to cut his blind duration by a large amount, while also being able to keep up with Teemo's mobility. Build these to have a much easier time into the match up. 

(7) Don't Hard Chase Teemo - Teemo W is a very annoying ability that can help him kite away and hard trade against you if you make a mistake. Like I already mentioned, mana burning his abilities is important. Stick to short trades, then look for the kill when he is in lethal range. 

(8) Respect Teemo's Shrooms - An obvious point, but obviously sometimes people don't respect the utility Teemo shrooms provide. While Teemo shrooms can poison his targets, it can also slow on top of also applying item passive effects. These item effects can be very deadly the later the game goes, so make sure to buy a red trinket post 6 and kill off any shrooms Teemo places for you and your team. 

(9) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(10) Build Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Hexdrinker to lower Teemo's overall damage and have a MR shield / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Teemo's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(11) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - At this point of the game Teemo will be playing to plant Shrooms on each objective side of the map, in which red trinket is absolutely vital for this point of the game. Make sure to kill off his shrooms around objectives, make sure to also use red trinket to spot Teemo hiding in his passive. In fights, Teemo doesn't typically play a huge factor other than blinding carry targets. Try to one shot him out of the fight if he's in range, then play to kill the rest of his carries.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite sua passiva - level 1, Teemo normalmente se esconderão no centro da pista tentando utilizar sua passiva invisível. Jogue com cautela e deixe-o sair primeiro e deixe seu bônus de velocidade de ataque diminuir. 

(2) (1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(3) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de iniciar o E e separar Teemo, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com Flash ativo. Teemo é muito fraco no início, a única coisa a realmente notar é que se você estiver indo para sua troca letal, certifique-se de segurar W depois que ele cegar, então, quando você estiver fora do cego, você pode atirar nele com um Empowered W e garantir a morte. 

(4) Brincar Teemo Blind - Teemo blind é a única graça salvadora de Teemo no confronto. Se ele cegar você, ele pode devolver muitos auto attacks e kite enquanto você sofre muitos danos. Normalmente você tenta manter seu HP alto fazendo trocas curtas com E > Q > AA ou E > Q > E, então, eventualmente, quando o HP dele estiver menor e sua mana estiver menor no geral, você pode procurar o kill segurando W após seu blind. 

(5) Trocas rápidas - Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > E Q E - Dependendo se Teemo desperdiça cego, como o último ponto apenas faça trocas rápidas de E Q para cortar seu HP, então procure por uma troca mais longa quando ele estiver na faixa letal em torno de 30-40% de HP. 

(6) Rush Mercury Treads - Entrar em Mercs em Teemo é praticamente uma vitória grátis, pois você é capaz de reduzir bastante a duração do blind dele, ao mesmo tempo em que consegue acompanhar a mobilidade de Teemo. Construa-os para facilitar o confronto. 

(7) Don't Hard Chase Teemo - Teemo W é uma habilidade muito irritante que pode ajudá-lo kite a se afastar e fazer uma troca difícil contra você se você cometer um erro. Como já mencionei, esgotar a mana em suas habilidades é importante. Atenha-se a trocas curtas e procure matar quando ele estiver em alcance letal. 

(8) Respeite os cogumelos de Teemo - Um ponto óbvio, mas obviamente às vezes as pessoas não respeitam a utilidade que os cogumelos Teemo fornecem. Embora os cogumelos Teemo possam envenenar seus alvos, eles também podem desacelerar, além de aplicar efeitos passivos de itens. Esses efeitos de itens podem ser muito mortais à medida que o jogo avança, então certifique-se de comprar uma bugiganga vermelha no posto 6 e matar todos os cogumelos Teemo lugares para você e sua equipe. 

(9) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base de Renekton e as stats de seu R permitem que Renekton stat check complete seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

(10) Construa Hexdrinker, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profano - Vá Hexdrinker para diminuir o dano geral de Teemo e tenha um escudo MR / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Go Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Teemo e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe / Go Profane para estilos de jogo focados em dano total.

(11) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - Neste ponto do jogo Teemo estará jogando para plantar cogumelos em cada lado objetivo do mapa, onde a bugiganga vermelha é absolutamente vital para este ponto do jogo. Certifique-se de matar seus cogumelos perto dos objetivos, certifique-se de usar também uma bugiganga vermelha para localizar Teemo escondido em sua passiva. Em lutas, Teemo normalmente não desempenha um grande papel além de cegar os alvos de transporte. tente one-shot nele para fora da luta se ele estiver ao alcance, então jogue para matar o resto de seus carregadores.

videoTitle: Gen Peyz Renekton vs Thresh  - KR CHALLENGER Patch 13.21
summaryEn: Solo lane Thresh looks for Death Sentence (Q) hook setups under tower and Flay (E) disengages. Watch for early invade setups at level 1 and start Q for wave control. Use your E dashes to dodge his hook and collapse on him with Empowered W. Empowered W shatters his Dark Passage (W) lantern shield, ensuring easy kills at levels 3 and 6.
summaryPt: Thresh na rota solo tenta puxar para a torre com a Sentença (Q) e controlar com o Esfolar (E). No nível 1, fique atento a invasões na selva e comece com Q para obter vantagem de onda. Use seus dashes de E para desviar do gancho de Thresh e caia sobre ele com W Fortalecido. O W Fortalecido quebra o escudo da Lanterna (W) de Thresh, garantindo all-ins com 100% de letalidade no nível 3 e 6.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Thresh's Invade Cheese - The only thing Thresh can really do within the start of the game, is simply forcing an invade. 9/10 times Thresh will always force an early invade, these can take place on both sides of the map, so make sure to either cover 5 point vision, or stack up and look to use your comps potential strength to overpower Thresh and his team early. Make sure not to AFK level 1 in the open, be proactive and skill E if you need to avoid his flash Q if you're caught.  

(2) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Thresh with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Thresh.

(3) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Thresh you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Thresh lose a lot more. 

(4) Respect His CC - Thresh's only form of aggression and survivability is based within his CC. If Thresh is able to use his Q, E or R properly within a fight, this can cause some troublesome situations where he is able to lock you out of an entire fight. Try your best to avoid playing into his abilities, such as using minions to block his Q or weaving side to side to avoid his CC. Alternatively, you can also rush Mercury Treads to completely gut his CC duration to present you with more offensive opportunities. 

(5) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(6) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

summaryEn: Solo lane Tristana packs high burst with Explosive Charge (E) and Rocket Jump (W) resets. detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Play For Sustain Early - Tristana’s lane bully playstyle within the beginning of the game can cause slight issues for Renekton’s playstyle, as typically she will be able to out range and out DPS him if he tries to come into contact. Try to play safe by keeping your HP by farming with Q, then trying to play the wave on your side of the map. Utilise D Shield And Second Wind to outsustain and survive the laning phase.

(2) Respect Tristana's Q and E - Tristana’s damage within most stages of the game is very high, this mainly due to her Q and E interactions. Her Q provides her with 60% to 120% additional attack, which combined with her E, she can instantly nuke whoever she puts her bomb on. Within the laning phase, she can chunk really hard if she detonates her bomb, which also resets her W jump. Try to leave her auto attack range if she puts her E onto you, doing this will lose a lot of damage for Tristana, providing you the ability to safely trade with her once it’s on CD. 

(3) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Plated Steelcaps are essential for this match up as Tristana can easily out DPS you, while also being able to easily escape your combos with her W. Once you build plated, you will be easily able to out space Tristana’s range, while also being able to easily soak up a lot more of her auto attacks and her overall AD damage. After this you can get regular damage items or utility, based on whatever your preference for the match up is.

(4) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(5) Play For Ganks - Trying to do combos on Tristana can always be a pain with her naturally long range, high damage and safety tools to peel away Renekton with her R and using her W. With that said though, pre 6 if you’re able to get her W out, while keeping the wave on your side of the map, this will easily present an opportunity to gank a Tristana. Post 6 will be trickier to gank as she can easily R a target away, but as long as you can burn out her R in the process it becomes a lot easier to have your way in the lane against Tristana. Make sure to do either of these things to create an easier time and give yourself the help you need to win the match up. 

(6) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent. 

(8) Ping Tristana's Roams - Tristana’s goals are naturally to try and either hard shove the lane to get easy platings, or simply to roam the map and pick up kills using her W reset and utilising her naturally high damage. With that said, try to always ping out Tristana’s roams and make sure to crash the wave whenever Tristana tries to roam. Doing this results in her missing gold and xp, which are needed to leverage an advantage over Tristana through the game.

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Tristana’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Tristana as a champion works in a strange way, where in the early stage of the game she will out perform and dps a lot of champions within the laning phase. However in the mid portion of the game she becomes very average until she finishes her last couple of items, where her power levels once again spike up to disgusting levels of damage. Tristana’s biggest weaknesses are utilising heavy CC onto her all in damage patterns, alongside her being able to keep her HP up on the outside of a fight. With those in mind, try to hard focus Tristana if she jumps into close range of your team and look to stun one shot her as soon as you can. Alternatively, if you can distract her and her team by engaging on top of her carries or self, your team will be able to free fire ranged or aoe abilities, chunking Tristana out and denying her overall play presence within the game.
