Na fase de rotas (laning phase), ela pode atacar com muita força se detonar sua bomba, o que também reinicia seu salto W. Tente deixar seu alcance auto attack se ela colocar seu E em você, fazendo isso você perderá muito dano para Tristana, proporcionando a você a habilidade de trocar com ela com segurança quando estiver em CD.

tips.titlePt: Rush de Plated Steelcaps
tips.contentEn: Plated Steelcaps are essential for this match up as Tristana can easily out DPS you, while also being able to easily escape your combos with her W. Once you build plated, you will be easily able to out space Tristana’s range, while also being able to easily soak up a lot more of her auto attacks and her overall AD damage. After this you can get regular damage items or utility, based on whatever your preference for the match up is.
tips.contentPt: Plated Steelcaps são essenciais para este confronto, pois Tristana pode facilmente superar DPS você, ao mesmo tempo em que é capaz de escapar facilmente de seus combos com seu W. Depois de construir o platado, você será facilmente capaz de ultrapassar o alcance de Tristana, ao mesmo tempo em que será capaz de absorver facilmente muito mais de seu auto attacks e seu dano geral de AD. Depois disso, você pode obter itens de dano regular ou utilidade, dependendo de sua preferência para o confronto.

tips.titlePt: Mantenha a Wave do seu Lado
tips.contentEn: Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down.
tips.contentPt: Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes com muito mais facilidade em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

tips.titlePt: Jogue para Ganks
tips.contentEn: Trying to do combos on Tristana can always be a pain with her naturally long range, high damage and safety tools to peel away Renekton with her R and using her W. With that said though, pre 6 if you’re able to get her W out, while keeping the wave on your side of the map, this will easily present an opportunity to gank a Tristana. Post 6 will be trickier to gank as she can easily R a target away, but as long as you can burn out her R in the process it becomes a lot easier to have your way in the lane against Tristana. Make sure to do either of these things to create an easier time and give yourself the help you need to win the match up.
tips.contentPt: tentar fazer combos em Tristana pode sempre ser uma dor com seu alcance naturalmente longo, alto dano e ferramentas de segurança para peel afastar Renekton com seu R e usar seu W. Porém, antes de 6, se você conseguir tirar seu W, enquanto mantém o wave do seu lado do mapa, isso facilmente apresentará uma oportunidade para gank um Tristana. A postagem 6 será mais complicada para gank, pois ela pode facilmente fazer R a um alvo de distância, mas contanto que você consiga queimar seu R no processo, será muito mais fácil avançar na pista contra Tristana. Certifique-se de fazer uma dessas coisas para tornar o tempo mais fácil e obter a ajuda necessária para vencer o confronto.

tips.titlePt: Trocas Rápidas (Short Trades)
tips.contentEn: E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash
tips.contentPt: E> Q> AA> W> AA> E Out / E> Q> W> E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.
tips.contentPt: Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base e stats de seu R de Renekton permitem que Renekton stat check completamente seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

tips.titlePt: Ping nas andanças de Tristana
tips.contentEn: Tristana’s goals are naturally to try and either hard shove the lane to get easy platings, or simply to roam the map and pick up kills using her W reset and utilising her naturally high damage. With that said, try to always ping out Tristana’s roams and make sure to crash the wave whenever Tristana tries to roam. Doing this results in her missing gold and xp, which are needed to leverage an advantage over Tristana through the game.
tips.contentPt: Os objetivos de Tristana são naturalmente tentar empurrar com força a rota para obter placas fáceis ou simplesmente roam o mapa e matar usando seu reset W e utilizando seu dano naturalmente alto. Com isso dito, tente sempre fazer ping nos roamings de Tristana e certifique-se de crash o wave sempre que Tristana tentar roam. Fazer isso resulta na perda de ouro e XP, que são necessários para obter vantagem sobre Tristana durante o jogo.

tips.titlePt: Build de Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou Profane Hydra
tips.contentEn: Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Tristana’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.
tips.contentPt: Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Tristana e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo com foco total no dano.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Tristana as a champion works in a strange way, where in the early stage of the game she will out perform and dps a lot of champions within the laning phase. However in the mid portion of the game she becomes very average until she finishes her last couple of items, where her power levels once again spike up to disgusting levels of damage. Tristana’s biggest weaknesses are utilising heavy CC onto her all in damage patterns, alongside her being able to keep her HP up on the outside of a fight. With those in mind, try to hard focus Tristana if she jumps into close range of your team and look to stun one shot her as soon as you can. Alternatively, if you can distract her and her team by engaging on top of her carries or self, your team will be able to free fire ranged or aoe abilities, chunking Tristana out and denying her overall play presence within the game.
tips.contentPt: Tristana como campeã funciona de uma forma estranha, onde na fase inicial do jogo ela terá desempenho superior e DPS muitos campeões dentro da fase de rotas (laning phase). No entanto, no meio do jogo, ela se torna muito mediana até terminar seus últimos itens, onde seus níveis de poder mais uma vez aumentam para níveis de dano nojentos. As maiores fraquezas de Tristana são a utilização de CC pesado em seus padrões de dano de all in, além de ser capaz de manter seu HP alto fora de uma luta. Com isso em mente, tente se concentrar Tristana se ela pular para perto de sua equipe e atordoá-la com one-shot assim que puder. Alternativamente, se você puder distrair ela e sua equipe engajando-se em cima de seus carregadores ou de si mesmo, sua equipe será capaz de liberar habilidades de ataque à distância ou aoe, fragmentando Tristana e negando sua presença geral no jogo.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de E para encurtar a distância e punir a fragilidade de campeões de longo alcance.
level1ExplanationEn: Start E to gapclose and punish ranged champions early.
winConditionPt: Sobreviva ao poke inicial usando D Shield e Second Wind; no nível 3/6 feche a distância com E nos minions, guarde o Flash para o desengaje de Tristana e exploda com W Fortalecido.
winConditionEn: Survive early poke with D Shield and Second Wind; at lvl 3/6 gapclose via minion dash and burst Tristana with Flash + Empowered W.
cautionPt: Não tome dano gratuito ao coletar CS no nível 1 e 2; respeite o controle de grupo de desengaje de Tristana.
cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Tristana's disengage crowd control.

videoTitle: (NBS Strode) Renekton Top vs Trundle - EUW Challenger Patch 26.15
summaryEn: Trundle dominates extended melee slugfests through Chomp (Q) AD steal and Frozen Domain (W). Golden rule: NEVER duel Trundle in level 1 auto-attack fights, as his Q will steal your attack damage and overwhelm you. The proper playstyle is strict hit-and-run short trading: E in > Empowered W stun > Q burst and heal > E2 out before he can retaliate with Chomp. At level 6 when Trundle casts Subjugate (R) to steal your stats, kite back with E and re-engage once his ultimate expires.
summaryPt: Trundle é o rei dos duelos corpo a corpo prolongados graças ao roubo de AD da Mordida (Q) e ao Domínio Congelado (W). A regra de ouro: NUNCA tente trocar auto-ataques no nível 1 com Trundle, pois ele roubará seu AD e vencerá com facilidade. O método correto de jogar contra Trundle é fazer APENAS trocas curtas com hit-and-run: E para entrar > W Fortalecido para atordoar > Q para causar dano e curar > E2 para sair imediatamente antes que ele possa morder você de volta. No nível 6, quando Trundle usar o Subjugar (R) para roubar suas resistências, kite para longe com o E e reengaje após o término da ult dele.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Trundle's Q trades - Most people make the mistake of overtrading with Trundle Level 1, who simply outdamages and kills Renekton players based on the additional AD and low CD Trundle Q has. Instead, you can simply AA Q him, then walk back towards your tower. Each time Trundle gets Q, do not walk into him and over extend the fight. As long as you're patient Trundle cannot really force his Level 1 Advantage.  

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you reach level 2, you can skill W level 2 to assert lane dominance. Having Empowered W level 2 will completely shred Trundle's HP if he tries to bully you off the wave. If Trundle is fairly healthy, try to walk back after doing AA > W > AA > Q. If he's low you can look to kill him off this and force the remaining auto attacks for the kill. 

(3) Respect Trundle W - Trundle's W is another big tool for Trundle's fights. Once Trundle activates W, he will be trying to utilise every second of it. Try to only go for short burst trades, never trade Auto for Auto in his W, otherwise Trundle will smash you down. 

(4) Hold E for Trundle Pillar - A big aspect of this match up that makes it completely unfair for Trundle, is the fact Renekton can completely avoid any aggression from Trundle level 3 onwards. Each trade you do vs Trundle needs to be quick and heavy, once you do your trade E1 towards your side of the map, then if Trundle Pillars, simply E2 through it. Doing this ensures Trundle can never lock down Renekton and punish back after a trade, always resulting in Trundle not being able to do anything. 

(5) Quick Trades - AA > W > AA > Q > AA > E  Out > E2  Pillar / E > Q > AA > W > AA > E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) 3 Points Q > W Max - Make sure to abuse W max in this match up, as it allows Renekton to stand toe to toe vs Trundle at all stages within the game. Renekton W can be abused disgustingly bad vs Trundle as you can always disengage fights after W, followed by using it again another 7-4 seconds later. Definitely Max W to completely ruin Trundle. 

(7) Respect Trundle R - Trundle R is a massive dueling boost for Trundle in 1v1 fights. Depending on how much you have already snowballed, you can afford to tank Trundle R. However if Trundle is semi strong or even, try to instantly disengage with your dashes after he ults, so he can't utilise the additional DPS and stats he steals in a fight. 

(8) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse or BoTRK. - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Trundle's overall damage and utilise the movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Trundle's objective within the mid game is to abuse his crazy tower pushing speed in side lanes, focusing on outdueling his opponents and punishing his enemies every time they leave. As Renekton this can be very awkward if you're fed, overall the objective is to make sure you clear the side lane out each time you look to make a play on the map. However if you don't have Tp, you can communicate your mid laner to side lane vs Trundle as long as they don't fight him. Doing this allows you to use your lead on the map more effectively to help you snowball the map. In other scenarios, you should try to get your team to jump on Trundle to make sure you can take him off the map, then look towards playing objectives or teamfights in the time he is dead. If Trundle joins a regular fight he is relatively useless and easy to peel against with your W max CD and overall armour shred utility. Make sure to protect your teammates and try to obliterate him first if he runs into your team.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite as trocas de Q de Trundle - A maioria das pessoas comete o erro de overtrading com Trundle level 1, que simplesmente supera e mata jogadores de Renekton com base no AD adicional e no baixo Q de CD Trundle. Em vez disso, você pode simplesmente AA Q ele e depois voltar para sua torre. Cada vez que Trundle pegar Q, não esbarre nele e prolongue demais a luta. Contanto que você seja paciente, Trundle não pode realmente forçar sua vantagem level 1.  

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de chegar a level 2, você pode usar a habilidade W level 2 para afirmar o domínio da pista. Ter Empowered W level 2 irá destruir completamente o HP de Trundle se ele tentar tirar você da wave. Se Trundle estiver razoavelmente saudável, tente voltar depois de fazer AA > W > AA > Q. Se ele estiver baixo, você pode conseguir matá-lo e forçar o auto attacks restante a matá-lo. 

(3) Respeite Trundle W - O W de Trundle é outra grande ferramenta para as lutas de Trundle. Assim que Trundle ativar W, ele tentará utilizar cada segundo dele. tente apenas fazer trocas curtas de burst, nunca troque Auto por Auto em seu W, caso contrário Trundle irá derrubá-lo. 

(4) Segure E para Pilar Trundle - Um grande aspecto deste confronto que o torna completamente injusto para Trundle, é o fato de Renekton poder evitar completamente qualquer agressão de Trundle level 3 em diante. Cada troca que você faz vs Trundle precisa ser rápida e pesada, uma vez que você faz sua troca E1 em direção ao seu lado do mapa, então se Trundle Pilares, simplesmente E2 através dela. Fazer isso garante que Trundle nunca possa bloquear Renekton e punir de volta após uma troca, sempre resultando em Trundle não ser capaz de fazer nada. 

(5) Trocas rápidas - AA > W > AA > Q > AA > E Out > E2 Pilar / E > Q > AA > W > AA > E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com baixo HP com Flash. 

(6) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Certifique-se de abusar do W max neste confronto, pois permite que Renekton fique frente a frente contra Trundle em todas as fases do jogo. Renekton W pode ser abusado de forma repugnante contra Trundle, pois você sempre pode disengage lutar após W, seguido de usá-lo novamente 7-4 segundos depois. Definitivamente Max W para arruinar completamente Trundle. 

(7) Respeite Trundle R - Trundle R é um grande impulso de duelo para Trundle em lutas 1v1. Dependendo de quanto você já cresceu como uma bola de neve, você pode tankar Trundle R. No entanto, se Trundle for semiforte ou par, tente instantaneamente disengage com suas investidas após ele ultar, para que ele não possa utilizar o DPS adicional e as stats que ele rouba em uma luta. 

(8) Construa Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse ou BoTRK. - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Trundle e utilize a velocidade de movimento. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O objetivo de Trundle dentro do mid game é abusar de sua torre maluca aumentando a velocidade nas rotas laterais, focando em superar seus oponentes e punir seus inimigos toda vez que eles saem. Como Renekton isso pode ser muito estranho se você estiver alimentado, no geral o objetivo é garantir que você limpe a side lane cada vez que fizer uma jogada no mapa. No entanto, se você não tiver TP, você pode comunicar seu mid laner para side lane contra Trundle, desde que eles não lutem com ele. Fazer isso permite que você use sua liderança no mapa de forma mais eficaz para ajudá-lo a snowball o mapa. Em outros cenários, você deve tentar fazer com que sua equipe pule em Trundle para ter certeza de que pode tirá-lo do mapa e, em seguida, olhar para os objetivos de jogo ou teamfights no momento em que ele estiver morto. Se Trundle se juntar a uma luta normal, ele será relativamente inútil e fácil de peel contra com seu W max CD e utilidade geral de destruição de armadura. Certifique-se de proteger seus companheiros de equipe e tente eliminá-lo primeiro se ele encontrar seu time.

winConditionPt: Controle a wave para criar freezes e force trocas curtas com E > W > Q > E; no mid-game use o E2 Fortalecido para triturar até 35% da armadura de Trundle.
winConditionEn: Control the wave for freezes and execute short E > W > Q > E trades; use Empowered E2 in mid-game to shred Trundle's armor by 35%.
cautionPt: Evite trocas prolongadas onde Trundle possa escalar dano com Aperto dos Mortos-Vivos ou itens de armadura pesada (Coração Congelado / Armadura de Espinhos).
cautionEn: Avoid prolonged trades where Trundle scales damage with Grasp or heavy armor items (Frozen Heart / Thornmail).

tips.titlePt: Aproveitar o Powerspike do Nível 3
tips.contentEn: After Level 3, Renekton has the first strike advantage. When Trundle's W (Frozen Domain) is on cooldown or unavailable, use your E-W-Q combo for a quick trade and disengage to avoid Trundle's sustained combat.
tips.contentPt: Antes do nível 3, o Q de Trundle rouba seu AD. A partir do nível 3, execute trocas curtas e rápidas (hit and run) para evitar que ele estenda a luta na área do W.

tips.titlePt: Respondendo à Ultimate Subjugar (R) de Trundle
tips.contentEn: When Trundle uses his ultimate (R), he steals your Armor and Magic Resist. Utilize the bonus Health and Fury from Renekton's ultimate (R) to sustain through it, or use your E ability to quickly create distance and outlast Trundle's ultimate duration.
tips.contentPt: A Ultimate de Trundle rouba vida e resistências. Não use Dominus (R) imediatamente; guarde seu R para quando a drenagem dele terminar ou use E para recuar e resetar a luta.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Tryndamere - KR Grandmaster Patch 26.06
summaryEn: The Tryndamere matchup revolves around respecting Battle Fury critical strike RNG and controlling early wave trades. Start W at level 1 to punish his early aggression: hit AA + W stun and disengage before he stacks full fury. From level 3 onwards, Renekton dictates the lane with quick short trades (E in > W > Q > E out). Put 3 points in Q then max W for massive burst. At level 6 when Tryndamere triggers Undying Rage (R), DO NOT waste your W stun immediately; kite back with E, pop Dominus (R), and land your W stun during the final 1.5 seconds of his ultimate to execute him the moment invulnerability fades.
summaryPt: O confronto contra Tryndamere gira em torno de respeitar os acertos críticos da passiva de fúria dele e gerenciar o all-in no nível 1-2. No nível 1, se Tryndamere começar a bater na onda para empilhar fúria, comece com W: use AA + W para puni-lo e recue para não trocar auto-ataques longos. A partir do nível 3, Renekton domina o duelo com trocas curtas (E > W > Q > E out). Max W após 3 pontos no Q para maximizar o dano de atordoamento. No nível 6, quando Tryndamere ativar a Fúria Sem Fim (R), NÃO gaste seu W no início da ult dele; kite com o E, ative Dominus (R) e guarde o atordoamento para os últimos 1,5 segundos da ult de Tryndamere para abatê-lo no momento exato em que a imortalidade dele acabar.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Tryndamere’s Level 1 - Tryndamere level 1 is one of the scariest starts to a game you can play against as Renekton. Typically Renekton should try to play passive if Tryndamere gets to hit the wave first, but if you’re able to be there first you can posture to push for level 2 and try to defuse Tryndamere’s level 1 strength. Most typically however, you’re going to have to give Tryndamere push on the first 2 waves before you’re able to play. Try to keep your HP up and don’t greed vs his crit passive, just last hit with Q and short click in and out of the wave to bait out Tryndamere E.

(2) Respect Tryndamere passive - As Tryndamere gains crit based on his fury, it’s in your own interest to respect Trydamere’s passive within long extended fights or if he’s consistently attacking the minion wave.. Try to play for short trades and make him burn his fury  bar by forcing him to use Q. Once tryndamere has no fury Renkton can easily zone off Tryndamere from the wave and stat check him in short to mid range trades.

(3) Play For Level 3 - Once Renekton reaches level 3 within the match up, Renekton is essentially able to fight Tryndamere consistently through his fast combos, and the ability to utilise empowered W’s and dashes to peel off Tryndamere from fighting against him. Use this point of the lane to start being more aggressive, looking to kill Tryndamere before his level 6 powerspike.

(4) Respect Tryndamere W - An underrated aspect about this match up is people trading too heavily into Tryndamere’s W. Tryndamere W lowers from 20AD > 80AD at rank 5, making it an incredibly heavy damage reduction that affects all of Renekton’s AD ratios. Make sure to avoid heavily trading into tryndamere W until it wears off. Sometimes however you will need to W tryndamere as soon as he dashes on you, in which you can try to get your damage off to chunk him, but if you have the option to wait it out then you most certainly should. 

(5) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Respect And Counter Tryndamere R - Tryndamere’s power that comes from winning most of his duels is usually rooted within his R. Tryndamere R is very strong in the fact he can live up to 5 additional seconds, on top of also filling out his fury bar to dish out as much crit damage as he possibly can onto his target. Renekton usually fulfills a great role in being able to easily burst Tryndamere to his R state, so essentially you want to burst him down then kite him out or tank the additional damage through your R until you can finish him off with your abilities or ignite at the end of his R. Make sure to space perfectly if you’re playing squishier builds, or utilise slow items such as Randiun’s to completely counter his crit damage and slow him from escaping. 

(8) 3 Points Q > W Max - Tryndamere gets completely hard countered within this match up as he is unable to duel Renekton if he goes W Max. W max’s utility from the amount of stuns you can receive is way too much for Tryndamere to handle, on top of the extreme amount of damage you can consistently apply onto Tryndamere. No matter if you’re stomping or behind, W max’s playstyle offers a great deterrent for Tryndamere to go for long trades, as your W’s 7-4 second CD is too low for Tryndamere to really deal with.

(9) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK -  Go Plated Steelcaps to lower her Tryndamere's overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Tryndamere’s overall role within the game is to operate as a high pressure split pusher, whose aim is to bring his laner into being side laned with him. This playstyle is overall very annoying no matter if you’re fed or behind, as he completely locks you into being isolated in dealing with him. Renekton typically can fight Tryndamere if he has Eclipse and Randuin's at any point, however if your team is behind and you need to group for teamfights, try to swap another player from your team to lane against him. If no champion can simply survive vs him on your team, try to coordinate a group attack onto Tryndamere to get him out of the game to free up map pressure. In teamfights Tryndamere is generally useless, to which you can just consistently CC him from his engages and look to burst him as fast as you can within the fights. Just make sure to protect your carries and not ignore his engage onto them. .

(5) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(6) Jogue waves de acordo - Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(7) Respeite e contra-ataque Tryndamere R - O poder de Tryndamere que vem de vencer a maioria de seus duelos geralmente está enraizado em seu R. Tryndamere R é muito forte no fato de que ele pode viver até 5 segundos adicionais, além de também preencher sua barra de fúria para distribuir o máximo de dano crítico possível em seu alvo. Renekton geralmente desempenha um grande papel em ser capaz de facilmente burst Tryndamere para seu estado R, então essencialmente você quer burst ele para baixo e então kite para fora ou tankar o dano adicional através de seu R até que você possa acabar com ele com suas habilidades ou Ignite no final de seu R. Certifique-se de espaçar perfeitamente se você estiver jogando builds mais moles, ou utilizar itens lentos como Randiun para neutraliza completamente seu dano crítico e o impede de escapar. 

(8) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Tryndamere é completamente contra-atacado neste confronto, pois ele é incapaz de duelar com Renekton se for W Max. A utilidade do W max pela quantidade de atordoamentos que você pode receber é demais para Tryndamere aguentar, além da quantidade extrema de dano que você pode aplicar consistentemente em Tryndamere. Não importa se você está pisando forte ou atrás, o estilo de jogo do W max oferece um grande impedimento para Tryndamere fazer trocas longas, já que o CD de 7-4 segundos do seu W é muito baixo para Tryndamere realmente lidar.

(9) Construa Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de seu Tryndamere e utilizar a velocidade de movimento adicional. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilidade. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O papel geral de Tryndamere dentro do jogo é operar como um split pusher de alta pressão, cujo objetivo é fazer com que seu laner fique na lateral com ele. No geral, esse estilo de jogo é muito irritante, não importa se você está alimentado ou atrasado, pois ele o impede completamente de ficar isolado ao lidar com ele. Renekton normalmente pode lutar contra Tryndamere se ele tiver Eclipse e Randuin em qualquer momento, porém se seu time estiver atrás e você precisar se agrupar para teamfights, tente trocar outro jogador de seu time para lane contra ele. Se nenhum campeão de sua equipe puder simplesmente sobreviver contra ele, tente coordenar um ataque em grupo em Tryndamere para tirá-lo do jogo e liberar a pressão no mapa. Em teamfights Tryndamere geralmente é inútil, para o qual você pode simplesmente CC ele de seus combates e obtê-lo burst o mais rápido que puder nas lutas. Apenas certifique-se de proteger seus carregadores e não ignorar o engage dele sobre eles. .

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Twisted Fate - KR Grandmaster Patch 25.13
summaryEn: Solo lane Twisted Fate relies on Pick a Card (W) gold card stuns and Wild Cards (Q) poke. Start E at level 1 for instant PTA trade pressure. Whenever TF locks a blue or red card, dash in with double E and deliver Empowered W. If he locks a Gold Card, bait it out or dash in immediately to trade. Rush Mercury's Treads and Eclipse to snowball the matchup.
summaryPt: Twisted Fate na rota solo aposta em controle de grupo à distância com a Carta Dourada (W) e cartas curinga (Q). No nível 1, comece com E para aplicar trocas rápidas com PTA (E1 > auto-ataques > E2). Quando Twisted Fate travar uma carta azul ou vermelha, avance com o E duplo e descarregue o W Fortalecido. Se ele travar a Carta Dourada, absorva com o primeiro dash ou espere a carta expirar para all-in. Construa Passos de Mercúrio e Letalidade/Eclipse para destruí-lo com facilidade.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Twisted Fate you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Twisted Fate lose a lot more. 

(3) Avoid TF Poke - TF’s poke isn’t really meant to cause a lot of harm towards Renekton's laning ability, however it should be said that tanking too much damage vs AP champions is always a rough time for Renekton. Try to avoid TF's Q, W and E passive poke, avoiding any of these presents more successful trade opporunities to completely weaken TF's general ability within the game. 

(4) Respect TF’s Cards - TF’s cards provide a lot of utility that can help him within an abundance of situations. TF’s blue card allows him to sustain his mana through the laning while dealing the most single target damage. Red cards provide an AoE slow and damage to help wave clear or slow mass targets. Then finally his Gold card allows him to stun his target up to 1-2 seconds, providing great utility for catching out his targets. Try to avoid the strengths of TF’s card by avoiding their damage and overall utility they provide. In the laning phase, try to keep distance when TF has his card active and wait to trade once they go on cooldown. 

(5) Buffer W Stun Vs TF Gold Card - A big trick Renekton can do within the TF match up, to help Renekton stay consistently on TF is to abuse Renekton’s W buffering. When Renekton typically reaches TF, TF will panic to select his Gold card to help him peel off Renekton from comboing him. Instead, as soon as you land on TF you can spam W through your E, then spam right click to instantly W within the same frame TF throws his gold card. This is a big tool to help you burst TF down, so make sure to utilise this and mercury treads to break out of his stun faster to abuse TF in your own stun timer. 

(6) Quick Trades - Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(7) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(8) Abuse And Ping TF Roams - TF’s biggest power within the Renekton match up is being able to outroam and utilise his R presence to be anywhere on the map. TF R can be a big game changer to heavily impact the map, while being able to provide constant utility for his teammates. Try to constantly ping TF’s R and ping his roams in fog of war to help your teammate stay alert when he is missing. Alternatively, try to perma shove waves into his side of the map to help you get platings or keep him from leaving the lane.

(9) Rush Mercury Treads, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Mercury Treads to lower Twisted Fate’s overall damage and CC duration. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Twisted Fate's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - TF in the mid game will most likely be trying to play off side lanes, in his quick ability to shove the wave then he will most likely try to rotate in the objective to catch out individual targets with his rapid fire cannon/rocket belt gold card utility. To avoid TF from playing his game, simply stack and back ping any teammates over extending to avoid TF from getting to catch out any targets with R, or try to collapse on TF to make sure he is off the map and you’re able to play more aggressively. Alternatively in fights, try to focus the highest DPS characters first, then focus towards TF if he is still alive. TF functions off as a utility mage, in the objective to play for gold cards and present engage opportunities for his team. If you can eliminate any carries through this play method then TF will fall useless.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Twisted Fate, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Twisted Fate perca muito mais. 

(3) Evite TF poke - O poke do TF não foi feito para causar muitos danos à habilidade de rotas de Renekton, no entanto, deve-se dizer que aguentar muito dano contra campeões AP é sempre um momento difícil para Renekton. tente evitar os passivos Q, W e E do TF poke, evitando qualquer um deles apresenta oportunidades de troca mais bem-sucedidas para enfraquecer completamente a habilidade geral do TF dentro do jogo. 

(4) Respeite as cartas do TF - as cartas do TF oferecem muita utilidade que pode ajudá-lo em diversas situações. O cartão azul de TF permite que ele sustente sua mana durante a rota enquanto causa o maior dano em um único alvo. Os cartões vermelhos fornecem lentidão e dano ao AoE para ajudar wave a eliminar ou retardar alvos em massa. Então, finalmente, sua carta Dourada permite que ele atordoe seu alvo por até 1-2 segundos, proporcionando grande utilidade para capturar seus alvos. Tente evitar os pontos fortes do cartão TF, evitando os danos e a utilidade geral que eles fornecem. Na fase de rotas (laning phase), tente manter distância quando TF estiver com sua carta ativa e esperar para trocar assim que entrarem em cooldown. 

(5) Buffer W Stun Vs TF Gold Card - Um grande truque que Renekton pode fazer no confronto TF, para ajudar Renekton a permanecer consistentemente no TF é abusar do W buffering de Renekton. Quando Renekton normalmente atinge TF, TF entrará em pânico para selecionar sua carta Gold para ajudá-lo a peel evitar Renekton de combiná-lo. Em vez disso, assim que você chegar ao TF, você pode enviar spam para W através do E e, em seguida, clicar com o botão direito do mouse para W instantaneamente dentro do mesmo quadro que TF lança seu cartão dourado. Esta é uma grande ferramenta para ajudá-lo a diminuir o TF, então certifique-se de utilizar isso e os Mercury's Treads para sair do atordoamento mais rápido e abusar do TF em seu próprio temporizador de atordoamento. 

(6) Trocas rápidas - Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procurar uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(7) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(8) Abuso e Ping TF Roams - O maior poder de TF dentro do confronto Renekton é ser capaz de fazer outroam e utilizar sua presença R para estar em qualquer lugar do mapa. TF R pode ser uma grande virada de jogo para impactar fortemente o mapa, ao mesmo tempo em que é capaz de fornecer utilidade constante para seus companheiros de equipe. Tente fazer ping constantemente no R do TF e em suas andanças na névoa da guerra para ajudar seu companheiro de equipe a ficar alerta quando ele estiver desaparecido. Alternativamente, tente perma enfiar waves em seu lado do mapa para ajudá-lo a obter placas ou impedi-lo de sair da pista.

(9) Rush Mercury Treads, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Use Mercury Treads para diminuir o dano geral de Twisted Fate e a duração de CC. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Twisted Fate e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Dicas mid game + teamfighting - TF no mid game provavelmente estará tentando jogar fora das side lanes, em sua habilidade rápida de empurrar o wave, então ele provavelmente tentará girar no objetivo para pegar alvos individuais com seu utilitário de cartão dourado de Rapid Firecannon / cinto de foguete. Para evitar que TF jogue seu jogo, simplesmente empilhe e faça backping em qualquer companheiro de equipe para evitar que TF consiga pegar qualquer alvo com R, ou tente colapsar em TF para ter certeza de que ele está fora do mapa e você pode jogar de forma mais agressiva. Alternativamente, em lutas, tente focar primeiro nos personagens DPS mais altos e depois focar em TF se ele ainda estiver vivo. TF funciona como um mago utilitário, com o objetivo de jogar por cartas douradas e apresentar engage oportunidades para seu time. Se você puder eliminar qualquer carregamento através deste método de jogo, o TF ficará inútil.

summaryEn: Udyr brings heavy single-target burst in Wilding Claw (Q) or waveclear and slows in Wingborne Storm (R). summaryPt: Udyr possui forte dano isolado na Postura da Garra (Q) ou sustento e desacelerações na Postura da Tempestade (R). detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Udyr's Level 1 Cheese - Udyr in general doesn’t have a lot of tools to deal with Renekton, as everything Udyr can do, Renekton can essentially do it way better. Udyr level 1 however can leverage a giant lead for himself if he is able to utilise his Empowered Q or R stance to poke out Renekton. If Udyr starts Q, try to take W and fight in your minion wave while trying to space away with W. You do potentially have a chance to kill him if you play it right, but ultimately you don’t need to go for a long trade vs him, just W and walk away. If Udyr skills Q, simply take Q and try not to get hit by his empowered Q. Udyr will most likely assert push, but depending on how much HP you have, you will regain full lane control by level 3 onwards. 

(2) Don't Fight His Empowered Stance - As already mentioned, Udyr’s power comes overall from his empowered stance. If you try to 1v1 Udyr with his Q stance, he will absolutely obliterate you if you’re isolated, so make sure to be near minions or teammates to prevent his total damage. Udyr with empowered R is also a similar situation, but instead he will play to poke you out and try to focus on proxying, or shoving waves. Try to just avoid getting hit by R and equally shove the waves back as soon as he doesn’t have his empowered R. As long as Renekton plays around his strengths and avoids Udyr’s empowered abilities,  Renekton will successfully stat check and easily deal with Udyr.

(3) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(4) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(5) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(7) 3 Points Q > W Max - W Max is pretty vital here as you’re able to consistently fight against Udyr with your abundance of stuns, while also being able to consistently shred against Udyr’s W shield while also preventing his hit and run playstyle. Simply utilise this to the fullest and play to heavy trade once reaching your maxed out W.

(8) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Renekton naturally outscales Udyr as the game progresses as he’s able to apply more utility through sustain, stuns and his empowered E shred. Udyr’s role is more so just to be annoying for your teammates, playing off his empowered abilities to catch out with his E, or trying to shred your teammates HP with his empowered Q or R. As Renekton try to initiate diving onto his teammates, if Udyr doesn’t pay attention to you diving the backline, your team will easily be able to deal with him while you’re soaking up pressure onto his own carries. With that said, try to ignore him and focus on his carries to win the fights.

videoTitle: T1 Doran Renekton vs Urgot TOP - KR CHALLENGER Patch 15.8
summaryEn: Urgot outputs heavy percentage damage with passive shotgun knees (Echoing Flames) and lethal all-ins via Disdain (E) flip. Start E at level 1 and use the top Alcove strategy to avoid getting zoned by his passive knees on wave 1. The critical counter-play: NEVER get hit by Urgot's E flip; sidestep his charge using your E dash. When Urgot gains his shield, Renekton's Empowered W instantly destroys 100% of the shield. Rush Plated Steelcaps and Black Cleaver, activating Dominus (R) to stay safely above his 25% execute threshold.
summaryPt: Urgot possui alto dano percentual com os tiros da passiva das pernas (Chamas do Eco) e perigo de all-in com o arremesso do Desdém (E). No nível 1, utilize a estratégia do Alcove com início de E para entrar no arbusto lateral e evitar tomar poke das pernas dele na primeira onda. O segredo para vencer Urgot: NUNCA seja atingido pelo E (arremesso) de Urgot; desvie do dash dele usando o seu E. Além disso, quando Urgot ativar o escudo do E ou do W, use o W Fortalecido do Renekton para quebrar 100% do escudo dele instantaneamente. Compre Botas Galvanizadas e Cutelo Negro, e use o Dominus (R) no nível 6 para ganhar vida e se manter fora do limiar de execução de 25% do R de Urgot.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Alcove Strat - Alcove Strat - Level 1 try to rush into the topside alcove with E start to avoid being zoned off the wave level 1. Being zoned off leaves Renekton in a terrible position, however being in the alcove prevents losing XP and losing any necessary HP. Once you achieve the first wave of XP, try to leave the alcove safely through bushes and walk towards your side of the wave state. 

(2) Level 1 E Start - Compared to other match ups, trying to cheese level 1 with E is hard aside from getting the Alcove strat to help you get in there faster. However, Level 1 Urgot can start E, in which if you avoid it you can punish Urgot with the E Auto E trade to abuse PTA or Conqueror. 

(3) Respect Urgot Passive - A big thing people lose a lot of respect for in the match up is Urgot’s passive. Urgot passive does a lot of damage upclose, dealing 2%-6% max HP damage as physical damage. These absolutely hurt consecutively in combination with Urgot E. With that said, wait for Urgot passive to go on CD in 1 direction and directly play off that side. Try not to walk around Urgot in a 1v1 as he will unload even more damage, staying directly in 1 direction loses Urgot so much damage that he will not be able to beat Renekton in the 1v1. 

(4) Avoid Urgot E - From level 1 onwards, avoiding Urgot E is an absolute must for Renekton to win any fights with Urgot. Avoiding the Urgot E will result in you being able to trade hard vs Urgot, always giving you a major advantage. To avoid Urgot E, simply look for the visual cast time before it goes off and E or side step out. A way to bait Urgot E is E into Urgot then quickly E out. Doing this allows you to quickly bait out the ability, forcing you to trap him in a fight with you. 

Another thing to respect is Urgot E Flash, this allows him to surprise his opponent with a quick hard to read combo that can easily sneak him kills. If you’re low and you know he has E, try to stay out of range and look to reset, or read the E start up animation, and predict his flash path to avoid the combo.

(5) Quick Trades - E in > E out > Bait Urgot E > AA > W > AA > Q > AA / E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent.

(8) Respect Urgot R - Urgot R is another dangerous tool to avoid and try to actively avoid getting hit by. Most typically Urgot will look to R after his E Flash, or if his opponent is low in his R execute range. Simply try to avoid standing in front of him with low HP, or instantly R before the Urgot R hits you, so he isn’t able to pull you into execute range. Another tip to think about, is always try to play off the one side of his passive, as any additional damage while having R on you will increase your chances of death to Urgot R.

(9) 3 Points Q > W Max - Personally I find this matchup another W max style match up as you’re able to consistently be in Urgot’s face with multiple W’s, while Urgot completely struggles to peel away from you. You don’t need to W max, but I just find it a lot better and it suits my 1v1 playstyle more vs him in side lane, or even in skirmishes to help me deal with him a lot easier with my teams.

(8) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK. - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Urgot’s overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(9) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Urgot’s main objective within the mid to later stages of the game, is to look for flash E R plays onto your carries while trying to look for a giant fear within the team fight. As already stated, it is absolutely essential to not give Urgot the R by any means, as this is a giant tool to help him completely change teamfights. If you’re tanky enough, try to block the Urgot R and hard peel your carries against his E flash. If Urgot doesn’t have flash he is usually pretty useless when it comes to fights, so just play off blocking him from your team and utilise your empowered W and E shred to instantly melt him within the fights.

Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los.

Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente.

Simplesmente tente evitar ficar na frente dele com HP baixo, ou R instantaneamente antes que o Urgot R atinja você, para que ele não seja capaz de puxá-lo para o alcance de execução. Outra dica para pensar é sempre tentar jogar de um lado de sua passiva, pois qualquer dano adicional ao ter R em você aumentará suas chances de morte para Urgot R.

(9) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Pessoalmente, acho este confronto outro confronto no estilo W max, pois você é capaz de estar consistentemente na cara de Urgot com vários W's, enquanto Urgot luta completamente para peel se afastar de você. Você não precisa de W max, mas acho que é muito melhor e combina mais com meu estilo de jogo 1v1 contra ele na rota lateral, ou mesmo em skirmishes para me ajudar a lidar com ele com muito mais facilidade em minhas equipes.

(8) Construa Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK. - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Urgot e utilize a velocidade de movimento adicional. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilidade. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O principal objetivo de Urgot nos estágios intermediários e posteriores do jogo é procurar por Flash E R em seus carregadores enquanto tenta procurar por um medo gigante na luta em equipe. Como já foi dito, é absolutamente essencial não dar o R ​​ao Urgot de forma alguma, pois esta é uma ferramenta gigante para ajudá-lo a mudar completamente o teamfights. videoTitle: HOW A PROFESSIONAL TEAM PLAYS RANKED IN 2026! – Renekton VS Varus TOP
summaryEn: Solo lane Varus relies on long-range Piercing Arrow (Q) poke and Blighted Quiver (W) percent damage. Start E at level 1 using the Alcove strategy to prevent getting zoned off wave 1 XP. Conserve your health pool with Doran's Shield and Second Wind. At level 3+, dash through the wave with double E, bursting him with Empowered W + Q + Ignite. Build Plated Steelcaps/Merc Treads and Lethality/Eclipse to crush him in lane.
summaryPt: Varus na rota solo aposta em longo alcance com Flecha Perfurante (Q) e dano percentual da aljava (W). No nível 1, comece com E e utilize a estratégia do Alcove para não ser afastado da onda de minions. Mantenha seu HP alto usando Doran's Shield e Ventos Revigorantes. A partir do nível 3, use os minions para avançar com o E duplo, alcance Varus e execute-o com W Fortalecido + Q + Ignite. Feche Botas Galvanizadas ou Passos de Mercúrio e finalize itens de Letalidade/Eclipse para explodi-lo antes que ele consiga responder.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Alcove Strat - Level 1 try to rush into the topside alcove with E start to avoid being zoned off the wave level 1. Being zoned off leaves Renekton in a terrible position, however being in the alcove prevents losing XP and losing any necessary HP. Once you achieve the first wave of XP, try to leave the alcove safely through bushes and walk towards your side of the wave state. 

(2) Play For Sustain - Varus is one of the most disgusting champions within the entire game for Renekton to deal with, usually due to the fact he can take PTA, boneplating, barrier and just naturally have the stats to tank Renekton’s damage. Try to avoid any direct conflict unless Varus is playing like an NPC. Otherwise if he is playing it optimally, give respect for Varus passive and try to play for teammates and abuse D Shield + Second Wind to help you get through the laning phase.

(3) Respect Varus W Passive - Varus W passive is absolutely crazy as a concept, due to the fact it can apply on hit AP damage, which can be utilised with Varus’s passive attack speed from minion or champion kills, also factoring the overall amount of max HP damage he can deal with his regular Q and W Q. Try to avoid taking fights with passive stacks already applied on you, let them drop off and avoid any Varus abilities that can proc it. 

(4) Don't Underestimate Varus - The amount of times I think I’m about to kill Varus, only to get his giant throbbing huge W AP damage one shot my face is simply too much to think about. With that said, even if he is low, respect the fact he can barrier, have boneplating, or can apply passive stacks into his W Q one shot. Always play with caution. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Play For Ganks - As already mentioned, this lane is a complete horror show for Renekton. With that said, play for your teammates. Even if you’re receiving a gank, still respect Varus passive and his overall damage. Try to get his boneplating before the initial gank, to help you burst Varus down in the event of a gank. If you’re a jungler reading this, PLEASE GANK RENEKTON, PLEASE!

(7) Rush Plated Steel caps + Hexdrinker / Negatron - These items may seem like a very weird combination to build, but due to Varus’s high base and hybrid damage, Renekton needs these to survive this match up. You can potentially risk going to a normal build, but Varus will most likely tower dive you if you don’t have these items to survive. Firstly rush boots to mitigate against his auto attacks, then aim towards either of the MR options to lower varus passive and R damage. PLEASE NERF LANE VARUS RIOT!

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - In the off chance Varus misses R, or fails his W Q, Renekton can have a chance to statcheck and run down Varus if these conditions are met. Before you opt into an all in, make sure Varus has no boneplating and is below 70% HP. Just remember, Varus can get up to 2 Q’s within a fight, so make sure he misses 1 and you’re able to tank the other.

(9) Respect Varus R - One of the more crazy things about the match up is the fact Varus can instantly apply passive stacks through his R, leading him to W Q to instantly one shot his targets. Depending on his build, these abilities alone can completely one shot you if he opts into a full AP build, and yes… ONE SHOTS YOU. However if he doesn’t go full AP, he can one shot you a little less faster. Simply try to avoid Varus R at all costs, or this becomes a death sentence the moment it hits you. Try to flash or use E to avoid his R in these moments, or look to bait it out aggressively by E’ing into him at range, then quickly side stepping to the side. 

(10) Play For Teammates - The best thing to do in this match up is just play for your teammates. Whenever an objective is up, simply roam towards your team and try to get your gold funneled through picks or objective secures. You can also play with your team to shut down Varus if they give you the time of day, but most likely you’re just going to have to find a way to win by roaming and using TP to initiate cross map plays. 

(11) Build Maw of Malmortius, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or Stridebreaker - Go Maw of Malmortius to survive against Varus’s AP burst damage / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Varus's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility.

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - The whole game is typically a struggle fest against Varus, so the most you can do is just play for your team at any stage when there is an opportunity. Typically I opt into building utility items such as Stridebreaker or Black Cleaver into tank items, to allow me to soak up damage and utilise my peel based strengths to help my teammates play the game. When it comes to dealing with Varus, you’re going to need your teammates to collapse on him in the side lane, so make sure to ping your teammates to help shut him down before he is able to take everything in the side lane. Alternatively, within team fights try to lock him down with your W and utilise empowered E shred if he’s going the tank build. It will be very hard to genuinely play against him, so try to look for winning fights when he isn’t there or get picks beforehand that will help you win.

videoTitle: (DIG Photon) Renekton Top vs Vayne - KR Master Patch 26.14
summaryEn: Top lane Vayne is an oppressive ranged matchup requiring immense discipline during levels 1-2. Start E at level 1 and use the Alcove to avoid free harass, letting the wave bounce toward your turret. Never position near lane walls to avoid Condemn (E) stuns. At level 3 and 6, gap-close with E1 through minions; the moment Vayne uses Condemn to push you away, follow up with Flash + Empowered W + Dominus (R) to obliterate her health bar. Rush Plated Steelcaps early and build Edge of Night or Eclipse to negate her disengage.
summaryPt: Vayne no topo é um confronto opressivo à distância que exige paciência extrema nos níveis 1 e 2. No nível 1, use o E para entrar no Alcove e evitar tomar auto-ataques gratuitos; deixe a onda empurrar para perto da sua torre. Nunca fique perto de paredes para não ser atordoada pelo Condenar (E) de Vayne. Ao atingir o nível 3 e especialmente no nível 6, feche a distância com E1 nos minions; quando Vayne usar o Condenar (E) para empurrar você, utilize o Flash + W Fortalecido + Dominus (R) para deletá-la instantaneamente. Compre Botas Galvanizadas com urgência e feche Limiar da Noite ou Eclipse para anular o desengaje dela.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Alcove Strat - Level 1 try to rush into the topside alcove with E start to avoid being zoned off the wave level 1. Being zoned off leaves Renekton in a terrible position, however being in the alcove prevents losing XP and losing any necessary HP. Once you achieve the first wave of XP, try to leave the alcove safely through bushes and walk towards your side of the wave state. 

(2) Play For Sustain Early - Vayne’s terrifying early game is very much to be respected. Early on your objective is to keep your HP up, while trying to stay in XP range and farm any CS that’s under your tower. Wait for Vayne to walk up like an NPC then look to combo her on your side of the map. Utilise D Shield + Second Wind to survive any early poke. 

(3) Respect Vayne's Early Game - Vayne’s early game overall is very dangerous, her true damage passive, Q poke spam and her high passive movement speed, all make her a dangerous factor in trying to go for fights. Like previously mentioned, play safe and look to take short trades to whittle her HP down and look for any major misplays. 

(4) Respect Vayne's E  - Vayne’s E is also another ability you really have to think about. Typically Vayne will use E any time Renekton tries to engage her. Try to avoid E’ing near walls, otherwise she will stun you into it and mass fire tons of damage onto you. The main takeaway from Vayne E, is that if she doesn’t have it, she will be very easy to gank. Alternatively, if Vayne is killable, you can double dash when she least expects it and land behind her, to cut off her way of escape, providing you a free kill opportunity. Later on Renekton can hard counter Vayne with Edge of night, as her E is the only ability to break it. 

(5) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(6) Play For Ganks - Vayne is a very dangerous match up, which also heavily outscales Renekton the longer the game goes. Try to ask or ping for ganks to allow you to shut down Vayne a lot easier. Make sure you play waves on your side of the map, to allow your jungler to gank your lane. 

(7) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(8) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Due to Vayne's high movement speed and auto attack damage, Renekton needs to rush boots to have a chance to fight Vayne. Once Renekton purchases boots, he is able to stick onto Vayne more effectively while also lowering her overall damage output. 

(9) Respect Vayne's R - Vayne R is a really, REALLY scary ability. So unless you have ultimate and plated steelcaps, you most likely won't be able to do anything if Vayne all in's you within the middle of the lane. Try to instantly dip out and escape, otherwise it's GG.

(10) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Prior to this point in the match up, if Renekton has farmed safely and rushed defensive boots in the match up, Renekton is now ready to fight his opponent in an all in. Renekton's high base damage and stats from his R, allows Renekton to completely stat check his counter match up. Simply wait for the enemy to make a mistake, then go all out and kill your opponent. 

(11) Build Edge of Night, Eclipse or Stridebreaker - Go Edge of Night to completely counter Vayne E, while allowing the ability to burst down and kill Vayne / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Vayne's mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. 

(12) Midgame + Teamfighting Tips - No matter what point of the game or what score Vayne has, you always need to try and shut her down. Her W true damage is always a consistent tool for Vayne to always be relevant, dealing damage to her targets no matter how much HP they have. Try to shut down Vayne in fights as quickly as you can by dashing onto her with E or your flash to help you one shot her out the fight. Alternatively, use red trinket to help you spot her out in her R active, which can allow you to trace her movement at all times.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Alcove Strat - level 1 tente correr para a alcova superior com início E para evitar ser zoneado para fora da wave level 1. Ficar zoneado deixa Renekton em uma posição terrível, porém estar na alcova evita a perda de XP e de qualquer HP necessário. Depois de atingir o primeiro wave de XP, tente sair da alcova com segurança através dos arbustos e caminhe em direção ao seu lado do estado wave. 

(2) Jogue For Sustain Early - O aterrorizante early game de Vayne deve ser respeitado. No início, seu objetivo é manter seu HP alto, enquanto tenta permanecer no alcance do XP e farmar qualquer CS que esteja sob sua torre. Espere que Vayne apareça como um NPC e então obtenha um combo com ela no seu lado do mapa. Utilize D Shield + Second Wind para sobreviver a qualquer poke inicial. 

(3) Respeite o early game de Vayne - o early game de Vayne no geral é muito perigoso, seu dano verdadeiro passivo, spam Q poke e sua alta velocidade de movimento passivo, todos fazem dela um fator perigoso na tentativa de lutar. Como mencionado anteriormente, jogue pelo seguro e faça trocas curtas para reduzir seu HP e procurar por erros graves. 

(4) Respeitar o E de Vayne - O E de Vayne também é outra habilidade que você realmente precisa pensar. Normalmente Vayne usará E sempre que Renekton tentar engage ela. Tente evitar E'ing perto das paredes, caso contrário ela irá atordoá-lo e causará toneladas de danos em você. A principal lição de Vayne E é que se ela não tiver, será muito fácil gank. Alternativamente, se Vayne for matável, você pode correr duas vezes quando ela menos esperar e pousar atrás dela, para impedir sua fuga, proporcionando a você uma oportunidade de matança gratuita. Mais tarde, Renekton pode contra-atacar Vayne com Edge of night, já que seu E é a única habilidade de quebrá-lo. 

(5) Jogue wave do seu lado - Jogar o wave do seu lado significa essencialmente jogar os estados wave do seu lado do mapa, abusando das táticas de manipulação da wave ou do freezing do seu lado do mapa. Simplesmente use isso para ajudá-lo a fazer combos em seu laner, tirando qualquer espaço para que eles possam trocá-lo de volta (isso também ajuda a evitar que o inimigo o atropele com suas habilidades de velocidade de movimento estendida ou sustentada). Você também pode usar este estado wave para atropelar seu oponente com suas habilidades aumentadas, ajudando você a obter mortes muito mais fáceis em comparação com impasses ou combates à distância. Procure fazer isso quando seus oponentes estiverem com menos de 50% de HP ou potencialmente cometer um erro ao fornecer a você uma oportunidade all in de derrubá-los. 

(6) Jogar For ganks - Vayne é um confronto muito perigoso, que também escala melhor Renekton quanto mais o jogo dura. tente perguntar ou executar ping para ganks para permitir que você desligue Vayne com muito mais facilidade. Certifique-se de jogar waves no seu lado do mapa, para permitir que seu caçador gank sua rota. 

(7) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(8) Rush Plated Steelcaps - Devido à alta velocidade de movimento de Vayne e ao dano de auto attack, Renekton precisa apressar as botas para ter uma chance de lutar contra Vayne. Depois que Renekton compra botas, ele é capaz de aderir a Vayne de forma mais eficaz, ao mesmo tempo que reduz seu dano geral. 

(9) Respeite o R de Vayne - Vayne R é uma habilidade muito, MUITO assustadora. Então, a menos que você tenha ultimate e Plated Steelcaps, provavelmente não será capaz de fazer nada se Vayne all in estiver no meio da pista. Tente mergulhar e escapar instantaneamente, caso contrário é GG.

(10) Abusar do R powerspike de Renekton - Antes deste ponto do confronto, se Renekton farmou com segurança e apressou as botas defensivas no confronto, Renekton agora está pronto para lutar contra seu oponente em um all in. O alto dano base e stats de seu R de Renekton permitem que Renekton stat check completamente seu contra-confronto. Simplesmente espere que o inimigo cometa um erro, então faça tudo e mate seu oponente. 

(11) Build Edge of Night, Eclipse ou Stridebreaker - Vá Edge of Night para contra-atacar completamente Vayne E, enquanto permite a habilidade de burst derrubar e matar Vayne / Go Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Vayne e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. 

(12) Midgame + Dicas de teamfighting - Não importa em que ponto do jogo ou qual pontuação Vayne tenha, você sempre precisa tentar desligá-la. O dano verdadeiro do W dela é sempre uma ferramenta consistente para Vayne ser sempre relevante, causando dano aos seus alvos, não importa quanto HP eles tenham. tente desligar Vayne nas lutas o mais rápido que puder, correndo para ela com E ou seu Flash para ajudá-lo a atirar nela para sair da luta. Alternativamente, use uma bugiganga vermelha para ajudá-lo a identificá-la em seu R ativo, o que pode permitir que você rastreie seus movimentos o tempo todo.

Com isso dito, tente abusar do tempo de lançamento de 0,5 para causar todo o dano que puder sobre ele, ao mesmo tempo em que tenta evitar ativamente o dano dentro da gaiola também.
