tips.titlePt: Dicas de Mid Game e Teamfights
tips.contentEn: Xerath in the mid game will play to utilise his range to try and burst and one shot your teammates. Try to force fights and soak up the damage building defensive items, within the fights try to lock down Xerath and buy time for your teammates to play back to front. Eventually look for Baron to help you push against Xerath’s wave clear to help you end the game vs him.
tips.contentPt: Xerath no mid game jogará para utilizar seu alcance para tentar e burst e one-shot em seus companheiros de equipe. tente forçar lutas e absorver o dano construindo itens defensivos, dentro das lutas tente travar Xerath e ganhar tempo para seus companheiros jogarem de trás para frente. Eventualmente, procure o Barão para ajudá-lo a avançar contra o wave de Xerath para ajudá-lo a terminar o jogo contra ele.

cautionEn: Do not take free harass while farming early; respect Xerath's disengage crowd control.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Xin Zhao - KR Diamond Patch 25.19
summaryEn: Xin Zhao is a very easy match up for Renekton, due to his low stats and linear kit providing Renekton a free win within most duels. Xin Zhao's only threat is his level 1, where he will try to look to cheese with his E start and rush level 2 towards his Q. Renekton can fight off Xin Zhao taking W start, or Q with Conqueror, allowing him to heavily chunk out Xin or kill him in the process. after level 3 Renekton can do whatever he wants, as Renekton's stats simply become too much for Xin Zhao to deal with. Within the mid stages of the game, Renekton also heavily outscales with his pick, providing Renekton more ways to play the game in comparison to Xin Zhao.
summaryPt: Xin Zhao é um confronto muito fácil para Renekton, devido às suas stats baixas e kit linear proporcionando a Renekton uma vitória grátis na maioria dos duelos. A única ameaça de Xin Zhao é seu level 1, onde ele tentará obter queijo com seu início E e correrá level 2 em direção ao seu Q. Renekton pode lutar contra Xin Zhao tomando início W, ou Q com Conqueror, permitindo que ele destrua Xin ou mate-o no processo. depois de level 3 Renekton pode fazer o que quiser, já que as stats de Renekton simplesmente se tornam demais para Xin Zhao lidar. Nos estágios intermediários do jogo, Renekton também escala melhor com sua escolha, fornecendo a Renekton mais maneiras de jogar em comparação com Xin Zhao.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Xin Zhao's First Two Levels - Xin Zhao's first two levels are very strong compared to the rest of the match up. Within the first two levels, Xin will try to E start into Q level 2. Try to simply wait out till level 3, or simply hard push with Q for level 2, then skill W to fight Xin Zhao and win. 

(2) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(3) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(4) Respect Xin Zhao's Gank Setup - The only thing Xin can do is slow you with his E, and knock up with his 3rd Q. As long as you're not getting hit by his 3rd Q and you dash at the right time, Xin Zhao will never really be able to lock you down with his jungler. 

(5) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(6) Ping Xin Zhao’s Roams - Xin naturally succeeds in his ganking style playstyle, hence why he is mainly played as a jungler. With that said, Xin will look to roam to mid lane or in your jungle, make sure to ping your team his whereabouts and punish him with freezes or crashing the wave in if he’s able to miss a lot. 

(7) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse or BoTRK - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Xin’s overall damage. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(8) Midgame And Teamfighting Tips - Naturally Xin Zhao's power is more focused within the early stage of the game, which he usually abuses through the jungle. As a top lane pick he falls off really hard to offer much damage or utility, meaning he isn't that great when it comes to teamplay. His only hint of success is through pick and catch plays, in which if you guide your team not to get caught and never give him those moments, he simply will not be able to do anything.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite os dois primeiros níveis de Xin Zhao - Os dois primeiros níveis de Xin Zhao são muito fortes comparados ao resto do confronto. Nos dois primeiros níveis, Xin tentará E começar em Q level 2. Tente simplesmente esperar até level 3, ou simplesmente empurrar com força com Q para level 2, então use a habilidade W para lutar contra Xin Zhao e vencer. 

(2) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(3) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se você deseja ou não freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(4) Respeite a configuração de gank de Xin Zhao - A única coisa que Xin pode fazer é atrasar você com seu E e derrubar com seu 3º Q. Contanto que você não seja atingido por seu 3º Q e você corra no momento certo, Xin Zhao nunca será realmente capaz de prendê-lo com seu caçador. 

(5) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(6) Roams de Ping Xin Zhao - Xin naturalmente tem sucesso em seu estilo de jogo ganking, por isso ele é jogado principalmente como um caçador. Com isso dito, Xin irá procurar roam para a rota intermediária ou em sua selva, certifique-se de avisar sua equipe sobre o paradeiro dele e puni-lo com congelamentos ou crashing o wave se ele for capaz de errar muito. 

(7) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse ou BoTRK - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Xin. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(8) Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting - Naturalmente o poder de Xin Zhao é mais focado na fase inicial do jogo, que ele geralmente abusa na selva. Como uma escolha de rota superior, ele cai muito para oferecer muito dano ou utilidade, o que significa que ele não é tão bom quando se trata de jogo em equipe. Sua única dica de sucesso é através de jogadas de pick and catch, nas quais se você orientar seu time para não ser pego e nunca lhe dar esses momentos, ele simplesmente não conseguirá fazer nada.

videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Yasuo - KR Master Patch 26.01
summaryEn: Yasuo is quite an easy match up for Renekton to snowball against, as his weak stats and doomed 10 death powerspike force him to feed against Renekton. As Renekton, try to avoid fighting him level 1, as Yasuo's damage and attack speed is simply too high to fight against. Post level 2, Renekton can try to be more aggressive, taking W to help him burst Yasuo when he's in range. When laning vs Yasuo, try to avoid any of his incoming Q's by short clicking in and out, allowing him to miss a stack and lose damage.  By level 3 Renekton can do anything, just make sure to remove his boneplating behind his passive as well as using your Q or auto attack to remove his passive shield before using anything else. Yasuo get's completely destroyed most of the match up until his BoTRK spike, however Renekton can keep destroying him with BoTRK, Eclipse or Profane. Within teamfights, try to avoid being knocked up for his ultimate, as it can allow him to easily apply his damage with his team. If Yasuo tries to engage, look to time your W stun on his knock up frame, preventing him from using his R and keeping him in place.
summaryPt: Yasuo é um confronto bastante fácil para Renekton a snowball contra, já que suas stats fracas e 10 mortes condenadas powerspike o forçam a se alimentar contra Renekton. Como Renekton, evite lutar contra ele level 1, já que o dano e a velocidade de ataque de Yasuo são simplesmente altos demais para lutar contra. Após level 2, Renekton pode tentar ser mais agressivo, pegando W para ajudá-lo burst Yasuo quando ele estiver ao alcance. Ao laning vs Yasuo, tente evitar qualquer um de seus Q's clicando rapidamente para dentro e para fora, permitindo que ele perca uma pilha e perca dano.  Por level 3 Renekton pode fazer qualquer coisa, apenas certifique-se de remover a cobertura óssea atrás de sua passiva, bem como usar seu Q ou auto attack para remover seu escudo passivo antes de usar qualquer outra coisa. Yasuo get destruiu completamente a maior parte do confronto até seu pico de BoTRK, porém Renekton pode continuar destruindo-o com BoTRK, Eclipse ou Profane. Dentro de teamfights, tente evitar ser derrubado em seu ultimate, pois isso pode permitir que ele aplique facilmente seu dano com sua equipe. Se Yasuo tentar engage, ganhe tempo para atordoar seu W em seu quadro de arremesso, impedindo-o de usar seu R e mantendo-o no lugar.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Respect Yasuo's Level 1 and 2 - Yasuo compared to Yone is surprisingly much different, Yasuo's overall power is his passive shield and his attack speed. Try to play for CS, don't get caught up in his damage and try to reach level 3. 

(2) Play For Movement - This essentially means, try to always click around Yone and time his 4-2 Second Q with your side steps, Yone losing out on missing a Q stack and damage really hurts his play potential for the lane. 

(3) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(4) Respect Yasuo's Shield - Compared to most other shields, Yasuo's shield doesn't fully break the way it's intended to with Renekton's W, which overall Renekton's damage gets eaten up by it. Instead use your auto attack first, wait till its fully gone as well as his boneplating, then use your W once both are on Cooldown. 

(5) Play Around Yasuo's E positioning - Yasuo's E can be very annoying when he’s defensively playing around it, however Yasuo also has to use them to be aggressive. Yasuo has more room to make mistakes, with aggressive E’s putting Yasuo in an unfavourable position within the match up. Yasuo E’ing closer to your side of the map can present you with the opportunities to fight and kill him, so make sure to hold your abilities until he is on your side of the lane. Try to not be on Yasuo's side of the map, otherwise he will have a free dash to closer to his tower and easily escape you.

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) Respect Yasuo R - Yasuo R, while being a CC based ability, also has great utility usage in being able to give himself bonus armour pen, allowing to shred any armour you have purchased into him. Try to avoid giving him his ult, as the free pen will later stack up towards Yasuo overpowering Renekton through the later stages of the game.

(9) 3 Points Q > W Max - I would suggest to do this if the lane is going super well for you. Renekton’s high utility, low CD and damage from W max allows you to consistently fight Yasuo deep within the game, on top of also nullifying the ability for him to land Q’s if you can time your W through his Q frame, which results in him doing 0 damage. Exploit timing plays like this to overpower Yasuo and consistently beat him within the side lane.

(10) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse or Profane - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Yasuo’s overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield.  / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles and getting his passive easier. 

(11) Midgame And Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid game Yasuo's damage spikes really hard in the 1v1 against Renekton, if Renekton goes more bruisery focused Yasuo will naturally outscale in the side lane. Instead you need to play to clear waves and look for teamfights, unless you’re playing a more damage focused Renekton build to one shot Yasuo. In team fights, try to lock down Yasuo if he tries to engage onto your team, if he is unable to get a massive R play off, Yasuo will lose a lot of value in being able to win the fights for his team. Later in the game, play off your strengths of W max and potentially buy Death's Dance and Randiun’s Omen to lower Yasuo's overall damage.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) Respeite o level 1 de Yasuo e 2 - Yasuo em comparação com Yone é surpreendentemente muito diferente, o poder geral de Yasuo é seu escudo passivo e sua velocidade de ataque. tente jogar por CS, não se deixe levar pelo dano dele e tente alcançar level 3. 

(2) Jogar por movimento - Isso significa essencialmente, tente sempre clicar em torno de Yone e cronometrar seu Q de 4-2 segundos com seus passos laterais, Yone perdendo por perder uma pilha de Q e o dano realmente prejudica seu potencial de jogo na rota. 

(3) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes desde o início até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(4) Respeite o escudo de Yasuo - Comparado com a maioria dos outros escudos, o escudo de Yasuo não quebra totalmente da maneira pretendida com o W de Renekton, cujo dano geral de Renekton é consumido por ele. Em vez disso, use seu auto attack primeiro, espere até que ele desapareça completamente, assim como o boneplating, e então use seu W quando ambos estiverem em cooldown. 

(5) Brinque com o posicionamento E de Yasuo - O E de Yasuo pode ser muito irritante quando ele está brincando defensivamente, no entanto, Yasuo também precisa usá-los para ser agressivo. Yasuo tem mais espaço para cometer erros, com E agressivos colocando Yasuo em posição desfavorável no confronto. Yasuo Chegar mais perto do seu lado do mapa pode lhe apresentar oportunidades de lutar e matá-lo, então certifique-se de manter suas habilidades até que ele esteja do seu lado da pista. Tente não estar do lado de Yasuo no mapa, caso contrário ele terá uma corrida livre para se aproximar de sua torre e escapar facilmente de você.

(6) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(7) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(8) Respeite Yasuo R - Yasuo R, embora seja uma habilidade baseada em CC, também tem grande utilidade ao ser capaz de dar a si mesmo uma caneta de armadura bônus, permitindo destruir qualquer armadura que você tenha comprado nele. Tente evitar dar a ele seu ult, pois a caneta grátis mais tarde se acumulará para Yasuo dominar Renekton nas fases posteriores do jogo.

(9) 3 pontos Q > W Max - Eu sugiro fazer isso se a pista estiver indo muito bem para você. A alta utilidade de Renekton, o baixo CD e o dano do W max permitem que você lute consistentemente contra Yasuo nas profundezas do jogo, além de também anular a capacidade dele de acertar Q's se você conseguir cronometrar seu W através de seu quadro Q, o que resulta em ele causando 0 de dano. Explore o tempo de jogo como esse para dominar Yasuo e vencê-lo de forma consistente na side lane.

(10) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse ou Profane - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Yasuo e utilize a velocidade de movimento adicional. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo.  / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo focados em dano total e tornando sua passiva mais fácil. 

(11) Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting - Dentro dos picos de dano de mid game Yasuo muito fortes no 1v1 contra Renekton, se Renekton for mais focado em hematomas, Yasuo naturalmente escalará melhor na side lane. Em vez disso, você precisa jogar para limpar waves e procurar por teamfights, a menos que esteja jogando um Renekton mais focado em dano, construído para one-shot Yasuo. Em lutas de equipe, tente bloquear Yasuo se ele tentar engage em seu time, se ele não conseguir um play off R massivo, Yasuo perderá muito valor em ser capaz de vencer as lutas para seu time. Mais tarde no jogo, use seus pontos fortes de W max e potencialmente compre Death's Dance e Randiun’s Omen para reduzir o dano geral de Yasuo.

tips.contentEn: This essentially means, try to always click around Yone and time his 4-2 Second Q with your side steps, Yone losing out on missing a Q stack and damage really hurts his play potential for the lane.
tips.contentPt: Isso essencialmente significa que você sempre clica em Yone e cronometra seu Q de 4-2 segundos com seus passos laterais, Yone perde ao perder uma pilha de Q e o dano realmente prejudica seu potencial de jogo na rota.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Early Game do Renekton
tips.contentEn: In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.
tips.contentPt: Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes desde o início até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Yasuo's Shield
tips.contentEn: Compared to most other shields, Yasuo's shield doesn't fully break the way it's intended to with Renekton's W, which overall Renekton's damage gets eaten up by it. Instead use your auto attack first, wait till its fully gone as well as his boneplating, then use your W once both are on Cooldown.
tips.contentPt: Comparado com a maioria dos outros escudos, o escudo de Yasuo não quebra totalmente como deveria com o W de Renekton, cujo dano geral de Renekton é consumido por ele. Em vez disso, use seu auto attack primeiro, espere até que ele desapareça completamente, assim como o boneplating, e então use seu W quando ambos estiverem em cooldown.

tips.titlePt: Jogue em Torno de Yasuo's E positioning
tips.contentEn: Yasuo's E can be very annoying when he’s defensively playing around it, however Yasuo also has to use them to be aggressive. Yasuo has more room to make mistakes, with aggressive E’s putting Yasuo in an unfavourable position within the match up. Yasuo E’ing closer to your side of the map can present you with the opportunities to fight and kill him, so make sure to hold your abilities until he is on your side of the lane. Try to not be on Yasuo's side of the map, otherwise he will have a free dash to closer to his tower and easily escape you.
tips.contentPt: O E de Yasuo pode ser muito irritante quando ele está brincando defensivamente, mas Yasuo também precisa usá-los para ser agressivo. Yasuo tem mais espaço para cometer erros, com E agressivos colocando Yasuo em posição desfavorável no confronto. Yasuo Chegar mais perto do seu lado do mapa pode lhe apresentar oportunidades de lutar e matá-lo, então certifique-se de manter suas habilidades até que ele esteja do seu lado da pista. Tente não estar do lado de Yasuo no mapa, caso contrário ele terá uma corrida livre para se aproximar de sua torre e escapar facilmente de você.

tips.titlePt: Gerencie as Waves Corretamente
tips.contentEn: Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.
tips.contentPt: Basta avaliar se você quer ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades para criar lutas. Ou jogue para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma morte nele com seu caçador.

tips.titlePt: Abuse do Powerspike da Ult (R) do Renekton
tips.contentEn: Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies.
tips.contentPt: Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos.

tips.titlePt: Respeite Yasuo R
tips.contentEn: Yasuo R, while being a CC based ability, also has great utility usage in being able to give himself bonus armour pen, allowing to shred any armour you have purchased into him. Try to avoid giving him his ult, as the free pen will later stack up towards Yasuo overpowering Renekton through the later stages of the game.
tips.contentPt: Yasuo R, embora seja uma habilidade baseada em CC, também tem grande utilidade ao ser capaz de dar a si mesmo uma caneta de armadura bônus, permitindo destruir qualquer armadura que você tenha comprado nele. Tente evitar dar a ele seu ult, pois a caneta grátis mais tarde se acumulará para Yasuo dominar Renekton nas fases posteriores do jogo.

tips.titlePt: 3 Pontos no Q > Max W em seguida
tips.contentEn: I would suggest to do this if the lane is going super well for you. Renekton’s high utility, low CD and damage from W max allows you to consistently fight Yasuo deep within the game, on top of also nullifying the ability for him to land Q’s if you can time your W through his Q frame, which results in him doing 0 damage. Exploit timing plays like this to overpower Yasuo and consistently beat him within the side lane.
tips.contentPt: Eu sugeriria fazer isso se a pista estiver indo muito bem para você. A alta utilidade de Renekton, o baixo CD e o dano do W max permitem que você lute consistentemente com Yasuo nas profundezas do jogo, além de também anular a capacidade de ele acertar Q's se você conseguir cronometrar seu W através de seu quadro Q, o que resulta em ele causando 0 de dano. Aproveite jogadas de tempo como essa para dominar Yasuo e vencê-lo de forma consistente na rota lateral.

tips.titleEn: Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse or Profane
tips.titlePt: Build de Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse or Profane
tips.contentEn: Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Yasuo’s overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield.  / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles and getting his passive easier.
tips.contentPt: Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Yasuo e utilize a velocidade de movimento adicional. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo.  / Torne-se Profano para estilos de jogo focados em dano total e tornando sua passiva mais fácil.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting
tips.contentEn: Within the mid game Yasuo's damage spikes really hard in the 1v1 against Renekton, if Renekton goes more bruisery focused Yasuo will naturally outscale in the side lane. Instead you need to play to clear waves and look for teamfights, unless you’re playing a more damage focused Renekton build to one shot Yasuo. In team fights, try to lock down Yasuo if he tries to engage onto your team, if he is unable to get a massive R play off, Yasuo will lose a lot of value in being able to win the fights for his team. Later in the game, play off your strengths of W max and potentially buy Death's Dance and Randiun’s Omen to lower Yasuo's overall damage.
tips.contentPt: Dentro dos picos de dano de mid game Yasuo muito fortes no 1v1 contra Renekton, se Renekton for mais focado em contusões, Yasuo irá naturalmente escalar melhor na rota lateral. Em vez disso, você precisa jogar para limpar waves e procurar por teamfights, a menos que esteja jogando um Renekton mais focado em dano, construído para one-shot Yasuo. Em lutas de equipe, tente bloquear Yasuo se ele tentar engage em seu time, se ele não conseguir um play off massivo de R, Yasuo perderá muito valor em ser capaz de vencer as lutas para seu time. Mais tarde no jogo, use seus pontos fortes de W max e potencialmente compre Death's Dance e Randiun’s Omen para reduzir o dano geral de Yasuo.

level1ExplanationPt: Comece de Q para minar a vida do oponente e buscar a prioridade do nível 2.
level1ExplanationEn: Start Q to whittle enemy HP and push for level 2 priority.
winConditionPt: Aproveite a vantagem de robustez do Renekton para punir tentativas de all-in com W Fortalecido + Q; mantenha a fúria acima de 50 para contra-atacar instantaneamente.
winConditionEn: Leverage Renekton's durability to punish all-in attempts with Empowered W + Q; keep fury above 50 to counter-burst immediately.
cautionPt: Respeite os picos de mobilidade e dano letal de Yasuo; não gaste o stun no vazio quando Yasuo estiver com habilidades de fuga ativas.
cautionEn: Respect Yasuo's mobility spikes and lethal burst; do not waste your stun when they have escape tools ready.

tips.titleEn: Disable Yasuo's Shield with Empowered W
tips.titlePt: Destruir o Escudo Passivo com W Fortalecido
tips.contentEn: Yasuo's passive shield and Immortal Shieldbow's shield are disabled by Renekton's Empowered W (Ruthless Predator). When trading with Yasuo, accumulate 50 Fury to use Empowered W to break his shield and initiate a one-sided trade.
tips.contentPt: O escudo do fluxo de Yasuo é destruído instantaneamente pelo W Fortalecido de Renekton, abrindo espaço para um combo letal sem resistência.

tips.titlePt: Prioridade Total de Rota Após o Nível 3
tips.contentEn: While Yasuo may have an advantage before Level 3, Renekton gains strong trading power after Level 3. From Level 3 onwards, actively seek trades to seize lane priority and pressure Yasuo.
tips.contentPt: A Parede de Vento (W) de Yasuo é completamente inútil contra todas as habilidades corpo a corpo de Renekton! Pressione e controle a wave com facilidade.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Yone - KR Master Patch 26.07
summaryEn: Yone is a pretty easy lane for Renekton to snowball against, as Renekton has the ability to easily weave in and out of Yone's Q, as well as returning his heavy burst damage every time Yone gets into range. Yone's lack of stats and survivalbility makes him a sitting duck, in which Renekton can do the bare minimum and practically win. Make sure you use your shied break against Yone's W, as this will allow you to easily nuke through his shield and melt hsi HP bar. Once Yone gets BoTRK, his damage will be a lot more substantial, so make sure to rush Eclipse, BoTRK or Profane to help maintain damage to easily one shot him. Within teamfights, try to look out for Yone R engages, by using your W as soon as he finishes his R, or side stepping his ultimate altogether.
summaryPt: Yone é uma rota bastante fácil para Renekton a snowball contra, já que Renekton tem a habilidade de entrar e sair facilmente do Q de Yone, além de devolver seu pesado dano de burst toda vez que Yone entra no alcance. A falta de stats e capacidade de sobrevivência de Yone faz dele um alvo fácil, no qual Renekton pode fazer o mínimo e praticamente vencer. Certifique-se de usar seu escudo contra o W de Yone, pois isso permitirá que você destrua facilmente seu escudo e derreta sua barra de HP. Assim que Yone obtiver BoTRK, seu dano será muito mais substancial, então certifique-se de apressar Eclipse, BoTRK ou Profano para ajudar a manter o dano facilmente com one-shot nele. Dentro de teamfights, procure Yone R se envolver, usando seu W assim que ele terminar seu R, ou evitando seu ultimate completamente.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Level 1 Yone should technically have an advantage with Lethal Tempo, however Renekton's stats and base damage from Q, is enough to win level 1 fights to kill Yone, or allow you to push level 2 and abuse your early power. Try to avoid Q’s through fighting him, and return damage with auto attacks and weaving towards your minion wave.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Yone you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Yone lose a lot more. 

(3) Play For Movement - This essentially means, try to always click around Yone and time his 4-2 Second Q with your side steps, Yone losing out on missing a Q stack and damage really hurts his play potential for the lane. Another tip for the match up, is that if you can time W the same time through his Q frame, Yone deals 0 damage and doesn’t obtain a stack. Use this to outplay him even harder through your DPS. 

(4) Play Around His Shield - Yone W can be used to block Renekton's short trading damage, however Renekton can shred Yone's shield with Empowered W. Use Empowered W on his shield creation, Do not W in the same frame or Renekton W won't break the shield. 

(5) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(6) Play off Yone's E positioning - Don't chase Yone while he uses E, try to sit on the location he has to go back to, which always ensures you're able to catch him and get your damage off if he’s initially trying to bait you out to chase him.

(7) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) Respect Yone's R + CC combo - Yone's 3rd Q into R can be devastating combined with ganks, try to always avoid getting hit by Q with your movement or E. As for R, try to always be prepared for it in high pressure situations and avoid it with your E or Flash. Alternatively, Yone can use R to escape bad situations at times, in which you can counter if you dash in front of him to avoid his long dash to escape. 

(10) Points Q > W Max - Just like the Yasuo match up, Renekton can essentially overpower Yone throughout the whole game with W maxed out. Having 7-4 Second W’s results in Yone practically getting bullied throughout the whole game, even more so than a Yasuo would. Make sure to do this if you’re hard winning the lane and make sure to abuse it every time you come into contact with Yone.

(11) Build Plated Steelcaps, Eclipse or Profane - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Yone’s overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield.  / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles and getting his passive easier. 

(12) Midgame And Teamfighting Tips - Within the mid game Yone's damage begins to spike in the 1v1 against Renekton, if Renekton goes more bruisery focused Yone will naturally outscale in side lane, however with W max and some items such as Death’s Dance or Randiun’s, Yone won’t be able to have the damage or sustain to beat Renekton in the 1v1. Within teamfights, Yone’s role is to look for a big R or Q3 engage, to allow him to get his damage off and present a giant opportunity for his team. Try to hard engage on Yone before he gets Q3, or block the R for your team. If Yone is in the open, you can simply play to lock him down your team instantly to make him irrelevant and useless to do much else.

Having 7-4 Second W’s results in Yone practically getting bullied throughout the whole game, even more so than a Yasuo would. Make sure to do this if you’re hard winning the lane and make sure to abuse it every time you come into contact with Yone.
tips.contentPt: Assim como o confronto Yasuo, Renekton pode essencialmente dominar Yone durante todo o jogo com W no máximo. Ter 7-4 segundos de W resulta em Yone praticamente sendo intimidado durante todo o jogo, ainda mais do que um Yasuo faria. Certifique-se de fazer isso se estiver ganhando muito na pista e abuse dela sempre que entrar em contato com Yone.

tips.titlePt: Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting
tips.contentEn: Within the mid game Yone's damage begins to spike in the 1v1 against Renekton, if Renekton goes more bruisery focused Yone will naturally outscale in side lane, however with W max and some items such as Death’s Dance or Randiun’s, Yone won’t be able to have the damage or sustain to beat Renekton in the 1v1. Within teamfights, Yone’s role is to look for a big R or Q3 engage, to allow him to get his damage off and present a giant opportunity for his team. Try to hard engage on Yone before he gets Q3, or block the R for your team. If Yone is in the open, you can simply play to lock him down your team instantly to make him irrelevant and useless to do much else.
tips.contentPt: Dentro do mid game, o dano de Yone começa a aumentar no 1v1 contra Renekton, se Renekton for mais focado em contusões, Yone irá naturalmente escalar melhor na rota lateral, no entanto, com W max e alguns itens como Death's Dance ou Randiun, Yone não será capaz de ter o dano ou sustentação para vencer Renekton no 1v1. Dentro de teamfights, o papel de Yone é procurar um grande R ou Q3 engage, para permitir que ele reduza o dano e apresente uma oportunidade gigante para sua equipe. tente forte engage em Yone antes que ele chegue ao Q3, ou bloqueie o R para seu time. Se Yone estiver aberto, você pode simplesmente jogar para prendê-lo em seu time instantaneamente, tornando-o irrelevante e inútil para fazer qualquer outra coisa.

videoTitle: Renekton Top vs Yorick - NA Diamond Patch 25.20
summaryEn: Yorick is a pretty simple match up to deal within the early game. Simply don't over trade with Yorick level 1, as his Q start damage is way too high for Renekton to trade into. By level 2, Renekton can play to bully Yorick with his push advantage, allowing him to bounce the wave and look for a kill on the wave rebound. By level 3 onwards, Renekton can assert all the kills and trades, using his E to engage and disengage from Yorick's W. Yorick's only real spike is at level 6, where he and his maiden apply a lot of damage together. Renekton should priortise small trades at this stage, until Yorick is 50%HP where Renekton can all in him with his R active. Killing Yorick Maiden is also essential if you're able to do it. Later on, Yorick will keep trying to look for split push opportunities, forcing you to deal with him in side lane or using your team to help shut him down. Once he is dead, you can force objectives and teamfigths with his death timer.
summaryPt: Yorick é um confronto bastante simples de lidar dentro do early game. Simplesmente não exagere na troca com Yorick level 1, pois o dano inicial do Q dele é muito alto para Renekton trocar. Por level 2, Renekton pode jogar para intimidar Yorick com sua vantagem de push, permitindo-lhe saltar o wave e procurar matar no rebote de wave. De level 3 em diante, Renekton pode afirmar todas as mortes e trocas, usando seu E para engage e disengage do W de Yorick. O único pico real de Yorick é em level 6, onde ele e sua donzela aplicam muitos danos juntos. Renekton deve priorizar pequenas trocas nesta fase, até que Yorick esteja com 50% de HP onde Renekton possa all in ele com seu R ativo. Matar Yorick Maiden também é essencial se você for capaz de fazer isso. Mais tarde, Yorick continuará tentando procurar oportunidades de split push, forçando você a lidar com ele na rota lateral ou usando sua equipe para ajudar a detê-lo. Depois que ele estiver morto, você poderá forçar objetivos e lutas em equipe com seu cronômetro de morte.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Try to push for level 2 advantage while poking Yorick with your Q, on level 2 skill E/W use advantage to chunk out Yorick. 

(2) Respect Yorick's Q- Since the changes, Yorick is able to hold more of his own with the Q buffs and his ghouls spawning faster. Respect Yorick’s damage through long trades, try to play for short trades until he is in lethal range to finish off with a combo.

(3) Respect Yorick’s E - Yorick E is Yorick’s main poking tool within the laning phase, with that he will aim to spam his E to do a decent amount of damage alongside with his ghouls focusing them. Try to do lots of short clicks to bait out the Yorick E, then try to trade after he misses it. 

(4) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(5) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Respect Yorick's R - Once Yorick reaches level 6 his R completely changes the state of the lane, as it provides more damage and healing utility through 1v1 fights . Try to avoid tanking his maiden and E damage then punish with a fast combo to get him close to lethal range. If you have the chance to kill his maiden then try to do that first as he loses so much combat stats once she’s dead.

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(9) Build, Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(10) Midgame And Teamfighting Tips - Against Yorick try to manage side waves effectively, try to hard push each time before you plan on roaming, otherwise Yorick will be able to instantly clear up towers within the side lane. If Yorick is hard pushing the side lane, try to get your teammates to collapse on him to free up map pressure, or try to force a hard fight onto the rest of his team to punish the enemies 4v5 disadvantage with Yorick being in side lane. Yorick doesn’t offer much utility and reassurance into team fights, so make sure to also abuse your overall teamfighting power to over power your pick into Yorick.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 Q Start - tente push para vantagem de level 2 enquanto poking Yorick com seu Q, na habilidade level 2 E/W use vantagem para dividir Yorick. 

(2) Respeite o Q de Yorick- Desde as mudanças, Yorick é capaz de aguentar mais com os buffs de Q e seus ghouls surgindo mais rápido. Respeite o dano de Yorick através de trocas longas, tente jogar trocas curtas até que ele esteja em alcance letal para finalizar com um combo.

(3) Respeite o E de Yorick - Yorick E é a principal ferramenta de Yorick poking dentro da fase de rotas (laning phase), com isso ele terá como objetivo enviar spam para seu E para causar uma quantidade razoável de dano junto com seus ghouls focando-os. tente fazer vários cliques curtos para atrair o Yorick E, então tente trocar depois que ele errar. 

(4) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(5) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(6) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(7) Respeite o R de Yorick - Quando Yorick atinge level 6, seu R muda completamente o estado da pista, pois fornece mais dano e utilidade de cura por meio de lutas de 1v1. tente evitar tankar sua donzela e o dano E e depois punir com um combo rápido para deixá-lo perto do alcance letal. Se você tiver a chance de matar a donzela dele, tente fazer isso primeiro, pois ele perde muitas stats de combate quando ela morre.

(8) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(9) Build, Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(10) Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting - Contra Yorick tente gerenciar o lado waves de forma eficaz, tente empurrar com força todas as vezes antes de planejar roaming, caso contrário, Yorick será capaz de limpar instantaneamente as torres dentro da side lane. Se Yorick estiver empurrando com força a rota lateral, tente fazer com que seus companheiros de equipe caiam sobre ele para liberar a pressão do mapa ou tente forçar uma luta dura para o resto de sua equipe para punir os inimigos em desvantagem 4v5 com Yorick estando na rota lateral. Yorick não oferece muita utilidade e segurança em lutas de equipe, então certifique-se de abusar também de seu poder geral de teamfighting para dominar sua escolha em Yorick.

videoTitle: Renekton death by Yunara
summaryEn: Yunara doesn't really do anything to Renekton, as her lack of mobility pre 6 forces her into being killed by Renekton on repeat. Renekton can force heavy burst trades from level 3, forcing him to get a kill by his 2nd E trade, or every 1st trade once he gets his first few components. By level 6, Yunara spikes in her ability to apply damage within a fight, however Renekton's level 6 powerspike is way too much for her to deal. Renekton can essentially do whatever he wants within this match up, allowing him to easily snowball the map and win the game through objectives and teamfights.
summaryPt: Yunara realmente não faz nada com Renekton, já que sua falta de mobilidade antes do 6 a força a ser morta por Renekton repetidamente. Renekton pode forçar trocas pesadas de burst de level 3, forçando-o a matar em sua 2ª troca E, ou a cada 1ª troca assim que ele obtiver seus primeiros componentes. Por volta de level 6, Yunara aumenta sua capacidade de causar dano em uma luta, no entanto, o level 6 powerspike de Renekton é demais para ela lidar. Renekton pode essencialmente fazer o que quiser neste confronto, permitindo-lhe facilmente snowball o mapa e vencer o jogo através de objetivos e teamfights.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Yunara you're most likely able to kill her with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Yunara lose a lot more. 

(3) Respect Yunara’s Q - Yunara’s Q requires 8 stacks to use, with each minion and monster providing 1 stack and champions providing 2 stacks. Once Yunara has max stacks, she is able to unleash a flurry of damage providing 25% to 65% attack speed, additional on hit damage and allowing her to spread her damage across other targets. Yunara’s Q doesn’t really do much within the early game, allowing you to easily fight and out damage her at will. Later on in the game, Yunara’s Q damage will become threatening within the later stages, so make sure to avoid tanking her damage within these stages of the game. 

(4) Avoid Yunara’s W - Yunara’s W allows her to throw out a ball, slowing and dealing damage. Yunara’s W can also pass through other targets, allowing it to deal additional damage to clumped up targets. Yunara’s W isn’t really a threat in lane, so you can simply E through it and avoid the additional damage it is able to deal. 

(5) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage.

(6) Play Waves Accordingly - Simply assess whether or not you want to play for freeze, to help you deny XP and CS, while presenting yourself more opportunities to create fights. Or, play to shove waves to create proxy angles, tempo resets or create a dive opportunity. Renekton has all the cards to do whatever he wants with wave management. Also respect that if your laner tries to proxy, simply proxy back or coordinate a kill on them with your jungler.

(7) Heavy Trades - Being that Renekton carries a lot of high damage, Renekton is able to just jump on his target nearly at will. Whenever your laners present you with the ability to jump on them, simply take the opportunity to burst them as much as you can. If you didn't kill them already from that, use your options of freezing or your tower diving ability to help you finish off your opponent.

(8) Respect Yunara’s R - Yunara’s R allows her to enter a flow state, amplifying all her abilities for 15 seconds. Yunara’s Q through this time does not need to be stacked, allowing her to use its activation through the duration of her R. Yunara’s W is upgraded into a laser beam, lowering its overall CD through the duration of her R. Yunara’s E also changes from a movement speed steroid to a dash, allowing her to keep her distance away from other champions. Yunara’s R is a giant steroid and powerspike towards her kit, allowing her to become a giant threat within the later stages of the game. Earlier on, Yunara does not possess the damage to really beat Renekton, relying entirely on her scaling playstyle to become a threat. 

(9) Build Eclipse, Stridebreaker or Profane - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Yunara’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go Profane for full damage focused playstyles.

videoTitle: Guia de Matchup: Renekton vs Zaahen (Godrekton)
summaryEn: Zaahen's playstyle revolves around using his CC combo to short trade against Renekton, allowing him to cheese off damage while trying to quickly disengage in the lane. Renekton's whole advantage in the match up is simply to counter Zaahen as he engages, Renekton should always wait for him to engage then use W, otherwise if you E into him he will simply dash away, while potentially CC'ing you in the process. Doing counter trades back into Zaahen allows Renekton to chunk him out, allowing Renekton to kill him on the second or third trade. As Renekton, buying antiheal or using Ignite, rushing Eclipse or BoTRK and maxing W, are all high priority in being able to put Zaahen at a constant disadvantage. When fighting Zaahen, make sure to wait off your ult timer and make sure not to stun or full combo into his R, otherwise you will lose out on all damage. Taking long trades is also not advised, as he will be able to hit his passive and simply win off that. Within the mid game, Renekton can still steamroll Zaahen with W max and item advantages, however its in your best interest to simply play for your teammates and objectives, otherwise Zaahen will try to use chaotic fights you're not involved in towards his own advantage.
summaryPt: O estilo de jogo de Zaahen gira em torno de usar seu combo CC para trocar rapidamente contra Renekton, permitindo que ele reduza o dano enquanto tenta rapidamente disengage na rota. Toda a vantagem de Renekton no confronto é simplesmente contra-atacar Zaahen enquanto ele se envolve, Renekton deve sempre esperar que ele engage e então usar W, caso contrário, se você usar E nele, ele simplesmente fugirá, enquanto potencialmente CC acertará você no processo. Fazer contra-trocas de volta a Zaahen permite que Renekton o destrua, permitindo que Renekton o mate na segunda ou terceira troca. Como Renekton, comprar antiheal ou usar Ignite, apressar Eclipse ou BoTRK e maximizar W são todos de alta prioridade para poder colocar Zaahen em constante desvantagem. Ao lutar contra Zaahen, espere o cronômetro final e certifique-se de não atordoar ou combo completo em seu R, caso contrário você perderá todo o dano. Fazer trocas longas também não é aconselhável, pois ele poderá acertar sua passiva e simplesmente vencer. Dentro do mid game, Renekton ainda pode esmagar Zaahen com W máximo e vantagens de itens, no entanto, é do seu interesse simplesmente jogar por seus companheiros de equipe e objetivos, caso contrário, Zaahen tentará usar lutas caóticas nas quais você não está envolvido para obter vantagem própria.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 Q Start - Level 1 Q starts allows you to hit level 2 before Zaahen, allowing you to chunk him out and obtain level 2 priority. Level 2 priority is important to allow you to chunk his HP out, allowing a level 2 or level 3 kill within the process. 

(2) Avoid His Q Heal + Knock Up - These are the most important tools for Zaahen to leverage good trades. Whenever Zaahen activates his Q, simply let it time out or buffer your W click on his knock up auto attack. If he’s able to get his knock up, Zaahen can be very frustrating to get trades against, so make sure you’re always punishing him by avoiding the auto attack, or timing your W on the knock up.

(3) Respect Zaahen Full Passive Stacks + Revive - Long trades with Zaahen isn’t recommended unless you’re clearly stronger than he is, otherwise he will be able to utilise Conqueror and his passive, to help him sustain heavy damage through long fights and obtain his revive. Zaahen getting his revive isn’t the end of the world if you’re fed, however if you’re even, he’s able to get the second wind needed to survive the fight, while also allowing him to heal a ton of HP within the process. Try to play for short or mid timing fights, as this will allow you to squeeze enough damage against him, while he’s also unable to get his passive. If he has stacked passive, try to walk or dash away until he loses all stacks. 

(4) Avoid His Short Trades - Zaahen has a very annoying combo where he can stack his Q1, then use W > AA > Q2 > E away. This combo can be very frustrating, allowing him to always get the upper hand in trades, as well as spacing away from you to deal damage. Like I already mentioned, you can try to W him as he knocks you up, or you can try to retaliate back after his E if he’s in range with your own dash, holding your E2 to disengage back after dealing your damage. 

(5) Counter Zaheen's Engages - Renekton vs Zaahen works similar to the Ambessa match up, where you must wait for her to come into you, before you use your E and fight back, otherwise it can lead to very awkward and unfavourable  trading patterns. If Zaahen only uses E to disengage, then hold your E’s to follow up against his E. If you dash first vs Zaahen, typically he will use his E to dash away, or use his W or Q2 to CC you at the end or mid animation of E, allowing him to easily escape. Use your dash optimally and you won’t ever have problems. 

(6) Abuse Renekton's Early Game - In this match up Renekton is essentially able to do whatever he simply wants. With that said, really hone into your strong early to mid game strengths to help you dominate and win the game. Play to deny your enemy of gold and xp, play to proxy and generally lead any top side skirmishes with your insane lane advantage. 

(7) Play Wave On Your Side - Playing the wave on your side essentially means playing wave states on your side of the map, via abusing wave manipulation tactics or freezing on your side of the map. Simply use this to help you combo on your laner, taking away any space from them being able to trade you back (This also helps prevent the enemy running you down with their extended or sustained movement speed abilities). You can also use this wave state to run down your opponent with your abilities up, helping you obtain kills a lot easier vs stalemate or ranged match ups. Look to do this when your opponents are below 50% HP, or potentially make a mistake to provide you an all in opportunity to run them down. 

(8) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. Against Zaahen, this will be vital in being able to beat him in 1v1’s later on within the game.

(9) 3 Points Q > W Max - This playstyle allows you to constantly have W’s to help you stay onto Sylas while abusing your high damage ratios, allowing you to easily snowball and permanently shutdown Kassadin within all stages of the game. Make sure to put 3 points into your early wave clear and poke, then look to max W throughout the rest of your points. Once completed, max your E for additional mobility to help enable your up close stun abusing playstyle. Having more W’s against Zaahen is important to snowball within the mid stages of the game, as it gives you the side laning power needed to keep dominating. 

(10) Respect Zaahen R - Zaahen’s R is a giant power play of an ability, as if timed right he can completely negate your whole combo’s damage, crucial for own win condition of beating Renekton. Zaahen can negate 50% of your total damage within his cast time of R, allowing him to heal based on all the champions he hits. Typically whenever Zaahen is low, try to bait out his R before tower diving him, otherwise he will be able to survive your combo, as well as bait you into a death. Whenever Zaahen ults earlier within a fight, try to just bait that alone and disengage until he has no passive stacks. While Zaahen ulting early is a good thing, him being able to have longer time to stack his passive isn’t, so opting to disengage isn’t a bad idea if you want to ensure you have a statistically higher chance of winning a 1v1.

(11) Build Eclipse, Black Cleaver or BoTRK - Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Black Cleaver for additional CDR and other versatile stats for utility based gameplay. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build. 

(12) Mid Game + Teamfighting Tips - Zaahen is a very chaotic champion when it comes to fighting, he will try to use any skirmish or teamfight as a way to create win conditions, so playing away from that playstyle is within you and your team's best interest. Typically within this match up, putting Zaahen behind is a pretty easy feat, however by the mid game that’s where the challenge really relies. With the season 16 changes, Zaahen has the function of staying in side lane longer to help him scale a lot harder within the game, becoming more problematic within the mid game. To deal with Zaahen, try to always be first towards mid game objectives, try to initiate fights and remove the enemies' win conditions (Adcs or Mid laners), try to always make sure you’re using your lead you have gathered in the lane. Any complacency will always aid Zaahen in being able to comeback, so make sure you’re always using your lead 100% of the time to really put him behind and outscale Zaahen as the better teamfighter. If Zaahen does join a fight, try to stun him with your W max and nuke him before he’s able to get his passive.

(2) Negar Blobs Passivos - O poder de Zac vem de seus blobs W, que dão redução de HP, dano e W CD. Negar seus blobs fará com que ele perca muito poder consistente na rota e ele não será capaz de causar dano maior se não conseguir obter seus blobs.

(3) Respeite o combo Q E W de Zac - Este combo é essencialmente ele CC impedindo você de fazer Q'ing nos lacaios e em você mesmo, que é seguido por dano de E e W burst, impedindo você de fazer qualquer coisa. Evite ser atingido pelo Q dele e seja cauteloso ao usar seu E.

(4) Abusar do early game de Renekton - Neste confronto Renekton é essencialmente capaz de fazer o que quiser. Com isso dito, realmente aprimore seus pontos fortes iniciais até mid game para ajudá-lo a dominar e vencer o jogo. Jogue para negar ouro e XP ao seu inimigo, jogue até proxy e geralmente lidere qualquer lado superior skirmishes com sua vantagem insana na rota.

(5) Jogue waves de acordo - Basta avaliar se deseja ou não jogar por freeze, para ajudá-lo a negar XP e CS, ao mesmo tempo que apresenta mais oportunidades de criar lutas. Ou toque para empurrar waves para criar ângulos proxy, redefinir o tempo ou criar uma oportunidade dive. Renekton tem todas as cartas para fazer o que quiser com o gerenciamento de wave. Respeite também que se o seu laner tentar proxy, simplesmente proxy recue ou coordene uma matança nele com seu caçador.

(6) Ping Zac Roams - Zac realmente não realiza muito na fase de rotas (laning phase) vs Renekton, então ele se certificará de roam com seu E. Ping imediatamente assim que Zac estiver faltando, caso contrário ele será capaz de matar facilmente para sua equipe. 

(7) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. (8) Construa Eclipse, Black Cleaver ou BoTRK - Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Black Cleaver para CDR adicional e outras stats versáteis para jogabilidade baseada em utilitários. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano. 

(9) Dicas de meio de jogo e teamfighting - O papel de Zac no meio de jogo até late game é simplesmente jogar na névoa da guerra e tentar procurar combates em grandes equipes. videoTitle: Renekton Mid vs Zed - KR Master Patch 26.16
summaryEn: The Zed lane is pretty Renekton favoured, however Zed's ability to play safe and crafty, does make the match up a lot more harder the better a Zed player is. Playing against Zed completely relies on his shadows, if Zed uses W in any way to farm or apply damage, Renekton can abuse it's long CD to force an E trade, allowing him to burst out Zed and punish his overall positioning. In 1v1's Zed cannot really do anything to Renekton, making it practically unwinnable for him. Zed's main objective is simply trying to roam in search of a lead, make sure to ping Zed's whereabouts at all times, otherwise his kills will allow him to easily nuke any of your carries. In the later stages, Zed's role to play the game is a lot more difficult, allowing Renekton to have more ways to win. Make sure to always peel your teammates with your W ready, allowing you to instantly stun Zed and lock him out of the game.
summaryPt: A via Zed é bastante preferida por Renekton, no entanto, a habilidade de Zed de jogar com segurança e astúcia torna o confronto muito mais difícil quanto melhor for o jogador Zed. Jogar contra Zed depende completamente de suas sombras, se Zed usar W de alguma forma para farmar ou aplicar dano, Renekton pode abusar de seu longo CD para forçar uma troca E, permitindo-lhe burst sair de Zed e punir seu posicionamento geral. Em 1v1, Zed realmente não pode fazer nada para Renekton, tornando-o praticamente invencível para ele. O objetivo principal de Zed é simplesmente tentar roam em busca de uma pista, certifique-se de rastrear o paradeiro de Zed o tempo todo, caso contrário, suas mortes permitirão que ele destrua facilmente qualquer um de seus carregadores. Nas fases posteriores, o papel de Zed no jogo é muito mais difícil, permitindo que Renekton tenha mais maneiras de vencer. Certifique-se de sempre peel seus companheiros de equipe com seu W pronto, permitindo que você atordoe Zed instantaneamente e o bloqueie fora do jogo.
detailedNotesRawEn:
(1) Level 1 E Start - Try to cheese PTA proc or Conq with E1 > 3 auto's > disengage with E2.

(2) Play For Level 2/3 Kill Angle - Once you chunk out Zed you're most likely able to kill him with your W, Dash or Flash up. Look to shove the wave around your kill timer, so you're able to make Zed lose a lot more. 

(3) Avoid Tanking Zed Combo - Zed typically will W > E > Q to apply his damage, in which he will repetitively do it until you’re in his lethal range of 30% HP to easily finish off his kill. Try to abuse D Shield + Second wind to make his damage non existent, while also clicking around a lot to avoid his combo. 

(3) Abuse Long W Timer - Zed W is 20-17 seconds depending on if he hits E onto a target, use this to help you punish him every time his W is on cooldown as it’s the best timer to punish him. 

(4) Quick Trades - E > Q > AA  > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - These combos allow for Renekton to get quick damage off in being able to keep health up and whittling his opponent down, use these to get your laner low and look for a low HP kill with flash. 

(5) Ping Zed Roams - Zed can’t really achieve a lot in this lane, so his alternative plan to get ahead is simply trying to roam and pick up kills with his R. Always ping his movements if he is missing in the lane, try to abuse Zed by shoving in waves to make him miss out on gold and xp.

(6) Respect Zed R - Much later in the game Zed’s damage gets increasingly stronger through each R rank, it will also continue to do more damage based on how much he applies to his target. Try to avoid his Q combos within his ult to make him miss out on extra damage, make sure to also anticipate where Zed will go based off his R shadow position, this will then allow you to get the head start on your damage. 

(7) Abuse Renekton's R Powerspike - Once you reach level 6 your ultimate will essentially help you consistently stat check and dominate any match ups you were winning or losing. Make sure to always wait for your R CD to help you make plays, otherwise it will lead you towards a major disadvantage in dueling your enemies. 

(8) Build Plated Steelcap, Eclipse, Stridebreaker or BoTRK - Go Plated Steelcaps to lower Zed’s overall damage and utilise the additional movement speed. / Go Eclipse for consistent power through mid game and damage mitigation with the shield. / Go Stridebreaker to cripple Zed’s mobility and provide teammates with additional utility. / Go BoTRK to one shot and snowball with a damage focused build.

(9) Mid game + Teamfighting Tips - Zed’s role within the game is to look for isolated plays onto your squishy carry teammates. With that in mind try to protect your carries and instantly look for a W stun when Zed tries to engage. Zed is unable to do much if he is targeted by CC, so make sure to hard focus him and remove his team’s main hard source of damage. You should also look to abuse teamfights whenever Zed is split pushing and not grouped with his team.
detailedNotesRawPt:
(1) level 1 E Start - tente cheese PTA proc ou Conq com E1 > 3 auto's > disengage com E2.

(2) Jogue For level 2/3 ângulo de kill - Depois de cortar Zed, você provavelmente será capaz de matá-lo com seu W, Dash ou Flash para cima. Coloque o wave em torno do seu cronômetro de eliminação, para que você possa fazer com que Zed perca muito mais. 

(3) Evite Tanking Zed Combo - Zed normalmente usará W> E> Q para aplicar seu dano, no qual ele fará isso repetidamente até que você esteja em sua faixa letal de 30% de HP para finalizar facilmente sua morte. tente abusar de D Shield + Second Wind para tornar seu dano inexistente, ao mesmo tempo em que clica bastante para evitar seu combo. 

(3) Abuse do Long W Timer - Zed W dura de 20 a 17 segundos, dependendo se ele acertar E em um alvo, use isso para ajudá-lo a puni-lo toda vez que seu W estiver em espera, pois é o melhor cronômetro para puni-lo. 

(4) Trocas rápidas - E > Q > AA > W > AA > E Out / E > Q > W > E / E Q E - Esses combos permitem que Renekton obtenha dano rápido ao ser capaz de manter a saúde alta e reduzir seu oponente, use-os para diminuir seu laner e procure uma morte com HP baixo com Flash. 

(5) Ping Zed Roams - Zed não consegue realmente conseguir muito nesta lane, então seu plano alternativo para progredir é simplesmente tentar roam e matar com seu R. Sempre faça ping em seus movimentos se ele estiver perdido na lane, tente abusar de Zed empurrando waves para fazê-lo perder ouro e XP.

(6) Respeite Zed R - Muito mais tarde no jogo, o dano de Zed fica cada vez mais forte a cada classificação R, ele também continuará a causar mais dano com base em quanto ele aplica ao seu alvo. Tente evitar seus combos Q dentro de seu ult para fazê-lo perder dano extra, certifique-se também de antecipar para onde Zed irá com base em sua posição de sombra R, isso permitirá que você obtenha uma vantagem inicial em seu dano. 

(7) Abuse do R powerspike de Renekton - Depois de atingir level 6, seu ultimate irá essencialmente ajudá-lo a stat check de forma consistente e a dominar qualquer confronto que você esteja ganhando ou perdendo. Certifique-se de sempre esperar que seu R CD o ajude a fazer jogadas, caso contrário, isso o levará a uma grande desvantagem no duelo com seus inimigos. 

(8) Construir Plated Steelcap, Eclipse, Stridebreaker ou BoTRK - Vá Plated Steelcaps para diminuir o dano geral de Zed e utilize a velocidade de movimento adicional. / Vá Eclipse para poder consistente através de mid game e mitigação de danos com o escudo. / Vá Stridebreaker para prejudicar a mobilidade de Zed e fornecer utilidade adicional aos companheiros de equipe. / Vá BoTRK para one-shot e snowball com uma build focada em dano.

(9) Dicas de mid game + teamfighting - O papel de Zed dentro do jogo é procurar jogadas isoladas em seus companheiros de equipe que carregam moles. Com isso em mente, tente proteger seus carregadores e procure instantaneamente um atordoamento W quando Zed tentar engage. Zed é incapaz de fazer muito se for alvo de CC, então certifique-se de concentrá-lo e remover a principal fonte de dano de sua equipe. Você também deve abusar de teamfights sempre que Zed estiver em split push e não estiver agrupado com sua equipe.
